local local_class = newclass('NightmareFutureCastle2GladosRepairSection1')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = NightmareFutureCastle2GladosRepair @
		Comment = NightmareFutureCastle2GladosRepair 퀘스트/이벤트 섹션 @
		Index = 0 @
		NextSections = 1 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	-- 이벤트 존 이름
	self.glados_event_zone_name = 'glados_wellcome'

	-- 캐릭터를 가져오는 함수
	self.get_glados_head = controller.get_glados_head

	-- 오브젝트를 가져오는 함수
	self.get_lab_door = function(num) return get_field_object('lab_door_' .. num) end

	-- 마커를 가져오는 함수
	self.get_lab_first_room_center_marker = function() return field:GetMarker('lab_room_1_center') end

	self.progress = {
		none = 0,
		enter_glados_event_zone = 1,
		interact_glados = 2
	}
	self.current_progress = self.progress.none
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')

	local glados = self.get_glados_head()
	character_util.set_emotion(glados, { name = 'damaged' })
	character_util.add_listener(glados, self.controller)

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')

	local glados = self.get_glados_head()
	character_util.remove_relate_event(glados, self.controller)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		return self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then
			if self.current_progress < self.progress.enter_glados_event_zone and e.Zone.Name == self.glados_event_zone_name then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.enter_glados_event_zone, self))
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local glados = self.get_glados_head()

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, glados) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_glados, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end
--endregion

function local_class:enter_glados_event_zone()
	local glados = self.get_glados_head()

	self.current_progress = self.progress.enter_glados_event_zone

	-- 글라도스 (damaged, idle) : 앱버쳐 사이언스에 오신 걸 환영합니다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_worker_01', parent = glados, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(glados, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_glados_repair_1' })
end

-- 글라도스 인터랙션 시 조작 뺏는 이벤트
function local_class:interact_glados()
	local glados = self.get_glados_head()

	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(glados)

	party_util.align_to_target(glados, 'right', 1, 'arc')

	if self.current_progress < self.progress.interact_glados then
		-- 공주 emoticon_bubble_question
		character_util.show_emoticon_async(user_party.Leader, nil, 'question')

		-- 글라도스 (점프 1회) : 오, 드디어 다음 피험자로군요.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_01')
		character_util.normal_jump(glados, true)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(glados, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_glados_repair_2', skip = true })

		-- 글라도스 : 보시다시피 망가져 버린 제 몸을 수리하는 테스트를 진행하려고 합니다.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(glados, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_glados_repair_3', skip = true })

		-- 글라도스 : 웬 평균보다 뚱뚱한 피험자가 절 이렇게 만들었거든요.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(glados, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_glados_repair_4', skip = true })

		-- 글라도스 : 결국 그녀를 죽이지는 못했지만, 가 버려서 다행이에요.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(glados, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_glados_repair_5', skip = true })

		-- 글라도스 : 제가 정성껏 준비한 케이크를 선보이지 못한 건 아쉽지만 말이죠.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(glados, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_glados_repair_6', skip = true })

		-- 플레이어 선택지
		-- 나도 먹을래! (mercy) / 케이크가 상한 것 아냐? (brutal)
		local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({ { 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_glados_repair_6_1', 'mercy' }, { 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_glados_repair_6_2', 'brutal' } })

		if choose_result == 1 then
			-- 나도 먹을래! (mercy)
			-- 공주 (idle, idle) : 정성껏 만든 케이크라니… 나도 먹어 보고 싶은걸?
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(user_party.Leader, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_glados_repair_6_3', skip = true })

			-- 글라도스 : 테스트에 통과하신다면 케이크를 드리겠습니다.
			character_util.remove_emotion(user_party.Leader)
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(glados, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_glados_repair_7', skip = true })
		else
			-- 케이크가 상한 것 아냐? (brutal)
			-- 공주 (question) : 상한 케이크여서 그녀가 떠난 거 아닐까?
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
			character_util.set_emotion(user_party.Leader, { name = 'tired' })
			character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'question', loop = false })
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(user_party.Leader, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_glados_repair_7_1', skip = true })

			-- 글라도스 : 케이크의 신선도는 91.4%입니다.
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_01')
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader)
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(glados, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_glados_repair_8', skip = true })

			-- 글라도스 : 먹고 탈이 날 확률은 0.02% 뿐이죠.
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(glados, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_glados_repair_9', skip = true })
		end
	end

	self.current_progress = self.progress.interact_glados

	-- 글라도스 : 자, 그럼 실험에 참여하시겠어요?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(glados, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_glados_repair_10', skip = true })

	-- 플레이어 선택지
	-- 도와 준다. / 그냥 간다.
	choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({ { 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_glados_repair_10_2', 'mercy' }, { 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_glados_repair_10_1', 'brutal' } })

	if choose_result == 1 then
		-- 도와 준다.
		-- 공주 (nod 2회) : 그래, 한번 해볼게. 어떤 테스트인데?
		character_util.set_animation_n_times(user_party.Leader, { name = 'nod', count = 2 })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(user_party.Leader, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_glados_repair_11_1', skip = true })

		-- 글라도스 : 테스트 방법에 대해 안내드리겠습니다.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(glados, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_glados_repair_12', skip = true })

		-- 글라도스 : 직접 포탈을 생성할 수 있는 포탈건은 뚱뚱한 피험자가 가지고 사라져 버려, 사용 불가합니다.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(glados, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_glados_repair_13', skip = true })

		-- 글라도스 : 방에 있는 포탈 큐브 이용해 부품을
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(glados, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_glados_repair_14', skip = true })

		-- 글라도스 : 제 수리가 성공적으로 끝나면 케이크를 받게 될 것입니다.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_01')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(glados, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_glados_repair_15', skip = true })

		-- 글라도스, 합성기 안으로 점프해서 데굴데굴 들어감.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_iron_teatan_head_shake_01')
		character_util.move_waypoint_async(glados, glados.Position + vector(0, 0, 1.5), 4, false)
		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_jump_01')
		character_util.jump(glados, 0.5, 0.5)
		character_util.move_to_async(glados, glados.Position + vector(0, 0.7, 1), 0.5, nil, true, true)
		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		character_util.set_direction(glados, 'left')
		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_iron_teatan_head_shake_01')
		character_util.move_waypoint_async(glados, glados.Position + vector(-3, 0, 0), 4, false)

		-- 합성기 쪽 말풍선 : 자, 그럼 진행하시죠.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_01')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(glados, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_glados_repair_16', skip = true })

		-- 이후 방 좌측의 도어쪽으로 카메라 이동하고, 도어 full open
		local door = self.get_lab_door(1)
		camera_util.move_async(door.Position, 1)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create('lab_door_1', false))
		wait_for_sec(2)

		camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

		-- 이벤트 종료. 이후 첫 번째 부품 쪽으로 목적지 마커 표시
		yield_return_func(quest_util.progress_section, self.controller)
	else
		-- 그냥 간다.
		-- 공주 (tired, idle) : 미안, 다른 할일이 있어서…
		character_util.set_emotion(user_party.Leader, { name = 'tired' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(user_party.Leader, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_glados_repair_10_3', skip = true })

		-- 글라도스 : 당신이라면 통과할 수 있을 거라고 생각했는데 아쉽군요.
		character_util.remove_emotion(user_party.Leader)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(glados, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_glados_repair_11', skip = true })
	end
end

return local_class

local local_class = newclass('NightmareFutureCastle2GladosRepairSection2')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = NightmareFutureCastle2GladosRepair @
		Comment = NightmareFutureCastle2GladosRepair 퀘스트/이벤트 섹션 @
		Index = 1 @
		NextSections = 2 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	-- 이벤트 존 이름
	self.glados_ending_zone_name = 'glados_ending'
	self.glados_conveyor_belt_zone_name = 'glados_conveyor_belt'

	-- 그리드 이름
	self.lab_grid_name = controller.lab_grid_name

	-- 스타 피스를 가져오는 함수
	self.get_star_piece = controller.get_star_piece

	-- 퀘스트 마커 이름
	self.glados_gear_quest_marker_name = 'glados_gear'

	-- 캐릭터를 가져오는 함수
	self.get_glados = controller.get_glados
	self.get_glados_head = controller.get_glados_head
	self.get_machine = function() return get_field_object('repair_machine') end
	self.get_marian = function() return get_character('lab_marian') end

	-- 오브젝트를 가져오는 함수
	self.get_glados_gear = controller.get_glados_gear
	self.get_lab_door = function(num) return get_field_object('lab_door_' .. num) end
	self.get_portal_gimmick = function() return get_field_object('red_portal_1') end

	-- 이펙트를 가져오는 함수
	self.get_hit_effect = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit') end
	self.get_impact_hit_effect = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_lasthit') end
	self.get_star_piece_effect = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_starpiece_in_character') end
	self.get_missile_effect = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('Manual_AssaultRifle_TeatanHero_Missile_Enhance') end
	self.get_missile_explosion_effect = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_cwp_destruction_fire_explosion') end

	-- 마커를 가져오는 함수
	self.get_glados_conveyor_belt_marker = function(num) return field:GetMarker('glados_conveyor_belt_marker_' .. num) end

	-- 이펙트
	self.star_piece_effect = nil

	-- 획득한 부품의 갯수
	self.gear_count = 0

	-- 필요한 부품의 갯수
	self.need_gear_count = 3

	-- FieldObject Animator
	self.conveyor_belt_animator_list = {}
	self.machine_animator = nil

	-- sfx
	self.conveyor_belt_sfx = nil
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	self.get_hit_effect()
	self.get_impact_hit_effect()
	self.get_star_piece_effect()
	self.get_missile_effect()
	self.get_missile_explosion_effect()
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent), 'on_event')

	local glados_head = self.get_glados_head()
	glados_head.Position = vector(98, 0.7, 34.5)

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if self.controller.starting_inner_progress < 1 then
		self:show_quest_marker()
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent), 'on_event')

	self:hide_quest_marker()

	if self.star_piece_effect then
		self.star_piece_effect:Dispose()
		self.star_piece_effect = nil
	end

	for i = 1, #self.conveyor_belt_animator_list do
		self.conveyor_belt_animator_list[i] = nil
	end
	self.conveyor_belt_animator_list = nil

	if self.conveyor_belt_sfx then
		self.conveyor_belt_sfx:Stop()
		self.conveyor_belt_sfx = nil
	end

	self.machine_animator = nil
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		return self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent) then
		return self:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent) then
		return self:on_camera_grid_enter_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent) then
		return self:on_camera_grid_leave_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then
			if self.gear_count >= self.need_gear_count and e.Zone.Name == self.glados_ending_zone_name then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.ending, self))
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'glados_gear_get' then
		local gear_num = tonumber(e:GetParamAt(1))
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.glados_gear_get, self, gear_num))
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_enter_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) or lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party) then
		if e.CameraGrid.name == self.lab_grid_name then
			self:show_quest_marker()
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_leave_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) or lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party) then
		if e.CameraGrid.name == self.lab_grid_name then
			self:hide_quest_marker()
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end
--endregion

--region quest_marker
function local_class:show_quest_marker()
	if self.gear_count < self.need_gear_count then
		local gear = self.get_glados_gear(self.gear_count + 1)
		quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.glados_gear_quest_marker_name, gear)
	end
end

function local_class:hide_quest_marker()
	quest_marker_util.remove(self.glados_gear_quest_marker_name)
end
--endregion

--region gear_get
function local_class:freefall(fo, fall_time, offset_y)
	local falltime = fall_time
	local curpos = fo.Position
	local freefall = CS.CalculatorFreeFall(falltime, curpos.y, 2);
	offset_y = lua_helper.get_or_default(offset_y, 0)

	freefall:SetElasticity(0.4)

	local bound_num = freefall:NumBounced()
	while not freefall:IsDone() do
		if bound_num ~= freefall:NumBounced() then
			bound_num = freefall:NumBounced()
			curpos = vector_util.get_x0z(curpos)
		end

		local dist_y = freefall:GetDistance()
		local y = curpos.y + dist_y + offset_y

		fo.Position = vector(curpos.x, y, curpos.z)

		coroutine.yield()

		freefall:Proceed(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
	end
end

function local_class:glados_gear_get(gear_num)
	local gear = self.get_glados_gear(gear_num)

	-- 부품 떨어지는 연출
	local time_passed = 0
	local duration = 0.5
	local start_scale = unity_class.vector3.one
	local end_scale = unity_class.vector3.zero
	local start_position = gear.Position
	local offset = {
		vector(-0.3, 0, -0.3),
		vector(0, 0, 0.3),
		vector(0.3, 0, -0.3)
	}
	local end_position = gear.Position + offset[gear_num]

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fall_down_01')
	while time_passed < duration do
		local progress = time_passed / duration
		gear.Transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_scale, end_scale, progress)
		gear.Position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_position, end_position, progress)

		coroutine.yield()

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
	end

	gear.Transform.localScale = end_scale
	gear.Position = end_position

	-- 포탈 기믹을 사용중(CharacterControllerScreenplayState)일 경우, 끝날 때 까지 기다린다.
	yield_return_func(self.waiting_end_screenplay_state, self)

	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	local start_marker = self.get_glados_conveyor_belt_marker(1)

	gear.Transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one
	gear.Position = start_marker.position + vector(0, 0, -1 * (3 - gear_num))
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	if gear_num == 1 then
		yield_return_func(self.glados_gear_get_1, self)
	elseif gear_num == 2 then
		yield_return_func(self.glados_gear_get_2, self)
	elseif gear_num == 3 then
		yield_return_func(self.glados_gear_get_3, self)
	end
	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

	self.gear_count = self.gear_count + 1

	party_util.reset_controllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()
end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_quest_complete_a_01')

	-- 이후 붉게 표시된 지점의 도어 쪽으로 카메라 이동

-- 합성기 방 입장 시 조작 뺏는 이벤트
function local_class:ending()
	local glados_head = self.get_glados_head()
	local glados = self.get_glados()
	local marian = self.get_marian()
	local machine = self.get_machine()

	-- 포탈 기믹을 사용중(CharacterControllerScreenplayState)일 경우, 끝날 때 까지 기다린다.
	yield_return_func(self.waiting_end_screenplay_state, self)

	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	local portal_gimmick = self.get_portal_gimmick()
	message_system:SendSync(portal_gimmick, CS.Oak.GimmickResetEvent.Instance)

	quest_marker_util.remove(self.glados_gear_quest_marker_name)

	-- 파티, 합성기 아래쪽에 up 방향으로 정렬
	party_util.align_party(machine.Position + vector(1, 0, -0.5), 'down', 1, 'arc')

	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(function()
			-- 합성기 쪽 말풍선 : 환상적입니다. 평균 피험자보다 103초 정도 느렸지만요.
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_01')
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(glados_head, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_glados_repair_17', skip = true })

			-- 합성기 쪽 말풍선 : 이런 것을 통상 약간 모자라다고들 하죠.
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(glados_head, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_glados_repair_18', skip = true })
		end),
		util.cs_generator(function()
			-- 화면 바깥 컨베이어 벨트 위쪽에서 gear 아이템 3개가 연달아 합성기 안을 향해 이동 중.
			self.conveyor_belt_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_belt_01', loop = true, type_priority = 'loop', player_priority = 'object' })
			self:play_conveyor_belt_animation()

			local gear_1 = self.get_glados_gear(1)
			local gear_2 = self.get_glados_gear(2)
			local gear_3 = self.get_glados_gear(3)
			local marker_list = {
				self.get_glados_conveyor_belt_marker(2),
				self.get_glados_conveyor_belt_marker(3)
			}

			local gear_move_func = function(fo)
				character_util.move_to_async(fo, marker_list[1].position, nil, 2, false, false)
				character_util.move_to_async(fo, marker_list[2].position, nil, 2, false, false)
				fo.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
			end

			wait_all({
				util.cs_generator(gear_move_func, gear_1),
				util.cs_generator(gear_move_func, gear_2),
				util.cs_generator(gear_move_func, gear_3),
			})

			self:stop_conveyor_belt_animation()
			self.conveyor_belt_sfx:Stop()
			self.conveyor_belt_sfx = nil
		end)
	})

	-- 합성기가 빠르게 3번 내려 찍음.
	yield_return_func(self.play_machine_n_count, self, 3)

	-- 이후, 기계 안에서 victory_get 상태로 레일을 따라 나오는 완성된 글라도스
	character_util.set_active_state(glados_head, 'disabled')
	character_util.set_active_state(glados, 'enabled')
	character_util.set_direction(glados, 'left')
	character_util.set_locked_dir(glados, 'left')
	character_util.set_emotion(glados, { name = 'smile' })
	character_util.set_anim(glados, { name = 'get' })
	glados.Position = glados_head.Position

	character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'right')

	-- 완성된 글라도스에 FX_starpiece_in_character 이펙트 적용
	self.star_piece_effect = self.get_star_piece_effect():Instantiate(glados.Position, unity_class.quaternion.identity, glados.Transform)
	self:play_conveyor_belt_animation()

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(glados, glados.Position + vector(4.5, 0, 0), 2, false, nil, nil, 'left')
	character_util.set_locked_dir(glados, 'none')

	-- 컨베이어 벨트 애니메이션 멈춤
	self:stop_conveyor_belt_animation()

	-- 완성된 글라도스 (smile, victory_get) : 테스트를 성공적으로 마친 것을 축하드립니다.
	character_util.set_emotion(glados, { name = 'smile' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(glados, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_glados_repair_19', skip = true })

	-- 컨베이어 벨트에서 점프해서 내려오는 글라도스.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_01')
	character_util.remove_anim(glados)
	character_util.mario_jump_new(glados, 'left', 0.5, 0.5)
	character_util.move_to_async(glados, glados.Position + vector(0, -0.7, -1.5), 0.5, nil, false, false)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_land_01')

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	character_util.move_waypoint_async(glados, { vector_util.get_xy0(glados.Position, user_party.Leader.Position.z), user_party.Leader.Position + vector(2, 0, 0) }, 4, false, nil, 'left')

	-- 완성된 글라도스 : (smile, left 방향) 당신의 성공을 축하하기 위한 케이크를 준비하겠습니다.
	character_util.set_emotion(glados, { name = 'smile' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(glados, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_glados_repair_20', skip = true })

	-- 글라도스 줌 인 되면서, 주변 필드 까맣게 틴트.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_camera_emphasize_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_02')
	self.controller:lab_loop_sfx_fade_out(0)
	camera_util.resize_to(3, 0.5)
	field:Tint('glados', unity_color({ 0, 0, 0, 1 }), 0.5)

	character_util.set_emotion(glados, { name = 'mad' })
	character_util.set_anim(glados, { name = 'upgrade', loop = false })
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 공주, (scared, embarrassed)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(user_party.Leader, { name = 'scared' })
	character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'embarrassed' })

	-- 완성된 글라도스 : (mad, 캐릭터 shake, 약간 줌 인) 일단 당신을 구워내면, 케이크가 생길 테니까요.
	character_util.shake(glados, 0.04, 9999)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(glados, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_glados_repair_21', skip = true })

	-- 대사가 끝나고 shake 0.5초 유지하던 중 옆에서 마리안의 미사일이 날아옴. 줌 인 돌아옴.
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	local missile = self.get_missile_effect():Instantiate(glados.Position + vector(10, 0, 0), unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, -90, 0), nil)
	local time_passed = 0
	local duration = 0.5
	local start_position = missile.transform.position
	local end_position = glados.Position

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_push_rock_unit_02')
	while time_passed < duration do
		local progress = time_passed / duration
		local position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_position, end_position, progress)

		missile.transform.position = position

		coroutine.yield()

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
	end

	missile:Dispose()

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_chasing', state = 'event' })
	camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.5)
	field:RemoveTint('glados', 0.5)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_stomp_robot_01')
	self.get_missile_explosion_effect():Instantiate(glados.Position)
	self.star_piece_effect:Dispose()
	self.star_piece_effect = nil

	-- 글라도스, 포격을 맞고 머리만 남게 됨 (broken_worker_a_head로 변경)
	character_util.stop_shake(glados)
	character_util.set_active_state(glados, 'disabled')
	character_util.set_active_state(glados_head, 'enabled')

	-- 글라도스 머리, confused 상태
	self.star_piece_effect = self.get_star_piece_effect():Instantiate(glados_head.Position, unity_class.quaternion.identity, glados_head.Transform)
	glados_head.Position = glados.Position
	character_util.set_direction(glados_head, 'left')
	character_util.set_emotion(glados_head, { name = 'confused' })

	-- 머리가 허공에 한바퀴 회전
	character_util.set_emotion(user_party.Leader, { name = 'surprise' })
	character_util.remove_anim(user_party.Leader)
	character_util.set_anim(glados_head, { name = 'walk' })
	character_util.spine_rotate(glados_head, 360, 1.5)

	local freefall = CS.CalculatorFreeFall(16, 34, 0, 2)
	local freefall_position = glados_head.Position
	local bounce_num = 0
	while not freefall:IsDone() do
		local dist_y = freefall:GetDistance()

		freefall_position.y = dist_y
		character_util.set_position(glados_head, freefall_position, true)

		if bounce_num ~= freefall:NumBounced() then
			bounce_num = freefall:NumBounced()
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_projectile_01')
		end

		coroutine.yield()

		freefall:Proceed(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
	end
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_projectile_01')
	character_util.set_anim(glados_head, { name = 'walk', scale = 0 })
	character_util.set_position(glados_head, vector_util.get_x0z(freefall_position), false)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 부들부들 떨다가, 살짝 낮게 점프. (깨어난 느낌이 들게 연출)
	for i = 1, 2 do
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_rustle_01')
		character_util.shake(glados_head, 0.02, 0.5)
		wait_for_sec(1)
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_popup_01')
	character_util.remove_anim(glados_head)
	character_util.jump(glados_head, 0.25, 0.3)
	wait_for_sec(0.3)
	character_util.remove_emotion(glados_head)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 이후 mad 이모션으로 변경.
	camera_util.resize_to_default(0.5)
	character_util.set_direction(glados_head, 'right')
	character_util.set_emotion(glados_head, { name = 'mad' })

	-- 입구쪽에서 마리안이 달려옴.
	character_util.set_active_state(marian, 'enabled')
	marian.Position = glados_head.Position + vector(10, 0, 0)
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(marian, glados_head.Position + vector(3, 0, 0), 7, true)

	-- 달려온 마리안 : 저 정신나간 로봇 누가 또 고쳤어?!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	character_util.remove_emotion(user_party.Leader)
	character_util.set_emotion(marian, { name = 'mad' })
	character_util.normal_double_jump(marian, true)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(marian, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_glados_repair_22', skip = true })

	-- 머리만 남은 글라도스 : (마리안에게) 혹시 어렸을 때 이런 말 자주 듣지 않았나요?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(glados_head, { name = 'doyagao' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(glados_head, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_glados_repair_23', skip = true })

	-- 머리만 남은 글라도스 : (mad) 난 당신이 정말, 정말 싫어요.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fade_out_03')
	character_util.set_emotion(glados_head, { name = 'mad' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(glados_head, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_glados_repair_24', skip = true })

	-- 마리안 (attack, gauntlet_kick2) : 입 다물어, 이 또라이야!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(marian, { name = 'attack' })
	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(function()
			character_util.move_waypoint_async(marian, glados_head.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0), 7, true)
			character_util.set_animation_n_times(marian, { name = 'gauntlet_kick2' })
			wait_for_sec(0.2)

			-- 글라도스 머리, airspin으로 화면 밖으로 날아감.
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_light_04')
			self.get_hit_effect():Instantiate(glados_head.Position)
			self.get_impact_hit_effect():Instantiate(glados_head.Position)
			character_util.air_spin(glados_head, { offset = vector(-12, 6, 0) })

			-- 글라도스 머리의 FX_starpiece_in_character 이펙트 제거되며, 스타피스 드랍.
			self.star_piece_effect:Dispose()
			self.star_piece_effect = nil

			local star_piece = self.get_star_piece()
			star_piece_util.appear(star_piece, glados_head.Position)
		end),
		util.cs_generator(speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async, marian, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_glados_repair_25', skip = true, bubble_type = 'shout' })
	})

	-- 공주 쪽으로 다가오는 마리안.
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(marian, user_party.Leader.Position + vector(1.5, 0, 0), 4, false)

	-- 마리안 : (공주에게 attack, releasex2) 안드로이드 중에 스스로한테  '비디오 게임 최고의 악당' 패치를 한 녀석이 있었지 뭐야.
	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(character_util.set_animation_n_times, marian, { name = 'release', count = 2, sfx = '01_swing_01' }),
		util.cs_generator(speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async, marian, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_glados_repair_26', skip = true })
	})

	-- 마리안 : (tired) 허튼 짓 못하게 코어를 뜯어냈는데, 가끔 저렇게 사람들을 꾀어서 수리를 시키더라고.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(marian, { name = 'tired' })
	character_util.set_anim(marian, { name = 'question', loop = false })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(marian, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_glados_repair_27', skip = true })

	-- 마리안 : (왼쪽, 오른쪽 두리번) 이런 실험실은 어제 또 만든 거야…?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(marian)
	character_util.set_direction(marian, 'left')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_direction(marian, 'right')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(marian, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_glados_repair_28', skip = true })

	-- 마리안 : (tired, bomb_idle) 안드로이드들한테 얘기해서 철거해 놔야지…
	character_util.set_emotion(marian, { name = 'tired' })
	character_util.set_anim(marian, { name = 'bomb_idle' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(marian, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_glados_repair_29', skip = true })

	-- 이후 마리안 이모션 리셋.
	-- 방 밖으로 떠나가는 마리안
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(marian)
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(marian, marian.Position + vector(10, 0, 0), 4, false)
	character_util.set_active_state(marian, 'disabled')

	-- 이벤트 종료.
	-- 퀘스트 클리어 처리
	yield_return_func(quest_util.complete_quest, self.controller, 0, false, false, false)

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })
	self.controller:lab_loop_sfx_play()

	party_util.reset_controllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()
end

function local_class:play_conveyor_belt_animation()
	if #self.conveyor_belt_animator_list == 0 then
		self:caching_conveyor_belt_animator()
	end

	for i = 1, #self.conveyor_belt_animator_list do
		local belt_animator = self.conveyor_belt_animator_list[i]
		belt_animator:Play('xmas_belt_rolling')
		belt_animator.speed = 3
	end
end

function local_class:stop_conveyor_belt_animation()
	if #self.conveyor_belt_animator_list == 0 then
		self:caching_conveyor_belt_animator()
	end

	for i = 1, #self.conveyor_belt_animator_list do
		local belt_animator = self.conveyor_belt_animator_list[i]
		belt_animator.speed = 0
	end
end

function local_class:play_machine_n_count(count)
	if not self.machine_animator then
		local machine = self.get_machine()
		self.machine_animator = machine.Transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_iron_teatan_prepare_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_die_robot_01')
	self.machine_animator.enabled = true
	self.machine_animator:Play('idle')
	self.machine_animator.speed = 3
	coroutine.yield()

	while self.machine_animator:GetCurrentAnimatorStateInfo(0).normalizedTime < count do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	self.machine_animator:Play('idle', -1, 0)
	coroutine.yield()
	self.machine_animator.enabled = false
end

function local_class:caching_conveyor_belt_animator()
	local conveyor_belt_zone = field:GetZone(self.glados_conveyor_belt_zone_name)
	local fo_list = CS.Oak.LuaCollisionUtil.GetFieldObjectsCollidedBy(unity_class.vector3.zero, conveyor_belt_zone.Bounds)

	-- 컨베이어 벨트 애니메이션 재생
	for i = 0, fo_list.Count - 1 do
		local fo = fo_list[i]

		if string.sub(fo.Name, 1, 13) == '[gimmick]belt' then
			local belt_animator = fo:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))
			table.insert(self.conveyor_belt_animator_list, belt_animator)
		end
	end
	fo_list:Dispose()
end

function local_class:waiting_end_screenplay_state()
	-- CharacterControllerScreenplayState가 끝날 때 까지 기다린다.
	while lua_helper.type_compare(user_party.Leader.FieldObjectController.CurrentState, CS.Oak.CharacterControllerScreenplayState) do
		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

return local_class

	local guardian_wolf = self.controller.get_guardian_wolf()

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_growl_wolf_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc', parent = guardian_wolf })
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_runaway_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc', parent = resistances[1] })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(resistances[1], { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_guardian_wolf_1' })

	-- 지, 진정 좀 해…
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_sadness_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc', parent = resistances[2] })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(resistances[2], { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_guardian_wolf_2' })

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_dark_wolf_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc', parent = guardian_wolf })
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(guardian_wolf, { name = 'pounce', count = 1, keep_anim = false })
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_player_jump_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc', parent = resistances[1] })
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_runaway_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc', parent = resistances[1] })
	character_util.set_group_anim(resistances, { name = 'embarrassed' })
	character_util.jump(resistances, 0.5, 0.3)
	self.is_resistances_shaking = false
	wait_for_sec(1)
	character_util.remove_group_anim(resistances)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_runaway_02', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc', parent = resistances[1] })
	local sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_dash_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc', parent = resistances[1], loop = true })
	character_util.move_group_distance_async(resistances, vector(-6, 0, 0), nil, 7, true, true)
	character_util.move_group_distance_async(resistances, vector(0, 0, 3), nil, 7, true, true)
	character_util.set_direction(resistances[1], 'right')
	character_util.set_direction(resistances[2], 'right')
	sfx:FadeOut()

	for i = 1, 2 do
		local resistance = resistances[i]
		resistance.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable.Create()
		resistance.Interactable.Talk = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_guardian_wolf_' .. (i + 3)

function local_class:talk_to_guardian_wolf()
	local guardian_wolf = self.controller.get_guardian_wolf()
	local leader = user_party.Leader
	local wolf_move_marker = self.controller.get_wolf_move_marker()

	leader:HideWeapon(true)

	-- 흰둥아, 표정이 왜 그래… 누가 괴롭혔어?
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_wolf_boss_breath_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
	party_util.align_party(guardian_wolf.Position + vector(-2, 0, -0.15), 'left', 1)
	character_util.set_emotion(leader, { name = 'tired' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(leader, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_guardian_wolf_6', skip = true })

	character_util.move_distance_async(leader, vector(1, 0, 0), nil, 2, true, true)
	character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'shoot', loop = true, scale = 0.45 })
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(leader, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_guardian_wolf_7', skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim(leader)
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_pet_ordinary_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
	character_util.set_anim(guardian_wolf, { name = 'pat', loop = true })
	wait_for_sec(2)

	character_util.set_anim(guardian_wolf, { name = 'walk2', loop = true })
	character_util.move_distance_async(guardian_wolf, vector(2, 0, 0), nil, 2, true, false)
	character_util.set_direction(guardian_wolf, 'left')
	character_util.set_anim(guardian_wolf, { name = 'pat', loop = true })
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_bad_fairy_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(guardian_wolf.Position + vector(-1.25, 0, 2.25), nil, 'heart')

	-- 따라오라고?
	character_util.remove_emotion(leader)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(leader, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_guardian_wolf_8', skip = true })

	character_util.set_anim(guardian_wolf, { name = 'walk2', loop = true })
	character_util.move_waypoint(guardian_wolf, wolf_move_marker.position, 2.5, false, 'stop', 'floor')

	while true do
		if not screen_util.is_fo_in_screen(guardian_wolf.Position) then
			break
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	character_util.show_emoticon_async(leader, nil, 'question')

	character_util.stop(guardian_wolf)
	character_util.remove_anim(guardian_wolf)
	leader:HideWeapon(false)

	yield_return_func(quest_util.progress_section, self.controller)
end

function local_class:shake_resistances()
	local resistances = self.controller.resistances

	while self.is_resistances_shaking do
		character_util.shake(resistances[1], 0.03, 0.3)
		character_util.shake(resistances[2], 0.03, 0.3)
		wait_for_sec(0.3)
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

return local_class

function local_class:habal_event_begin()
	local leader = user_party.Leader
	local halbal = self.halbal
	local akayuki = self.akayuki
	local audiences = self.audiences
	local cam_target_pos = halbal.Position + vector(0, 0, -0.5)

	camera_util.move_async(cam_target_pos, 1)

	-- …그리고 땅이 마구마구 흔들리며 꺼지더니!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(halbal, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_halbal_akayuki_1', skip = true })

	-- 드디어 모습을 드러낸 거야! 거대한 용이 된 그 모습을!
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_ready_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(halbal, { name = 'release', count = 2, sfx = '01_swing_01' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(halbal, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_halbal_akayuki_2', skip = true })

	-- 아직 대사가 진행 중이면 계속 주먹질 하게 변경 (읏챠! 헛챠! 할 때 애니메이션 연출이 먼저 끝나면 어색해 보임)
	local talking = true
	character_util.set_direction(halbal, 'left')
	local routine = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
		character_util.set_anim(halbal, { name = 'attack', loop = true })
		while talking do
			character_util.set_direction(halbal, direction_util.to_str(direction_util.get_opposite(halbal.Direction)))
			for i = 1, 2 do
				wait_for_sec(0.2)
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
				wait_for_sec(0.3)
			end
		end
		character_util.remove_anim(halbal)
	end))

	-- 불을 뿜는 그 거대한 입을 노리고! 읏챠! 헛챠!
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_boss_sapa_shout_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(halbal, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_halbal_akayuki_3', skip = true })
	talking = false
	coroutine_util.wait_coroutines({ routine })

	-- 그렇게 이 아저씨가 암흑 마법사를 무찌른 거란다
	character_util.set_direction(halbal, 'down')
	character_util.set_anim(halbal, { name = 'cross_arm', loop = true })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(halbal, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_halbal_akayuki_4', skip = true })

	character_util.set_direction(audiences.kids[1], 'right')
	character_util.set_direction(audiences.kids[2], 'left')

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_clap_02', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
	character_util.set_group_anim_and_emotion(audiences.kids, { name = 'clap', loop = true }, { name = 'smile' })

	-- 우와…! 진짜 멋지다…!
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_positive_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(audiences.kids[1],
			{ key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_halbal_akayuki_5', skip = true,
			  world_pos = (audiences.kids[1].Position + audiences.kids[2].Position) / 2 + vector(-1, 0, 0) })

	character_util.set_active_state(akayuki, 'enabled')
	character_util.set_position(akayuki, halbal.Position)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_musarame_hit_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_musarame_ready_01')
	character_util.set_anim(akayuki, { name = 'katana_batto', loop = false, scale = 999 })
	character_util.set_emotion(akayuki, { name = 'sleep_deep' })

	local scale_offset = 1.5
	local slash_term = 0.08
	local radius = 1

	local origin_pos = halbal.Position

	self.get_fx_akaoni_trans():Instantiate(origin_pos)

	camera_util.shake(0.3, slash_term * 0.75)

	character_util.remove_group_anim(audiences.kids)

	character_util.normal_jump(leader, true)
	character_util.set_emotion(leader, { name = 'surprise' })

	for k, _ in pairs(audiences) do
		for i = 1, table_util.get_size(audiences[k]) do
			local audience = audiences[k][i]
			character_util.normal_jump(audience)
			character_util.set_emotion(audience, { name = 'surprise' })
		end
	end

	local duration = slash_term * 6
	local speed = radius * 0.9 * scale_offset / duration

	local dif = vector(4, 0, 1)
	local angle_vector = unity_class.quaternion.LookRotation(dif) * unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, -90, 0)

	local init_pos = origin_pos + radius * scale_offset * dif

	local rand_fx_index = random_util.get_random_int(1, 3)

	local clone = self.get_fx_akaoni_clone(rand_fx_index):Instantiate(init_pos)
	local shadow = self.get_fx_akaoni_shadow(rand_fx_index):Instantiate(init_pos)

	self.get_fx_akaoni_slashline():Instantiate(init_pos, angle_vector, nil)

	local time_passed = 0

	while time_passed < duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local progress = CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutExpo(unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration), 0, 1, 1)
		local progress_pos = origin_pos + progress * duration * dif * speed

		character_util.set_locked_dir(halbal, 'left')
		character_util.set_emotion(halbal, { name = 'confused' })
		character_util.set_position(halbal, vector(progress_pos.x, 0, halbal.Position.z))

		clone.transform.position = progress_pos
		shadow.transform.position = progress_pos
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_trip_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
	character_util.set_locked_dir(halbal, 'none')
	character_util.set_direction(halbal, 'left')
	character_util.set_anim(halbal, { name = 'prostrate' })

	character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(akayuki, { name = 'katana_batto_end', count = 1 })

	-- 오~ 너도 드래곤이 된 암흑 마법사를 물리쳤다고?
	character_util.set_emotion(akayuki, { name = 'smile' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(akayuki, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_halbal_akayuki_6', skip = true })

	character_util.remove_anim(halbal)
	character_util.set_emotion(halbal, { name = 'surprise' })
	character_util.normal_jump(halbal, true)
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	-- 저, 전설 속의… 아카유키 님…?!
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_negative_02', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(halbal, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_halbal_akayuki_7', skip = true })

	character_util.remove_emotion(leader)

	for k, _ in pairs(audiences) do
		for i = 1, table_util.get_size(audiences[k]) do
			local audience = audiences[k][i]
			character_util.remove_emotion(audience)
		end
	end

	-- 요즘 용사들은 참 유망주가 많나 봐?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(akayuki, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_halbal_akayuki_8', skip = true })

	-- 내 기억에 암흑 마법사를 물리친 녀석은 분명 대적할 만한 녀석이었는데 말이야…
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(akayuki, { name = 'release', count = 2, sfx = '01_swing_01' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(akayuki, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_halbal_akayuki_9', skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim(akayuki)

	-- 어때, 대련 한 번?
	camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.3)
	character_util.set_anim(akayuki, { name = 'katana_batto_ready_loop', loop = true })
	character_util.set_emotion(akayuki, { name = 'greed' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_emphasize_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_gatcha_point_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(akayuki, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_halbal_akayuki_10', skip = true })

	-- 아… 하하… 오늘은 제가 컨디션 조금 안좋아서…
	character_util.set_anim(halbal, { name = 'sing', loop = true })
	character_util.set_emotion(halbal, { name = 'smile' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_tipsy_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(halbal, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_halbal_akayuki_11', skip = true })

	character_util.set_anim(akayuki, { name = 'cross_arm', loop = true })
	character_util.set_emotion(akayuki, { name = 'attack' })

	-- 그럼 이만…!
	character_util.set_group_emotion(audiences.kids, { name = 'tired' })
	character_util.set_anim(halbal, { name = 'embarrassed', loop = true })
	character_util.set_emotion(halbal, { name = 'scared' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_runaway_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(halbal, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_halbal_akayuki_12', skip = true })

	character_util.remove_anim(halbal)
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_runaway_02', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	local waypoints = {
		vector(halbal.Position.x, 0, self.flee_points[1].z),
		self.center_marker_pos,
		self.center_marker_pos + vector(0, 0, -4)
	}
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(halbal, waypoints, 8, true, 'stop', 'floor')

	character_util.remove_emotion(halbal)
	character_util.set_active_state(halbal, 'disabled')

	wait_for_sec(1)

	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	yield_return_func(quest_util.complete_quest, self.controller, 0, false, false, false)
end

return local_class

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.interact_with_loraine_flower, self))

		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_with_loraine, self)
		return true
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if not e.FullEnter or not lua_helper.reference_equals(user_party.Leader, e.FieldObject) then return false end

	if e.Zone.Name == 'loraine_on_sight' then
		self:play_construction_sfx()

		if self.did_enter_loraine_on_sight_zone == false then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.entered_loraine_on_sight_zone, self))
		end

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if not e.FullLeave or not lua_helper.reference_equals(user_party.Leader, e.FieldObject) then return false end

	if e.Zone.Name == 'loraine_on_sight' then
		self:stop_construction_sfx()

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:play_construction_sfx()
	self.construction_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_event_dw_10', loop = true, fade_in_time = 1 })
end

function local_class:stop_construction_sfx()
	if self.construction_sfx ~= nil then
		self.construction_sfx:FadeOut(1)
	end
end

function local_class:interact_with_loraine()
	self.interacted = true
	local loraine = self.get_loraine()
	local princess = user_party.Leader

	party_util.align_to_target(loraine, 'right', 1, 'arc')

	-- 로레인: 아, 공주님이네요.
	character_util.set_direction(loraine, 'right')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(loraine, { key = self.script_key .. 2, skip = true })

	-- 로레인: {0}님이 돌아갔다고 또 어디서 징징대고 있었던 건 아니죠?
	local script_to_play = game_string:Format(self.script_key .. 3, user.Name)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(loraine, { key = script_to_play, skip = true })

	-- 미래공주: 걱정해줘서 고마워, 로레인.
	character_util.set_emotion(princess, { name = 'smile' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, { key = self.script_key .. 4, skip = true })

	-- 로레인: 걱정은 무슨, 제가 공주님 걱정할 시간이 어디 있어요?
	character_util.remove_emotion(princess)
	character_util.set_anim(loraine, { name = 'cross_arm', loop = true })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(loraine, { key = self.script_key .. 5, skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim(loraine)

	-- 로레인: 놀고 있는 안드로이드 없게 관리하는 것만으로도 충분히 바쁘다고요?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(loraine, { key = self.script_key .. 6, skip = true })

	-- 로레인: 일 없으면 가 보세요. 잔해들이 아직 널브러져 있으니까 조심하고요.
	character_util.set_anim(loraine, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(loraine, { key = self.script_key .. 7, skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim(loraine)

	-- 미래공주: 고마워.
	character_util.nod_twice(princess)
	character_util.set_emotion(princess, { name = 'smile' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, { key = self.script_key .. 8, skip = true })
	character_util.remove_emotion(princess)

	character_util.set_direction(loraine, 'left')

	character_util.remove_relate_event(loraine, self.controller)

	yield_return_func(quest_util.complete_quest, self.controller, 0, false, false, false)
end

function local_class:interact_with_loraine_flower()
	self.interacted = true

	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	field_ui_util.show_narration_async(		{ key = self.script_key .. 'narration' })

	party_util.reset_controllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()

	yield_return_func(quest_util.complete_quest, self.controller, 1, false, false, false)
end

function local_class:entered_loraine_on_sight_zone()
	self.did_enter_loraine_on_sight_zone = true

	local trio_quest = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(204)
	local clear_trio_quest = trio_quest ~= nil and trio_quest.IsComplete

	if clear_trio_quest then
		quest_util.set_custom_state(self.controller.quest_progress, 'seen_loraine_alive', 1)

	else
		quest_util.set_custom_state(self.controller.quest_progress, 'seen_loraine_alive', 2)
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

return local_class

function local_class:enter()

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_custom_stage_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent), 'on_camera_grid_enter_event')

	self.mouse_head.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.zero

function local_class:exit()

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MoveFieldObjectEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent))

	if self.touch_handler then
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self.touch_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
		self.touch_handler = nil
	end

	local soldier_1 = self.get_soldier(1)
	character_util.remove_relate_event(soldier_1, self.controller)

	local smile_doll = self.get_smile_doll()
	character_util.remove_relate_event(smile_doll, self.controller)

	if self.mouse_head then
		self.mouse_head:ConsumeComplete()
		self.mouse_head = nil
	end

	if self.room_quest_item then
		self.room_quest_item:ConsumeComplete()
		self.room_quest_item = nil
	end

	for i = 1, #self.passage_garbage_item do

			self.passage_garbage_item[i].item = nil
		end
	end
	self.passage_garbage_item = nil

	if self.background_effect then
		self.background_effect:Dispose()
		self.head_darkness_effect = nil
	end

	if self.head_darkness_effect then
		self.head_darkness_effect:Dispose()
		self.head_darkness_effect = nil
	end
