	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--- OnEvent
function local_class:on_event(e)
	local soldier_1 = self.get_soldier(1)
	if type_util.is_interacted_target(e, soldier_1) then

		-- 처음 병사와 대화
		if self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.starting_event then

			self.current_progress = self.current_progress + 1

			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.talk_with_soldier, self)

			return true
		end

		-- 장난감 방에서 아이템 획득 후 병사와 대화
		if self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.finding_soldier_item then

			self.current_progress = self.current_progress + 1

			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.talk_with_soldier_2, self)

			return true
		end
	end

	-- 웃는 인형에 상호작용 시
	local smile_doll = self.get_smile_doll()
	if type_util.is_interacted_target(e, smile_doll) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_smile_doll, self, smile_doll)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

--- ZoneEnterEvent
function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	-- 처음에 병사들이 얘기하는 이벤트
	if self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.none and
		type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 'moving_tree_starting') then

		self.current_progress = self.current_progress + 1

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.start_event, self))

		return true
	end

	-- 웃는 인형이 말하는 이벤트
	if self.show_smile_doll_interact_event and not self.show_smile_doll_event and
		type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 'moving_tree_smile_doll_speech') then

		self.show_smile_doll_event = true

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
			local smile_doll = self.get_smile_doll()
			-- 싫음 말고.
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(smile_doll,
				{ key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_moving_tree_24', bubble_direction = 'rb' })

			self.stop_room_speech_routine = false
		end))

		return true
	end

	-- 쥐 인형의 목이 떨어지는 이벤트
	if not self.show_mouse_doll_event and
		type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 'moving_tree_mouse_doll_anim') then

		self.show_mouse_doll_event = true

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.fall_down_mouse_head, self))

		return true
	end

	-- 추격 이벤트 직전
	if self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.talking_with_soldier_2 and
		type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 'moving_tree_start_chasing') then

		self.current_progress = self.current_progress + 1

		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.ready_chasing, self)

	end

	return false
end

--- InteractEvent
function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	-- 장난감 방의 퀘스트 아이템 획득 이벤트
	local room_table_f = self.get_room_table_f()
	if  type_util.is_interacted_target(e, room_table_f) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_table_f, self, room_table_f)
		return true
	end

	-- 장난감 방 안에 아오바 상호작용 했을 때
	local leaf_fairy_tree = self.get_leaf_fairy_tree()
	if type_util.is_interacted_target(e, leaf_fairy_tree) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(function()
			leaf_fairy_tree.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

			-- 형체만 알아볼 수 있는 트리다.
			field_ui_util.show_narration_async(
				{ key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_moving_tree_66', mintotalduration = 1 })

			leaf_fairy_tree.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
		end)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

--- MoveFieldObjectEvent
function local_class:on_move_field_object_event(e)
	local leader = user_party.Leader

	if self.is_chasing and self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.entered_curse_passage and
		lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, leader) then

		-- 플레이어가 움직였을 때 통로의 쓰레기와 충돌했는지 체크하여 충돌 이벤트 발생
		for i = 1, #self.passage_garbage_item do
			local garbage = self.passage_garbage_item[i].item

			-- 쓰레기 및 플레이어 충돌 범위
			local leader_extents = vector(0.3, 0, 0.3)
			local garbage_extents = vector(0.3, 0, 0.3)

			-- 쓰레기가 존재할 때만 충돌
			if self.passage_garbage_item[i].is_active and
				not (math.abs(self:get_overlapped_xz_area(user_party.Leader.Position, garbage.Position,
					leader_extents, garbage_extents)) < constants.epsilon) then

				if lua_helper.type_compare(
					leader.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentActionState, typeof(CS.Oak.CharacterHoldUpState)) then

					character_util.release_hold_object(leader, leader.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentActionState.HoldTarget)
				end

				self.get_hit_effect():Instantiate(leader.Position + vector(0, 0.2, -0.2))
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_snowball_hit_01')

				-- 플레이어 표정 변경 및 리셋
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
					character_util.set_emotion(leader, { name = 'damaged' })
					character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'damaged' })
					wait_for_sec(0.2)

					character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
				end))

				-- 플레이어 넉백 방향
				local dir = vector_util.to_direction(leader.Position - garbage.Position)
				local player_knock_back_dir = direction_util.to_vector3(dir)

				-- 플레이어 넉백
				local knock_back_info = character_util.knockback_info(
					'linear', true, player_knock_back_dir, nil, nil,
					nil, true, nil, CS.Oak.Constants.WallBounceTime,
					CS.Oak.Constants.WallBounceDistance)

				command_util.publish_knock_back(leader.Owner, leader, knock_back_info, leader.Position)

				garbage.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
				self.passage_garbage_item[i].is_active = false
			end
		end

		return true
	end

	return false
end

--- CustomStageEvent
function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	if e.Params[0] == 'lorain_head_out' then
		self.broken_worker_a_head_out = true

		if self.is_chasing then
			local broken_worker_a_head = self.get_broken_worker_a_head()
			speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(broken_worker_a_head)
		end
		return true
	end

	if e.Params[0] == 'lorain_head_in' then
		self.broken_worker_a_head_out = false

		if self.is_chasing then
			local broken_worker_a_head = self.get_broken_worker_a_head()
			command_util.execute_burn(user_party.Leader, broken_worker_a_head, true)
		end
		return true
	end

	return false
end

--- CameraGridEnterEvent
function local_class:on_camera_grid_enter_event(e)
	-- 이벤트 마지막 그리드에 들어갔을 때
	if self.is_chasing and type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, 'moving_tree_ending_grid') then
		self.is_chasing = false

		party_util.stop_and_disable_control()
		field_ui_manager:Hide()

		return true
	end

	-- 장난감 방에 들어갔을 때
	if type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, self.controller.room_grid_name) then
		if not self.is_playing_room_speech_routine then

			self.is_playing_room_speech_routine = true

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
				util.cs_generator(self.speech_smile_doll_routine, self))
		end

		self.stop_room_speech_routine = false

		return true
	end

	return false
end

--- CameraGridLeaveEvent
function local_class:on_camera_grid_leave_event(e)
	if type_util.is_player_leave_to_cam_grid(e, self.controller.room_grid_name) then
		self.stop_room_speech_routine = true
		return true
	end

	return false
end

--- 이벤트 시작
function local_class:start_event()
	local soldier_1 = self.get_soldier(1)
	local soldier_2 = self.get_soldier(2)
	local soldier_3 = self.get_soldier(3)

	character_util.set_emotion(soldier_2, { name = 'smile' })
	character_util.set_anim(soldier_2, { name = 'cast' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_tipsy_01', parent = soldier_2, max_distance = 9 })
	-- 풉, 그게 말이 돼?!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(soldier_2, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_moving_tree_1' })

	if self.current_progress > self.progress_enum.starting_event then
		return
	end

	character_util.set_emotion(soldier_3, { name = 'awesome' })
	character_util.set_anim(soldier_3, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_ghost_laugh_evil_01', parent = soldier_3, max_distance = 9 })
	-- 그러니까! 완전 겁쟁이잖아!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(soldier_3, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_moving_tree_2' })

	character_util.remove_anim(soldier_3)

	if self.current_progress > self.progress_enum.starting_event then
		return
	end

	character_util.set_emotion(soldier_1, { name = 'scared' })
	character_util.set_anim(soldier_1, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_negative_02', parent = soldier_1, max_distance = 9 })
	-- 아니… 진짜라니까! 너희가 들어가보던가!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(soldier_1, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_moving_tree_3' })

	character_util.remove_anim(soldier_1)

	if self.current_progress > self.progress_enum.starting_event then
		return
	end

	self:end_talking_soldier_setting()
end

--- 병사 3명이 얘기하는 이벤트 끝난 후 세팅
function local_class:end_talking_soldier_setting()
	local soldier_2 = self.get_soldier(2)
	local soldier_3 = self.get_soldier(3)

	-- 병사들 애니메이션 및 표정 세팅
	character_util.set_emotion(soldier_2, { name = 'smile' })
	character_util.set_anim(soldier_2, { name = 'cast' })

	character_util.set_emotion(soldier_3, { name = 'awesome' })

	-- 풉, 그게 말이 돼?!
	soldier_2.Interactable.Talk = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_moving_tree_1'

	-- 그러니까! 완전 겁쟁이잖아!
	soldier_3.Interactable.Talk = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_moving_tree_2'
end

--- 처음 병사와 대화
function local_class:talk_with_soldier()
	local leader = user_party.Leader
	local soldier_1 = self.get_soldier(1)
	local soldier_2 = self.get_soldier(2)
	local soldier_3 = self.get_soldier(3)

	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(soldier_1)
	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(soldier_2)
	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(soldier_3)

	character_util.remove_anim(soldier_1)
	character_util.remove_anim(soldier_2)
	character_util.remove_anim(soldier_3)

	if not self.first_talking then
		self:end_talking_soldier_setting()
	end

	character_util.remove_relate_event(soldier_1, self.controller)

	party_util.align_to_target(soldier_1, 'left', 1, 'linear')

	if not self.first_talking then
		character_util.set_direction(soldier_1, 'left')
		character_util.normal_jump_async(soldier_1, '01_player_jump_01')

		-- 엇… 공주님!
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(soldier_1,
			{ key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_moving_tree_4', skip = true })

		character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
		-- 왜 그래? 괜찮아?
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(leader,
			{ key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_moving_tree_5', skip = true })

		character_util.remove_anim(leader)
		character_util.remove_emotion(soldier_1)

		character_util.set_emotion(soldier_1, { name = 'tired' })
		character_util.set_anim(soldier_1, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
		-- 제가 방금… 저 장난감 방을 정리하고 있었거든요…
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(soldier_1,
			{ key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_moving_tree_6', skip = true })

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(soldier_1)

		character_util.set_emotion(soldier_1, { name = 'damaged' })
		character_util.set_anim(soldier_1, { name = 'embarrassed' })
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
		-- 등 뒤에서 인기척이 느껴져 뒤돌아보니까…
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(soldier_1,
			{ key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_moving_tree_7', skip = true })

		-- 병사1 줌 인 + 주변 배경 검정 틴트.
		local soldier_1_tint_key = 'soldier_1_tint'
		field:Tint(soldier_1_tint_key, unity_class.color.black, 1)
		camera_util.resize_to(3, 1)
		camera_util.move_async(soldier_1.Position, 1, { ignorecameragrids = true })

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(soldier_1)

		character_util.set_emotion(soldier_1, { name = 'scared' })
		character_util.set_anim(soldier_1, { name = 'cross_arm' })
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
		-- 시커먼 형체가 저를 뚫어지게 쳐다보면서…
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(soldier_1,
			{ key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_moving_tree_8', skip = true })

		character_util.remove_anim(soldier_1)

		character_util.set_anim(soldier_1, { name = 'embarrassed' })
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
		-- 파스스… 파스스… 소리를 내며 다가오는 거예요! (bold)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(soldier_1,
			{ key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_moving_tree_9', skip = true })

		-- 카메라 줌 아웃 + 틴트 해제
		field:RemoveTint(soldier_1_tint_key, 1)
		camera_util.resize_to_default(1)
		wait_for_sec(1)

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(soldier_1)

		character_util.set_emotion(soldier_1, { name = 'tired' })
		-- 너무 무서워서 뒤도 안돌아보고 도망쳐나왔어요…
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(soldier_1,
			{ key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_moving_tree_10', skip = true })

		-- 정신이 없어서 제가 아끼는 책을 두고나왔는데 도저히 못 들어가겠어요…
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(soldier_1,
			{ key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_moving_tree_11', skip = true })

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(soldier_1)

		character_util.set_emotion(soldier_1, { name = 'cry' })
		character_util.set_anim(soldier_1, { name = 'seat' })

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_01')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_hit_npc_01')

		self.first_talking = true
	end

	-- 저 방에서 제 책 좀 구해다 주시면 안 될까요…?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(soldier_1,
		{ key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_moving_tree_12', skip = true })

	-- 플레이어 선택지
	local player_choice = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		-- 찾아준다고 한다
		{ 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_moving_tree_13', 'mercy' },
		-- 거절한다
		{ 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_moving_tree_14', 'brutal' }
	})

	if player_choice == 2 then
		character_util.set_emotion(leader, { name = 'tired' })
		character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
		-- 미안, 지금은 다른 할일이 있어서.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(leader,
			{ key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_moving_tree_18', skip = true })

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_01')
		-- 어쩔 수 없죠… 흐아앙…
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(soldier_1,
			{ key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_moving_tree_19', skip = true })

		character_util.add_listener(soldier_1, self.controller)
		self.current_progress = self.current_progress - 1

		camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)
		return
	end

	-- 감사합니다…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(soldier_1,
		{ key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_moving_tree_15', skip = true })

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(soldier_1)

	character_util.set_emotion(soldier_1, { name = 'tired' })
	character_util.set_anim(soldier_1, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
	-- 방 안쪽 책상 위에 오싹한게 딱좋아(bold)라는 만화책이 있을 거예요.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(soldier_1,
		{ key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_moving_tree_16', skip = true })

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(soldier_1)

	character_util.set_emotion(soldier_1, { name = 'scared' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	-- 방에 뭔가가 있을지 모르니 꼭! 조심하세요!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(soldier_1,
		{ key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_moving_tree_17', skip = true })

	character_util.remove_emotion(soldier_1)

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)

	soldier_1.Interactable.Talk = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_moving_tree_16'

	self.controller.is_finding_book = true
end

--- 웃는 인형 상호작용 시
function local_class:interact_smile_doll(smile_doll)
	self.stop_room_speech_routine = true

	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(smile_doll)

	local leader = user_party.Leader

	character_util.remove_relate_event(smile_doll, self.controller)

	party_util.align_party(vector_util.get_x0z(smile_doll.Position), 'right', 1, 'linear')

	-- 등에 스퍼커가 달린 인형이다. 버튼을 누르면 소리가 나오는 듯 하다. 하지만 아무도 누르고 있지 않은데…?
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_moving_tree_22', mintotalduration = 1 })

	camera_util.move(smile_doll.Position, 0.2)
	camera_util.resize_to(3.6, 0.2)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_ghost_laugh_evil_01')
	-- 깔깔깔, 나랑 놀래?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(smile_doll,
		{ key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_moving_tree_21', skip = true })

	camera_util.resize_to(3.2, 0.2)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_ghost_laugh_evil_01')
	-- 깔깔깔, 나랑 놀래?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(smile_doll,
		{ key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_moving_tree_21', skip = true })

	camera_util.resize_to(2.8, 0.1)
	character_util.shake(smile_doll, 0.04, 99)
	character_util.set_emotion(smile_doll, { name = 'smile' })
	character_util.set_emotion(leader, { name = 'scared' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_horror_01')
	-- 나랑 놀자! 나랑 놀자! 나랑 놀자! 나랑 놀자! 나랑 놀자! 나랑 놀자! 나랑 놀자! 나랑 놀자! + 플레이어 점프 2번
	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async, smile_doll,
			{ key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_moving_tree_23', skip = true }),
		util.cs_generator(character_util.normal_double_jump, leader)
	})

	character_util.stop_shake(smile_doll)
	camera_util.resize_to_default(1)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	character_util.remove_emotion(leader)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	-- ……
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(smile_doll,
		{ key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_moving_tree_23_1', skip = true })

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

	self.show_smile_doll_interact_event = true

	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)
end

--- 방 내부 테이블f에 상호작용 시
function local_class:interact_table_f(table)
	local leader = user_party.Leader

	table.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

	if self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.talking_with_soldier then
		self.current_progress = self.current_progress + 1

		party_util.align_party(
			table.Position + vector(-0.15, 0, 0), 'right', 1, 'linear')

		field_ui_util.show_narration_async(
			{ key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_moving_tree_25', mintotalduration = 1 })

	else
		field_ui_util.show_narration_async(
			{ key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_moving_tree_25', mintotalduration = 1 })

		table.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
		return
	end

	local eat_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true })

	character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'eat' })
	wait_for_sec(2)

	eat_sfx:Stop()

	self.room_quest_item.ConsumeTarget = leader
	self.room_quest_item = nil

	character_util.remove_anim(leader)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	local leaf_fairy_tree = self.get_leaf_fairy_tree()

	local speech_offset = vector(2.5, 0, 1.5)

	-- 어 …
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(leaf_fairy_tree,
		{ key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_moving_tree_25_1', skip = true,
		  world_pos = leader.Position + speech_offset })

	-- 그 거 내 껀 데 …
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(leaf_fairy_tree,
		{ key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_moving_tree_26', skip = true,
		  world_pos = leader.Position + speech_offset })

	leaf_fairy_tree.Position = leaf_fairy_tree.Position + vector(4, 0, -2)

	local soldier_1 = self.get_soldier(1)
	soldier_1.Interactable.Talk = nil
	character_util.add_listener(soldier_1, self.controller)
end

--- 장난감 방에서 아이템 획득 후 병사1과 대화
function local_class:talk_with_soldier_2()
	local leader = user_party.Leader
	local soldier_1 = self.get_soldier(1)
	local soldier_2 = self.get_soldier(2)
	local soldier_3 = self.get_soldier(3)

	character_util.remove_relate_event(soldier_1, self.controller)

	self.controller.is_finding_book = false

	local soldiers = { soldier_1, soldier_2, soldier_3 }

	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(soldier_2)
	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(soldier_3)

	party_util.align_to_target(soldier_1, 'left', 1, 'linear')

	character_util.set_direction(soldier_1, 'left')
	-- 오셨군요, 공주님! 혹시 뭐 이상한 건 없었나요?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(soldier_1,
		{ key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_moving_tree_27', skip = true })

	character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'bomb_idle' })
	-- 딱히 모르겠던데…?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(leader,
		{ key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_moving_tree_28', skip = true })

	character_util.remove_anim(leader)

	-- 자, 여기 네가 찾던 책 가져왔어. 잠시만…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(leader,
		{ key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_moving_tree_29', skip = true })

	local eat_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true })
	character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'eat' })

	local leaf_fairy_tree = self.get_leaf_fairy_tree()
	leaf_fairy_tree.Position = leader.Position + vector(-9, 0, 0)

	-- 아오바 이동 함수
	local move_leaf_fairy_tree = function()
		local move_duration = 1
		character_util.shake(leaf_fairy_tree, 0.04, move_duration)
		character_util.move_to_async(leaf_fairy_tree,
			leaf_fairy_tree.Position + vector(2, 0, 0), move_duration)

		wait_for_sec(0.5)
	end

	move_leaf_fairy_tree()

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_flower_hit_01')

	for _ = 1, 2 do
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_grass_slide_02')
		move_leaf_fairy_tree()
	end

	-- 병사들 무서워 하는 행동 + 점프
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
	for _, soldier in pairs(soldiers) do
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(soldier)
		character_util.set_emotion(soldier, { name = 'scared' })
		character_util.set_anim(soldier, { name = 'embarrassed' })
		character_util.normal_jump(soldier)
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_camera_emphasize_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_haunted_house_01')
	-- 그 거 내 거 라 니 까…?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(leaf_fairy_tree,
		{ key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_moving_tree_30', skip = true })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	-- 고…공주님! 뒤… 뒤에…!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(soldier_1,
		{ key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_moving_tree_31', skip = true, bubble_type = 'shout' })

	eat_sfx:Stop()
	character_util.remove_anim(leader)

	-- 으아아아악!!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(soldier_1,
		{ key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_moving_tree_32', bubble_type = 'shout' })

	-- 병사들 도망
	local soldier_waypoint = {
		{
			soldier_1.Position + vector(2, 0, 0),
			soldier_1.Position + vector(2, 0, 10)
		},
		{
			soldier_2.Position + vector(1, 0, 0),
			soldier_2.Position + vector(1, 0, 10)
		},
		{
			soldier_3.Position + vector(1, 0, 0),
			soldier_3.Position + vector(1, 0, 10)
		}
	}

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_dash_06')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_villain_scream_01')
	for k, soldier in pairs(soldiers) do
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(soldier)

		character_util.move_waypoint(soldier, soldier_waypoint[k], 5)

		character_util.set_anim(soldier, { name = 'embarrassed' })
	end

	-- 페이드 인 아웃 세팅
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_count_01')
	screen_util.fade_out_async(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	leaf_fairy_tree.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	screen_util.fade_in_async(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'left')
	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	character_util.show_emoticon_async(leader, nil, 'question')

	character_util.set_emotion(leader, { name = 'tired' })
	-- 뭐야…?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(leader,
		{ key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_moving_tree_33', skip = true })

	character_util.remove_emotion(leader)

	local chasing_start_pos = self.get_chasing_start_pos()

	local soldier_pos = {
		chasing_start_pos + vector(0, 0, 1),
		chasing_start_pos + vector(-0.5, 0, 2),
		chasing_start_pos + vector(0.5, 0, 2)
	}

	-- 다음 이벤트 장소에 병사들 세팅
	for k, soldier in pairs(soldiers) do
		soldier.Interactable.Talk = nil
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(soldier)
		character_util.set_direction(soldier, 'down')
		character_util.set_emotion(soldier, { name = 'scared' })
		character_util.shake(soldier, 0.04, 9999)
		soldier.Position = soldier_pos[k]
	end
end

--- 추격 직전 이벤트
function local_class:ready_chasing()
	local soldier_1 = self.get_soldier(1)
	local soldier_2 = self.get_soldier(2)
	local soldier_3 = self.get_soldier(3)
	local leader = user_party.Leader

	local soldiers = { soldier_1, soldier_2, soldier_3 }

	for _, soldier in pairs(soldiers) do
		character_util.stop_shake(soldier)
		character_util.shake(soldier, 0.04, 999)
	end

	-- bgm_transition: Field(bgm_futurecastle2_dungeon) -> Muted
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })

	party_util.align_to_target(soldier_1, 'down', 1, 'linear')

	-- 카메라, 병사들 쪽으로 이동.
	camera_util.move_async(soldier_1.Position, 1)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
	-- 부, 분명 파스스거리면서…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(soldier_1,
		{ key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_moving_tree_34', skip = true })

	character_util.normal_double_jump(leader, '01_jump_01')

	-- 뭘 보고 그렇게 놀란 거야?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(leader,
		{ key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_moving_tree_35', skip = true })

	-- 못 보셨어요? 아까 공주님 뒤에…
	-- 암전 이벤트
	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(
			character_util.set_animation_n_times_async, soldier_1, { name = 'release', count = 2, sfx = '01_swing_01' }),
		util.cs_generator(speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async,
			soldier_1, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_moving_tree_36', skip = true, layer = 'Fades' }),
		util.cs_generator(function()
			wait_for_sec(0.5)

			-- bgm_transition: Muted -> Event(bgm_thriller), 0
			music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_thriller', state = 'event', mix = 0 })
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_light_turn_off_01')
			screen_util.fade_out_async(0.2, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

			wait_for_sec(0.3)

			screen_util.fade_in_async(0.2, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
		end)
	})

	screen_util.fade_out_async(0.3, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	-- 병사 쪽 말풍선 : 어어…! 불이…!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(soldier_1,
		{ key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_moving_tree_37', skip = true, layer = 'Fades' })

	-- 공주 쪽 말풍선 : 내가 켜줄게.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(leader,
		{ key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_moving_tree_38', skip = true, layer = 'Fades' })

	if lua_helper.type_compare(leader.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentActionState, typeof(CS.Oak.CharacterHoldUpState)) then
		character_util.release_hold_object(leader, leader.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentActionState.HoldTarget)
	end

	local broken_worker_a_head = self.get_broken_worker_a_head()

	broken_worker_a_head.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)

	-- 안드로이드 머리에 불 붙이기
	self.origin_burn_life_time = broken_worker_a_head.CombustibleBehaviour.BurnLifeTime
	broken_worker_a_head.CombustibleBehaviour.BurnLifeTime = 0
	command_util.execute_burn(leader, broken_worker_a_head, true)

	-- 어두운 배경 이펙트 생성
	self.background_effect = self.get_fx_darkness_background():Instantiate(
		stage_camera.transform.position + vector(0, 0, 0.5),
		unity_class.quaternion.Euler(-45, 0, 0), stage_camera.transform)

	self.background_effect.transform.localScale = vector(3, 1, 2)

	self.head_darkness_effect = self.get_fx_darkness_target():Instantiate(
		broken_worker_a_head.Position + vector(0, 4.7, -3.6),
		unity_class.quaternion.identity, broken_worker_a_head.transform)

	local tint_color = 0.5
	field:Tint(self.chasing_tint_key, unity_class.color(tint_color, tint_color, tint_color), 0)

	local leaf_fairy_tree = self.get_leaf_fairy_tree()
	leaf_fairy_tree.Position = leader.Position + vector(0, 0, -3)

	wait_for_sec(1)

	if self.broken_worker_a_head_out then
		command_util.execute_holdup(leader, broken_worker_a_head, leader.Position, nil, false)
	else
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(leader, { 'press_lorain_button', 'false' }))
	end

	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(broken_worker_a_head)

	screen_util.fade_in_async(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	-- 병사들 점프
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_01')
	for _, soldier in pairs(soldiers) do
		character_util.normal_jump(soldier)
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
	-- 으악! 여…여기까지…!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(soldier_1,
		{ key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_moving_tree_39', skip = true, bubble_type = 'shout' })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_victim_scream_02')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_dash_06')
	-- 도망쳐!!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(soldier_1,
		{ key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_moving_tree_40', bubble_type = 'shout' })

	-- 병사들 도망 + 쓰레기 투척
	local garbage_item_id = 20395

	local soldier_1_waypoint = {
		soldier_1.Position + vector(0, 0, 2),
		soldier_1.Position + vector(0, 0, 4),
		soldier_1.Position + vector(0, 0, 7)
	}

	-- 병사1이 도망가면서 쓰레기 투척
	local soldier_1_cb = function(waypoint_index)
		if waypoint_index == 0 then
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_projectile_01')
		end

		if waypoint_index + 1 < #soldier_1_waypoint then
			local target_pos = self.get_garbage_pos(waypoint_index + 1)

			local garbage = drop_item_util.create_item(
				{ pos = soldier_1.Position, target = target_pos,
				  itemid = garbage_item_id, notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', sprscale = 0.7 })

			garbage.ShadowTransform.localPosition = vector(0, 0.01, -0.03)

			table.insert(self.passage_garbage_item,
				{ item = garbage, is_active = true, origin_pos = target_pos })
		end
	end

	-- 위쪽 복도로 병사들 도망가기 시작
	for k, soldier in pairs(soldiers) do
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(soldier)

		if k == 1 then
			character_util.move_waypoint(soldier, soldier_1_waypoint, 5, false, nil,
				nil, nil, nil, nil, soldier_1_cb)
		else
			character_util.move_waypoint(soldier,
				soldier.Position + vector(0, 0, 7), 5)
		end

		character_util.set_anim(soldier, { name = 'embarrassed' })
	end

	-- 아니 대체 뭐 때문에…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(leader,
		{ key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_moving_tree_41', skip = true })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'down')
	camera_util.move_async(leader.Position + vector(0, 0, -1.5), 1)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_grass_slide_02')
	character_util.move_to_async(leaf_fairy_tree,
		leaf_fairy_tree.Position + vector(0, 0, 1), nil, 2)

	-- 내 거 내 놔…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(leaf_fairy_tree,
		{ key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_moving_tree_42', skip = true })

	character_util.set_emotion(leader, { name = 'surprise' })
	character_util.normal_jump_async(leader, '01_player_jump_01')

	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

	character_util.remove_emotion(leader)

	local ending_soldier_pos = self.get_ending_soldier_pos()

	local soldier_pos = {
		ending_soldier_pos,
		ending_soldier_pos + vector(1, 0, 0.5),
		ending_soldier_pos + vector(1, 0, -0.5)
	}

	for k, soldier in pairs(soldiers) do
		character_util.stop_shake(soldier)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(soldier)
		soldier.Position = soldier_pos[k]
		character_util.set_direction(soldier, 'left')
	end

	-- 쓰레기들 배치
	for i = 3, 7 do
		local garbage = drop_item_util.create_item(
			{ pos = self.get_garbage_pos(i), itemid = garbage_item_id,
			  notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', sprscale = 0.7 })

		table.insert(self.passage_garbage_item,
			{ item = garbage, is_active = true, origin_pos = garbage.Position })
	end

	leaf_fairy_tree.OverrideCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
	leaf_fairy_tree.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable.Create()

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.start_chasing, self))
end

--- 추격 이벤트 시작
function local_class:start_chasing()
	local leader = user_party.Leader
	local leaf_fairy_tree = self.get_leaf_fairy_tree()

	local leader_start_pos = leader.Position
	local leaf_fairy_tree_start_pos = leaf_fairy_tree.Position

	self.is_chasing = true

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	local chasing_end_pos = self.get_chasing_end_pos()
	character_util.move_waypoint(leaf_fairy_tree, chasing_end_pos, 2.5)
	character_util.set_anim(leaf_fairy_tree, { name = 'meditation', loop = false })

	local caught_with_leaf_fairy_tree = false
	while self.is_chasing do

		if leader.Position.z - leaf_fairy_tree.Position.z < 1 then
			caught_with_leaf_fairy_tree = true
			self.is_chasing = false
			break
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	character_util.stop(leaf_fairy_tree)

	if caught_with_leaf_fairy_tree then
		-- 아오바한테 잡혔을 때
		party_util.stop_and_disable_control()
		field_ui_manager:Hide()

		self:hold_down_with_player()

		screen_util.fade_out_async(0.5, unity_class.color.red, 'linear')

		camera_util.resize_to_default(0)

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
		character_util.set_direction(leader, 'up')
		leader.Position = leader_start_pos

		leaf_fairy_tree.Position = leaf_fairy_tree_start_pos

		-- 쓰레기 아이템들 재배치
		for i = 1, #self.passage_garbage_item do
			local garbage = self.passage_garbage_item[i].item
			garbage.Position = self.passage_garbage_item[i].origin_pos
			self.passage_garbage_item[i].is_active = true
		end

		local broken_worker_a_head = self.get_broken_worker_a_head()
		broken_worker_a_head.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)

		command_util.execute_burn(leader, broken_worker_a_head, true)

		wait_for_sec(1)

		speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(broken_worker_a_head)

		if self.broken_worker_a_head_out then
			command_util.execute_holdup(leader, broken_worker_a_head, leader.Position, nil, false)
		else
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(leader, { 'press_lorain_button', 'false' }))
		end

		screen_util.fade_in_async(0.5, unity_class.color.red, 'linear')

		field_ui_manager:Show()
		party_util.reset_controllers()

		self:start_chasing()

	else
		-- 아오바 추격을 따돌렸을 때
		self.current_progress = self.current_progress + 1

		leaf_fairy_tree.OverrideCrashBehaviour = nil

		for i = 1, #self.passage_garbage_item do
			self.passage_garbage_item[i].item:ConsumeComplete()
			self.passage_garbage_item[i].item = nil
		end

		wait_for_sec(0.3)

		self.background_effect:Dispose()
		self.background_effect = nil

		self.head_darkness_effect:Dispose()
		self.head_darkness_effect = nil

		local tint_color = 0.15
		field:Tint(self.chasing_tint_key, unity_class.color(tint_color, tint_color, tint_color), 0)

		if self.broken_worker_a_head_out then
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(leader, { 'press_lorain_button' }))
		end

		wait_for_sec(0.1)

		field:RemoveTint(self.chasing_tint_key, 1)

		wait_for_sec(0.4)

		local broken_worker_a_head = self.get_broken_worker_a_head()
		broken_worker_a_head.CombustibleBehaviour.BurnLifeTime = self.origin_burn_life_time

		local leader_origin_pos = leader.Position
		leaf_fairy_tree.Position = chasing_end_pos + vector(0, 0, -1)

		-- QTE 실패 시 연출
		local qte_fail = function()
			self:hold_down_with_player()

			screen_util.fade_out_async(0.5, unity_class.color.red, 'linear')

			camera_util.resize_to_default(0)

			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
			character_util.set_direction(leader, 'up')
			leader.Position = leader_origin_pos

			leaf_fairy_tree.Position = chasing_end_pos + vector(0, 0, -1)

			wait_for_sec(0.5)

			screen_util.fade_in_async(0.5, unity_class.color.red, 'linear')
		end

		local hiding_pos = self.get_hiding_pos() + vector(-0.2, 0, 0)

		local qte_clear = false

		-- QTE 이벤트를 성공할 때까지 반복
		while not qte_clear do
			-- 플레이어가 기둥 옆까지 이동
			character_util.move_waypoint_async(leader, vector(leader.Position.x, 0, hiding_pos.z),
				5, true, nil, nil, nil, true)

			-- 어딘가 숨을 곳이…!
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(leader,
				{ key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_moving_tree_67', skip = true })

			-- QTE 이벤트
			qte_clear = self:qte_event('right', 'fail')

			if not qte_clear then
				-- 아오바도 따라서 들어옴
				leaf_fairy_tree.Position = chasing_end_pos
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_grass_slide_02')
				character_util.move_to_async(leaf_fairy_tree,
					vector(leaf_fairy_tree.Position.x, 0, leader.Position.z - 1), nil, 3)

				qte_fail()
			end
		end

		character_util.set_direction(leader, 'right')
		character_util.set_emotion(leader, { name = 'attack' })
		character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'prostrate' })
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_twohand_stomp_jump_01')
		character_util.jump(leader, 0.7, 0.7)
		character_util.move_to_async(leader, hiding_pos, 0.7)

		wait_for_sec(1)

		camera_util.move_async(leaf_fairy_tree.Position + vector(0, 0, 7.5), 1)

		-- 아오바도 따라서 들어옴
		leaf_fairy_tree.Position = chasing_end_pos
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_grass_slide_01')
		character_util.move_to_async(leaf_fairy_tree,
			leaf_fairy_tree.Position + vector(0, 0, 7.5), nil, 3)

		character_util.normal_double_jump(leaf_fairy_tree, '01_jump_01')

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_angry_01')
		character_util.show_emoticon_async(leaf_fairy_tree, nil, 'annoyed')

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

		-- 아오바 뒤로 이동하는 플레이어
		local player_waypoint = {
			vector(leaf_fairy_tree.Position.x, 0, leader.Position.z),
			leaf_fairy_tree.Position + vector(0, 0, -1)
		}

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		character_util.move_waypoint_async(leader, player_waypoint, 1)

		character_util.set_direction(leader, 'up')

		leader:HideWeapon(true)
		leader.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', 'head_crusher')
		leader.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon2', 'empty')
		character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'sword_idle' })

		-- 아오바 공격하는 QTE
		self:qte_event('up', 'not_fail')

		-- 점프 어택
		character_util.remove_anim(leader)
		character_util.jump(leader, 0.7, 0.5)
		character_util.move_waypoint(leader,
			leaf_fairy_tree.Position + vector(0, 0, -0.5), 2)
		character_util.set_animation_n_times(leader, { name = 'sword_attack', loop = false, scale = 0.3 })
		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		-- bgm_transition: Event(bgm_thriller) -> Muted
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_critical_01')
		self.get_hit_effect():Instantiate(leaf_fairy_tree.Position + vector(0, 0.2, -0.2))
		self.get_last_hit_effect():Instantiate(leaf_fairy_tree.Position)

		-- 아오바 날라가는 연출
		camera_util.shake(0.4, 0.3)
		camera_util.move(leader.Position + vector(0, 0, 4), 1)

		local duration = 1
		local time_passed = 0
		local height = 4

		local start_pos = leaf_fairy_tree.Position
		local end_pos = self.get_air_spin_pos()

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_air_spin_01')
		character_util.spine_rotate(leaf_fairy_tree, 360 * 5, duration)

		while time_passed < duration do
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

			local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration)

			local cur_xz = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress)
			local cur_y = unity_class.mathf.Sin(unity_class.mathf.PI * progress) * height

			leaf_fairy_tree.Position = cur_xz
			leaf_fairy_tree.SpineController.SpineOffset = cur_y * unity_class.vector3.up

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leaf_fairy_tree)

		-- 아오바 땅에 쓰러지는 연출
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_interact_tree_01')
		character_util.set_direction(leaf_fairy_tree, 'right')
		character_util.set_emotion(leaf_fairy_tree, { name = 'confused' })
		character_util.set_anim(leaf_fairy_tree, { name = 'prostrate' })
		wait_for_sec(1)

		leader:HideWeapon(false)

		-- 플레어가 아오바 옆으로 이동
		player_waypoint = {
			vector(leader.Position.x, 0, leaf_fairy_tree.Position.z),
			leaf_fairy_tree.Position + vector(1, 0, 0)
		}

		character_util.move_waypoint_async(leader, player_waypoint, 4.5,
			true, nil, nil, nil, true)

		local eat_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true })
		character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'eat' })
		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		leaf_fairy_tree.SpineController:RemoveFadeColor('leaf_fairy_tree', 1)
		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		eat_sfx:Stop()
		character_util.remove_anim(leader)

		-- bgm_transition: Muted -> Event(bgm_trickery_theme), 2
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_trickery_theme', state = 'event', mix = 2 })

		character_util.set_direction(leader, 'left')
		character_util.set_emotion(leader, { name = 'surprise' })
		character_util.normal_jump_async(leader, '01_player_jump_01')

		-- 아오바?!
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(leader,
			{ key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_moving_tree_44', skip = true })

		character_util.remove_emotion(leader)

		character_util.remove_emotion(leaf_fairy_tree)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_popup_01')
		character_util.mario_jump_async(leaf_fairy_tree, 'right')

		character_util.set_emotion(leader, { name = 'tired' })
		character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
		-- 왜 그런 모습으로 사람들을 놀래키고 다녀?
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(leader,
			{ key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_moving_tree_45', skip = true })

		character_util.remove_anim(leader)

		character_util.set_emotion(leaf_fairy_tree, { name = 'tired' })
		character_util.set_anim(leaf_fairy_tree, { name = 'bomb_idle' })
		-- 놀래킨다니… 난 그저 숨어서 쉬고 싶었을 뿐이야!
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(leaf_fairy_tree,
			{ key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_moving_tree_46', skip = true })

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leaf_fairy_tree)

		character_util.set_emotion(leaf_fairy_tree, { name = 'doyagao' })
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
		-- 이 옷만 입으면 사람들이 나를 못 찾는다고, 잘 봐! + 점프 2번
		wait_all({
			util.cs_generator(speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async, leaf_fairy_tree,
				{ key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_moving_tree_47', skip = true }),
			util.cs_generator(character_util.normal_double_jump, leaf_fairy_tree, true)
		})

		character_util.remove_emotion(leaf_fairy_tree)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_interact_tree_01')
		character_util.set_direction(leaf_fairy_tree, 'up')
		character_util.set_anim(leaf_fairy_tree, { name = 'cast2' })

--- QTE 이벤트
function local_class:qte_event(swipe, qte_kind)
	local swipe_value = 'none'

	self.touch_handler = {
		callback = function(_, e)
			if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeLeft then
				swipe_value = 'left'
				return true
			end

			if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeRight then
				swipe_value = 'right'
				return true
			end

			if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeDown then
				swipe_value = 'down'
				return true
			end

			if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeUp then
				swipe_value = 'up'
				return true
			end

			return false
		end
	}

	message_system:Subscribe(self.touch_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'callback')

	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.QTESwipe(swipe)

	if qte_kind == 'fail' then
		-- 실패가 있는 QTE
		while swipe_value == 'none' do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

	elseif qte_kind == 'not_fail' then
		-- 실패가 없는 QTE
		while swipe_value ~= swipe do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end

	local result = swipe_value == swipe

	if result then
		yield_return_func(CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.QTEComplete, 0)
	else
		CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.CloseTutorialSpine()
	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.touch_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))

	return result
end

--- 쥐 인형 머리 떨어지는 연출
function local_class:fall_down_mouse_head()
	-- 인형 이동 및 회전 함수
	local move_and_rotate = function(duration, end_pos_offset, start_rot, end_rot, shadow)
		local time_passed = 0
		local start_pos = self.mouse_head.Position
		local end_pos = start_pos + end_pos_offset

		while time_passed < duration do
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

			local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration)
			local cur_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress)
			local cur_rot = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(start_rot, end_rot, progress)

			self.mouse_head.Position = cur_pos
			self.mouse_head.SpriteTransform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, cur_rot, 0)
			self.mouse_head.ShadowTransform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, cur_rot, 0)

			if shadow then
				local shadow_cur_pos = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(-0.33, -0.03, progress)
				self.mouse_head.ShadowTransform.localPosition = vector(0, 0, shadow_cur_pos)
			end

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end

	-- 인형 튕기기 및 회전 함수
	local bounce_and_rotate = function(duration, end_pos_offset, start_rot, end_rot, height)
		local time_passed = 0
		local start_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(self.mouse_head.Position)
		local end_pos = start_pos + end_pos_offset

		local start_height = self.mouse_head.Position.y

		while time_passed < duration do
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

			local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration)
			local cur_xz = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress)
			local cur_y = unity_class.mathf.Sin(unity_class.mathf.PI * progress) * height + start_height
			local cur_rot = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(start_rot, end_rot, progress)

			self.mouse_head.Position = cur_xz + cur_y * unity_class.vector3.up

			self.mouse_head.SpriteTransform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, cur_rot, 0)
			self.mouse_head.ShadowTransform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, cur_rot, 0)

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end

	-- 그림자 다시 보이도록
	self.mouse_head.ShadowTransform.localScale = vector(0.53, 0.53, 0.53)
	self.mouse_head.ShadowTransform.localPosition = vector(0, 0.75, -0.03)

	local start_rot = 0
	local end_rot = -160
	move_and_rotate(0.5, vector(-0.4, 0, -0.2), start_rot, end_rot)

	-- 머리 처음 잘려 떨어짐
	start_rot = end_rot
	end_rot = end_rot - 160 * 3
	move_and_rotate(1.2, vector(-1.2, 0, 0), start_rot, end_rot)

	-- 테이블 위에서 굴러감
	start_rot = end_rot
	end_rot = end_rot - 20
	move_and_rotate(0.05, vector(-0.1, -0.2, 0), start_rot, end_rot)

	-- 땅에 그림자 보이도록
	self.mouse_head.ShadowTransform.localPosition = vector(0, 0, -0.33)

	self.mouse_head:SetSortingLayer(false)

	-- 테이블 밑으로 떨어짐
	start_rot = end_rot
	end_rot = end_rot - 180
	move_and_rotate(0.2, vector(0, -0.47, -0.3), start_rot, end_rot, true)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_hit_npc_01', parent = self.mouse_head })
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_haunted_house_01', parent = self.mouse_head })

	-- 첫 번째 바운스
	start_rot = end_rot
	end_rot = end_rot - 220
	bounce_and_rotate(0.5, vector(-0.5, 0, 0), start_rot, end_rot, 0.7)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_hit_comic_01', parent = self.mouse_head })

	-- 두 번째 바운스
	start_rot = end_rot
	end_rot = end_rot - 120
	bounce_and_rotate(0.3, vector(-0.3, 0, 0), start_rot, end_rot, 0.4)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_hit_npc_01', parent = self.mouse_head })

	-- 바운스 끝난 후 살짝 굴러감
	start_rot = end_rot
	end_rot = end_rot - 60
	move_and_rotate(0.3, vector(-0.2, 0, 0), start_rot, end_rot)
end

--- 타켓1과 타켓2의 특정 범위 충돌 체크
function local_class:get_overlapped_xz_area(target_pos_1, target_pos_2, extents_1, extents_2)
	local min_x = math.max(target_pos_1.x - extents_1.x, target_pos_2.x - extents_2.x)
	local min_z = math.max(target_pos_1.z - extents_1.z, target_pos_2.z - extents_2.z)
	local max_x = math.min(target_pos_1.x + extents_1.x, target_pos_2.x + extents_2.x)
	local max_z = math.min(target_pos_1.z + extents_1.z, target_pos_2.z + extents_2.z)

	return math.max(0, max_x - min_x) * math.max(0, max_z - min_z)
end

return local_class

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateOpenEvent.Create('popcorn_battlegate_1', false))
	end
end

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.get_butter, self))
	end
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local circus_man = self.get_circus_man()
	local craig = self.get_craig()
	local ailie = self.get_ailie()

	-- 서커스 단장 인터랙트
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, circus_man) then
		if self.is_start_popcorn_quest == false then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.start_popcorn_event, self)
			return true
		else
			if self.popcorn_recipe.corn == true and self.popcorn_recipe.salt == true and self.popcorn_recipe.butter == true then
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.ending_popcorn_event, self)
			else
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(
						speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async, circus_man, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_popcorn_npc_8'}))
			end
			return true
		end
	end

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, craig) or lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, ailie) and self.current_craig_state == self.craig_event_states.talk_craig then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.craig_interact, self)
		return true
	end

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, ailie) and self.current_craig_state == self.craig_event_states.ending then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.ailie_item_choice, self)
		return true
	end

	for i = 1, 3 do
		local invader_dead = self.get_invader_dead(i)
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, invader_dead) and self.invader_dead_table[i].is_farming == false and self.current_craig_state == self.craig_event_states.farming then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.invader_farming, self, i , invader_dead)
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) or e.FullEnter == false then
		return false
	end

	local zone = e.Zone.Name

	if zone == 'popcorn_battle' and self.is_seen_invader == false then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.popcorn_invader_battle, self)
		return true
	end

	if zone == 'popcorn_craig_zone' and self.current_craig_state == self.craig_event_states.none then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.craig_ailie_talk, self))
		return true
	end

	if zone == 'popcorn_corn_zone' and self.popcorn_recipe.corn == false then
		self.popcorn_recipe.corn = true
		self.corn_table[1].ConsumeTarget = user_party.Leader
		self.corn_table[1] = nil
		return true
	end
end

		desertelf.Position = desertelf.Position + vector(-2,0,0)
		circus_man.Position = desertelf.Position + vector(1,0,0)
		character_util.set_direction(desertelf, 'right')

-- 인베이더 시체 털이
function local_class:invader_farming(idx, fo)
	self.invader_farming_count = self.invader_farming_count + 1
	local drop_pos
	if idx == 1 then
		drop_pos = vector(-0.4,0,0.8)
	else
		drop_pos = vector(-0.4,0,-0.5)
	end

	if fo.Position.x > user_party.Leader.Position.x then
		character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'right')
	else
		character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'left')
	end
	local equipping_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true, type_priority = 'loop', player_priority = 'npc' })
	character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'eat' })
	wait_for_sec(1)
	equipping_sfx:Stop()
	character_util.remove_anim(user_party.Leader)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_field_item_popup_01')
	self.invader_farming_table[self.invader_farming_count].order = idx
	self.invader_farming_table[self.invader_farming_count].item_1 = drop_item_util.create_item(
			{itemid = self.invader_farming_table[self.invader_farming_count].item_id_1, notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
			 pos = fo.Position, target = fo.Position + drop_pos, sprscale = 0.7, showoncharacter = false, skip_text = true })
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.set_item_text, self, get_field_object(self.invader_dead_table[idx].text_fo_1), self.invader_farming_table[self.invader_farming_count].item_1_text))

	self.invader_farming_table[self.invader_farming_count].item_2 = drop_item_util.create_item(
			{itemid = self.invader_farming_table[self.invader_farming_count].item_id_2, notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
			 pos = fo.Position, target = fo.Position + drop_pos + vector(0.8,0,0), sprscale = 0.7, showoncharacter = false, skip_text = true })

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.set_item_text, self, get_field_object(self.invader_dead_table[idx].text_fo_2), self.invader_farming_table[self.invader_farming_count].item_2_text))
	quest_marker_util.remove(self.invader_dead_table[idx].marker)
	character_util.remove_relate_event(fo, self)

	if self.invader_farming_count == 3 then
		self:get_salt(idx,fo)
	else
		wait_for_sec(0.8)
	end
end

	self.current_craig_state = self.craig_event_states.ending
	craig:HideWeapon(true)
	local item_order

	craig.Interactable.Talk = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_popcorn_craig_1'
	-- 에일리 웨이포인트
	local ailie_waypoint = {
			{ { vector(62.5,0,-37) }, { vector(62.5,0,-36.3), vector(60.5,0,-36.3) },
			  { vector(60.5,0,-35.5), vector(59.5,0,-35.5) }, { vector(59.5,0,-31.5), vector(60.5,0,-31.5) },
			  { vector(62.5,0,-31.5), vector(62.5,0,-37) } },
			{ { vector(62.5,0,-35), vector(61.5,0,-35) },
			  { vector(61.5,0,-31.5), vector(60.5,0,-31.5) }, { vector(60.5,0,-36.5) },
			  { vector(60.5,0,-35.5), vector(59.5,0,-35.5) }, { vector(61.5,0,-35.5), vector(61.5,0,-35) } },
			{ { vector(62.5,0,-31) }, { vector(62.5,0,-31.5), vector(60.5,0,-31.5) },
			  { vector(60.5,0,-35.5), vector(59.5,0,-35.5) }, { vector(59.5,0,-36.5), vector(60.5,0,-36.5)},
			  { vector(62.5,0,-36.5), vector(62.5,0,-31) } }
	}

	character_util.remove_emotion(craig)
	character_util.remove_anim(ailie)
	party_util.align_party(fo.Position, 'right', 1, 'linear')

	-- 드랍된 아이템 습득 순서
	if idx == 1 then
		item_order = { 1, 2, 3 }
		character_util.move_waypoint(craig, { craig.Position + vector(1,0,0), craig.Position + vector(1,0,-4) }, 3, false, nil, nil, 'left')
	elseif idx == 2 then
		item_order = { 3, 1, 2 }
		character_util.move_waypoint(craig, { craig.Position + vector(0,0,-2) }, 3, false, nil, nil, 'left')
	else
		item_order = { 3, 2, 1 }
		character_util.move_waypoint(craig, { craig.Position + vector(1,0,0), craig.Position + vector(1,0,2) }, 3, false, nil, nil, 'left')
	end
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(ailie, ailie_waypoint[idx][1], 3, false, nil, nil, 'left')

	wait_for_sec(0.2)
	character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'right')
	character_util.set_emotion(ailie, { name = 'surprise' })
	-- 와! 공주 엄청 소질 있는데?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(ailie, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_popcorn_51', skip = true })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(ailie, { name = 'awesome' })
	-- 레지스탕스들이 엄청 좋아할 거야!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(ailie, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_popcorn_52', skip = true })

	character_util.set_emotion(ailie, { name = 'smile' })
	for i = 2, 4 do
		character_util.move_waypoint_async(ailie, ailie_waypoint[idx][i], 4, true, nil, nil, 'left')
		character_util.set_anim(ailie, { name = 'eat' })

		-- 드랍된 아이템이 자기 order면 습득
		for j = 1, 3 do
			if self.invader_farming_table[j].order == item_order[i-1] then
				self.invader_farming_table[j].item_1.ConsumeTarget = ailie
				self.invader_farming_table[j].item_1 = nil
				self.invader_farming_table[j].item_2.ConsumeTarget = ailie
				self.invader_farming_table[j].item_2 = nil
			end
		end

		wait_for_sec(0.4)
		character_util.remove_anim(ailie)
	end
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(ailie, ailie_waypoint[idx][5], 4, true, nil, nil, 'left')

	character_util.set_animation_n_times(ailie, { name = 'release', sfx = '01_swing_01', count = 2 })
	-- 혹시 뭐 갖고 싶은 거 있었어?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(ailie, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_popcorn_53', skip = true })

	self:drop_ailie_item()
	character_util.remove_emotion(ailie)
	character_util.add_listener(ailie, self.controller)
	wait_for_sec(0.1)
end

function local_class:drop_ailie_item()
	local ailie = self.get_ailie()

	local wait = true
	local select = 0
	local branches = create_generic_list(typeof(CS.Oak.TalkBranch))

	for i = 1, 5 do
		if self.ailie_reward_table[i].is_get == false then
			branches:Add({
				Text = game_string:GetString(self.ailie_reward_table[i].choice_text),
				Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Normal,
				Callback = function()
					wait = false
					select = i
				end })
		end
	end

	branches:Add({
		Text = game_string:GetString('nightmare_futurecastle_2_popcorn_65'),
		Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Normal,
		Callback = function()
			wait = false
			select = 0
		end })

	ui_overlay_util.push_overlay(user_party.Leader, branches)

	while wait do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if select == 0 then
		-- 지금은 딱히 생각나는 게 없네.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(user_party.Leader, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_popcorn_54_1', skip = true })
		character_util.set_emotion(ailie, { name = 'smile' })
		-- 그래? 필요할 때 찾아와!
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(ailie, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_popcorn_56', skip = true })
		character_util.remove_emotion(ailie)
		return
	end

	self.ailie_reward_table[select].is_get = true
	-- 소금 선택
	if select == 4 then
		self.popcorn_recipe.salt = true

function local_class:popcorn_move(popcorn, pos)
	local duration = 0.6
	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	popcorn:SetPosition(pos)
	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < duration do
		local cur_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(pos, pos + vector(0, 5, 5), (unity_class.time.time - cur_time) / duration)

		popcorn:SetPosition(cur_pos)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
	popcorn:SetPosition(vector(998,0,999))
end

function local_class:kid_run_2(fo)
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(fo, { fo.Position + vector(1,0,0) }, 5, true, nil, nil)
	local pos = fo.Position
	while self.stop_run_2 == false do
		character_util.move_waypoint_async(fo, { pos + vector(2,0,0), pos + vector(2,0,2), pos + vector(0,0,2), pos }, 5, true, nil, nil)
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:kid_run_3(fo)
	local pos = fo.Position

	while self.stop_run_2 == false do
		character_util.move_waypoint_async(fo, { pos + vector(2,0,0), pos + vector(2,0,2), pos + vector(0,0,2), pos }, 5, true, nil, nil)
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

return local_class

local local_class = newclass('NightmareFutureCastle2RanpangPreSection')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = pre @
		QuestName = NightmareFutureCastle2Ranpang @
		Comment = 나이트메어 미래 부유성 파트2 란팡 서브 퀘스트 파비를 만나기 전 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	self.get_succubus_marker = function(index) return field:GetMarker('ranpang_pre_succubus_' .. index) end

	-- 파비 / 서큐버스 존 최초 입장시 이벤트 연출을 위한
	self.zone_name = 'ranpang_pre_event'

	-- string key 앞부분
	self.first_string_key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_ranpang_pre_'

	-- 존 이벤트 출력 했는지?
	self.is_show_zone_event = false
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')

	-- 프리섹션에서는 파비 애니메이션 이모티콘 변경
	self.controller:set_progress_npc()
	local favi = self.controller.get_favi()
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(favi, { name = 'question', loop = false }, { name = 'tired' })

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	self.controller:remove_progress_add_listener()

	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	-- 파비 상호작용 확인
	local favi = self.controller.get_favi()
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, favi) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_favi, self, favi)
		return true
	end

	-- 서큐버스 상호작용 확인
	for i = 1, 3 do
		local succubus = self.controller.get_succubus(i)
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, succubus) then
			character_util.set_direction(succubus, direction_util.get_opposite(user_party.Leader.Direction))
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(succubus, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_ranpang_interact_' .. i })
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.zone_name) and not self.is_show_zone_event then
		-- 파비와 서큐버스들 말하는 존 입장
		self.is_show_zone_event = true
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.favi_succubus_talk_event, self)
		return true
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.controller.ranpang_room_zone_name) then
		-- 란팡방에 최초 들어갔을 때
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.ranpang_room_enter, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

-- 파비 / 서큐버스 말하는 이벤트
function local_class:favi_succubus_talk_event()
	local favi = self.controller.get_favi()
	local princess = user_party.Leader

	-- 공주 오른쪽 보도록
	character_util.set_direction(princess, 'right')

	-- 카메라 파비에게
	camera_util.move_async(favi.Position + unity_class.vector3.right, 0.5)

	-- 파비: (tired, question, right) 어쩌면 좋지…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(favi, { key = self.first_string_key .. 1, skip = true })

	-- 서큐버스 1: 점점 드림 테라피에 대한 내성도 강해져서, 도저히…
	local succubus = self.controller.get_succubus(1)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(succubus, { key = self.first_string_key .. 2, skip = true })

	-- 파비: (tired, question, right) 잠에서 깨기만 하면 자꾸 그곳으로 돌아가 버리니…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(favi, { key = self.first_string_key .. 3, skip = true })
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 파비가 왼쪽으로 돌아 공주를 발견(emoticon_bubble_exclamation)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.remove_emotion(favi)
	character_util.set_anim(favi, { name = 'idle' })
	wait_for_sec(0.25)
	character_util.set_direction(favi, 'left')
	wait_for_sec(0.1)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_notice_01')
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(favi, nil, 'notice')

	-- 파비: (left, side, idle, 점프) 공주님!
	character_util.normal_jump(favi, '01_small_jump_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(favi, { name = 'attack' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(favi, { key = self.first_string_key .. 4, skip = true })
	character_util.remove_emotion(favi)
	character_util.remove_anim(favi)

	-- 파비가 공주 오른쪽으로 달려옴.
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(favi, princess.Position + unity_class.vector3.right,
			4.5, true, nil, nil, 'left', true)

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)

	-- 파비: (tired, release) 공주님, 저희 재활 치료 병동에서 환자가 탈출했어요...
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(favi, { name = 'tired' })
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(favi, { name = 'release', count = 1, keep_anim = false, sfx = '01_swing_01' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(favi, { key = self.first_string_key .. 5, skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim(favi)

	-- 파비: (tired, question) 굉장히 불안정안 환자라서 예의주시하고 있었는데, 또 놓쳐버렸어요…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.set_anim(favi, { name = 'question', loop = false })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(favi, { key = self.first_string_key .. 6, skip = true })

	-- 파비: (자세 유지) 성 깊은 곳에 꾸려놓은 자기 아지트로 가 버렸는데, 가는 길이 웬갖 함정이라…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(favi, { key = self.first_string_key .. 7, skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(favi)

	-- 선택지 출력
	local is_accept = self:show_choose_favi(favi)
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(favi, self.controller.get_favi_pre_section_marker().position,
			3, false, nil, nil, 'right')

	-- 수락한 것이 아니면 퀘스트 활성화를 하지 않는다.
	if not is_accept then
		return
	end

	-- 퀘스트 활성화
	yield_return_func(quest_util.activate_quest, self.controller)
end

-- 란팡에게 말걸었을 때 퀘스트 수락 여부
function local_class:interact_favi(favi)
	party_util.align_party(favi.Position, 'left', 0.5, 'arc')
	character_util.set_direction(favi, 'left')

	local is_accept = self:show_choose_favi(favi)
	character_util.set_direction(favi, 'right')

	-- 수락한 것이 아니면 퀘스트 활성화를 하지 않는다.
	if not is_accept then
		return
	end

	-- 퀘스트 활성화
	yield_return_func(quest_util.activate_quest, self.controller)
end

-- 파비 선택지
function local_class:show_choose_favi(favi)
	local princess = user_party.Leader

	-- 파비: (idle, idle) 공주님이 도망친 환자를 찾아주실 수 있을까요?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(favi, { key = self.first_string_key .. 8, skip = true })

	-- 선택지) 수락한다 / 거절한다.
	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event(
			{ { 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_ranpang_pre_choose_1', 'mercy' }
			, { 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_ranpang_pre_choose_2', 'brutal' } })

	if choose_result == 1 then
		-- 공주 : 내가 찾아볼게.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(princess, { name = 'nod', count = 2 })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, { key = self.first_string_key .. 11, skip = true })

		-- 수락한다 시 "(attack) 감사합니다. 몹시 불안정한 상태일 테니 조심하세요…"
		character_util.set_emotion(favi, { name = 'attack' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(favi, { key = self.first_string_key .. 9, skip = true })
		character_util.remove_emotion(favi)
	else
		-- 공주 : 미안… 지금은 좀 바빠서…
		character_util.set_emotion(princess, { name = 'tired' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, { key = self.first_string_key .. 12, skip = true })

		-- 거절한다 시 "(tired) 어쩔 수 없죠… 마음이 바뀌면 다시 와주세요."
		character_util.set_emotion(favi, { name = 'tired' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(favi, { key = self.first_string_key .. 10, skip = true })
	end
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(princess)

	return choose_result == 1
end

-- 란팡 방에 입장했을 때
function local_class:ranpang_room_enter()
	self.controller:ranpang_room_enter_event()

	-- 섹션을 1개 넘어서(란팡 이벤트로) 퀘스트 활성화
	yield_return_func(quest_util.activate_quest, self.controller, nil, 1)
end

function local_class:dispose()
end

return local_class
