function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.cur_section_state < self.section_state.qte_end then
		-- 란팡방의 배구공들과 상호작용 시
		for _, v in pairs(self.controller.volley_ball_data) do
			if e.Target.Name == v.object_name then
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_volley_balls, self, v.narration_key)
				return true
			end
		end
	else
		-- 파비 상호작용 확인
		local favi = self.controller.get_favi()
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, favi) then
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(favi, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_ranpang_interact_4' })
			return true
		end

		-- 서큐버스 상호작용 확인
		for i = 1, 2 do
			local succubus = self.controller.get_succubus(i)
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, succubus) then
				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(succubus, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_ranpang_interact_5' })
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local princess = user_party.Leader

	if self.cur_section_state == self.section_state.qte_end then
		if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, princess, self.room_zone_name) then
			-- qte 이벤트를 본 후 란팡 방을 나가려고 할 때
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.leave_ranpang_zone, self)
		elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, princess, self.puzzle_start_zone_name) then
			-- qte 이벤트를 본 후 란팡 퍼즐방 들어왔을 때
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.enter_puzzle_room, self)
		end
	elseif self.cur_section_state == self.section_state.play_puzzle then
		-- 퍼즐을 시작했으면서 3번 퍼즐 존에 등장했을 때
		for i = 1, 3 do
			if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, princess, self.get_ranpang_puzzle_zone_name(i)) then
				self:set_puzzle_count(i + 1)
				return true
			end
		end
	elseif self.cur_section_state == self.section_state.puzzle_end and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, princess, self.secret_room_zone_name) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.enter_secret_room, self)
	elseif self.cur_section_state == self.section_state.enter_secret_room and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, princess, self.event_zone_name) then
		-- 란팡 총난사 하는 지점 들어가서 엔딩 재생
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.ending, self)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_touch_event(e)
	if self.cur_section_state == self.section_state.step_one
			and e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeDown then
		self.qte_complete = true
		return true
	elseif self.cur_section_state == self.section_state.step_two
			and e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeLeft then
		self.qte_complete = true
		return true
	elseif self.cur_section_state == self.section_state.step_three
			and e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeRight then
		self.qte_complete = true
		return true
	elseif self.cur_section_state == self.section_state.enter_secret_room
			and e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeDown then
		self.qte_complete = true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_game_over_event(_)
	self.is_game_over = true
	if self.cur_section_state == self.section_state.play_puzzle then
		self.is_play_puzzle_room = false
	end
end

function local_class:on_field_object_revived_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader)
			and self.cur_section_state == self.section_state.play_puzzle then
		-- 퍼즐방 기믹 진행 중에 부활 한거라면 0.5초 후 퍼즐 기믹 재시작
		self.is_game_over = false
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.puzzle_room_bullet_routine, self, 0.5))
	end
end

function local_class:interact_volley_balls(narration_key)
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = narration_key, mintotalduration = 1 })
	self:ranpang_qte_event()
end

-- 란팡 qte이후 란팡 방을 나가려고 할 때
function local_class:leave_ranpang_zone()
	local princess = user_party.Leader

	-- 란팡을 찾아야해…!
	character_util.set_emotion(princess, { name = 'attack' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, { key = self.first_string_key .. 81, skip = true })
	character_util.remove_emotion(princess)
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(princess, princess.Position + unity_class.vector3.right * 2, 2, false)
end

-- 란팡 qte 이벤트
function local_class:ranpang_qte_event()
	local ranpang = self.controller.get_ranpang()
	local princess = user_party.Leader

	-- 이건…?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, { key = self.first_string_key .. 1, skip = true })

	-- 란팡 세팅
	character_util.set_active_state(ranpang, 'enabled')
	character_util.set_direction(ranpang, 'right')
	character_util.set_position(ranpang, vector(94, 0, 107.5))
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(ranpang)

	-- 공주 왼편으로 란팡이 dagger를 들고 들어오다가 공주를 발견
	character_util.set_anim(ranpang, { name = 'walk' })
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(ranpang, vector(101, 0, 107.5),
			3.5, false, nil, nil, 'right')
	character_util.remove_anim(ranpang)

	-- emoticon_bubble_exclmation을 띄우고 shout 말풍선으로 대사 후 공주를 밀친다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_notice_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(ranpang, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(ranpang, nil, 'notice')

	-- 란팡: (right, side, attack 표정) 내 동료들에게 손대지마아아!!!!
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_shaolin_intro', state = 'event' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_count_final_01')
	camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.2)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(ranpang, { key = self.first_string_key .. 2, bubble_type = 'shout'
	, skip = true })

	-- 란팡이 공주에게 뛰어간다.
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(ranpang, princess.Position + unity_class.vector3.left,
			7.5, true, nil, nil, 'right', true)

	-- 란팡이 공주를 공격.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_big_01')
	local anim_duration = CS.Oak.SpineControllerExtensions.GetAnimationDuration(ranpang.SpineController, 'boong_attack')
	character_util.spine_deviate_local(ranpang, vector(0.25, 0, 0), anim_duration * 0.6, anim_duration * 0.4)
	character_util.set_anim(ranpang, { name = 'boong_attack', scale = 1.5, loop = false, next_anim = 'boong_attack_ready_loop' })
	wait_for_sec(anim_duration * 0.5)

	-- 공주 왼쪽으로 밀림
	self.get_fx_hit():Instantiate(princess.Position + vector(0, 0.3, 0.1))
	character_util.shake(princess, 0.1, 0.3)
	character_util.set_direction(princess, 'left')
	character_util.set_emotion(princess, { name = 'damaged' })
	character_util.spine_deviate_local(princess, vector(-0.3, 0, 0), 0.2, 0.05)
	self:show_attack_effect(princess)
	character_util.move_to(princess, princess.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0), 0.15, nil,
			false, false)
	wait_for_sec(0.4)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(princess)
	wait_for_sec(0.4)

	-- 란팡: (right, side, attack 표정 boong_attack_ready) 인베이더인베이더인베이더… 또 내 동료들을 노리고…!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_evolution_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(ranpang, { key = self.first_string_key .. 3, skip = true })

	-- 란팡이 공주를 보고 놀람.
	character_util.set_emotion(princess, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.show_emoticon(princess, nil, 'notice')
	character_util.normal_double_jump(princess, '01_small_jump_01')
	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	-- 공주: (attack, left, side) ……란…팡…?!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	character_util.set_emotion(princess, { name = 'attack' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, { key = self.first_string_key .. 4, skip = true })

	-- 란팡 / 미래공주 초기 좌표
	local ranpang_start_pos = ranpang.Position
	local princess_start_pos = princess.Position

	-- 란팡 qte 연출 함수
	local qte_directing = function(qte_dir, next_state, qte_time, ranpang_ani_name, ani_scale, position)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_tap_guide_01')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_qte_action_wind_02')
		CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.QTESwipe(qte_dir)
		time_util.mod(self.mod_name, 0.2)
		if ranpang_ani_name ~= nil then
			character_util.set_anim(ranpang, { name = ranpang_ani_name, scale = ani_scale, loop = false })
			character_util.move_to(ranpang, position, 0.45, nil, false, false)
		end

		self.cur_section_state = next_state
		self.qte_complete = false
		local qte_delay = 0
		while qte_delay < qte_time do
			if self.qte_complete then
				yield_return_func(CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.QTEComplete, qte_time - qte_delay)
				break
			end

			qte_delay = qte_delay + unity_class.time.unscaledDeltaTime
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		time_util.unmod(self.mod_name)
		CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.CloseTutorialSpine()
	end

	-- qte 이벤트 시작
	self.is_qte_event = true
	self.cur_section_state = self.section_state.none
	while self.is_qte_event do
		-- 첫번째 qte 시작
		qte_directing('down', self.section_state.step_one, 1.5, 'twohand_attack4'
		, 3.5, princess.Position - vector(0.5, 0, 0))

		if self.qte_complete then
			-- 이전 qte 성공했으면 미래공주가 피한다.
			self.get_fx_jump_smoke():Instantiate(ranpang.Position + vector(0.8, 0.3, -0.2))
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_twohand_stomp_jump_01')
			character_util.move_to(princess, princess.Position + vector(0.5, 0, -1), 0.3)
			character_util.jump(princess, 0.5, 0.3)
			wait_for_sec(0.3)

			--  잠시만, 란팡…!
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, { key = self.first_string_key .. 5, skip = true })
			wait_for_sec(0.05)

			-- 두번째 qte 시작
			qte_directing('left', self.section_state.step_two, 1.5, 'sword_attack'
			, 0.45, princess.Position - vector(0.5, 0, 0))
		end

		if self.qte_complete then
			-- 이전 qte 성공했으면 미래공주가 백덤블링으로 피한다.
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_twohand_stomp_jump_01')
			character_util.set_emotion(princess, { name = 'attack' })
			character_util.set_anim(princess, { name = 'jump', loop = false, next_anim = 'basket_idle' })
			character_util.move_to(princess, princess.Position + unity_class.vector3.left * 2.5, 0.5)
			character_util.jump(princess, 1.25, 0.5)
			character_util.spine_rotate(princess, 360, 0.5)
			wait_for_sec(0.51)
			character_util.set_direction(princess, 'right')
			character_util.remove_anim(princess)

			-- 공주: 나야, 공주!
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, { key = self.first_string_key .. 6, skip = true })

			-- 공주: (release, attack 표정) 란팡, 정신차려! 날 보라고!
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
			character_util.set_anim(princess, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, { key = self.first_string_key .. 7, skip = true })

			-- 란팡: (현재 모션 유지) 내 이름 부르지 마, 이 개 같은 자식아!!!!
			-- 세번째 qte 시작
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_count_final_01')
			character_util.set_direction(ranpang, 'left')
			character_util.remove_anim(ranpang)
			character_util.set_anim(ranpang, { name = 'boong_attack_ready_loop' })
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(ranpang, { key = self.first_string_key .. 8, skip = true })
			character_util.remove_anim(princess)

			-- 공주: (idle, attack표정)이, 일단 진정을 시켜야…!
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, { key = self.first_string_key .. 9, skip = true })

			wait_for_sec(0.05)
			qte_directing('right', self.section_state.step_three, 1.5, nil
			, 2, princess.Position + vector(0.75, 0, 0))

			self.cur_section_state = self.section_state.qte_end
			if not self.qte_complete then
				character_util.set_anim(ranpang, { name = 'sword_attack_stab', scale = 2, loop = false })
				character_util.move_to_async(ranpang, princess.Position + vector(0.75, 0, 0)
				, 0.3, nil, false, false)
			end
		end

		if not self.qte_complete then
			-- qte 실패시 미래공주 쓰러지는 연출
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_critical_01')
			self.get_fx_hit():Instantiate(princess.Position + vector(0, 0.3, 0))
			character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(princess, { name = 'dead1', sfx_name = '01_hit_npc_01'
			, loop = false }, { name = 'damaged' })
			self:show_attack_effect(princess)
			wait_for_sec(2.5)

			screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

			self.cur_section_state = self.section_state.none

			-- 란팡 및 미래 공주 초기 자리로
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(ranpang)
			character_util.set_direction(ranpang, 'right')
			character_util.set_emotion(ranpang, { name = 'attack' })
			character_util.set_position(ranpang, ranpang_start_pos)

			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(princess)
			character_util.set_direction(princess, 'left')
			character_util.set_emotion(princess, { name = 'attack' })
			character_util.set_position(princess, princess_start_pos)
			character_util.spine_rotate(princess, 0, 0)
			wait_for_sec(0.75)

			screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
		else
			wait_for_sec(0.25)
			-- 마지막까지 qte 성공시 공주랑 란팡 둘이 충돌 난다.
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_twohand_stomp_jump_01')
			self.is_qte_event = false
			field:Darken('qte_end', 0.5, 0.2)
			time_util.mod(self.mod_name, 0.2)

			camera_util.resize_to(stage_camera:GetDefaultSize() - 1.25, 0.4)
			character_util.set_anim(princess, { name = 'sword_attack', scale = 0.35, loop = true })
			character_util.set_anim(ranpang, { name = 'sword_attack_stab', scale = 0.15, loop = true })
			character_util.move_waypoint(princess, princess.Position + vector(0.8, 1, 0)
			, 2.8, false, nil, 'flying')
			character_util.move_waypoint_async(ranpang, ranpang.Position + vector(-0.8, 1, 0)
			, 2.8, false, nil, 'flying')

			camera_util.shake(0.05, 0.15)
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_twohand_stomp_01')
			self.get_fx_hit():Instantiate(princess.Position + vector(0.2, 0, 0))
			self.get_fx_last_hit():Instantiate(princess.Position + vector(0.2, 0, 0))
			time_util.unmod(self.mod_name)
			camera_util.resize_to_default(0.4)
			field:Undarken('qte_end', 0.2)

			self:show_attack_effect(princess)
			character_util.remove_anim(princess)
			character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(princess, { name = 'damaged' }, { name = 'damaged' })
			character_util.move_to(princess, princess.Position + vector(-0.8, -1, 0),
					0.4, nil, false, false)

			self:show_attack_effect(ranpang)
			character_util.remove_anim(ranpang)
			character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(ranpang, { name = 'damaged' }, { name = 'damaged' })
			character_util.move_to_async(ranpang, ranpang.Position + vector(0.8, -1, 0),
					0.4, nil, false, false)

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_trip_01')
			self:show_attack_effect(princess)
			self.get_fx_jump_smoke():Instantiate(princess.Position + vector(-0.25, 0, 0))
			character_util.set_anim(princess, { name = 'prostrate' })

			self:show_attack_effect(ranpang)
			self.get_fx_jump_smoke():Instantiate(ranpang.Position)
			character_util.set_anim(ranpang, { name = 'prostrate' })

			wait_for_sec(1.2)
			break
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- exit 호출해서 qte 이벤트가 끝난거라면 return
	if self.is_exit then return end
	wait_for_sec(1.25)

	character_util.spine_rotate(princess, 360, 0)
	-- 란팡 캐릭터 shake 2회 후 tired 표정으로 일어서서 배구공들에게 (빠른 속도로) 이동해서 하나하나 eat 하며 대사
	for _ = 1, 2 do
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		character_util.shake(ranpang, 0.05, 0.5)
		wait_for_sec(1)
	end

	ranpang:HideWeapon(true)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(ranpang)
	character_util.set_emotion(ranpang, { name = 'scared' })
	character_util.normal_jump(ranpang, '01_small_jump_01')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 주변을 두리번 두리번 하고
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_direction(ranpang, 'right')
	wait_for_sec(0.75)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_direction(ranpang, 'left')
	wait_for_sec(0.75)
	character_util.remove_emotion(ranpang)
	character_util.set_emotion(ranpang, { name = 'damaged' })

	-- 란팡이 배구공 챙겨감
	local first_string_key_index = 9
	for i = 1, #self.controller.volley_ball_data do
		local volley_ball_data = self.controller.volley_ball_data[i]
		local volley_ball = get_field_object(volley_ball_data.object_name)

		local is_first = i == 1
		local last_dir = is_first and 'left' or 'right'
		local speed = is_first and 7 or 6
		character_util.move_waypoint_async(ranpang, vector(volley_ball.Position.x, 0, 109.25)
		, speed, true, nil, nil, last_dir, true)

		local sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true })
		character_util.set_anim(ranpang, { name = 'eat', scale = 1.5 })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(ranpang,
				{ key = self.first_string_key .. (first_string_key_index + i), life_time = 1, skip = true })
		character_util.remove_anim(ranpang)

		volley_ball_data.drop_item.ConsumeTarget = ranpang
		volley_ball_data.drop_item = nil
		volley_ball.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
		wait_for_sec(0.5)
		sfx:Stop()
	end

	-- 문이 열리고 란팡이 위 공간으로 사라짐
	self:set_ranpang_room_door(true, 1)
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(ranpang, { ranpang.Position + unity_class.vector3.right * 2
	, ranpang.Position + vector(2, 0, 5) }, 7, true, nil, nil
	, 'right', true)

	-- 란팡 다음 지점으로 이동 및 무기 게틀링 건으로 변경
	local ranpang_pos = self.get_ranpang_puzzle_point().position
	self:changed_ranpang_weapon(ranpang, ranpang_pos, false)

	--공주 캐릭터 shake 2회 후 일어섬. 컨트롤 돌아옴.
	for _ = 1, 2 do
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		character_util.shake(princess, 0.05, 0.5)
		wait_for_sec(1)
	end
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(princess)
	character_util.set_emotion(princess, { name = 'attack' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_popup_01')
	character_util.mario_jump_async(princess, 'right', 0.5, 0.5)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(princess)
end

-- qte 이벤트 끝내고 퍼즐방 첫 총쏘는 부분 입장

	for i = 1, 2 do
		self:set_ranpang_room_door(i ~= 1, i, true)

	self:stop_shoot_sfx(0)

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.show_bullet_effect,
			self, ranpang, 0.2, false))

	character_util.set_direction(princess, 'right')
	character_util.set_emotion(princess, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.move_to(princess, princess.Position + unity_class.vector3.left * 1.2, 0.5)
	character_util.jump(princess, 1, 0.5)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 란팡 총쏘는 애니메이션으로 변경
	self.is_loop_bullet_effect = true
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.set_random_bullet_target_pos, self
	, vector(114, 0, 121.5), vector(111, 0, 121.5), 0.5))
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.show_bullet_effect, self
	, ranpang, 0, true, false))
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(ranpang, { name = 'rifle_shoot2' }, { name = 'attack' })
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 란팡에게 카메라 보여줌
	camera_util.move_async(self.get_ranpang_puzzle_point().position, 0.5)
	wait_for_sec(1)
	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)

	self.is_loop_bullet_effect = false
	self.cur_section_state = self.section_state.play_puzzle

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(princess)
	self:stop_shoot_sfx(0)

-- 공격 받을 때 스파인 이팩트 함수
function local_class:show_attack_effect(target)
	character_util.spine_pulse_color(target, CS.Oak.Constants.DamageColor, 1, 1, 0.5)
	character_util.spine_damage_squish(target, 1.3, 0.7, 1, 0.2)
end

-- 퍼즐 카운트 올리는 함수
function local_class:set_puzzle_count(index)
	if self.puzzle_count >= index then
		return
	end

	-- 패턴크기보다 크면 끝난거니 패턴 종료
	if index > #self.puzzle_pattens then
		self.is_play_puzzle_room = false
		self.is_active_bullet_puzzle_room = false

		self.cur_section_state = self.section_state.puzzle_end
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.run_ranpang_routine, self))
		return
	end

	self.puzzle_count = index
end

-- 란팡방 총알 쏘는 루틴
function local_class:puzzle_room_bullet_routine(wait_time)
	self.is_play_puzzle_room = false

	wait_time = lua_helper.get_or_default(wait_time, 0.1)
	wait_for_sec(wait_time)

	local ranpang = self.controller.get_ranpang()
	character_util.set_anim(ranpang, { name = 'rifle_shoot2' })
	local princess = user_party.Leader

	local bullet_term = 0.015
	self.is_play_puzzle_room = true
	self.is_active_bullet_puzzle_room = true

	while self.is_play_puzzle_room do
		local cur_puzzle_count = self.puzzle_count
		local cur_patten_data = self.puzzle_pattens[cur_puzzle_count]

		if cur_patten_data ~= nil then
			local is_move = cur_patten_data.is_move
			local end_pos = cur_patten_data.end_pos
			local duration = cur_patten_data.bullet_duration
			local bullet_target_pos = cur_patten_data.start_pos

			local time_passed = 0
			self:stop_shoot_sfx(0)
			self.shoot_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_gun_shoot_07'
			, loop = true, play_pos = bullet_target_pos })
			while time_passed < duration do
				if cur_puzzle_count ~= self.puzzle_count then break end
				time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime + bullet_term

				-- 총알이 움직여야 한다면 좌표 보정
				if is_move then
					local progress = time_passed / duration
					bullet_target_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(cur_patten_data.start_pos, end_pos, progress)
				end

				-- 총알 이팩트 연출
				self:instantiate_fx_bullet_effect(ranpang.Position, bullet_target_pos, self.is_play_puzzle_room, false)

				-- 0.2초가 지났으면서 플레이어가 영역안에 들어왔다면 퍼즐 실패
				local distance = math.abs(vector_util.get_x0z(princess.Position - bullet_target_pos).magnitude)
				if time_passed > 0.2 and distance <= self.bullet_radius and self.is_play_puzzle_room then
					if not lua_helper.type_compare(princess.FieldObjectController.CurrentState,
							CS.Oak.CharacterControllerScreenplayState) then
						coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.fail_puzzle, self))
						self.is_play_puzzle_room = false
						self:stop_shoot_sfx()
						break
					end
				else
					wait_for_sec(bullet_term)
				end
				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end
			self:stop_shoot_sfx()

			-- 퍼즐 이 끝났으면 바로 break
			if not self.is_play_puzzle_room then break end

			-- 대기 시간동안 총쏘는 위치가 다른 위치로 바뀐다면 바로 다음 총 쏘는 패턴으로
			time_passed = 0
			while time_passed < cur_patten_data.shot_delay do
				time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
				if cur_puzzle_count ~= self.puzzle_count then break end
				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

-- 퍼즐방에서 총알 맞아 죽는 함수
function local_class:fail_puzzle()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	local princess = user_party.Leader
	local ranpang = self.controller.get_ranpang()

	-- 안드로이드 헤드(또는 다른 물체)를 들고 있으면 내려놓는다.
	if lua_helper.type_compare(princess.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentActionState,
			typeof(CS.Oak.CharacterHoldUpState)) then
		local hold_target = princess.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentActionState.HoldTarget
		character_util.release_hold_object(princess, hold_target)
	end

	-- 공주가 쓰러짐
	character_util.set_anim(ranpang, { name = 'rifle_idle' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_critical_01')
	princess.OverrideCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
	self:show_attack_effect(princess)
	character_util.set_direction(princess, 'right')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(princess, { name = 'dead1', sfx_name = '01_hit_npc_01'
	, loop = false }, { name = 'damaged' })
	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	-- 게임오버 되있다면 오버라이드 크래쉬 비헤이비어만 돌려 놓고 리턴
	if self.is_game_over then
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(princess)
		princess.OverrideCrashBehaviour = nil
		return
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_01')
	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(0.5, 'linear')

	-- 공주를 첫 시작점으로 이동
	self.puzzle_count = 1
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(princess)
	character_util.set_position(princess, self.get_respawn_point().position)
	princess.OverrideCrashBehaviour = nil
	wait_for_sec(1)

	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(0.5, 'linear')

	-- 퍼즐방 총알 루틴 재시작
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.puzzle_room_bullet_routine, self))
	party_util.reset_controllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()
end

-- 퍼즐방에서 란팡이 놀라서 도망가는 루틴
function local_class:run_ranpang_routine()
	local ranpang = self.controller.get_ranpang()
	ranpang.OverrideCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance

	-- 란팡 놀라며 점프
	ranpang:HideWeapon(true)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(ranpang)
	character_util.set_direction(ranpang, 'left')
	character_util.set_emotion(ranpang, { name = 'scared' })
	character_util.normal_jump(ranpang, '01_small_jump_01')
	wait_for_sec(0.25)

	-- 란팡이 위로 도망감
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(ranpang, {
		ranpang.Position + unity_class.vector3.right * 0.5,
		ranpang.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 13) }
	, 9, true, nil, nil, 'right', true)

	-- 란팡 다음 지점 배구공 세팅 및 무기 변경
	local ranpang_pos = self.get_hide_point(1).position
	self:changed_ranpang_weapon(ranpang, ranpang_pos, true)
	for i = 1, #self.controller.volley_ball_data do
		local data = self.controller.volley_ball_data[i]
		local is_knight_ball = i == #self.controller.volley_ball_data
		local pos = vector(is_knight_ball and 0 or 0.5, 0, (is_knight_ball and 0.6 or i * 0.5))
		local drop_item = drop_item_util.create_item(
				{ pos = ranpang_pos - pos, itemid = data.item_id
				, notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter' })
		drop_item.ShadowTransform.localPosition = vector(0, 0, -0.03)
		self.controller.volley_ball_data[i].drop_item = drop_item
	end
	ranpang.OverrideCrashBehaviour = nil
end

-- 란팡 게틀링건으로 바꾸는 함수
function local_class:changed_ranpang_weapon(ranpang, pos, is_right)
	ranpang.SpineController.AlwaysUpdateSpine = true
	ranpang:HideWeapon(false)
	coroutine.yield(nil)
	ranpang.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', 'gatling_gun')
	ranpang.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon2', 'empty')

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(ranpang)
	character_util.set_position(ranpang, pos)
	character_util.set_direction(ranpang, is_right and 'right' or 'left')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(ranpang, { name = 'rifle_idle', mix_duration = 0 }
	, { name = 'attack' })

	coroutine.yield(nil)
	coroutine.yield(nil)
	coroutine.yield(nil)
	ranpang.SpineController.AlwaysUpdateSpine = false
end

-- 란팡의 숨겨진 방에 입장하였을 때
function local_class:enter_secret_room()
	-- NPC 세팅
	local princess = user_party.Leader
	local ranpang = self.controller.get_ranpang()
	local favi = self.controller.get_favi()
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(favi)
	local succubus_members = {}
	for i = 1, 2 do
		local succubus = self.controller.get_succubus(i)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(succubus)
		table.insert(succubus_members, succubus)
	end

	-- bullet_target_pos을 타겟 좌표까지 이동 시켜주는 함수
	local move_target_pos = function(target_pos, duration)
		local time_passed = 0
		local start_pos = self.bullet_target_pos
		while time_passed < duration do
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			local progress = time_passed / duration
			self.bullet_target_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, target_pos, progress)
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end

	-- enter_secret_room State로 변경
	self.cur_section_state = self.section_state.enter_secret_room

	-- 특정 지점으로 정렬
	party_util.align_party(vector(127.75, 0, 139), 'right', 1, 'linear')

	-- 위 공간에 입장하면 총알bullet.png과 함께 총알 튀는 이펙트FX_GunShot_Groundhit가 공주 앞으로 출력. 공주 attack 표정으로 점프 1회.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_gun_shoot_07')
	self.bullet_target_pos = princess.Position + unity_class.vector3.left * 1.2
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.show_bullet_effect, self, ranpang, 0.2))
	character_util.set_emotion(princess, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.normal_jump(princess, '01_small_jump_01')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 아래 QTE로 우하단 바리케이트 뒤에 숨는다(숨은 자세 left, side, meditation)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_tap_guide_01');
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.QTESwipe('down')
	CS.GlobalTimeManager.Instance:Mod(0.2, self.mod_name)
	self.qte_complete = false
	while not self.qte_complete do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
	CS.GlobalTimeManager.Instance:Unmod(self.mod_name)
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.CloseTutorialSpine()

	-- 공주가 아래로 숨음
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(princess, self.get_hide_point(2).position, 6, true

-- 일정 영역안에 랜덤하게 bullet_target_pos를 지정해 주는 함수
function local_class:set_random_bullet_target_pos(min, max, duration)
	while self.is_loop_bullet_effect do
		self.bullet_target_pos = vector(CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(min.x, max.x),
				0, CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(min.z, max.z))
		local time_passed = 0
		while time_passed < duration do
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			if not self.is_loop_bullet_effect then break end
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end
end

-- ranpang_shout_point들 중에 랜덤으로 쏘는 함수
function local_class:point_delay_bullet_effect(shooter, min_value, max_value)
	self.is_loop_point_bullet = false
	wait_for_sec(0.05)
	self.is_loop_point_bullet = true

	self:stop_shoot_sfx()

	min_value = lua_helper.get_or_default(min_value, 1)
	while self.is_loop_point_bullet do
		local rnd = random_util.get_random_int(min_value, max_value)
		local bullet_target_pos = self.get_shout_point(rnd).position

		self:stop_shoot_sfx()
		self.shoot_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_gun_shoot_07'
		, loop = true, play_pos = bullet_target_pos })
		local time_passed = 0
		while time_passed < 0.15 or self.is_loop_bullet_effect do
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			self:instantiate_fx_bullet_effect(shooter.Position, bullet_target_pos)
			if not self.is_loop_point_bullet then break end
			wait_for_sec(self.directing_bullet_term)
		end
		self:stop_shoot_sfx()

		if not self.is_loop_point_bullet then break end
		wait_for_sec(0.2)
	end
end

-- 일정 시간 또는 bool 값이 true일 때 동안 bullet_target_pos에 이팩트를 그려주는 함수
function local_class:show_bullet_effect(shooter, effect_time, is_play_gun_fire, is_right_dir)
	local time_passed = 0
	is_right_dir = lua_helper.get_or_default(is_right_dir, true)
	is_play_gun_fire = lua_helper.get_or_default(is_play_gun_fire, true)

	while time_passed < effect_time or self.is_loop_bullet_effect do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		self:instantiate_fx_bullet_effect(shooter.Position, self.bullet_target_pos
		, is_play_gun_fire, is_right_dir)
		wait_for_sec(self.directing_bullet_term)
	end
end

function local_class:instantiate_fx_bullet_effect(shooter_pos, pos, is_play_gun_fire, direction)
	local rad = math.pi * CS.UnityEngine.Random.value * 2
	local range = self.bullet_radius * 0.7

	local cur_x = math.cos(rad) * CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(0.15, range)
	local cur_z = math.sin(rad) * CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(0.15, range)

	-- 총 쏘는 이팩트, 이팩트를 재생해야 할 때만 재생한다
	is_play_gun_fire = lua_helper.get_or_default(is_play_gun_fire, true)
	if is_play_gun_fire then
		local cur_dir = lua_helper.get_or_default(direction, true)
		local effect_x = cur_dir and 0.8 or -0.8
		local fx_gun_fire = self:get_fx_gun_fire():Instantiate(shooter_pos + vector(effect_x, 1, -0.5))
		fx_gun_fire.transform.localScale = vector(cur_dir and 1 or -1, 1, 1)
	end

	-- 총알 이팩트
	self.get_fx_gunshot_ground_hit():Instantiate(pos + vector(cur_x, 0, cur_z))
end

	, user.Name), skip = true })

	character_util.set_emotion(princess, { name = 'tired' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, { key = self.first_string_key .. 74, skip = true })
	character_util.remove_emotion(princess)

	-- 파비 끄덕 끄덕
	character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(favi, { name = 'nod', count = 2, keep_anim = false })
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 파비: (left, side, idle, idle) 저도 어서 병동으로 가봐야겠어요.

-- 첫번째 선택지 이벤트
function local_class:first_choose_event(princess, ranpang)
	-- 공주가 바리게이트로 이동
	character_util.remove_anim(princess)
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(princess, vector(125.5, 0, 139),
			6, true, nil, nil, 'left', true)
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(princess, { name = 'meditation' }, { name = 'attack' })

	-- 공주 : 란팡…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, { key = self.first_string_key .. 21, skip = true })

	-- 나야, 공주! / 당장 사격을 멈춰!
	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({ { self.first_choose_string_key .. 1, 'mercy' }
	, { self.first_choose_string_key .. 2, 'brutal' } })

	if choose_result == 2 then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	end

	self:release_and_talk(princess, self.first_choose_string_key .. choose_result)

	-- 란팡: (damaged, right, side, rifle_shoot2) 입 닥쳐! 내가 몇 번이고 속을 줄 알아?!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(ranpang, { key = self.first_string_key .. 22, skip = true })

	-- 란팡: (캐릭터 shake+ damaged, right, side, rifle_reload 모션 후 대사) 이번엔 누구로 위장하시려고?!
	self.is_loop_point_bullet = false
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_gun_reload_03')
	local anim_duration = CS.Oak.SpineControllerExtensions.GetAnimationDuration(ranpang.SpineController, 'rifle_reload')
	character_util.set_anim(ranpang, { name = 'rifle_reload', loop = false, next_anim = 'rifle_idle' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(ranpang, { key = self.first_string_key .. 23, skip = true })

	-- 란팡: (damaged, right, side, rifle_shoot2(+총알bullet.png 우다다다 튀어나옴 + 바리케이트에 총알 튀는 이펙트FX_GunShot_Groundhit)) 용감하고 기특한 마을 꼬맹이?!
	character_util.set_anim(ranpang, { name = 'rifle_shoot2' })
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.point_delay_bullet_effect, self, ranpang, 1, 5))
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(ranpang, { key = self.first_string_key .. 24, skip = true })

	-- 란팡: (모션+이펙트 유지) 부유성의 공주?!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(ranpang, { key = self.first_string_key .. 25, skip = true })

	-- 란팡: (모션+이펙트 유지) 또 내 동료들이 당하게 놔둘 줄 알아?!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(ranpang, { name = 'damaged' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(ranpang, { key = self.first_string_key .. 26, skip = true })

	-- 선택지(선택지 고르면 공주가 해당 대사 함) 네가 모두를 위험하게 하고 있어!/ 사람들이 너를 두려워하고 있어!
	choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({ { self.first_choose_string_key .. 3, 'brutal' }
	, { self.first_choose_string_key .. 4, 'normal' } })

	-- 공주 선택지 대사
	self:release_and_talk(princess, self.first_choose_string_key .. (choose_result + 2))

	-- 란팡: (right, side, rifle_reload 모션 후 대사) 아니! 이곳엔 나와 너희 인베이더 밖에 없어!!
	self.is_loop_point_bullet = false
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_gun_reload_03')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(ranpang, { name = 'rifle_reload', loop = false, next_anim = 'rifle_idle' },
			{ name = 'attack' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(ranpang, { key = self.first_string_key .. 27, skip = true })

	-- 란팡: (damaged, right, side, rifle_shoot2(+총알bullet.png 우다다다 튀어나옴 + 바리케이트에 총알 튀는 이펙트FX_GunShot_Groundhit))
	-- 너희가 다 죽기 전에 이건 끝나지 않아!!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	character_util.set_anim(ranpang, { name = 'rifle_shoot2' })
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.point_delay_bullet_effect, self, ranpang, 1, 5))
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(ranpang, { key = self.first_string_key .. 28, skip = true })

	-- 공주 표정 tired로 ……. 대사. 표정 idle로 돌아옴.
	character_util.set_emotion(princess, { name = 'tired' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, { key = '……', skip = true })
	character_util.remove_emotion(princess)
end

-- 두번째 선택지 이벤트
function local_class:second_choose_event(princess, ranpang)
	-- 공주가 다음 바리게이트로 이동
	character_util.remove_anim(princess)
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(princess, {
		princess.Position + unity_class.vector3.forward * 2,
		vector(122.5, 0, 141)
	}, 6, true, nil, nil, 'left', true)
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(princess, { name = 'meditation' }, { name = 'attack' })

	-- 전투는 끝났어, 란팡!
	local string_key = self.first_choose_string_key .. 5
	choose_util.play_choose_event({ { string_key, 'mercy' } })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_count_final_01')
	self:release_and_talk(princess, string_key)

	-- 란팡: (left, side, tired, rifle_shoot2 애니메이션 재생x, 자세 고정) 끝… 나…?
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })
	self.is_loop_point_bullet = false
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(ranpang)
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(ranpang, { name = 'rifle_idle' }, { name = 'tired' })
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(ranpang, nil, 'silence')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(ranpang, { key = self.first_string_key .. 29, skip = true })

	-- 란팡: (모션 유지, attack 표정) 무슨 소리를 하는 거야…!
	character_util.set_emotion(ranpang, { name = 'attack' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(ranpang, { key = self.first_string_key .. 30, skip = true })

	-- 란팡: (right, side, attack 표정으로 shout 말풍선, 화면 약간 shake) 아무것도 끝나지 않았어! (공주 깜짝 놀라 점프 후 tired 표정)
	character_util.remove_emotion(princess)
	character_util.normal_jump(princess, true)

	camera_util.shake(0.07, 0.2)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(ranpang, { key = self.first_string_key .. 31, bubble_type = 'shout', skip = true })

	character_util.remove_emotion(princess)
	character_util.set_emotion(princess, { name = 'tired' })

	-- 란팡: (표정 유지, shout 말풍선, 란팡이 들고 있던 개틀링 건을 아래로 집어 던진다) 아무것도!
	ranpang:HideWeapon(true)
	character_util.set_direction(ranpang, 'down')
	character_util.set_anim(ranpang, { name = 'attack', loop = false, remove_after = 0.5 })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(ranpang, { key = self.first_string_key .. 32, bubble_type = 'shout'
	, life_time = 1.5, force_sfx = true })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_throw_01')
	local start_pos = ranpang.Bounds.center + vector(0.2, 0, 0)
	local end_pos = ranpang.Position
	local gatling_gun = drop_item_util.create_item(
			{ itemid = 20406, notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', pos = start_pos, sprscale = 0.7 })
	gatling_gun.ShadowTransform.localPosition = vector(0, 0, -0.03)

	for i = 1, 3 do
		start_pos = end_pos
		end_pos = end_pos + vector(0, 0, -1.05 + (i * 0.2))
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gun_ready_01')
		sp_util.sine_move(gatling_gun, { from = start_pos, to = end_pos
		, duration = 0.6 - (0.1 * i), height = 1 * (0.5 / i) })

function local_class:set_ranpang_room_door(is_open, index, immediate)
	immediate = lua_helper.get_or_default(immediate, false)
	if is_open then
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create(self.ranpang_room_door_first_name .. index, immediate))
	else
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create(self.ranpang_room_door_first_name .. index, immediate))
	end
end

function local_class:stop_shoot_sfx(fade_time)
	if self.shoot_sfx == nil then
		return
	end

	fade_time = lua_helper.get_or_default(fade_time, 0.35)
	if fade_time <= 0 then
		self.shoot_sfx:Stop()
	else
		self.shoot_sfx:FadeOut(fade_time)
	end

	self.shoot_sfx = nil
end

function local_class:dispose()
end

return local_class

local local_class = newclass('NightmareFutureCastleFatElfSection1')

--[[QuestAttribute
      Type = progress@
      QuestName = NightmareFutureCastleFatElf @
      Comment = 악몽 미래부유성 체한 뚱보 엘프 이벤트 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	-- 뚱보 시작 이벤트를 봤는지
	self.saw_fat_elf = false

	-- 어린애들 이벤트를 봤는지
	self.saw_kid_start = false
	self.saw_kid_end = false

	self.get_kid_boy = function() return get_character('kid_boy') end
	self.get_kid_girl = function() return get_character('kid_girl') end
	self.get_fat_elf = function() return get_character('fat_elf') end

	self.get_elf_chair = function() return get_field_object('fat_elf_chair') end
	self.get_fall_chair = function() return get_field_object('fall_chair') end
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_custom_stage_event')

	-- 꼬마들 세팅
	local kid_position = field:GetMarker('kid_boy_point').position
	local kid_boy = self.get_kid_boy()
	character_util.set_position(kid_boy, kid_position)
	character_util.set_direction(kid_boy, 'left')
	character_util.set_emotion(kid_boy, { name = 'smile' })

	local kid_girl = self.get_kid_girl()
	character_util.set_position(kid_girl, kid_position + vector(0,0,-1))
	character_util.set_direction(kid_girl, 'left')
	character_util.set_emotion(kid_girl, { name = 'smile' })

	-- 의자 세팅
	local chair = self.get_fall_chair()
	chair.Holdable = CS.Oak.Holdable()
	chair.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
	command_util.execute_holdup(kid_girl, chair, kid_girl.Position, 0.1, false)

	-- 뚱보 엘프 세팅
	local fat_elf_position = field:GetMarker('fat_elf_point').position
	local fat_elf = self.get_fat_elf()
	character_util.set_position(fat_elf, fat_elf_position)
	character_util.set_direction(fat_elf, 'right')
	character_util.set_emotion(fat_elf, { name = 'damaged' })
	character_util.set_anim(fat_elf, { name = 'idle' })

	character_util.add_listener(fat_elf, self.controller)

	local chair2 = self.get_elf_chair()

	chair2.Position = field:GetMarker('fall_out_point').position + vector(-0.5,0,-0.5)

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()

	character_util.remove_relate_event(fat_elf, self.controller)

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))

end

function local_class:dispose()

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_fat_elf())
			and self.controller.current_progress == self.controller.event_progress.none then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.request_fat_elf, self)
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if not e.FullEnter then return end
	if e.FieldObject ~= user_party.Leader then return end
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == 'kid_zone' and not self.saw_kid_start then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.saw_kid_zone, self))
		return true
	elseif zone_name == 'fat_elf_zone' and not self.saw_fat_elf then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.saw_fat_elf_zone, self))
		return true
	elseif zone_name == 'dash_zone' and
			(self.controller.current_progress == self.controller.event_progress.accept or
					self.controller.current_progress == self.controller.event_progress.move_elf ) and
		lua_helper.type_compare(e.FieldObject.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentState, CS.Oak.CharacterForcedDashState) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.crash_fat_elf, self)
		return true
	elseif zone_name == 'kid_release_zone' and not self.saw_kid_end then
		self.saw_kid_end = true
		local kid_boy = self.get_kid_boy()
		local kid_girl = self.get_kid_girl()
		character_util.set_position(kid_boy, vector(999,0,999))
		character_util.set_position(kid_girl, vector(999,0,999))
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	if e:GetParamAt(0) == self.controller.fall_event_name then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.fall_down_success, self))
		return true
	end
	return false
end
--endregion

-- 아이들이 의자를 던지는 이벤트
function local_class:saw_kid_zone()
	self.saw_kid_start = true

	local fall_in_position = field:GetMarker('fall_in_point').position
	local kid_boy = self.get_kid_boy()
	local kid_girl = self.get_kid_girl()
	local chair = self.get_fall_chair()

	-- 빨리 더 던져봐!
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_positive_01', parent = kid_boy })
	character_util.set_direction(kid_boy, 'down')
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(kid_boy, { name = 'release', count = 2, sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(kid_boy,
			{ key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_fat_elf_1', bubble_direction = 'lt' })

	-- 하하, 알겠어!
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_ghost_laugh_evil_01', parent = kid_girl })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(kid_girl, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_fat_elf_2' })
	command_util.execute_throw(kid_girl, chair, vector(-1,0,0.5), fall_in_position, 2, true)
	chair.Holdable = CS.Oak.NonHoldable.Instance
	sp_util.sine_move(chair, { from = chair.Position, to = fall_in_position, duration = 1, height = 2})

	character_util.set_direction(kid_boy, 'left')
	wait_for_sec(1)

	if self.saw_kid_end then
		chair.Position = vector(999,0,999)
		return
	end

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
		local sink_sand = music_player:PlaySfx({ sfxName = '01_sink_sand_01', loop = true, parent = chair })
		character_util.move_to_async(chair, chair.Position + vector(0,-1,0), 4)
		chair.Position = vector(999,0,999)
		sink_sand:Stop()
	end ))

	if self.saw_kid_end then return end

	wait_for_sec(1)

	if self.saw_kid_end then return end

	-- 하하, 슉 하고 빨려들어가는 것 봐
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_slide_01', parent = kid_girl })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(kid_girl, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_fat_elf_3' })
	-- 다음엔 뭘 던질까?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(kid_boy, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_fat_elf_4' })

	kid_girl.Interactable.Talk = 'nightmare_futurecastle_fat_elf_3'
	kid_boy.Interactable.Talk = 'nightmare_futurecastle_fat_elf_4'
end

function local_class:saw_fat_elf_zone()
	self.saw_fat_elf = true
	local fat_elf = self.get_fat_elf()

	-- 우욱… 누가 도와줘…!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(fat_elf,
			{ key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_fat_elf_5', offset = vector(2.5, 3, 0) })
	if self.controller.current_progress == self.controller.event_progress.accept then return end

	-- 배가 너무 아파… 켁…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(fat_elf,
			{ key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_fat_elf_6', offset = vector(2.5, 3, 0) })
end

-- 뚱보 엘프의 부탁
function local_class:request_fat_elf()
	self.controller.current_progress = self.controller.event_progress.accept

	local fat_elf = self.get_fat_elf()

	party_util.align_to_target(fat_elf, 'right', 1, 'linear')

	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(fat_elf)

	-- 괜찮아 친구? 갑자기 왜 그러는거야?
	character_util.set_emotion(user_party.Leader, { name = 'idle' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(user_party.Leader,
			{ key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_fat_elf_7', skip = true })

	-- 너무 많이 먹었나… 갑자기 배가…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(fat_elf,
			{ key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_fat_elf_8', skip = true, offset = vector(2.5, 3, 0) })

	-- 윽… 너무 아파…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.set_anim(fat_elf, { name = 'unique/lie', mix_duration = 0.4 })

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(user_party.Leader,
			{ key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_fat_elf_10', skip = true })

	-- 잠깐 기다리고 있어, 내가 도와줄게!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')

-- 가속페달을 밟은 상태로 부딪칠 경우
function local_class:crash_fat_elf()
	local fat_elf = self.get_fat_elf()
	local chair = self.get_elf_chair()
	local fall_out_pos = field:GetMarker('fall_out_point').position

	character_util.set_emotion(user_party.Leader, { name = 'surprise' })
	character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'embarrassed' })

	-- 엘프에게 다가간 후 튕겨저 나감
	character_util.move_to_async(user_party.Leader, fat_elf.Position + vector(0,0,0.5), nil, 7)

	-- 플레이어 튕겨저 나감
	character_util.move_to(user_party.Leader, user_party.Leader.Position + vector(0,0,1), 0.3)

-- 뚱보 엘프의 배 위로 떨어질 경우
function local_class:fall_down_success()
	self.controller.current_progress = self.controller.event_progress.clear

	local fat_elf = self.get_fat_elf()
	local fall_time = 1
	local fall_party_delay = fall_time / user_party.Count
	local out_point = field:GetMarker('fall_out_point').position

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		local party = user_party[i]
		character_util.set_position(party, out_point + vector(0, 15, 0))
	end

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		local party = user_party[i]
		character_util.spine_scale(party, unity_class.vector3.one, 0)
		character_util.set_direction(party, 'down')

		character_util.set_active_shadow(party, true)
		-- 일정 시간 동안 자유낙하하는 캐릭터 연출
		local freefall_character = function(character, fall_time, offset_y, fat_elf)
			local curtime = unity_class.time.time
			local falltime = fall_time
			local curpos = character.Position
			local freefall = CS.CalculatorFreeFall(falltime, curpos.y, 0)
			offset_y = lua_helper.get_or_default(offset_y, 0)

			local shadow_offset_origin = character.SpineController.ShadowTransform.localPosition
			local shadow_offset = vector(0, -0.3, -0.1)

			while unity_class.time.time - curtime < falltime do
				freefall:Proceed(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
				local dist_y = freefall:GetDistance()

				local y = curpos.y + dist_y + offset_y
				if y < offset_y then
					y = offset_y
				end
				character_util.set_position(character, vector(curpos.x, y, curpos.z), true)
				character.SpineController.ShadowTransform.localPosition = shadow_offset_origin + shadow_offset + vector(0, -y + 1, 0)

				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fat_gnome_03')
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_jump_01')

			character_util.set_anim(fat_elf, { name = 'unique/jiggling', loop = false })
			character_util.jump(character, 0.5, 0.5)
			character_util.move_to_async(character, vector(curpos.x + 1 + i, 0, curpos.z), 0.5)
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_land_01')

			character_util.remove_anim(character)
			character.SpineController.ShadowTransform.localPosition = shadow_offset_origin
		end
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
				util.cs_generator(freefall_character, party, fall_time, 0.5, fat_elf))

		wait_for_sec(fall_party_delay)
		if i == 0 then
			character_util.set_emotion(party, { name = 'surprise' })
			character_util.set_anim(party, { name = 'embarrassed' })
		else
			character_util.set_anim(party, { name = 'get' })
		end
	end

	wait_for_sec(1.5)
	party_util.remove_emotion()
	party_util.align_to_target(fat_elf, 'right', 1, 'linear')

	-- 우욱!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(user_party.Leader, { name = 'surprise' })
	character_util.set_anim(fat_elf, { name = 'unique/lie' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(fat_elf,
			{ key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_fat_elf_14', skip = true, bubble_type = 'shout' })

	-- 우웩!!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_throwup_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fat_gnome_03')
	character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'embarrassed' })
	character_util.normal_jump(user_party.Leader, true)

	camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.3)
	character_util.set_anim(fat_elf, { name = 'unique/jiggling' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(fat_elf,
			{ key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_fat_elf_15', skip = true, bubble_type = 'shout' })

	local ham_id = 20248
	local banquet_id = 20263
	local carrot_id = 20014
	local cheese_id = 20043

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_field_item_popup_01')
	drop_item_util.create_item({ pos = fat_elf.Position + vector(-0.5,0.2,0.1),
								 target = fat_elf.Position + vector(1.5, 0, 2),
								itemid = ham_id, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', notforinven = true })

	wait_for_sec(0.2)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_field_item_popup_01')
	drop_item_util.create_item({ pos = fat_elf.Position + vector(-0.5,0.2,0.1),
								 target = fat_elf.Position + vector(1.7, 0, 1.2),
								itemid = banquet_id, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', notforinven = true })

	wait_for_sec(0.2)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_field_item_popup_01')
	drop_item_util.create_item({ pos = fat_elf.Position + vector(-0.5,0.2,0.1),
								 target = fat_elf.Position + vector(1.6, 0, 1.8),
								 itemid = carrot_id, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', notforinven = true })

	wait_for_sec(0.2)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_field_item_popup_01')
	drop_item_util.create_item({ pos = fat_elf.Position + vector(-0.5,0.2,0.1),
								 target = fat_elf.Position + vector(1.2, 0, 1.5),
								 itemid = cheese_id, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', notforinven = true })

	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	-- 스타피스 등장시 그림자 제거
	local star_piece = get_field_object('fat_elf_star_piece')
	star_piece:OnEvent(CS.Oak.StarPieceAppearEvent.Create(fat_elf.Position + vector(-0.5,0.2,0.1), false))
	wait_for_sec(2)

	character_util.set_anim(fat_elf, { name = 'unique/lie' })

	-- 우와!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader, { name = 'idle'}, { name = 'surprise' })
	character_util.normal_double_jump(user_party.Leader, true)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(user_party.Leader,
			{ key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_fat_elf_16', skip = true })
	character_util.remove_emotion(user_party.Leader)

	-- 고마워! 덕분에 속이 시원해졌어.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(fat_elf, { name = 'idle', mix_duration = 0.4 }, { name = 'idle' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(fat_elf,
			{ key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_fat_elf_17', skip = true, offset = vector(2.5, 3, 0) })

	character_util.set_anim(fat_elf, { name = 'idle' })

	-- 내가 언제 저런 돌덩이를 먹은거지…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(fat_elf,
			{ key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_fat_elf_18', skip = true, offset = vector(2.5, 3, 0) })

local local_class = newclass('NightmareFutureCastleLailaSection1')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = NightmareFutureCastleLaila @
		Comment = 나이트메어 미래부유성 파트1 라일라의 피클가게 후일담 @
		Index = 0 @
		NextSections = 1 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	-- 아이템 스펙 이름
	self.cactus_item_spec_name = 'edible_cactus'

	-- 캐릭터를 가져오는 함수
	self.get_princess = function() return get_character('princess') end
	self.get_marvin = function() return get_character('marvin') end
	self.get_laila = function() return get_character('laila') end

	-- 스타피스를 가져오는 함수
	self.get_star_piece = controller.get_star_piece

	-- 오브젝트를 가져오는 함수
	self.get_cactus = function(num) return get_field_object('laila_cactus_' .. num) end

	-- 선인장 획득 갯수
	self.get_cactus_count = 0

	-- 이벤트 Progress
	self.progress = {
		none = 0,
		meet_laila = 1
	}
	self.current_progress = self.progress.none
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ItemGetEvent), 'on_event')

	local laila = self.get_laila()
	character_util.add_listener(laila, self.controller)

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ItemGetEvent))

	local laila = self.get_laila()
	character_util.remove_relate_event(laila, self.controller)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent) then
		return self:on_field_object_destroyed_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ItemGetEvent) then
		return self:on_item_get_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local laila = self.get_laila()

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, laila) then
		if self.current_progress < self.progress.meet_laila then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_to_laila, self)
		else
			if self.get_cactus_count < 3 then
				-- 정말요? 3개 정도만 찾아주시면 정말 도움이 될 거예요!
				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(laila, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_laila_10' })
			else
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_to_laila_get_cactus, self)
			end
		end
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_field_object_destroyed_event(e)
	for i = 1, 3 do
		local cactus = self.get_cactus(i)

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, cactus) then
			self:drop_cactus_item(cactus.Position)
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_item_get_event(e)
	local item_data = game_data_service.GetData("ItemData")
	local item_id = item_data:GetSpec(self.cactus_item_spec_name).Id

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Getter, user_party.Leader) then
		if e.Item.ItemId == item_id then
			self.get_cactus_count = self.get_cactus_count + 1

			if self.get_cactus_count >= 3 then
				local laila = self.get_laila()
				character_util.add_listener(laila, self.controller)
			end
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end
--endregion

--region interact_to_laila
-- 라일라에게 상호작용 했을 때
function local_class:interact_to_laila()
	local princess = self.get_princess()
	local marvin = self.get_marvin()
	local laila = self.get_laila()

	self.current_progress = self.progress.meet_laila

	-- 파티, 라일라 우측에 정렬

	-- 라일라 (smile, idle): 아저씨! 오랜만이네요!

	character_util.set_emotion(laila, { name = 'smile' })
	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(character_util.normal_double_jump, laila, true),
		util.cs_generator(speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async, laila, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_laila_1', skip = true })
	})

	-- 마빈 (idle, nod): 잘 지내고 있구나, 라일라.

	-- 라일라 (smile, 점프): 기사님이 매번 말하던 공주님도 같이 오셨네요!

	character_util.set_anim(laila, { name = 'sing' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(laila, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_laila_3', skip = true })

	-- 공주 (smile): 마빈 친구 라일라네! 안녕!
	character_util.set_emotion(princess, { name = 'smile' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_laila_4', skip = true })

	-- 라일라 (smile, nodx2 후 idle 표정으로 대사): 모처럼 가게까지 오셨는데…
	character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(laila, { name = 'nod', count = 2 })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	character_util.remove_emotion(princess)
	character_util.set_emotion(laila, { name = 'tired' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(laila, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_laila_6', skip = true })

	-- 공주 (idle, 점프): 재료? 선인장 피클이니까… 선인장이 필요한 거야?
	character_util.normal_jump(princess, true)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_laila_7', skip = true })

	-- 라일라 (idle, nodx2): 네, 맞아요. 가게를 두고 찾으러 갈 수가 없어요.
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(laila, { name = 'nod', count = 2 })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(laila, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_laila_8', skip = true })

	-- 공주 (smile, release 2회) : 내가 찾아줄게!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(princess, { name = 'smile' })
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(princess, { naem = 'release', count = 2 })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_laila_9', skip = true })

	-- 라일라 (smile, idle) : 정말요? 3개 정도만 찾아주시면 정말 도움이 될 거예요!

local local_class = newclass('NightmareFutureCastleMainSection1')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = NightmareFutureCastleMain @
		Comment = 여관을 찾아온 아이샤와 샤피라. 기사가 사라진것을 깨닫는 공주. @

		NextSections = 1 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)

	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	-- npc
	self.get_princess = function() return get_character('princess') end
	self.get_maiden = function() return get_character('maiden') end
	self.get_steam_princess = function() return get_character('steam_princess') end
	self.get_steam_knight = function() return get_character('steam_knight') end

	self.stage_name = 'nightmare_futurecastle_1'

	self.maiden_portrait = 'maiden'
	self.steam_princess_portrait = 'steam_princess'
	self.steam_knight_portrait = 'steam_knight'

	self.tavern_2d_create_position = vector(100, 0, -100)
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return true
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:exit()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return
	end
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return
	end

	sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.opening, self)
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

-- 여관 오프닝
function local_class:opening()
	--배경음을 없애야하는데 c#을 수정할 수 없어 이렇게 처리 (ShowTitanTavernIntroTheatre 에서 bgm을 임의로 변경중)
	music_player:SetAudioSystemVolume('BgmVolume', 0)

	-- 여관용 부유성 인트로 재생
	local discover_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx(
		{ sfx_name = '01_discover_event_08', loop = true, type_priority = 'loop',
		  fade_in_time = '2', delayed_time = 1 })
	yield_return(CS.Oak.HeavenholdTheatre, 'ShowTitanTavernIntroTheatre')

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 0 })
	music_player:SetAudioSystemVolume('BgmVolume', CS.UnityEngine.PlayerPrefs.GetFloat('BgmVolume', 1))

	screen_util.fade_in(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	-- Tavern Background 로드
	local resholder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()
	local tavern_root
	local tavern_camera

	yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
		resholder, 'ui/backgrounds/tavern', 'tavern', function(prefab)
			tavern_root = CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Instantiate(prefab)
			tavern_root.transform.localPosition = self.tavern_2d_create_position
			tavern_root.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.identity

			CS.Utils.ChangeLayersRecursively(tavern_root.transform, 'Default')

			tavern_camera = tavern_root.transform:GetComponentInChildren(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Camera))
			tavern_camera.cullingMask = 1 -- 1 << LayerMask.NameToLayer('Default')
			tavern_camera.clearFlags = CS.UnityEngine.CameraClearFlags.SolidColor
			tavern_camera.backgroundColor = unity_class.color.black
			tavern_camera.orthographicSize = 3.75

			-- 카메라 탑뷰로 세팅
			tavern_camera.transform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.up * 5
			tavern_camera.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 0, 0)

			local bg = tavern_root.transform:Find('tavern_back')
			bg.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 0.5
			bg.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 0, 0)
			bg.transform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.zero
		end)

	-- Animation에 붙은 Sound 재생을 위해 카메라를 여관 씬으로 옮겨 둠
	camera_util.move(self.tavern_2d_create_position, 0)

	local princess = self.get_princess()
	local maiden = self.get_maiden()
	local steam_princess = self.get_steam_princess()
	local steam_knight = self.get_steam_knight()

	-- 여관씬에서 npc가 연출용으로 작동하도록
	local tavern_actor = { princess, maiden, steam_princess, steam_knight }
	for _, v in pairs(tavern_actor) do
		v.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 0, 0)

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = NightmareFutureCastleMain @
		Comment = 라 제국에서 기사를 발견하지 못하고 떠난다. @
		Index = 1 @
		NextSections = 2 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	self.progress_enum = {
		-- 기본 상태
		none = 1,
		-- 리본을 찾음
		find_ribbon = 2
	}

	self.current_progress = self.progress_enum.none

	-- npc
	self.get_princess = function() return get_character('princess') end
	self.get_steam_princess = function() return get_character('steam_princess') end
	self.get_steam_knight = function() return get_character('steam_knight') end

	-- 마커
	self.get_ribbon_pos = function() return field:GetMarker('section2_ribbon').position end

	self.stage_name = 'nightmare_futurecastle_1'

	self.steam_princess_portrait = 'steam_princess'
	self.steam_knight_portrait = 'steam_knight'
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return true
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')

	-- 리본 생성
	local ribbon_pos = self.get_ribbon_pos()
	drop_item_util.create_item(
		{ pos = ribbon_pos, itemid = 20288, notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', sprscale = 0.7 })

	self.yuze_portrait_name = 'succubus.png'

	self.target_stage_name = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2'

	self.section_progress = {
		-- 초기값
		none = 0,
		-- 서큐버스 마을 인트로
		intro = 1,
		-- 드림테라피 받음
		dream = 2,
		-- 꿈속에서 gem과 인터랙트 했는지
		gem = 3,
		-- 크레이그와 헤어지고 다음스테이지로
		exit = 4
	}

	self.current_progress = self.section_progress.none

	self.dream_item_counter = 0

	self.bgm_sfx = nil
end

function local_class:enter()

		return
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')

	self:set_environment()

	return true
end

function local_class:start()

		self.controller:set_default_quest_marker()
		return
	end
end

function local_class:exit()

		return
	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ItemGetEvent))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	if stage.Name ~= self.target_stage_name then
		return
	end

	if self.bgm_sfx ~= nil then
		self.bgm_sfx:Stop()
	end
	self.bgm_sfx = nil
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region on event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if stage.Name ~= self.target_stage_name then
		return
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter == false then return end
	if e.FieldObject ~= user_party.Leader then return end
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	-- 1
	if zone_name == 'section_4_succubus_town' and self.current_progress == self.section_progress.none then
		self.current_progress = self.section_progress.intro
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.welcome_succubus_town, self)
	elseif zone_name =='section_4_dream' then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.go_back, self)
	-- 4
	elseif zone_name == 'section_4_exit' and self.current_progress == self.section_progress.gem then
		self.current_progress = self.section_progress.exit
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.exit_dungeon_kingdom, self)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	for i = 1, 3 do
		local door = get_field_object('invisible_door_' .. i)
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, door) and self.current_progress == self.section_progress.intro then
			self.current_progress = self.section_progress.dream
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.dream_therapy, self, door)
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_item_get_event(e)
	--3
	self.dream_item_counter = self.dream_item_counter + 1

	if self.dream_item_counter >= 15 and self.current_progress == self.section_progress.dream then
		self.current_progress = self.section_progress.gem
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.meet_yuze, self)
	end
end
--endregion on event

function local_class:set_environment()
	local name_postfix =  {{1, 2, 3, 4}, {'a', 'b', 'c'}}
	for i = 1, 2 do
		for j = 1, #name_postfix[i] do
			local succubus = get_character('succubus_' .. name_postfix[i][j])
			character_util.set_with_marker(succubus, field:GetMarker(succubus.Name))
			if i == 1 then
				succubus.Interactable.Talk = 'nightmare_futurecastle_succubus'
				character_util.set_emotion(succubus, {name = 'smile'})
			end
		end
	end

	for i = 1, 3 do
		local door = get_field_object('invisible_door_' .. i)
		door.Position = field:GetMarker(door.Name).position
	end

end

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(succubus[3], { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_s4_1', skip = true })
	--어머~ 꼬마 아가씨네!

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_dash_06')
	character_util.move_waypoint(succubus[3], {succubus[3].Position + vector(-0.5, 0, 0),

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_s4_17', skip = true })
	--언니, 에바!

	local dash_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_dash_01', loop = true})
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(princess, princess.Position + vector(-3, 0, 0), 4, true)
	dash_sfx:Stop()

	local item_ids = {20298, 20004, 20191}
	local spr_scale = {0.5, 0.5, 0.7}

	local choose_table = {
		{'nightmare_futurecastle_s4_18_1', 'mercy'},
		{'nightmare_futurecastle_s4_18_2', 'brutal'},
		{'nightmare_futurecastle_s4_18_3', 'intellect'}
	}
	--젬을 준다.
	--골드를 준다.
	--스타피스를 준다.

	local reaction_table = {
		-- 젬
		function ()
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_throw_01')
			character_util.set_anim(princess, {name = 'attack', remove_after = 0.5, loop = false})
			wait_for_sec(0.2)

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
			character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(knight, {name = 'success', sfx_name = '01_jump_01'}, {name = 'awesome'})
			wait_for_sec(2.5)
		end,
		-- 골드
		function ()
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_throw_01')
			character_util.set_anim(princess, {name = 'attack', remove_after = 0.5, loop = false})
			wait_for_sec(0.2)
			local item = drop_item_util.create_item({ itemid = item_ids[1], pos = princess.Position,

													  notforinven = true, sprscale = spr_scale[1], showoncharacter = true })

			character_util.set_emotion(princess, {name = 'cry'})
			wait_for_sec(2.5)
		end,
		-- 스타피스
		function ()
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_throw_01')
			character_util.set_anim(princess, {name = 'attack', remove_after = 0.5, loop = false})
			wait_for_sec(0.2)

													  notforinven = true, sprscale = spr_scale[2], showoncharacter = true })

			wait_for_sec(2.5)
		end
	}

	while #choose_table ~= 0 do
		local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event(choose_table)

		character_util.remove_anim(knight)
		character_util.set_emotion(knight, {name = 'smile'})
		character_util.set_emotion(princess, {name = 'smile'})

		table.remove(choose_table, choose_result)

local local_class = newclass('NightmareFuturecastleMainSection5')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = NightmareFutureCastleMain @
		Comment = 셴 시 에서 투구 쓴 가디언을 발견하는 공주 @
		Index = 4 @
		NextSections = 5 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	-- 스테이지 이름
	self.stage_name = 'nightmare_futurecastle_3'

	-- 이벤트 존 이름
	self.find_guardian_zone_name = 'find_guardian'
	self.exit_zone_name = 'exit_zone'

	-- 문 이름
	self.door_name = 'door_exit'

	-- 캐릭터를 가져오는 함수
	self.get_princess = controller.get_princess
	self.get_fei = controller.get_fei
	self.get_mei = controller.get_mei
	self.get_bob = function() return get_character('bob') end
	self.get_zaco = function() return get_character('zaco') end
	self.get_shen_citizen = function(num) return get_character('shen_citizen_' .. num) end

	-- 마커를 가져오는 함수
	self.get_default_start_marker = function() return field:GetMarker('default_start') end

	-- 이펙트를 가져오는 함수
	self.get_dead_effect = controller.get_dead_effect

	-- 섹션 progress
	self.progress = {
		none = 0,
		find_guardian = 1
	}
	self.current_progress = self.progress.none
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return true
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')

	local zaco = self.get_zaco()
	character_util.add_listener(zaco, self.controller)

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		self.controller:set_default_quest_marker()
		return
	end

	sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.stage_start, self)
end

function local_class:exit()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return
	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')

	local zaco = self.get_zaco()
	character_util.remove_relate_event(zaco, self.controller)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		return self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then
			if self.current_progress < self.progress.find_guardian and e.Zone.Name == self.find_guardian_zone_name then
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.find_guardian, self)
				return true
			elseif e.Zone.Name == self.exit_zone_name then
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.guardian_call_princess, self)
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local zaco = self.get_zaco()

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, zaco) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_guardian, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end
--endregion

--region stage_start
function local_class:stage_start()
	local princess = self.get_princess()
	local fei = self.get_fei()
	local mei = self.get_mei()

	camera_util.move_async(vector(19.5, 1, 0.5), 0.01)

	-- 플레이어가 조작할 때와 동일한 크기의 Smoke를 연출하기 위해, 페이와 메이의 State를 원복시킴.
	fei:OnEvent(CS.Oak.StateResetEvent.Instance)

			wait_for_sec(0.5)

			-- princess: (smile) 출발!

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_female_shout_01')
			character_util.set_emotion(mei, { name = 'smile' })
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(mei, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_main_s5_3', portraitname = 'china_hero_girl', skip = true })

function local_class:enter()
	if self.controller.starting_inner_progress == 4 and stage.Name == self.prev_stage_name then
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event_stage3')
		return true
	elseif stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return true
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')

	for i = 1, 7 do
		local sandy_break_gimmick = self.get_sandy_break_gimmick(i)
		local marker = self.get_sandy_break_gimmick_marker(i)

		sandy_break_gimmick.Position = marker.position
	end

	local tentacle = self.get_tentacle(1)
	character_util.set_active_shadow(tentacle, false)
	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(tentacle, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		self.controller:set_default_quest_marker()
		return

	sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.meet_sandy, self)
end

function local_class:exit()
	if self.controller.starting_inner_progress == 4 and stage.Name == self.prev_stage_name then
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
		return
	elseif stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return
	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	if self.earthquake_sfx ~= nil then

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then

	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent) then
		return self:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent) then
		return self:on_field_object_destroyed_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then

end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event_stage3(e)

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then
			if not self.is_sandy_attack_invader_1 and e.Zone.Name == self.sandy_attack_invader_zone_name .. 1 then
				local invader = self.get_air_spin_invader(1)
				self.is_sandy_attack_invader_1 = true
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.sandy_attack_invader, self, invader))
				return true
			elseif not self.is_sandy_attack_invader_2 and e.Zone.Name == self.sandy_attack_invader_zone_name .. 2 then
				local invader = self.get_air_spin_invader(2)
				self.is_sandy_attack_invader_2 = true
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.sandy_attack_invader, self, invader))
				return true
			elseif not self.is_sandy_attack_invader_3 and e.Zone.Name == self.sandy_attack_invader_zone_name .. 3 then
				local invader = self.get_air_spin_invader(3)
				self.is_sandy_attack_invader_3 = true
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.sandy_attack_invader_3, self, invader))
				return true
			elseif not self.is_sandy_attack_gimmick_1 and e.Zone.Name == self.sandy_attack_gimmick_zone_name .. 1 then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.sandy_attack_gimmick_1, self))
				return true
			elseif not self.is_sandy_attack_gimmick_2 and e.Zone.Name == self.sandy_attack_gimmick_zone_name .. 2 then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.sandy_attack_gimmick_2, self))
				return true
			elseif self.current_progress < self.progress.invader_bombard_start and e.Zone.Name == self.invader_bombard_start_zone_name then
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.invader_bombard_start, self)
				return true
			elseif self.current_progress < self.progress.ending and e.Zone.Name == self.ending_zone_name then
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.ending, self)
				return true
			elseif self.current_progress >= self.progress.invader_bombard_start and self.current_progress < self.progress.ending_2 and e.Zone.Name == self.bombard_shot_zone_name then
				self:start_bombard_shot()
				return true

				return true

function local_class:princess_dig_small_rock(princess_position, marvin_position, rock_start_index, rock_end_index)

	local marvin = self.get_marvin()

	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	quest_marker_util.remove('landslide_small_rock_' .. math.floor(rock_end_index / 4))

	local middle_index = math.floor((rock_start_index + rock_end_index) / 2)
	for i = rock_start_index, middle_index do
		local rock = self.get_small_rock(i)
		self:break_rock(marvin, rock)
	end
	wait_for_sec(0.063)
	wait_for_sec(0.17)

	for i = middle_index, rock_end_index do
		local rock = self.get_small_rock(i)
		self:break_rock(marvin, rock)
	end

	equipping_sfx:Stop()
	character_util.remove_anim(princess)
	wait_for_sec(1.063)

	party_util.reset_controllers()
end

--region meet_sandy
function local_class:meet_sandy()
	local princess = self.get_princess()
	local marvin = self.get_marvin()
	local sandy = self.get_sandy()

	local tentacle_1 = self.get_tentacle(1)

	self.current_progress = self.progress.meet_sandy

	-- 입장 시 이벤트 씬 시작. 마빈이 공주를 hold로 무등 태우고 아래까지 이동(컨트롤 x, 겹쳐서 무등 태운 것처럼 보이도록)
