	coroutine.yield()
	message_system:SendSync(princess, CS.Oak.GetThrownEndEvent.Instance)
	coroutine.yield()
	princess.Holdable = CS.Oak.NonHoldable.Instance
	camera_util.move(marvin.Position + vector(-0.5, 0, 0), 0.4, { end_target = princess })
	character_util.mario_jump_new(princess, 'left', 0.4, 0.7)
	character_util.move_to_async(princess, vector(-1, 0, -4), 0.4, nil, false, false, false)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_land_01')
	character_util.set_anim(princess, { name = 'idle' })
	character_util.set_direction(princess, 'right')
	wait_for_sec(0.3)
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(marvin, marvin.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0), 2, false, nil, nil, 'left')

	-- 입장 시 마빈 파티 합류한 채로 이동. 유사 구역으로 가면 마빈과 공주 정렬해서 이벤트 씬 시작
	-- princess: (마빈 방향으로 smile) 같이 기사를 찾으러 가줘서 고마워!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	character_util.look_at(marvin, princess)
	character_util.look_at(princess, marvin)
	character_util.set_emotion(princess, { name = 'smile' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_main_s6_1', skip = true })

	-- princess: (smile, success) 마빈이랑 가니까 정말 든든해!
	character_util.set_anim(princess, { name = 'success', sfx_name = '01_small_jump_01' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_main_s6_2', skip = true })

	-- desert_slave_2: (question) 뭐… 그 꼬맹이가 정말 없어진 거라면 꽤 곤란할 테니…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.set_anim(marvin, { name = 'question', loop = false })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(marvin, { key = game_string:Format('nightmare_futurecastle_main_s6_3', user.Name), portraitname = 'desert_slave', skip = true })

	-- princess: (down 방향으로 emoticon_bubble_exclamation 후) 근데 여기는 왜 바닥에 파도가 쳐?

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_main_s6_4', skip = true })

	-- desert_slave_2: (down, release) 저건 바닥이 아니야.
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(marvin, vector(0, 0, -5), 1)
	character_util.set_anim(marvin, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(marvin, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_main_s6_5', portraitname = 'desert_slave', skip = true })

	-- desert_slave_2: 흐르고 있는 모래지. 섣불리 발을 디뎠다간 그대로…
	character_util.move_waypoint(princess, vector(-1, 0, -5), 1)
	character_util.remove_anim(marvin)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(marvin, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_main_s6_6', portraitname = 'desert_slave', skip = true })

	-- princess: (유사 구역안쪽으로 이동해서 대사) 흐르는 모래…?
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 1 })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(character_util.move_waypoint_async, princess, princess.Position + vector(0, 0, -1), 1),
		util.cs_generator(speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async, princess, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_main_s6_7', skip = true })
	})

	-- princess: (surprise, cliff) 어어어…!
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_suspense_theme', state = 'event', mix = 2 })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_01')
	local sink_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_sink_sand_01', loop = true, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'default' })
	character_util.set_locked_dir(princess, 'right')
	character_util.set_emotion(princess, { name = 'scared' })
	character_util.set_anim(princess, { name = 'embarrassed' })
	character_util.move_waypoint(princess, princess.Position + vector(0, -1, 0), 0.1)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_main_s6_8', skip = true })

	-- 마빈 대사 끝나면 공주가 유사 중앙으로 속으로 퐁 빠진다. 공주가 scared, embarrassed로 슬슬 밑으로 가라앉는다.
	-- desert_slave_2: (down, mad, release) 안 돼, 공주, 버둥대지 마!
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(marvin, { vector(1, 0, -5), vector(1, 0, -6) }, 7, true, nil, nil, 'left', true)
	character_util.set_emotion(marvin, { name = 'mad' })
	character_util.set_anim(marvin, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(marvin, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_main_s6_10', portraitname = 'desert_slave', skip = true })

	character_util.remove_anim(marvin)

	-- 마빈 대사 끝나면 shake되다가 공주가 유사 괴물 팔(boss_sandmonster_tentacle)에 매달려 올라간다. (연출 참고: https://youtu.be/eFvaKt5y2Nc?t=383 영상과 다르게 공주는 거꾸로 말고 정 자세로 매달리기) 공주는 embarrassed로 파닥파닥
	local earthquake_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_earthquake_03', loop = true, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'default' })
	camera_util.shake(0.2, 2)
	character_util.stop(princess)
	wait_for_sec(2)
	earthquake_sfx:Stop()
	sink_sfx:Stop()

	local bone_follower = nil
	local tentacle_appear = function(tentacle, attach_target)
		local duration = 0.5

		local start_y = -5.5
		local attach_y = -4
		local is_attach = false
		local is_camera_up = false

		if attach_target then
			tentacle.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(attach_target.Position, start_y)
		else
			tentacle.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(tentacle.Position, start_y)
		end

		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 2 })
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_sink_sand_02', play_pos = tentacle.Position, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_earthquake_02')
		camera_util.shake(0.2, duration)
		self.get_sandmonster_out_effect():Instantiate(vector_util.get_x0z(tentacle.Position))
		local sanddown_effect = self.get_sanddown_effect():Instantiate(vector_util.get_x0z(tentacle.Position) + vector(0, 0.09, -0.1))
		character_util.set_animation_n_times(tentacle, { name = 'out' })

		local time_passed = 0
		while time_passed < duration do
			local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutSine(time_passed, 0, 1, duration))
			local cur_y = (start_y * (1 - progress)) - 0.3

			tentacle.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(tentacle.Position, cur_y)

			if not is_attach and cur_y > attach_y then
				is_attach = true
				attach_target.SpineController.IsShadowActive = false
				character_util.spine_rotate(princess, 30, 0)

				character_util.set_anim(attach_target, { name = 'embarrassed' })

				bone_follower = attach_target.UnityGameObject:AddComponent(typeof(CS.Spine.Unity.BoneFollower))
				bone_follower.followBoneRotation = false
				bone_follower.SkeletonRenderer = tentacle.SpineController.SkeletonAnimation
				bone_follower:SetBone('bone15')
			end

			if not is_camera_up and is_attach then
				is_camera_up = true

				-- 속도 초당 11
				camera_util.move(vector_util.get_x0z(princess.Position) + vector(0, 3, 0), 3 / 11)
			end

			coroutine.yield()

			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		end

		sanddown_effect:Dispose()

		if self.sanddown_effect[tentacle] then
			self.sanddown_effect[tentacle]:Dispose()
		end
		self.sanddown_effect[tentacle] = self.get_sanddown_effect():Instantiate(vector_util.get_x0z(tentacle.Position) + vector(0, 0.09, -0.1), unity_class.quaternion.identity, tentacle.Transform)
	end

	yield_return_func(tentacle_appear, tentacle_1, princess)

	-- princess: (surprise, embarrassed) 우와!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(princess, { name = 'surprise' })
	character_util.set_anim(princess, { name = 'embarrassed' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_main_s6_11', skip = true })

	-- desert_slave_2: (mad) 저건…!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(marvin, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_main_s6_12', portraitname = 'desert_slave', skip = true })

	-- 샌디(boss_sandmonster) out 하며 등장.
	music_player_util.play_stage_music( { state = 'field' })
	yield_return_func(self.appear_sandy, self, vector_util.get_x0z(tentacle_1.Position) + vector(1, 0, 0))
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- desert_slave_2: (emoticon_bubble_sweat 후) 너였냐, 샌디…
	character_util.remove_emotion(princess)
	character_util.remove_emotion(marvin)
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(marvin, nil, 'sweat')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(marvin, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_main_s6_13', portraitname = 'desert_slave', skip = true })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_normal_slash_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_die_sand_monster_01')
	character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(sandy, { name = 'attack2' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(sandy, nil, 'happy')

	-- princess: (idle, embarrassed) 안녕? 네가 샌디구나?
	character_util.remove_emotion(princess)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_main_s6_14', skip = true })

	-- princess: (smile, embarrassed) 기사가 그러던데~ 사막에 엄청 예쁘고 든든한 친구가 있다고!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(princess, { name = 'smile' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_main_s6_15', skip = true })

	-- 샌디 cast 후 emoticon_bubble_heart 띄움
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
	character_util.set_anim(sandy, { name = 'cast' })
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(sandy, nil, 'heart')
	character_util.remove_anim(sandy)

	-- princess: (idle, embarrassed) 혹시 기사 본 적 있니?
	character_util.remove_emotion(princess)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_main_s6_16', skip = true })

	-- 샌디가 attack2 후 emoticon_bubble_remove_player 띄운다
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_normal_slash_01')
	character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(sandy, { name = 'attack2' })
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(sandy, nil, 'custom', 'emoticon_bubble_remove_player.png')

	-- princess: (tired, embarrassed) 그렇구나…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(princess, { name = 'tired' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_main_s6_17', skip = true })

	-- 샌디가 attack 후 emoticon_bubble_rowdy.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_normal_slash_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(sandy, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(sandy, nil, 'rowdy')

	-- desert_slave_2: (question) 네가 우리를 도와주겠다고…?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.set_anim(marvin, { name = 'question', loop = false })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(marvin, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_main_s6_17_1', portraitname = 'desert_slave', skip = true })

	-- princess: (smile, embarrassed) 우와! 정말?!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(princess, { name = 'smile' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_main_s6_18', skip = true })

	-- princess: (smile, embarrassed) 정말 고마워, 예쁜 샌디!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_princess_laugh_01')
	character_util.remove_anim(marvin)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_main_s6_18_1', skip = true })

	-- 샌디가 cast 후 emoticon_bubble_heart 띄우고, 공주가 포물선으로 날아 다시 (마빈 옆) 땅에 선다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
	character_util.set_anim(sandy, { name = 'cast' })
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(sandy, nil, 'heart')

	CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Destroy(bone_follower)
	princess.SpineController.IsShadowActive = true
	character_util.set_position(princess, princess.Position, true)
	character_util.spine_rotate(princess, 0, 0)
	character_util.set_locked_dir(princess, 'left')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(princess)
	character_util.jump(princess, 0.7, 0.5)
	character_util.move_to_async(princess, vector(-2.5, 0, princess.Position.z), 0.5, nil)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_land_01')
	character_util.set_locked_dir(princess, 'none')
	character_util.set_direction(princess, 'right')

	local tentacle_hidden = function(tentacle)
		local duration = 0.5

		local start_y = -5.5

		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_sink_sand_02', play_pos = tentacle.Position, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
		camera_util.shake(0.2, duration)
		local burrow_effect = self.get_sandmonster_ready_effect():Instantiate(tentacle.Position)
		if self.sanddown_effect[tentacle] then
			self.sanddown_effect[tentacle]:Dispose()
			self.sanddown_effect[tentacle] = nil
		end


		local time_passed = 0
		while time_passed < duration do
			local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutSine(time_passed, 0, 1, duration))
			local cur_y = start_y * progress

			tentacle.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(tentacle.Position, cur_y)

			coroutine.yield()

			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		end

		tentacle.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)

		burrow_effect:Dispose()
	end

	-- 샌디가 in으로 땅속으로 들어감
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(tentacle_hidden, tentacle_1))
	yield_return_func(self.hide_sandy, self)

	-- 컨트롤 돌아오고 마빈이 파티 합류해서 이동. 이후 전투 구역에 인베이더 npc를 배치해 샌디가 튀어올라 날려 버리는 멈추지 않는 이벤트. (샌디가 날릴 인베이더들은 실제 전투 대상이 아님). 나이트메어 사막 5스테이지 마빈이 황소벌레 잡는 멈추지 않는 이벤트들과 비슷.
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(party_util.align_party, princess.Position + vector(1, 0, 0), 'left', 1, 'linear'))
	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

	music_player_util.play_stage_music( { state = 'field' })
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowStageTitle(game_string:GetString(stage.Name))

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_stage_intro_jump_01')
	character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'victory_get', loop = false })

	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	character_util.remove_anim(user_party.Leader)
end

--region invader_bombard_start
function local_class:invader_bombard_start()
	local princess = self.get_princess()
	local marvin = self.get_marvin()
	local sandy = self.get_sandy()

	self.current_progress = self.progress.invader_bombard_start

	-- 이벤트 구역으로 들어가면 중앙에서 살짝 아래에 마빈과 공주 정렬(up방향)하고, 중앙 쪽에(마빈과 공주보다 위쪽)서 샌디가 out으로 올라온 후 attack2 2번.
	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(character_util.move_waypoint_async, princess, vector(-64, 0, 57.5), 2, false, nil, nil, 'up'),
		util.cs_generator(character_util.move_waypoint_async, marvin, vector(-63, 0, 57.5), 2, false, nil, nil, 'up')
	})

	yield_return_func(self.appear_sandy, self, vector(-63.5, 0, 58.5))

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
		local duration = spine_util.get_animation_duration(sandy, 'attack2')

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_normal_slash_01')
		wait_for_sec(duration)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_normal_slash_01')
	end))
	character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(sandy, { name = 'attack2', count = 2 })

	-- desert_slave_2: (up) 어때, 샌디.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(marvin, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_main_s6_19', portraitname = 'desert_slave', skip = true })

	-- desert_slave_2: (up, release) 기사의 흔적은 좀 찾았나?
	character_util.set_anim(marvin, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(marvin, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_main_s6_20', portraitname = 'desert_slave', skip = true })

	-- boss_sandmonster이 emoticon_bubble_remove_player 띄움.

function local_class:tentacle_appear(tentacle, position, is_sanddown)
	local duration = 0.5

	local start_y = -5.5
	local end_y = 0

	is_sanddown = lua_helper.get_or_default(is_sanddown, true)

	if position then
		tentacle.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(position, position.y + start_y)
		start_y = tentacle.Position.y
		end_y = position.y
	else
		tentacle.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(tentacle.Position, start_y)
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_sink_sand_02', play_pos = tentacle.Position, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
	camera_util.shake(0.05, duration)
	self.get_sandmonster_out_effect():Instantiate(position)
	local sanddown_effect = nil
	if is_sanddown then
		sanddown_effect = self.get_sanddown_effect():Instantiate(position + vector(0, 0.1, 0))
	end
	character_util.set_anim(tentacle, { name = 'out', loop = false })

	local time_passed = 0
	while time_passed < duration do
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutSine(time_passed, 0, 1, duration))
		local cur_y = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(start_y, end_y, progress)

		tentacle.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(tentacle.Position, cur_y)

		coroutine.yield()

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
	end

	tentacle.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(tentacle.Position, end_y)

	if is_sanddown then
		sanddown_effect:Dispose()

		if self.sanddown_effect[tentacle] then
			self.sanddown_effect[tentacle]:Dispose()
		end
		self.sanddown_effect[tentacle] = self.get_sanddown_effect():Instantiate(position + vector(0, 0.1, 0), unity_class.quaternion.identity, tentacle.Transform)
	end
end

function local_class:tentacle_hidden(tentacle, is_sanddown)
	local duration = 0.5

	local start_y = tentacle.Position.y
	local end_y = start_y - 5.5

	is_sanddown = lua_helper.get_or_default(is_sanddown, true)

	if is_sanddown then
		if self.sanddown_effect[tentacle] then

function local_class:missile_drop(pos, target)
	local missile_height = 15
	local missile = self.get_dark_magic_missile_effect():Instantiate(pos + vector(0, missile_height, 0))

	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local fall_time = 1
	local freefall = CS.CalculatorFreeFall(fall_time, missile_height, 0)

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < fall_time do
		freefall:Proceed(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
		missile.transform.position = pos + vector(0, missile_height + freefall:GetDistance(), 0)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_explosion_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	missile:Dispose()

	camera_util.shake(0.15, 0.15)

	local explosion = self.get_dark_magic_missile_explosion_effect():Instantiate(pos)
	explosion.transform.localScale = vector(1.5, 1.5, 1.5)

	if target then
		character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(target)
		character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(target)
		damage_util.show_damage_number(target, 1000, unity_class.color.red, target.Position)
	end
end

-- 공용 포격 루틴
function local_class:bombard_shot(pos, y)
	local radius = 1

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_dark_magician_shoot_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	local cur_y = lua_helper.get_or_default(y, stage_util.get_height(pos))

	local bombard_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(vector(pos.x, cur_y + 0.01, pos.z), radius)

	bombard_range:Show()

	yield_return_func(self.missile_drop, self, pos)

	bombard_range:Hide()

	-- 공격 범위에 Rock 오브젝트가 존재할 경우 데미지를 줘서 폭파시킴
	local collide_objs = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(pos, radius)

	for i = 0, collide_objs.Count - 1 do
		local fo = collide_objs[i]

		if lua_helper.type_compare(fo.DamagedBehaviour, CS.Oak.RockDamagedBehaviour) then
			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Explosion | CS.Oak.DamageType.AffectGimmick
			damage_info.sender = nil
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.damage = 100

			command_util.execute_damage(damage_info)
		end

		for j = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(fo, user_party[j]) then
				local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
				damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Trap
				damage_info.sender = user_party[j]
				damage_info.target = user_party[j]
				damage_info.damage = math.floor(user_party[j].FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP * 0.1)

				command_util.execute_damage(damage_info)
			end
		end
	end

	CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(bombard_range)
end
--endregion

--region earthquake
function local_class:start_earthquake()
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.earthquake_routine, self))
end

function local_class:stop_earthquake()
	self.is_do_earthquake = false
end

function local_class:earthquake_routine()
	self.is_do_earthquake = true

	local random_offset_list = {}
	for i = 1, 16 do
		local radian = unity_class.mathf.PI * 2 * (((i - 1) * 22.5 + 11.25) / 360)
		local offset = vector(unity_class.mathf.Cos(radian), 0, unity_class.mathf.Sin(radian))
		table.insert(random_offset_list, offset)
	end

	while self.is_do_earthquake do
		local rand = random_util.get_random_int(1, 4)

		if rand % 4 == 0 then
			camera_util.shake(0.15, 1)
			wait_for_sec(1)
		else
			local rand_cnt = random_util.get_random_int(1, 4)
			for _ = 1, rand_cnt do
				local distance = unity_class.random.Range(4, 6.0)
				local offset = random_offset_list[random_util.get_random_int(1, #random_offset_list)] * distance
				local rand_scale = unity_class.random.Range(0.3, 1)

				music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_earthquake_02', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'default' })
				local effect = self.get_landslide_effect():Instantiate(user_party.Leader.Position + offset)
				effect.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * rand_scale
				wait_for_sec(0.4)
				camera_util.shake(0.15, 0.15)
			end
		end

		local rand_additional_time = unity_class.random.Range(0.3, 2)
		wait_for_sec(2 + rand_additional_time)
	end
end
--endregion

	-- teatan_hero_2: (점프, attack 후 release하며 대사) 엄청난 공습이에요. 너무 갑작스러워서 누가 어디서 싸우는지 도무지…

	character_util.set_emotion(marian, { name = 'attack' })

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(marian, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_main_s7_7', portraitname = 'teatan_hero', skip = true })

	character_util.remove_anim(marian)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_main_s7_8', skip = true })

	character_util.set_emotion(marty_junior, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.normal_double_jump(marty_junior, true)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(marty_junior, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_main_s7_8_1', skip = true })

	-- teatan_robot_marty_junior: (attack, 점프x2) 여긴 전쟁터예요! 막대기로 싸우는 놀이터가 아니라고요!

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(marty_junior, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_main_s7_9', skip = true })

	-- 공주 표정 tired 됨
	character_util.remove_anim(marty_junior)
	character_util.set_emotion(princess, { name = 'tired' })
	character_util.shake(princess, 0.02, 0.5)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- teatan_hero_2: (right, side로 마티 주니어 보고) 캔터베리 공주님께 예의를 갖춰, 마티 주니어.
	character_util.set_direction(marian, 'down')
	character_util.set_emotion(marian, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.set_anim(marian, { name = 'shoot' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(marian, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_main_s7_10', portraitname = 'teatan_hero', skip = true })

	-- 마티 주니어 tired 표정 됨.
	character_util.set_emotion(marty_junior, { name = 'tired' })

	-- teatan_robot_marty_junior: (tired) 죄, 죄송합니다…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(marty_junior, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_main_s7_11', skip = true })

	-- teatan_hero_2: (left, side로 공주 보고) 저와 함께 가요. 같이 찾아보면 되죠.
	character_util.remove_emotion(marian)
	character_util.remove_anim(marian)
	character_util.set_direction(marian, 'left')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(marian, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_main_s7_12', portraitname = 'teatan_hero', skip = true })

	-- teatan_hero_2: (right, side로 마티 주니어 보고) 주니어, 각 방어선을 확인해볼 겸 다녀올게.
	character_util.set_direction(marty_junior, 'up')
	character_util.set_direction(marian, 'down')
	character_util.set_emotion(marian, { name = 'attack' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(marian, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_main_s7_13', portraitname = 'teatan_hero', skip = true })

	-- teatan_hero_2: 이쪽 방어선은 너한테 맡겨도 되겠지?
	character_util.set_anim(marian, { name = 'shoot' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(marian, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_main_s7_14', portraitname = 'teatan_hero', skip = true })

	-- teatan_robot_marty_junior: (attack, victory_get) 나한테 맡겨요, 마리안!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	character_util.remove_anim(marian)
	character_util.set_direction(marty_junior, 'left')
	character_util.set_emotion(marty_junior, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.set_anim(marty_junior, { name = 'victory_get', loop = false })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(marty_junior, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_main_s7_15', skip = true })

	-- 마리안 고개 끄덕. 공주에 파티 합류해서 이동.
	character_util.remove_emotion(marian)
	character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(marian, { name = 'nod', count = 2 })
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	marty_junior.Interactable.Talk = 'nightmare_futurecastle_main_s7_15'

	character_util.remove_emotion(princess)
	character_util.remove_anim(marty_junior)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(marian)
	character_util.convert_to_party_member(marian, user_party, true)

	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

	marian:HideWeapon(false)
end
--endregion

--region ending
function local_class:ending()
	local princess = self.get_princess()
	local marian = self.get_marian()

	-- 마지막 구역에서 공주, 마리안 정렬해서 이벤트 씬
	-- 마리안 왼편에서 right side 보고, 공주 오른편에서 left side 보고
	character_util.move_waypoint(marian, vector(68.5, 0, 42.5), 2, false, nil, nil, 'right')
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(princess, vector(70.5, 0, 42.5), 2, false, nil, nil, 'right')

	-- princess: (tired) 여기도 없잖아…
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 2 })
	character_util.set_emotion(princess, { name = 'tired' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_main_s7_16', skip = true })

	-- teatan_hero_2: 공주님… 괜찮으세요…?
	character_util.set_emotion(marian, { name = 'tired' })
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(marian, marian.Position + vector(1, 0, 0), 2)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(marian, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_main_s7_17', portraitname = 'teatan_hero', skip = true })

	-- princess: (right side로 돌아 tired) 기사를… 찾아야 하는데…
	character_util.set_emotion(princess, { name = 'cry' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_main_s7_18', skip = true })

	-- princess: (tired, 부들부들) 기사가 있어야… 샌디도… 모두들…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.shake(princess, 0.02, 9999)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_main_s7_19', skip = true })

	-- 컨트롤 돌아옴. 마리안 파티 해제.
	character_util.stop_shake(princess)
	character_util.convert_to_npc(marian)

	-- 마리안 oneline: 공주님…
	marian.Interactable.Talk = 'nightmare_futurecastle_s7_oneline_1'

	-- exit으로 이동해서 스테이지 클리어
	-- 재입장 시 마리안 파티 합류한 채로 이동.
	yield_return_func(quest_util.progress_section, self.controller)
end
--endregion

return local_class

local local_class = newclass('NightmareFuturecastleMainSection3')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = NightmareFutureCastleMain @
		Comment = 결국 여관으로 돌아온 공주. 하지만 분위기가 심상치 않다. @
		Index = 7 @
		NextSections = 8 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	self.get_princess = controller.get_princess
	self.get_pet = controller.get_pet

	self.pet_portrait_name = 'pet.png'

	self.target_stage_name = 'nightmare_futurecastle_6'
	self.prev_stage_name = 'nightmare_futurecastle_5'

	self.section_progress = {
		-- 초기값
		none = 0,
		-- 흰둥이와 대화
		pet = 1,
		-- 캔터베리 왕국  구경
		kingdom = 2,
		-- 부유성 입장
		heaven_hold = 3
	}

	self.current_progress = self.section_progress.none

	self.exit_origin_pos = nil
end

function local_class:enter()
	if self.controller.starting_inner_progress == 6 and stage.Name == self.prev_stage_name then
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event_stage5')
		return true
	elseif stage.Name ~= self.target_stage_name then
		return
	end
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.target_stage_name then
		self.controller:set_default_quest_marker()
		return
	end

	CS.Oak.UIQuestMarkersController.Instance:AddQuestMarkerToPoint('nightmare_futurecastle_main', self.quest_spec.QuestId,
			self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, field:GetMarker('princess_1').position)
end

function local_class:exit()
	if self.controller.starting_inner_progress == 6 and stage.Name == self.prev_stage_name then
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
		return
	elseif stage.Name ~= self.target_stage_name then
		return
	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	if stage.Name ~= self.target_stage_name then
		return
	end

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region on event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if stage.Name ~= self.target_stage_name then
		return
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter == false then return end
	if e.FieldObject ~= user_party.Leader then return end
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == 'section_8_pet' and self.current_progress == self.section_progress.none then
		self.current_progress = self.section_progress.pet
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.pet_talk, self)
	elseif zone_name == 'section_8_background' and self.current_progress == self.section_progress.pet then
		self.current_progress = self.section_progress.kingdom
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.sealed_kingdom, self)
	elseif zone_name == 'section_8_heaven_hold' and self.current_progress == self.section_progress.kingdom then
		self.current_progress = self.section_progress.heaven_hold
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.destroyed_heaven_hold, self)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event_stage5(e)
	if e.FullEnter then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then
			if e.Zone.Name == 'section_7_turnback' then
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.stage_5_event, self)
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:stage_5_event()
	local princess = self.get_princess()

	-- 여기도 없었어…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_main_s7_20', skip = true })

	character_util.move_waypoint_async(princess, princess.Position + vector(2, 0, 0), 2)
end
--endregion on event
function local_class:pet_talk()
	local princess = self.get_princess()
	local pet = self.get_pet()
	local marker_pos = field:GetMarker('princess_0').position

	character_util.move_waypoint(princess, marker_pos,
			4, false, nil, nil, 'left')
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(pet, marker_pos + vector(-1, 0, 0),
			4, false, nil, nil, 'right')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_pet_ordinary_01')
	character_util.set_anim(pet, {name = 'happy'})
	character_util.set_emotion(princess, {name = 'tired'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_s8_0', skip = true })
	--흰둥아, 기억나? 기사랑 처음 모험을 같이 했던 곳이야.

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_s8_0_1', skip = true })
	--흰둥이 네가 열심히 냄새를 맡아서 기사를 찾아줄 수 있을까…?

	character_util.set_anim(pet, {name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01'})
	wait_for_sec(1)
	character_util.remove_anim(pet)

	character_util.remove_emotion(princess)
end

function local_class:sealed_kingdom()
	local princess = self.get_princess()
	local pet = self.get_pet()
	local marker_pos = field:GetMarker('princess_1').position

	character_util.move_waypoint(princess, marker_pos + vector(-0.5, 0, 0),
			2, false, nil, nil, 'up')

	character_util.move_waypoint(pet, marker_pos + vector(0.5, 0, 0),
			2, false, nil, nil, 'up')

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 2 })
	local blizzard_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_blizzard_03', loop = true, fade_in_time = 2})

	camera_util.move_async(marker_pos + vector(0, 0, 5), 3)
	wait_for_sec(2)

	blizzard_sfx:FadeOut(2)
	local fire_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_fire_01', loop = true, fade_in_time = 2})
	camera_util.move_async(marker_pos, 2.5)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_s8_1', skip = true })
	--…….

	wait_for_sec(1)

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_s8_2', skip = true })
	--집…이다…

	wait_for_sec(1)

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess,
			{ key = game_string:Format('nightmare_futurecastle_s8_3', user.Name), skip = true })
	--저기서 {0}을(를) 처음 만났지…

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_s8_4', skip = true })
	--그리고 모험을 시작했고…

	character_util.show_emoticon_async(princess, nil, 'silence')

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess,
			{ key = game_string:Format('nightmare_futurecastle_s8_4_1', user.Name), skip = true })
	--여기도… {0}은(는) 없네…

	character_util.set_direction(pet, 'left')
	character_util.set_anim(pet, {name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01'})
	wait_for_sec(1)
	character_util.remove_anim(pet)

	character_util.set_direction(princess, 'right')
	character_util.set_emotion(princess, {name = 'tired'})

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_pet_ordinary_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(pet, {name = 'smile'})
	character_util.set_anim(pet, {name = 'happy'})
	wait_for_sec(1)
	character_util.remove_anim(pet)

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_s8_5', skip = true })
	--돌아가자… 부유성으로…

	wait_for_sec(1)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_stage_in_teleport_01')
	fire_sfx:FadeOut(2)
	screen_util.fade_out_circular(1, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear)
	wait_for_sec(1)
	local exit = get_field_object('heaven_hold_exit')
	self.exit_origin_pos = exit.Position
	exit.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
	camera_util.return_to_leader(0)
	character_util.convert_to_npc(pet)
	character_util.set_with_marker(pet, field:GetMarker('pet_2'))
	party_util.align_to_target(field:GetMarker('heaven_hold').position + vector(1, 0, 0), 'left')
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 0 })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_intro_futurecastle_01')
	screen_util.fade_in_circular(0.5, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear)
end

function local_class:destroyed_heaven_hold()
	local princess = self.get_princess()
	local marker_pos = field:GetMarker('princess_2').position

	self.controller:start_sfx_loop()

	for i = 1, 3 do
		local civilian = get_character('civilian_' .. i)
		civilian.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
		character_util.set_with_marker(civilian, field:GetMarker(civilian.Name))
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_stomp_fire_02')
	camera_util.shake(0.2, 2)
	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_dash_06')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_crowd_shout_02')

	for i = 1, 3 do
		local civilian = get_character('civilian_' .. i)
		character_util.set_emotion(civilian, {name = 'damaged'})
		character_util.move_waypoint(civilian, civilian.Position + vector(-25, 0, 0), 6, true)

		if i ~= 3 then
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(civilian, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_s8_5_' .. i, skip = true, bubble_type = 'shout' })
		end

	end

	character_util.set_emotion(princess, {name = 'surprise'})
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(princess, marker_pos, 4, false)

	--character_util.remove_emotion(princess)
	--
	--character_util.show_emoticon_async(princess, nil, 'silence')

	wait_for_sec(2)

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_s8_6', skip = true })
	--…부유성이…?

	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_direction(princess, 'left')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_direction(princess, 'up')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_direction(princess, 'right')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	character_util.set_emotion(princess, {name = 'tired'})

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_s8_7', skip = true })
	--무슨 일이 일어나고 있는 거지…

	for i = 1, 3 do
		local civilian = get_character('civilian_' .. i)
		civilian.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
	end

	music_player_util.play_stage_music(
			{ name = 'ondemand/v2_3_futurecastle/audio/music/bgm_futurecastle_main:bgm_futurecastle_main', state = 'field', mix = 2 })

	local exit = get_field_object('heaven_hold_exit')
	exit.Position = self.exit_origin_pos
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create('door_forest_1'))

	yield_return_func(quest_util.progress_section, self.controller)
end

return local_class

	self.do_shake = false

	-- 꼬물꼬물 노움 씬
	self.gnome_moving = false

	-- 노움 멈춤
	self.gnome_stop = false

	-- 노움들 위치 초기화
	self.gnome_reset = false

	-- 인베이더 추격 여부
	self.check_invader = false

	self.crowd_sfx = nil
	self.war_sfx = nil

	self.invader_dash_sfx = nil
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.target_stage_name then
		return
	end
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_zone_leave_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.SwitchOnOffEvent), 'on_switch_on_off_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')

	--projectile 설정
	local spec = CS.Oak.GameDataService.GetData('ProjectileData'):GetSpec('projectile_nightmare_mushroom')

	local pattern_Info = CS.Oak.ShootPatternInfo()
	pattern_Info.columns = 1
	pattern_Info.spreadDistance = 1
	pattern_Info.parallel = false

	-- ShootHelper 설정
	local ps = CS.Oak.LuaIProjectileShooter(self, self.get_maiden())
	self.shoot_helper = CS.Oak.ShootHelper(CS.Oak.Projectile.MoveType.Cannon,
			ps, spec, pattern_Info, CS.Oak.ShootHelperShootEffectType.EachShootWithShootOffset)

	self:set_environment()

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.target_stage_name then
		self.controller:set_default_quest_marker()
		return
	end

	if self.controller.starting_inner_progress < 8 then
		CS.Oak.UIQuestMarkersController.Instance:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('nightmare_futurecastle_main', self.quest_spec.QuestId,
				self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, self.get_maiden())
	else
		CS.Oak.UIQuestMarkersController.Instance:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('nightmare_futurecastle_main', self.quest_spec.QuestId,
				self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, get_field_object('forest_exit'))
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	if stage.Name ~= self.target_stage_name then
		return
	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.SwitchOnOffEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	self.shoot_helper = nil
	self.current_champion = nil
end

function local_class:dispose()
	if stage.Name ~= self.target_stage_name then
		return
	end

	local eva = self.get_eva()
	if eva ~= nil then
		character_util.remove_relate_event(eva, self.controller.cs_controller)
	end

	if self.crowd_sfx ~= nil then
		self.crowd_sfx:Stop()
		self.crowd_sfx = nil
	end

	if self.war_sfx ~= nil then
		self.war_sfx:Stop()
		self.war_sfx = nil
	end

	if self.invader_dash_sfx ~= nil then
		self.invader_dash_sfx:Stop()
		self.invader_dash_sfx = nil
	end

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region on event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if stage.Name ~= self.target_stage_name then
		return
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter == false then return end
	if e.FieldObject ~= user_party.Leader then return end
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == 'section_9_maiden_out' and self.current_progress == self.section_progress.none then
		self.current_progress = self.section_progress.maiden
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.meet_maiden, self)

	elseif zone_name == 'section_9_gnome' and self.current_progress == self.section_progress.maiden then
		self.in_gnome_zone = true
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.check_event_start, self))

	elseif zone_name == 'section_9_battle' and self.current_progress == self.section_progress.switch then
		self.current_progress = self.section_progress.death
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.invader_fight, self, true)

	elseif zone_name == 'section_9_gnome_end' and self.current_progress == self.section_progress.death then
		self.current_progress = self.section_progress.ending
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.jacks_end, self)

	elseif zone_name == 'section_9_oneline_1' and self.last_zone[1] == false then
		self.last_zone[1] = true
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.oneline_event, self, 1))

	elseif zone_name == 'section_9_oneline_2' and self.last_zone[2] == false then
		self.last_zone[2] = true
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.oneline_event, self, 2))

	elseif zone_name == 'section_9_champion' and self.last_zone[3] == false then
		self.last_zone[3] = true
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.champion_talk, self))

	elseif zone_name == 'section_9_maiden' and self.is_maiden_fight == false and
			self.current_progress == self.section_progress.none then
		self.is_maiden_fight = true

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.maiden_fight, self, 1))

	elseif zone_name == 'hide_pet' then
		local pet = self.get_pet()
		character_util.convert_to_npc(pet)
		character_util.set_with_marker(pet, field:GetMarker('pet_2'))

		if self.current_progress == self.section_progress.none then
			self.controller:start_sfx_loop()
			CS.Oak.UIQuestMarkersController.Instance:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('nightmare_futurecastle_main', self.quest_spec.QuestId,
					self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, self.get_maiden())
		end

	elseif zone_name == 'section_9_shake_zone' then
		self.do_shake = true
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.random_shake, self))

	elseif zone_name == 'section_9_gnome_start' and self.gnome_moving == false then
		self.gnome_moving = true
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.gnome_move, self))

	elseif zone_name == 'section_9_gnome_reset' and self.gnome_reset == false then
		self.gnome_reset = true
		self.gnome_stop = true

		local jack = get_character('fat_gnome')
		character_util.stop(jack)
		character_util.set_position(jack, vector(999, 0, 999))

		for i = 1, 9 do
			local gnome = get_character('gnome_' .. i)
			character_util.stop(gnome)
			character_util.set_position(gnome, vector(999, 0, 999))
		end

	elseif self.current_progress == self.section_progress.none then
		if zone_name == 'futurecastle_bgm' then
			self.controller:start_sfx_loop()
		elseif zone_name == 'forest_bgm' then
			self.controller:stop_sfx_loop()
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if not e.FullLeave then return false end
	if e.FieldObject ~= user_party.Leader then return false end

	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == 'section_9_gnome' and self.current_progress == self.section_progress.maiden then
		self.in_gnome_zone = false
	elseif zone_name == 'section_9_shake_zone' then
		self.do_shake = false
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_switch_on_off_event(e)
	local switch_name = e.SwitchObject.Name

	for i = 1, 2 do
		if switch_name == 'gnome_switch_' .. i then
			self.switch_checker[i] = e.IsTurningOn
		end
	end

	if self.switch_checker[1] and self.switch_checker[2] --and self.switch_checker[3]
			and self.current_progress == self.section_progress.jack then
		self.current_progress = self.section_progress.switch
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.jack_switch, self, true)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local maiden = self.get_maiden()
	local eva = self.get_eva()

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, eva) and self.current_progress == self.section_progress.ending then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.quest_ending, self)
	end
end
--endregion on event
function local_class:set_environment()
	for i = 1, 2 do
		local android = get_character('android_' .. i)
		character_util.set_with_marker(android, field:GetMarker(android.Name))
	end

	for i = 1, 3 do
		local invader = get_character('invader_1_' .. i)
		character_util.set_with_marker(invader, field:GetMarker(invader.Name))
	end

	local maiden = self.get_maiden()
	character_util.set_with_marker(maiden, field:GetMarker(maiden.Name))

	local char_name = {'eva', 'craig', 'sohee', 'linda', 'bob',
					   'marvin', 'marian', 'fei', 'mei', 'yuze', 'ishya', 'shyapira',
					   'resistance_1', 'resistance_2', 'resistance_3', 'resistance_4'}
	for i = 1, #char_name do
		local guardian = get_character(char_name[i])
		guardian.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
		character_util.set_with_marker(guardian, field:GetMarker(char_name[i]))
	end

	for i = 1, 4 do
		local guardian = get_character('resistance_' .. i)
		if i < 3 then
			character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(guardian, {name = 'prostrate'}, {name = 'damaged'})
			guardian.Interactable.Talk = 'nightmare_futurecastle_s9_oneline_1'
		else
			character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(guardian, {name = 'eat'}, {name = 'tired'})
		end
	end

	if self.controller.starting_inner_progress < 8 then
		self.do_shake = true
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.random_shake, self))
	end
end

-- 인베이더와 싸우고있는 로레인
function local_class:maiden_fight(idx)
	local maiden = self.get_maiden()

	local androids = {}
	for i = 1, 2 do
		local android = get_character('android_' .. i)
		androids[i] = android
	end

	local invaders = {}
	for i = 1, 3 do
		local invader = get_character('invader_' .. idx .. '_' .. i)
		invaders[i] = invader
	end

	while self.is_maiden_fight do

		character_util.set_anim(androids[2], {name = 'carpenter_hammer', remove_after = 0.5})
		androids[2].SpineController:DeviateLocal(vector(-0.5, 0, 0), 0.3, 0.2)

		character_util.set_anim(androids[1], {name = 'attack', remove_after = 0.5})
		androids[1].SpineController:DeviateLocal(vector(-0.5, 0, 0), 0.3, 0.2)

		if self.stop_maiden_fight == false then
			character_util.set_anim(maiden, {name = 'attack', remove_after = 0.5})
		end

		wait_for_sec(0.3)

		if self.stop_maiden_fight == false then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.shoot_mushroom, self, invaders[3].Position))
		end

		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_hit_big_01', play_pos = maiden.Position, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
		for i = 1, 2 do
			self.get_hit_effect():Instantiate(invaders[i].Position + vector(0, 0.03, 0))
			character_util.spine_damage_squish(invaders[i], 1.3, 0.7, 1, 0.3)
			character_util.spine_pulse_color(invaders[i], CS.Oak.Constants.DamageColor, 1, 1, 0.3)
		end

		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		for i = 1, 2 do
			character_util.set_anim(invaders[i], {name = 'attack', remove_after = 0.5})
			invaders[1].SpineController:DeviateLocal(vector(0.5, 0, 0), 0.3, 0.2)
		end

		wait_for_sec(0.3)

		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_hit_big_01', play_pos = maiden.Position, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
		for i = 1, 2 do
			self.get_hit_effect():Instantiate(androids[i].Position + vector(0, 0.03, 0))
			character_util.spine_damage_squish(androids[i], 1.3, 0.7, 1, 0.3)
			character_util.spine_pulse_color(androids[i], CS.Oak.Constants.DamageColor, 1, 1, 0.3)
		end

		wait_for_sec(0.5)

	end

end

-- 로레인과 재회
function local_class:meet_maiden()
	local maiden = self.get_maiden()
	local princess = user_party.Leader

	CS.Oak.UIQuestMarkersController.Instance:RemoveQuestMarker('nightmare_futurecastle_main')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_goblin_appear_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_01')
	self.controller:stop_sfx_loop()

	character_util.set_emotion(princess, {name = 'scared'})
	character_util.shake(princess, 0.04, 9999)
	party_util.align_to_target(maiden, 'right')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_s9_1', skip = true})
	--로레인!

	self.stop_maiden_fight = true
	character_util.set_emotion(maiden, {name = 'attack'})
	character_util.set_direction(maiden, 'right')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(maiden, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_s9_2', skip = true,
														  portraitname = self.maiden_portrait_name, bubble_type = 'shout'})
	-- 공주님!

	self.stop_maiden_fight = false
	character_util.set_direction(maiden, 'left')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(maiden, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_s9_3', skip = true,
														  portraitname = self.maiden_portrait_name, bubble_type = 'shout' })
	--어딜 그렇게 쏘다녀요? 한참 찾았잖아요!

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(maiden, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_s9_4', skip = true,
														  portraitname = self.maiden_portrait_name})
	--갑자기 인베이더 놈들이 잔뜩 들이닥쳤는데… 공주님은 온데간데없고…

	self.is_maiden_fight = false
	wait_for_sec(1.3)

	local androids = {}
	for i = 1, 2 do
		local android = get_character('android_' .. i)
		androids[i] = android
	end

	local invaders = {}
	for i = 1, 3 do
		local invader = get_character('invader_1_' .. i)
		invaders[i] = invader
	end

	character_util.set_anim(androids[2], {name = 'carpenter_hammer', remove_after = 0.5})
	androids[2].SpineController:DeviateLocal(vector(-0.5, 0, 0), 0.3, 0.2)

	character_util.set_anim(androids[1], {name = 'attack', remove_after = 0.5})
	androids[1].SpineController:DeviateLocal(vector(-0.5, 0, 0), 0.3, 0.2)

	character_util.set_anim(maiden, {name = 'attack', remove_after = 0.5})

	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.shoot_mushroom, self, invaders[3].Position, invaders[3]))

	for i = 1, 2 do
		self.get_hit_effect():Instantiate(invaders[i].Position + vector(0, 0.03, 0))
		local spin_state = CS.Oak.CharacterAirSpinState.Create(invaders[i],
				vector(-3, 0, 0), 1, 0.25, true)
		message_system:Send(invaders[i].CharacterBehaviour, CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(spin_state))
	end

	camera_util.shake(0.15, 0.15)

	wait_for_sec(2)

	character_util.show_emoticon(maiden, nil, 'notice')

	-- 인베이더 소환
	for i = 1, 3 do
		local marker = field:GetMarker('invader_2_' .. i)
		local invader = get_character('invader_2_' .. i)
		screen_util.invader_transfer(marker.position, marker.direction, invader)
		wait_for_sec(0.3)
		character_util.stop(invaders)
	end

	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	character_util.set_emotion(maiden, {name = 'mad'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(maiden, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_s9_8_1', skip = true,
														  portraitname = self.maiden_portrait_name })
	--거참, 바퀴벌레처럼 끈질긴 분들이네.

	character_util.set_direction(maiden, 'right')
	character_util.set_emotion(maiden, {name = 'attack'})
	character_util.normal_jump_async(maiden, '01_jump_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(maiden, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_s9_9', skip = true,
														  portraitname = self.maiden_portrait_name })
	--어서! 안전한 곳으로 이동해요!
	character_util.set_direction(maiden, 'left')

	for i = 1, #androids do
		character_util.move_waypoint(androids[i], androids[i].Position + vector(-1.5, 0, 0),
				4, false)
	end

	wait_for_sec(1.5 / 4)

	self.is_maiden_fight = true
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.maiden_fight, self, 2))

	character_util.set_direction(princess, 'left')
	character_util.set_emotion(princess, {name = 'tired'})
	character_util.normal_jump_async(princess, '01_small_jump_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_s9_10', skip = true})
	--나 혼자? 로… 로레인은 어떡하려고!

	camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.5)
	character_util.set_emotion(princess, {name = 'surprise'})
	character_util.normal_jump(princess)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(maiden, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_s9_10_1', skip = true,
														  portraitname = self.maiden_portrait_name, bubble_type = 'shout' })
	--거참 시끄럽네!

	character_util.set_emotion(princess, {name = 'tired'})

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(maiden, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_s9_10_2', skip = true,
														  portraitname = self.maiden_portrait_name})
	--제 걱정할 시간에 얼른 뛰라고요!

	character_util.stop_shake(princess)

	--로레인은 인베이더와 전투
end

function local_class:gnome_move()
	-- 이전 씬 정리
	self.is_maiden_fight = false
	self.war_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_war_loop_01', loop = true, fade_in_time = 2 })

	for i = 1, 3 do
		local invader = get_character('invader_2_' .. i)
		invader.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
	end

	local maiden = self.get_maiden()
	maiden.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)

	for i = 1, 2 do
		local android = get_character('android_' .. i)
		android.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
	end
	-- 정리 끝

	local jack = get_character('fat_gnome')
	character_util.set_with_marker(jack, field:GetMarker(jack.Name .. '_pre'))
	jack:SetGiantFactor('gnome', 0.3)
	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(jack, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)

	local gnomes = {}
	for i = 1, 9 do
		local gnome = get_character('gnome_' .. i)
		character_util.set_with_marker(gnome, field:GetMarker(gnome.Name .. '_pre'))
		gnome:SetGiantFactor('gnome', 0.3)
		field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(gnome, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
		gnomes[i] = gnome
	end

	table.insert(gnomes, jack)

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	for i = 1, #gnomes do
		character_util.move_waypoint(gnomes[i], gnomes[i].Position + vector(0, 0, -15), 1, false)
	end

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function ()
		wait_for_sec(4)

		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_fat_gnome_03', play_pos = jack.Position })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(jack, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_s9_10_3', scale = 0.8})
		--자, 조심조심!

		wait_for_sec(2)

		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_whistle_01', loop = true, duration = 2, play_pos = jack.Position })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(jack, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_s9_10_4', scale = 0.8})
		--하나 둘, 하나 둘!
	end))

	wait_for_sec(15)

	if self.gnome_stop then
		return
	end

	character_util.move_waypoint_async(jack, {jack.Position + vector(1.25, 0, 0),
											  jack.Position + vector(1.25, 0, 1.25)}, 1, false)

	for i = 1, #gnomes do
		character_util.move_waypoint(gnomes[i], gnomes[i].Position + vector(9, 0, 0), 1, false)
	end

	wait_for_sec(9)

	if self.gnome_stop then
		return
	end

	for i = 1, #gnomes do
		character_util.set_position(gnomes[i], vector(999, 0, 999))
	end
end

function local_class:check_event_start()
	wait_for_sec(3)
	if self.in_gnome_zone and self.current_progress == self.section_progress.maiden then
		self.current_progress = self.section_progress.jack
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.meet_jack, self)
	end
end

-- 잭과의 재회
function local_class:meet_jack()
	self.gnome_stop = true
	self.war_sfx:FadeOut(2)
	self.war_sfx = nil

	local princess = user_party.Leader
	local jack = get_character('fat_gnome')
	character_util.stop(jack)
	character_util.set_with_marker(jack, field:GetMarker(jack.Name))
	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(jack, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)

	local gnomes = {}
	for i = 1, 9 do
		local gnome = get_character('gnome_' .. i)
		character_util.stop(gnome)
		character_util.set_with_marker(gnome, field:GetMarker(gnome.Name))
		field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(gnome, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
		gnomes[i] = gnome
	end

function local_class:check_kidnap()
	local princess = self.get_princess()
	local invader = get_character('invader_3')
	local target_pos = field:GetMarker(invader.Name).position + vector(0, 0, -19)

	local catch = false

	if self.invader_dash_sfx == nil then
		self.invader_dash_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_dash_01', loop = true, type_priority = 'event',
													player_priority = 'npc' })
	end

	while self.check_invader do
		local speed = invader.Position.z - princess.Position.z
		if speed < 1 then
			catch = true
			break
		end
		character_util.move_waypoint(invader, target_pos, 6.3, true)
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if catch then
		character_util.stop(invader)
		character_util.look_at(invader, princess)

		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.princess_reset, self)
	end
end

	if self.invader_dash_sfx ~= nil then
		self.invader_dash_sfx:Stop()
		self.invader_dash_sfx = nil

	local princess = self.get_princess()
	local invader = get_character('invader_3')

function local_class:champion_talk()
	local talk_data = {
		{talker = get_character('sohee'), key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_s9_37', portrait = 'ghost_buster'},
		{talker = get_character('marvin'), key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_s9_37_1', portrait = 'desert_slave'},
		{talker = get_character('craig'), key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_s9_38', portrait = 'tanker'},
		{talker = get_character('eva'), key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_s9_39', portrait = 'knight_captain'}
	}

	--인베이더 놈들 드디어 미쳐버린 거야? 어딜 부유성까지…
	--사막은 진즉에 쑥대밭이 됐어.
	--점점 공격이 전 지역에 동시다발적으로 이루어지고 있어. 이번이 끝일 리가…
	--일단 부상자부터 이송하고, 제대로 전력을 정비해야 한다.

	for i = 1, #talk_data do

		if self.stop_champion_talk then
			break

		self.current_champion = data.talker
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(data.talker, { key = data.key, portraitname =  data.portrait})
	end

	for i = 1, #talk_data do
		local data = talk_data[i]
		data.talker.Interactable.Talk = data.key
	end
end

function local_class:shoot_mushroom(pos, target)
	local maiden = self.get_maiden()

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_dark_magician_shoot_01', play_pos = maiden.Position, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	self.shoot_helper:ShootTargetPosition(pos, vector(0, 0, 0), -1)

	wait_for_sec(math.sqrt(vector_util.sqr_distance(maiden.Position, pos)) / 3 - 0.2)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_hit_dark_01', play_pos = maiden.Position, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
	self.get_explosion_effect():Instantiate(pos)

	if target ~= nil then
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_explosion_01', play_pos = target.Position, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
		camera_util.shake(0.15, 0.2)
		local spin_state = CS.Oak.CharacterAirSpinState.Create(target,
				vector(0, 0, 0), 1, 0.25, true)
		message_system:Send(target.CharacterBehaviour, CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(spin_state))
	end
end

function local_class:throw_rock_to_target(thrower, target, target_pos)
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_swing_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	character_util.look_at(thrower, target)
	character_util.set_anim(thrower, { name = 'attack', loop = false })

	local rock = drop_item_util.create_item(
			{ itemid = 20019, notforinven = true, pos = thrower.Position + vector(0, 0, 0.5),
			  target = target_pos, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', sprscale = 0.8, showoncharacter = true })

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	character_util.remove_anim(thrower)

	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_hit_projectile_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	-- 명중에 성공했을 경우 실행

	character_util.spine_damage_squish(target, 1.3, 0.7, 1, 0.3)

	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	rock:ConsumeComplete()
end

function local_class:random_shake()
	while self.do_shake do
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_earthquake_02')
		camera_util.shake(0.15, 1)
		wait_for_sec(1)

		local rand_additional_time = unity_class.random.Range(0.3, 2)
		wait_for_sec(2 + rand_additional_time)
	end
end

	if self.resholder ~= nil then
		self.resholder:Dispose()
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

function local_class:set_sky()
	self.inn_scene = nil
	self.inn_camera = nil
	yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
			self.resholder, 'ondemand/v2_10_futurecastle_part2/theatres_6', 'future_stage5_castle', function(prefab)
				self.inn_scene = CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Instantiate(prefab)
				self.inn_scene.transform.localPosition = vector(-500, 0, -300)
				self.inn_camera = self.inn_scene.transform:Find('Main Camera').transform

				local inn_cam = self.inn_camera:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Camera))
				self.inn_camera_half_height = inn_cam.orthographicSize
				self.inn_camera_half_width = self.inn_camera_half_height
						* CS.UnityEngine.Screen.width / CS.UnityEngine.Screen.height
				self.camera_pivot = stage_camera.Transform.parent
				local stage_cam = stage_camera.Camera
				stage_cam.clearFlags = CS.UnityEngine.CameraClearFlags.Depth
				--stage_cam.orthographicSize = inn_cam.orthographicSize

				self.inn_scene.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(45, 0, 0)
			end)

	local asset_bundle_path = 'ondemand/v2_10_futurecastle_part2/theatres_6'
	local asset_bundle
	yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.AssetBundleManager.Instance.LoadAssetBundleAsync,
			CS.Foundations.AssetBundleManager.Instance, asset_bundle_path, function(res)
				asset_bundle = res
			end)

	local image_infos = {
		back_1 = {
			target_name = 'stage_5_ed_back1',
			asset_name = 'stage_5_ed_back1.png',
			layer_name = 'Under Effects',
			order = 1
		},
		back_2 = {
			target_name = 'stage_5_ed_back2',
			asset_name = 'stage_5_ed_back2.png',
			layer_name = 'Under Effects',
			order = 2
		},
		illust = {
			target_name = 'stage_5_ed_illust',
			asset_name = 'stage_5_ed_illust.png'
		},
		sky = {
			target_name = 'stage_5_ed_sky',
			asset_name = 'stage_5_ed_sky.jpg',
			layer_name = 'Under Effects',
			order = 0
		}
	}

	for key, info in pairs(image_infos) do
		local target_obj = self.inn_scene.transform:Find(info.target_name).gameObject
		yield_return_func(asset_bundle.LoadAssetAsync, asset_bundle, info.asset_name, function(texture_bytes)
			if texture_bytes then
				local texture = CS.UnityEngine.Texture2D(2, 2, CS.UnityEngine.TextureFormat.RGBA32, false)
				texture.wrapMode = CS.UnityEngine.TextureWrapMode.Mirror
				if CS.UnityEngine.ImageConversion.LoadImage(texture, texture_bytes.bytes, true) then
					local rect = CS.UnityEngine.Rect(0, 0, texture.width, texture.height)
					-- 텍스쳐를 스프라이트로 생성
					local sprite = CS.UnityEngine.Sprite.Create(texture,
							rect,
							vector(0.5, 0.5),
							100,
							0,
							CS.UnityEngine.SpriteMeshType.Tight,
							unity_class.vector4.zero,
							false)

					-- 새 오브젝트를 만들어서 SpriteRenderer를 붙여줌
					local sprite_renderer = CS.GameObjectExtensions.GetOrAddComponent(target_obj,
							typeof(CS.UnityEngine.SpriteRenderer))

					if sprite_renderer then
						sprite_renderer.sprite = sprite
						if info.layer_name ~= nil then
							sprite_renderer.sortingLayerName = info.layer_name
						end

						if info.order ~= nil then
							sprite_renderer.sortingOrder = info.order
						end
					end
				end
			end

							   :GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.SpriteRenderer))

	self.inn_background_x_min = inn_background.transform.localPosition.x - inn_background.bounds.size.x / 2

													 :Find(self.inn_back_layer_infos[i].name)
		self.inn_back_layer_infos[i].origin_pos = self.inn_back_layer_infos[i].transform.localPosition
	end

													  :Find(self.inn_cloud_layer_infos[i].name)
	end

	self:inn_camera_move(vector(4.1, 0, -15), 0)
	self:inn_camera_y_move(vector(1.5, 18.7, -15), 0)

-- 새 날아가는 연출
function local_class:bird_fly(fo, target_pos, speed)
	local time_passed = 0
	local start_pos = fo.transform.localPosition

	final_duration = (target_pos - start_pos).magnitude / speed

	while true do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if time_passed >= final_duration then
			break
		end

		fo.transform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, target_pos, time_passed / final_duration)
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

end

-- x축 방향으로 움직이는 경우만 산정
function local_class:get_inn_camera_pos(target_pos)
	if target_pos.x + self.inn_camera_half_width + self.inn_camera_max_shake > self.inn_background_x_max then
		target_pos = vector_util.get_0yz(target_pos,
				self.inn_background_x_max - self.inn_camera_half_width - self.inn_camera_max_shake)
	elseif target_pos.x - self.inn_camera_half_width - self.inn_camera_max_shake < self.inn_background_x_min then
		target_pos = vector_util.get_0yz(target_pos,
				self.inn_background_x_min + self.inn_camera_half_width + self.inn_camera_max_shake)
	end

	return target_pos
end

-- Y축 방향으로 움직이는 경우만 산정
function local_class:inn_camera_y_move(target_pos, duration, use_stage_camera)
	local time_passed = 0
	local start_pos = self.inn_camera.localPosition
	target_pos = vector_util.get_0yz(target_pos, start_pos.x)
	local layer_pos_infos = {}
	for i = 1, #self.inn_back_layer_infos do
		local layer_start_pos = self.inn_back_layer_infos[i].transform.localPosition
		layer_pos_infos[i] = {
			start_pos = layer_start_pos,
			target_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(layer_start_pos, vector_util.get_x0z(layer_start_pos, target_pos.y),
					self.inn_back_layer_infos[i].move_ratio)
		}
	end
	use_stage_camera = lua_helper.get_or_default(use_stage_camera, true)

	while time_passed < duration do
		local time_progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration)
		-- 보간법 적용
		local cur_cam_y = CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseInOutSine(
				time_progress, start_pos.y, target_pos.y - start_pos.y, 1)
		local cur_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(start_pos, cur_cam_y)

		self.inn_camera.localPosition = cur_pos
		if use_stage_camera then
			self.camera_pivot.position = self.inn_camera.position + self.camera_pivot_offset
		end

		for i = 1, #self.inn_back_layer_infos do
			local cur_y_pos = CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseInOutSine(
					time_progress, layer_pos_infos[i].start_pos.y,
					layer_pos_infos[i].target_pos.y - layer_pos_infos[i].start_pos.y, 1)

			self.inn_back_layer_infos[i].transform.localPosition = vector_util.get_x0z(
					layer_pos_infos[i].start_pos, cur_y_pos)
		end

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self.inn_camera.localPosition = target_pos
	if use_stage_camera then
		self.camera_pivot.position = self.inn_camera.position + self.camera_pivot_offset
	end

	for i = 1, #self.inn_back_layer_infos do
		self.inn_back_layer_infos[i].transform.localPosition = layer_pos_infos[i].target_pos
	end
end

-- 여관 카메라 이동
function local_class:inn_camera_move(target_pos, duration)
	-- self.inn_camera.localPosition = vector(1.5, 0, -15)
	target_pos = self:get_inn_camera_pos(target_pos)

	local time_passed = 0
	local start_pos = self.inn_camera.localPosition

	while true do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if time_passed >= duration then
			break
		end

		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration)
		local cur_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, target_pos, progress)
		self.inn_camera.localPosition = cur_pos
		self.camera_pivot.position = self.inn_camera.position + self.camera_pivot_offset
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self.inn_camera.localPosition = target_pos
	self.camera_pivot.position = self.inn_camera.position + self.camera_pivot_offset
end

return local_class

		CS.Oak.UIQuestMarkersController.Instance:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('nightmare_futurecastle_main', self.quest_spec.QuestId,

	elseif zone_name == 's3_prologue_battle_1' and not self.battle_progress[1] then
		self.battle_progress[1] = true
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create('door_2', false))

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create('door_4', false))
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create('door_5', false))

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create('boss_door', false))

		self.current_progress = self.section_progress.eva

		CS.Oak.UIQuestMarkersController.Instance:RemoveQuestMarker('nightmare_futurecastle_main')

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'main_character_hit' then
		if not self.earthquake_sfx then
			self.earthquake_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx(
				{ sfx_name = '01_earthquake_03', loop = true, fade_in_time = 2, player_priority = 'object' })
		end
		return true
	end

	if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'prologue1_end' then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.hero_landing, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:boss_battle()
	local eva = get_character('eva')
	local knight = get_character(not user_util.has_knight_male() and 'super_knight_male' or 'super_knight_female')
	local boss = get_character('minotaurs')

	local end_marker = field:GetMarker('prologue_end')

	character_util.move_waypoint(knight, end_marker.position + vector(-0.5, 0, 0),
			3, false, nil, nil, 'up')

	character_util.move_waypoint(eva, end_marker.position + vector(0.5, 0, 0),
			3, false, nil, nil, 'up')

	--music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_suspense_theme', state = 'event', mix = 1 })

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	camera_util.move(end_marker.position + vector(0, 0, 13), 3)

	wait_for_sec(2.3)

	wait_for_sec(1.1)

	character_util.set_anim(boss, {name = 'buttbounce_ready', loop = false})
	wait_for_sec(0.6)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_minotaurs_jump_01')
	character_util.set_anim(boss, {name = 'buttbounce_up', loop = false})

	local free_fall = CS.CalculatorFreeFall(32, 8, 0, 0)
	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local shadow_move_time = 0.5
	local start_pos = boss.Position

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < shadow_move_time do
		free_fall:Proceed(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
		local cur_y = free_fall:GetDistance()

		character_util.set_position(boss, start_pos + vector(0, cur_y, 0), true)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	camera_util.return_to_leader(2)

	character_util.remove_anim(boss)
	boss.Transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.zero
	character_util.set_position(boss, start_pos + vector(0, 3, -4.5))

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
		wait_for_sec(0.3)

		character_util.set_direction(knight, 'right')
		character_util.set_emotion(knight, {name = 'attack'})

		character_util.set_direction(eva, 'left')
		character_util.set_emotion(knight, {name = 'attack'})
	end))

	free_fall = CS.CalculatorFreeFall(0, 28, 16, 0)
	cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	start_pos = boss.Position
	local free_fall_time = 1
	local scale_time = 0.5
	local start_scale = 0
	local end_scale = 1

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < free_fall_time do
		free_fall:Proceed(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
		local cur_y = free_fall:GetDistance()

		character_util.set_position(boss, vector(start_pos.x, cur_y, start_pos.z), true)

		if unity_class.time.time - cur_time < scale_time then
			local cur_scale = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(start_scale, end_scale,
					(unity_class.time.time - cur_time) / scale_time)
			boss.Transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * cur_scale
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_minotaurs_stomp_01')
	character_util.set_position(boss, vector_util.get_x0z(start_pos))
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_minotaur_buttbounce'):Instantiate(boss.Position)

	camera_util.shake(0.5, 1)
	character_util.shake(boss, 0.03, 1)

	character_util.set_direction(knight, 'up')
	character_util.set_direction(eva, 'up')

	local friction = CS.CalculatorFrictionPush(0, knight.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.FieldObjectSpec.Mass,
			CS.Oak.Constants.DefaultFrictionCoefficient, 6000, 0.3)

	local friction_time = 0.7
	cur_time = unity_class.time.time

	local knight_pos = knight.Position
	local eva_pos = eva.Position

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < friction_time do
		friction:Proceed(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
		local friction_z = friction:GetDistance()

		knight.Position = knight_pos + vector(0, 0, -friction_z)
		eva.Position = eva_pos + vector(0, 0, -friction_z)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	character_util.spine_rotate(eva, 0, 0)

	character_util.remove_anim(knight)

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	wait_for_sec(1)

	character_util.remove_emotion(knight)
	character_util.remove_emotion(eva)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_costume_equip_01')

	character_util.set_direction(knight, 'right')
	character_util.set_direction(eva, 'left')

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	character_util.set_animation_n_times(knight, {name = 'nod', count = 1})
	character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(eva, {name = 'nod', count = 1})

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	character_util.set_direction(knight, 'up')
	character_util.set_direction(eva, 'up')

	camera_util.resize_to(4.5, 1)
	camera_util.move(boss.Position, 1)
	character_util.remove_anim(boss)

	wait_for_sec(1.2)

	camera_util.move(boss.Position + vector(0, 0, -4.5), 4.5)

	for i = 1, 3 do
		character_util.move_waypoint_async(boss, boss.Position + vector(0, 0, -1.5), 3)
		character_util.remove_anim(boss)

		if i ~= 3 then
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_mech_stomp_01')
			camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.5)
			wait_for_sec(1.5)
		end
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_minotaurs_shout_01')

	screen_util.show_boss_title('minotaurs',	'minotaurs_desc',
			2, false)

	character_util.set_anim(boss, {name = 'attack_ready', loop = false})
	wait_for_sec(1.2)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_minotaurs_slash_01')
	character_util.set_anim(boss, {name = 'attack', loop = false})
	camera_util.shake(0.3, 1)
	wait_for_sec(1.3)

	character_util.remove_anim(boss)
	camera_util.resize_to_default(1.5)
	camera_util.return_to_leader(1.5)
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	--music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_battle_boss', state = 'event', mix = 0 })

	character_util.convert_to_monster(boss, 'minotaurs_battle')
	command_util.execute_monster_notice(boss, user_party.Leader, 'battle')
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.ShowBossHPEvent.Create(boss))
end

function local_class:throne()

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.SetBackgroundColorEvent.Create(CS.UnityEngine.Color32(0, 0, 0, 255), 0.5))

	local eva = get_character('eva')
	--local knight = user_party.Leader

	character_util.move_waypoint(knight, end_marker.position + vector(-0.5, 0, 0),
			3, false, nil, nil, 'up')
	character_util.move_waypoint(eva, end_marker.position + vector(0.5, 0, 0),
			3, false, nil, nil, 'up')

			1, false)
	character_util.move_waypoint(eva, eva.Position + vector(0, 0.5, 1),

	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(0.6, 'linear')

	wait_for_sec(2)

	-- ThroneRoom 타일맵 로드
	self.throne_room_obj = CS.UnityEngine.GameObject('throneRoom')
	self.throne_room_obj.transform.parent = stage.StageTransform

	local throne_room_stage_loaded = false

	local throne_room_stage = self.throne_room_obj:AddComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.EventStage))
	throne_room_stage:Init('throneroom', function()
		throne_room_stage_loaded = true
	end)

	while not throne_room_stage_loaded do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- ThroneRoom 타일맵 설정
	self.throne_room_obj.transform.localPosition = vector(-200, 0, 0)

	local queen = get_character('queen')
	queen.Position = throne_room_stage:GetNPC('queen').transform.position + vector(-0.2, 0, 0)

	local female = get_character('escape_female')
	female.Position = throne_room_stage:GetNPC('civ_f').transform.position

	local male = get_character('escape_male')
	male.Position = throne_room_stage:GetNPC('civ_m').transform.position

	knight.Position = throne_room_stage:GetNPC('mknight').transform.position
	eva.Position = throne_room_stage:GetNPC('knightcaptain').transform.position

	-- NPC들은 전부 사용하지 않으므로 비활성화
	throne_room_stage.transform:GetChild(0):GetChild(3).gameObject:SetActive(false)

	local effect_parent = self.throne_room_obj.transform:GetChild(0)
	self.resholder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()

	local magic_circle = nil
	yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
			self.resholder, 'effects/prologue_throneroom_effects', 'FX_magicCircle_big_teleport', function(prefab)
				magic_circle = CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Instantiate(prefab)
				magic_circle.transform:SetParent(effect_parent)
				magic_circle.transform.localPosition = vector(0.5, 0.01, 35)
				magic_circle:SetActive(true)
			end)

	local sphere_blue = nil
	local sphere_blue2 = nil
	yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
			self.resholder, 'effects/prologue_throneroom_effects', 'FX_teleportsphere_blue', function(prefab)
				sphere_blue = CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Instantiate(prefab)
				sphere_blue.transform:SetParent(effect_parent)
				sphere_blue:SetActive(false)

				sphere_blue2 = CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Instantiate(prefab)
				sphere_blue2.transform:SetParent(effect_parent)
				sphere_blue2:SetActive(false)
			end)

	self.throne_camera_root:SetActive(true)
	self.throne_camera.enabled = true
	stage_camera.Camera.enabled = false

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_throne_main', state = 'event', mix = 2 })

	screen_util.fade_in_circular(2, 'linear')
	screen_util.fade_in(0, unity_class.color.black, "linear")

	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local start_z = 19
	local end_z = 22
	local camera_time = 2

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < camera_time do
		local progress = (unity_class.time.time - cur_time) / camera_time
		local cur_z = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(start_z, end_z, progress)

		self.throne_camera.transform.localPosition = vector(0.5, 8, cur_z)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowStageTitle(game_string:GetString('kanterbury_throne'))

	local start_size = self.throne_camera.fieldOfView
	local end_size = 22
	camera_time = 3.5

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < camera_time do
		local progress = (unity_class.time.time - cur_time) / camera_time
		local cur_size = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(start_size, end_size, progress)

		self.throne_camera.fieldOfView = cur_size

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self.throne_camera.fieldOfView = end_size

	--local queen = throne_room_stage:GetNPC('queen')
	--local female = throne_room_stage:GetNPC('civ_f')
	--local male = throne_room_stage:GetNPC('civ_m')

	character_util.set_anim(queen, {name = 'cast'})

	--안전한 곳에 착지할 때까지 서로 꼭 붙잡고 있어요. 알겠죠?

	character_util.normal_jump(female, '01_jump_01')

	local time_passed = 0
	local fly_height = 10

	local female_base_pos = female.Position
	local male_base_pos = male.Position

	while time_passed < fly_duration do
		local progress = time_passed / fly_duration

		female.Position = female_base_pos + vector(0, fly_height * progress, 0)
		male.Position = male_base_pos + vector(0, fly_height * progress, 0)

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield(nil)

	character_util.set_active_state(male, 'disabled')

function local_class:shake_camera(cam, magnitude, duration)
	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local origin_pos = cam.transform.position

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < duration do
		local rand_x = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(-magnitude, magnitude)
		local rand_z = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(-magnitude, magnitude)

		cam.transform.position = origin_pos + vector(rand_x, 0, rand_z)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	cam.transform.position = origin_pos
end
