local local_class = newclass('NightmareFutureCastleMain2Section5')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = NightmareFutureCastleMain2 @
		Comment = 3, 4 스테이지 구세주 등장 / 5 스테이지 구세주와 대면 @
		Index = 3 @
		NextSections = 4 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	self.stage_names = {
		'nightmare_futurecastle_part2_3',
		'nightmare_futurecastle_part2_4',
		'nightmare_futurecastle_part2_5'
	}

	self.section_progress = {
		-- 초기값
		none = 0,
		-- 구세주와 만남
		messiah = 1,
		-- 시간을 멈춰버릴 정도로 강력한 구세주
		the_world = 2,
		-- 포탈을 소환한 구세주
		summon = 3,
		-- 포탈을 타고 이동하는 공주
		portal = 4,
	}

	self.current_progress = self.section_progress.none

	-- 메인이 아닌 다른 이벤트 판별 여부 저장
	self.check_event = false

	-- 카메라 일렁이는 이펙트용 머터리얼
	self.mat_container = nil
	self.mat_container_obj = nil

	-- 카메라 색 반전 이미지 이펙트 데이터
	self.image_effect_data_container = nil
	self.image_effect_data_obj = nil

	self.portal_effect = nil

	self.data_storage = nil

	self.baby_knight_run_sfx_holder = nil

	self.portal_sfx = nil

	self.crystal_move = false
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	--unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Blockaura_Char_Boss')
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('custom_sprite')
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_m_futureprincess_ready')
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_m_futureprincess_fire')
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_stage5_final_portal_protect_shield')
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_m_futureprincess_thrust')
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_m_futureprincess_pull')
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_stage5_distorted_spacetime_backstage_fx')
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_stage6_bossroom_floating_rock')
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_reset_object')
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('MagicCircle_AppearIdle')
end

function local_class:enter()
	local do_return = self:check_stage_name()
	if do_return then
		return true
	end

	self.res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')

	self:set_environment()

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_names[3] then
		self.controller:set_default_quest_marker()
	else
		CS.Oak.UIQuestMarkersController.Instance:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('nightmare_futurecastle_main2', self.quest_spec.QuestId,
				self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, get_field_object('stair_hall'))
	end

	local do_return = self:check_stage_name()
	if do_return then
		return
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	local do_return = self:check_stage_name()
	if do_return then
		return true
	end

	if self.res_holder ~= nil then
		self.res_holder:Dispose()
		self.res_holder = nil
	end

	if is_unity_null(self.mat_container_obj) == false then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.mat_container_obj)
	end
	self.mat_container_obj = nil
	self.mat_container = nil

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	local messiah = get_character('messiah')
	if stage.Name == self.stage_names[3] and messiah ~= nil then
		character_util.remove_relate_event(messiah, self.controller)
	end

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
	self.stage_names = nil
end

--region on event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()
	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter == false then return end
	if e.FieldObject ~= user_party.Leader then return end
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if stage.Name == self.stage_names[1] then
		if zone_name == 's5_stage3_baby' and not self.check_event
		and quest_util.get_custom_state(self.quest_progress, 'stage_3_messiah') ~= 1 then
			self.check_event = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.stage3_baby, self))
		end
	elseif stage.Name == self.stage_names[2] then
		if zone_name == 's5_stage4_baby' and not self.check_event
			and quest_util.get_custom_state(self.quest_progress, 'stage_4_messiah') ~= 1 then
			self.check_event = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.stage4_baby, self))
		end
	elseif stage.Name == self.stage_names[3] then
		if zone_name == 's5_throne' and self.current_progress == self.section_progress.none then
			self.current_progress = self.section_progress.messiah
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.meet_messiah, self)
		elseif zone_name == 's5_portal' and self.current_progress == self.section_progress.summon then
			self.current_progress = self.section_progress.portal
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.princess_teleport, self)
		elseif zone_name == 's5_marker_zone_1' then
			CS.Oak.UIQuestMarkersController.Instance:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('nightmare_futurecastle_main2', self.quest_spec.QuestId,
					self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, get_field_object('stair_hall'))
		elseif zone_name == 's5_marker_zone_2' then
			if self.current_progress == self.section_progress.summon then
				CS.Oak.UIQuestMarkersController.Instance:AddQuestMarkerToPoint('nightmare_futurecastle_main2', self.quest_spec.QuestId,
						self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, field:GetMarker('s5_princess').position)
			else
				CS.Oak.UIQuestMarkersController.Instance:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('nightmare_futurecastle_main2', self.quest_spec.QuestId,
						self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, get_character('messiah'))
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local messiah = get_character('messiah')
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, messiah)
			and stage.Name == self.stage_names[3] then
		if self.current_progress == self.section_progress.messiah then
			self.current_progress = self.section_progress.the_world
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.the_world, self, true)
		elseif self.current_progress == self.section_progress.the_world then
			--sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.princess_portal, self, true)
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.princess_portal, self))
		end
	end
end
--endregion

function local_class:check_stage_name()
	local do_return = true
	for i = 1, #self.stage_names do
		if stage.Name == self.stage_names[i] then
			do_return = false
		end
	end

	return do_return
end

function local_class:set_environment()
	local set_npc = function (npc)
		character_util.set_with_marker(npc, field:GetMarker('s5_' .. npc.Name))
		field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(npc, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(npc, 0, 0)
		npc.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
		npc.SpineController.AlwaysUpdateSpine = true
	end

	if stage.Name == self.stage_names[1] and
			quest_util.get_custom_state(self.quest_progress, 'stage_3_messiah') ~= 1 then
		local stage_3_npc_name = {'baby_princess', 'baby_knight', 'messiah', 'researcher'}
		for i = 1, #stage_3_npc_name do
			local npc = get_character(stage_3_npc_name[i])
			set_npc(npc)
		end

		local princess = get_character('baby_princess')
		local knight = get_character('baby_knight')
		local messiah = get_character('messiah')

		princess.Holdable = CS.Oak.Holdable()
		command_util.execute_holdup(knight, princess, knight.Position, 0, false)

		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(messiah, 1, 0)
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(knight, 0.7, 0)
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(princess, 0.7, 0)

		self.baby_knight_run_sfx_holder = music_player_util.play_sfx({
			sfx_name = '01_dash_01', loop = true, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc', parent = knight
		})

		character_util.set_anim(knight, {name = 'run'})

		character_util.move_waypoint(knight, {knight.Position + vector(0, 0, 2),
													knight.Position + vector(5, 0, 2),
													knight.Position + vector(5, 0, 0),
											  knight.Position}, 6, true, 'loop')

	elseif stage.Name == self.stage_names[2] and
			quest_util.get_custom_state(self.quest_progress, 'stage_4_messiah') ~= 1 then
		local stage_4_npc_name = {'baby_princess', 'baby_knight', 'queen', 'researcher'}
		for i = 1, #stage_4_npc_name do
			local npc = get_character(stage_4_npc_name[i])
			set_npc(npc)
		end

		local messiah = get_character('messiah')
		character_util.set_with_marker(messiah, field:GetMarker('s5_messiah'))
		field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(messiah, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
		character_util.set_anim(messiah, {name = 'question', loop = false})
	elseif stage.Name == self.stage_names[3] then
		local bg = get_field_object('sky_bg')
		bg.transform.localScale = vector(1.5, 1, 1)

		local messiah = get_character('messiah')
		character_util.set_direction(messiah, 'down')
		character_util.set_active_state(messiah, 'enabled')
		character_util.add_listener(messiah, self.controller)

		if quest_util.get_custom_state(self.quest_progress, 'unfinished_world', 1) ~= 1 then

			local npc_name = {'aisha', 'craig', 'marian', 'trio_boss', 'trio_man', 'trio_panda'}
			for i = 1, #npc_name do
				local npc = get_character(npc_name[i])
				character_util.set_with_marker(npc, field:GetMarker('s5_' .. npc_name[i]))
				character_util.set_active_state(npc, 'enabled')
				if i ~= 1 then
					npc.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', 'empty')
					npc.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon2', 'empty')
					npc:HideWeapon(true)

					coroutine.yield(nil)

					character_util.remove_anim(npc)
				end
			end

			character_util.set_with_marker(messiah, field:GetMarker('s5_' .. messiah.Name))
		else -- 이 세계를 선택하지 않겠다 이후 재접속
			local origin_pos = field:GetMarker('s5_' .. messiah.Name).position
			character_util.set_position(messiah, origin_pos + vector(0, 0, -0.5))
			character_util.set_direction(messiah, 'down')

			local aisha = get_character('aisha')
			character_util.set_active_state(aisha, 'enabled')
			character_util.set_position(aisha, field:GetMarker('s5_princess').position + vector(-3, 0, 0))
			character_util.set_direction(aisha, 'right')
			character_util.set_anim(aisha, {name = 'question', loop = false})

			local rose = drop_item_util.create_item({pos = messiah.Position + vector(0, 0.5, 0.6), itemid = 20202,
													 notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', sprscale = 0.8 })

			self.current_progress = self.section_progress.the_world
		end

	end
end

function local_class:the_world()
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(user_party.Leader, { 'lorain_head_active_false' }))
	local npc_name = {'aisha', 'craig', 'marian', 'trio_boss', 'trio_man', 'trio_panda'}
	local npcs = {}

	for i = 1, #npc_name do
		npcs[i] = get_character(npc_name[i])
	end

	local messiah = get_character('messiah')
	local princess = user_party.Leader
	local marker = field:GetMarker('s5_princess')

	party_util.align_to_target(vector_util.get_x0z(messiah.Position, 1) + vector(0, 0, 0.2), 'down', 1, 'linear')

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_s5_10_1_1',
															skip = true, bubble_direction = 'cb' })
	--…….

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_s5_10_1_2',
															skip = true, bubble_direction = 'cb' })
	--최상층에서 수상한 기운이 나온다던데… 무슨 속셈이야.

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_s5_10_1_3',
															skip = true, bubble_direction = 'cb' })
	--소히가 말한 이상 현상의 원인은 너…

	wait_for_sec(1)

	character_util.set_direction(messiah, 'down')

	-- 0.5초 색 반전 + 멈춤
	self:load_image_effect_data_container()
	local image_effect_controller = stage_camera.ImageEffectController
	image_effect_controller.ImageEffectDataList = self.image_effect_data.ImageEffectDataList
	local negative_effect = image_effect_controller:FindImageEffectByName('negative_effect')

	local new_camera = CS.UnityEngine.GameObject('Character Camera')
	local camera = stage_camera.Camera
	new_camera.transform.parent = stage_camera.Transform
	new_camera.transform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.zero
	new_camera.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 0, 0)
	local copied_camera = new_camera:AddComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Camera))
	self:copy_camera_from(copied_camera, camera)
	copied_camera.cullingMask = 1 << CS.UnityEngine.LayerMask.NameToLayer('SpecialEvents')
	copied_camera.clearFlags = CS.UnityEngine.CameraClearFlags.Depth
	copied_camera.depth = camera.depth + 1
	copied_camera.allowHDR = false

	CS.Utils.ChangeLayersRecursively(messiah.Transform, 'SpecialEvents')
	CS.Utils.ChangeLayersRecursively(princess.Transform, 'SpecialEvents')

	local vps = camera.gameObject:GetComponent(typeof(CS.ViewportScaler))
	vps.enabled = false
	local new_vps = copied_camera.gameObject:AddComponent(typeof(CS.ViewportScaler))
	new_vps.enabled = true
	vps.enabled = true

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	-- ZA WARUDO!

function local_class:princess_portal()
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(user_party.Leader, { 'lorain_head_active_false' }))
	local messiah = get_character('messiah')
	local aisha = get_character('aisha')
	local princess = user_party.Leader

	character_util.remove_relate_event(messiah, self.controller)

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'ondemand/v2_18_nightmare_futurecastle_2/audio:bgm_messiah_theme', state = 'event' })
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	character_util.set_with_marker(messiah, field:GetMarker('s5_messiah_2'))
	character_util.set_position(messiah, messiah.Position + vector(0, 0.1, 0))

	princess.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon2', 'empty')

		character_util.set_position(messiah, messiah.Position + vector(-0.5, 0, 0))

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_s5_36', skip = true })
		--…넌…

		character_util.set_emotion(princess, {name = 'tired'})

		--…누구지?

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(messiah, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_s5_36_2', skip = true })
		--너희가 인베이더라 부르는 세력의 지도자…

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(messiah, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_s5_36_3', skip = true })
		--…그게 가장 단순한 설명이겠군.

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(aisha, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_s5_36_4', skip = true })
		--……허무맹랑한 소리라 하고 싶지만…

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_land_01')
		character_util.remove_anim(aisha)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(aisha, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_s5_36_5', skip = true })
		--…공주… 네 반응을 보면 그런 것만도 아닌 것 같군.

		character_util.set_emotion(princess, {name = 'sleep_deep'})

function local_class:shake_crystal(crystals, magnitude, duration)
	local time_passed = 0
	local cur_offset = {}
	for i = 1, #crystals do
		cur_offset[i] = vector(0, 0, 0)
	end

	while time_passed < duration do

		for i = 1, #crystals do
			local origin_pos = { crystals[i].SpriteTransform.position - cur_offset[i],
								 crystals[i].ShadowTransform.position - cur_offset[i] }

			local random_angle = 2 * unity_class.mathf.PI * unity_class.random.value
			local h_offset = math.cos(random_angle) * 0.5 * magnitude
			local v_offset = math.sin(random_angle) * 0.5 * magnitude

			cur_offset[i] = crystals[i].SpriteTransform.right * h_offset
					+ crystals[i].SpriteTransform.up * v_offset

			crystals[i].SpriteTransform.position = origin_pos[1] + cur_offset[i]
			crystals[i].ShadowTransform.position = origin_pos[2] + cur_offset[i]
		end

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:crystal_movement(crystals)
	local time_passed = 0
	local messiah = get_character('messiah')

	local sprites = {}
	for i = 1, #crystals do
		sprites[i] = crystals[i].SpriteTransform.gameObject:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
	end

	while self.crystal_move do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		for i = 1, #crystals do

			local term = 0.1
			local speed = 2
			local y = 0.6

			if i <= #crystals / 3 * 2 and i > #crystals / 3 then
				term = 0.2
				speed = 1
				y = 0.2
			elseif i > #crystals / 3 * 2 then
				term = 0.15
				speed = 1.5
				y = -0.4
			end

			local start_time = time_passed - (0.1 * i)
			local local_time_passed = time_passed - (term * i)

			if start_time > 0 then

				local x = math.cos(speed * unity_class.mathf.PI * local_time_passed)
				local z = math.sin(speed * unity_class.mathf.PI * local_time_passed) * 0.4

				if z < 0 then
					sprites[i]:SetSortingLayer('Top Effects')
				else
					sprites[i]:SetSortingLayer('Under Effects')
				end

				crystals[i]:SetPosition(messiah.Position + vector(x, 0.5 + y, z))
			end

		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

end

return local_class

	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return true
	end

	self.res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		self.controller:set_default_quest_marker()
		return
	end

	sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.opening, self)
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))

	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return
	end

	if self.staff_roll_background ~= nil then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.staff_roll_background)
		self.staff_roll_background = nil
	end

	if self.fairy_obj ~= nil then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.fairy_obj)
		self.fairy_obj = nil
	end

	if self.sky_background ~= nil then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.sky_background)
		self.sky_background = nil
	end

	if self.bird_list ~= nil then
		for i = 1, #self.bird_list do
			CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.bird_list[i])
		end
		self.bird_list = nil
	end

	if self.invader_ship ~= nil then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.invader_ship)
		self.invader_ship = nil
	end

	if self.basic_trail ~= nil then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.basic_trail)
		self.basic_trail = nil
	end

	if self.fire_curtain ~= nil then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.fire_curtain)
		self.fire_curtain = nil
	end

	if self.princess_barrier ~= nil then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.princess_barrier)
		self.princess_barrier = nil
	end

	if self.fragments ~= nil then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.fragments)
		self.fragments = nil
	end

	if self.res_holder ~= nil then
		self.res_holder:Dispose()
		self.res_holder = nil
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region on event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_touch_event(e)
	if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeLeft then
		self.swipe_type = 'left'
		return true
	elseif e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeRight then
		self.swipe_type = 'right'
		return true
	elseif e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.TouchDown then
		self.swipe_type = 'touch_down'
		self.touch_count = self.touch_count + 1
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:doong_sil_move(transform, move_scale, move_speed, index)
	local speed = lua_helper.get_or_default(move_speed, 1.25)
	local idx = lua_helper.get_or_default(index, -1)

	local check = function ()
		if idx == -1 then
			return self.doong_sil
		else
			return self.doong_sils[idx]
		end
	end

	local origin_pos = transform.position
	local time_passed = 0
	while check() do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local fairy_offset = vector(0, -unity_class.mathf.Sin(time_passed * speed) * move_scale, 0)
		transform.position = origin_pos + fairy_offset
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:move_target_bezier_curve(transform, spline_list, cycle)
	local calculator = CS.Oak.BezierCurveCalculator()

	local curve_type = CS.Oak.BezierCurveType.Linear

	if #spline_list == 3 then
		curve_type = CS.Oak.BezierCurveType.Quadratic
	elseif #spline_list == 4 then
		curve_type = CS.Oak.BezierCurveType.Cubic
	end

	local list = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)
	for i = 1, #spline_list do
		list:Add(spline_list[i])
	end

	calculator:Add(list, cycle, curve_type)

	local time_passed = 0

	while time_passed < cycle do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local cur_pos = vector(0, 0, 0)

		calculator:UpdateFrame(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
		cur_pos = calculator.CurrentPosition

		transform.position = cur_pos

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

end

function local_class:scale_target(transform, scale, duration)
	local time_passed = 0

	local origin_scale = transform.localScale
	local start_scale = origin_scale.y

	while time_passed < duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local progress = time_passed / duration

		transform.localScale = origin_scale * (start_scale + (scale - start_scale) * progress)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

end

function local_class:scale_target(transform, scale, duration)
	local time_passed = 0

	local origin_scale = transform.localScale
	local start_scale = origin_scale.y

	while time_passed < duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local progress = time_passed / duration

		transform.localScale = origin_scale * (start_scale + (scale - start_scale) * progress)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

end

function local_class:rotate_target(transform, target_rotation, duration)
	local time_passed = 0

	local start_rotation = transform.localRotation.eulerAngles
	local end_rotation = target_rotation

	while time_passed < duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local progress = time_passed / duration

		local cur_angle = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_rotation, end_rotation, progress)
		transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(cur_angle)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

end

function local_class:copy_camera_from(to, from)
	to.orthographic = from.orthographic
	to.orthographicSize = from.orthographicSize
	to.nearClipPlane = from.nearClipPlane
	to.farClipPlane = from.farClipPlane

end

function local_class:qte_swipe(type, count)

local local_class = newclass('NightmareFutureCastleMain2Section7')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = NightmareFutureCastleMain2 @
		Comment = 과거처럼 기사를 도와주는 공주 @
		Index = 5 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	self.stage_name = 'nightmare_futurecastle_part2_6'

	self.section_progress = {
		-- 초기값
		none = 0,
		-- 왜 안오지?
		waiting = 1,
		-- 문 닫힘
		door_close = 2,
		-- 기사랑 싸우기엔 강한 인베이더 물리쳐줌
		invader_battle = 3,
		-- 무기를 던저줌
		sword = 4,
		-- 갑자기 등장한 인베이더
		invader = 5,
		-- 과거의 공주와 마주하는 미래 공주
		ending = 6
	}

	self.current_progress = self.section_progress.none

	self.get_dumb_knight = function()
		if user_util.has_knight_male() then
			return get_character('dumb_knight_male')
		end

		return get_character('dumb_knight_female')
	end

	self.sword_item = nil

	self.invader_fight = false

	self.check_situation = false

	self.ultimate_move = false

	-- 메인 이벤트 플레이 중 체크
	self.playing_main_event = false
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Event_InvaderBeam')
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_event_fairy_spawn')
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit')
	screen_util.preload_item_get_event()
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return true
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_battle_group_eliminated_event')

	self:set_environment()

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		self.controller:set_default_quest_marker()
		return
	end

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })
	self.check_situation = true
end

function local_class:exit()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return
	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	if self.sword_item ~= nil then
		self.sword_item:ConsumeComplete()
	end

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region on event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter == false then return end
	if e.FieldObject ~= user_party.Leader then return end
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == 's7_wait' and self.current_progress == self.section_progress.none then
		self.current_progress = self.section_progress.waiting
		self.playing_main_event = true
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.waiting_knight, self)

	elseif zone_name == 's7_door_1' and self.current_progress == self.section_progress.waiting then
		self.current_progress = self.section_progress.door_close
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create('door_1', false))

	elseif zone_name == 'BATTLE_1' and self.current_progress == self.section_progress.door_close then
		self.current_progress = self.section_progress.invader_battle
		self.playing_main_event = true
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.princess_battle, self)

	elseif zone_name == 's7_sword' and self.current_progress == self.section_progress.invader_battle then
		self.current_progress = self.section_progress.sword
		self.playing_main_event = true
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.give_sword, self)

	elseif zone_name == 's7_invader' and self.current_progress == self.section_progress.sword then
		self.current_progress = self.section_progress.invader
		self.playing_main_event = true
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.cheer_up, self)

	elseif zone_name == 's7_ending' and self.current_progress == self.section_progress.invader then
		self.current_progress = self.section_progress.ending
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.across_future, self)

	elseif self.check_situation and not self.playing_main_event then
		local progress = {0, 1, 4, 0, 0}
		local move_pos = {vector(1.5, 0, 0), vector(2.5, 0, 0), vector(1, 0, -2.5), vector(0, 0, 1.5), vector(0, 0, -1.5)}
		for i = 1, #progress do
			if zone_name == 'watch_situation_' .. i and self.current_progress >= progress[i] then
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.watch_situation, self, vector_util.get_x0z(e.Zone.Bounds.center), move_pos[i])
			end
		end
	elseif self.ultimate_move == false then
		for i = 1, 2 do
			if zone_name == 'watch_situation_ultimate_' .. i then
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.watch_situation_ultimate, self)
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	if e.BattleGroupName == 'BATTLE_1' then
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create('battle_door_1', false))
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create('door_2', false))
	end

	return false
end

	local knight = self.get_dumb_knight()

	--별 볼일 없는 거지만… 분명 도움이 될 거야…!

	choose_util.play_choose_event({{'nightmare_futurecastle_2_s7_12', 'normal'}})
	--검을 던져준다.

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_equip_weapon_01')
	local sword = drop_item_util.create_item(
			{itemid = 9010011 , notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
			 pos = princess.Position, target = princess.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0), sprscale = 0.7 })

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function ()

		wait_for_sec(1)

		knight.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
		character_util.move_waypoint(knight, knight.Position + vector(2, 0, 0), 1.5, false)

		wait_for_sec(2/1.5)

		sword.ConsumeTarget = knight
		sword:Fly()

		knight.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.NPCCrashBehaviour.Instance

		local item_placeholder = CS.Oak.ItemPlaceholder()
		item_placeholder.ItemId = 9010011
		item_placeholder.NotForInventory = true

		local item_target_pos = vector(knight.Position.x, 1, knight.Position.z)

		--music_player:PlaySfxOneShot("01_get_keyitem_01")

		character_util.set_direction(knight, 'down')
		character_util.set_anim(knight, { name = 'get', upper = true })
		character_util.set_emotion(knight, { name = 'smile' })
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_get_keyitem_01', volume = 0.7 })

		self.sword_item = CS.Oak.DropItem.Create(knight.Position, item_placeholder)
		self.sword_item.SpriteTransform.localScale = vector(0.7, 0.7, 0.7)
		self.sword_item.ShadowTransform.localScale = vector(0.7, 0.7, 0.7)

		self.sword_item.State = CS.Oak.DropItem.LootState.DontFindLooter
		self.sword_item.SpriteTransform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(90, 0, 0))
		self.sword_item:SetSortingLayer(true)

		local cur_time = unity_class.time.time

		while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < 1.5 do
			local curpos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(knight.Position, item_target_pos,
					(unity_class.time.time - cur_time) / 1.5)

			if self.sword_item ~= nil then
				self.sword_item:SetPosition(curpos)
			end

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

	end ))

	character_util.move_waypoint_async(princess, princess.Position + vector(0, 0, -2.5), 2.5, true)

	self.playing_main_event = false
end

function local_class:knight_vs_invader()
	local invaders = {}
	for i = 1, 3 do
		invaders[i] = get_character('invader_' .. i)
	end

	local knight = self.get_dumb_knight()

	character_util.move_waypoint(invaders[1], { invaders[1].Position + vector(-0.5, 0, 0),
												invaders[1].Position + vector(-0.5, 0, -1) },
			1, false, nil, nil, 'left')

	character_util.move_waypoint(invaders[3], { invaders[3].Position + vector(-1.5, 0, 0),
												invaders[3].Position + vector(-1.5, 0, 2) },
			1.2, false, nil, nil, 'left')

	--knight.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
	character_util.set_anim(knight, {name = 'sword_walk'})
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(knight, knight.Position + vector(5.5, 0, 0), 1.5, false)
	character_util.set_anim(knight, {name = 'sword_idle'})
	--knight.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.NPCCrashBehaviour.Instance

	character_util.remove_anim(invaders[2])

	character_util.set_anim(invaders[1], {name = 'attack', scale = 1.1})
	character_util.set_anim(invaders[3], {name = 'attack', scale = 0.9})

	while self.invader_fight do
		character_util.set_anim(knight, {name = 'attack', loop = false, remove_after = 0.5})
		wait_for_sec(0.3)
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_hit_big_01', parent = knight, max_distance = 12 })
		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit'):Instantiate(invaders[2].Position + vector(0, 0.5, 0))
		character_util.spine_deviate_local(invaders[2], vector(1, 0, 0) * 0.3, 0.3, 0.2)
		character_util.spine_pulse_color(invaders[2], CS.Oak.Constants.DamageColor, 1, 1, 0.2)
		character_util.spine_damage_squish(invaders[2], 1.3, 0.7, 1, 0.2)
		wait_for_sec(0.2)
		character_util.set_anim(knight, {name = 'sword_idle'})
		wait_for_sec(0.1)

		character_util.set_anim(invaders[2], {name = 'attack', loop = false, remove_after = 0.5})
		wait_for_sec(0.3)
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_hit_big_01', parent = invaders[2], max_distance = 12 })
		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit'):Instantiate(knight.Position)
		character_util.spine_deviate_local(knight, vector(-1, 0, 0) * 0.3, 0.3, 0.2)
		character_util.spine_pulse_color(knight, CS.Oak.Constants.DamageColor, 1, 1, 0.2)
		character_util.spine_damage_squish(knight, 1.3, 0.7, 1, 0.2)
		wait_for_sec(0.3)
	end
end

local local_class = newclass('NightmareFutureCastleSaunaPostSection')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = post @
		QuestName = NightmareFutureCastleSauna @
		Comment = 나이트메어 미래부유성 2스테이지 용암 사우나 퀘스트 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	-- 사우나 좌표 마커
	self.get_sauna_marker = function(index) return field:GetMarker('sauna_marker_' .. index) end

	-- 사우나 레버 가져오기
	self.get_sauna_lever = function(index) return get_field_object('sauna_lever_' .. index) end

	-- 손님 대화 연속 방지용 bool값
	self.is_talking_customer = { false, false, false, false }

	-- 사우나 이팩트 재생중에 있는지?
	self.is_in_camera_grid = false

	self.event_grid_name = 'sauna'
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent), 'on_camera_grid_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent), 'on_camera_grid_leave_event')

	-- 매니져 세팅
	local manager = self.controller.get_manager()
	character_util.add_listener(manager, self.controller)
	character_util.set_position(manager, self.controller.get_manager_default_pos().position)
	character_util.set_direction(manager, 'left')
	character_util.set_active_state(manager, 'enabled')

	-- 손님 및 레버 세팅
	local root_indexs = { 1, 2, 5, 6 }
	for i = 1, 4 do
		local customer = self.controller.get_customer(i)
		if i <= 2 then
			character_util.set_emotion(customer, { name = 'blush' })
		end
		character_util.set_position(customer, self.get_sauna_marker(root_indexs[i]).position)
		character_util.set_direction(customer, 'down')
		character_util.add_listener(customer, self.controller)
		character_util.set_active_state(customer, 'enabled')

		-- 레버 애니메이션 pull로 세팅
		local lever = self.get_sauna_lever(root_indexs[i])
		local animator = lever:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))
		animator:Play('pull')
	end

	self.controller:set_active_wall_invisible(false)
	self.controller.get_sauna_effect()
	return true
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent))

	self.is_talking_customer = nil
	self.is_in_camera_grid = false

	local manager = self.controller.get_manager()
	character_util.remove_relate_event(manager, self.controller)

	for i = 1, 4 do
		local customer = self.controller.get_customer(i)
		character_util.remove_relate_event(customer, self.controller)
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	-- 사우나 매니져 인터렉트 확인
	local manager = self.controller.get_manager()
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, manager) then
		-- 어서 오세요~ 후끈후끈 용암 사우나입니다! / 다음에 한번 놀러 오세요, 특별히 입장료는 안 받겠습니다.
		local string_key = self.controller.starting_grade >= 0 and 'nightmare_futurecastle_sauna_interact_manager_2' or 'nightmare_futurecastle_sauna_interact_manager_1'
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(manager, { key = string_key })
		return true
	end

	-- 사우나 손님들과 인터렉트 했을 때
	for i = 1, 4 do
		local customer = self.controller.get_customer(i)
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, customer) and not self.is_talking_customer[i] then
			self.is_talking_customer[i] = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.talk_customer, self, i, customer))
			return true
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_enter_event(e)
	if self.controller.is_in_camera_grid then
		return false
	end

	if type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, self.event_grid_name) then
		self.controller.is_in_camera_grid = true
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.controller.show_sauna_burn_effect, self.controller))
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_leave_event(e)
	if type_util.is_player_leave_to_cam_grid(e, self.event_grid_name) then
		self.controller.is_in_camera_grid = false
		return true
	end

	return false
end

-- 손님들 대화
function local_class:talk_customer(index, customer)
	if index == 4 then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
		character_util.show_emoticon_async(customer, nil, 'happy')
	else
		if index == 1 then
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
		end
		-- 그래 이거지… 이 맛이야! / 땀이 삐질삐질 흐른다… / 어우 뜨끈하구만… 멀리서 온 보람이 있어.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(customer, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_sauna_interact_2_' .. index })
	end

	self.is_talking_customer[index] = false
end

return local_class

		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.enter_event_zone, self)
	end
end

function local_class:enter_event_zone()
	-- 손님들
	local customers = {}
	for i = 0, 4 do
		local customer = self.controller.get_customer(i)
		table.insert(customers, customer)

local local_class = newclass('NightmareFutureCastleSaunaSection1')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = NightmareFutureCastleSauna @
		Comment = 나이트메어 미래부유성 2스테이지 용암 사우나 퀘스트 @
		Index = 0 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	-- 게임시작시 위치할 좌표
	self.get_game_start_marker = function() return field:GetMarker('sauna_game_start') end

	-- 퀘스트 마커 이름
	self.quest_marker_name = 'sauna_management'

	-- 미니게임 이름
	self.game_name = 'sauna_management_game'

	-- 첫 대화를 하였는가?
	self.is_first_talk = false

	-- 한번 실패를 했었는가?
	self.is_fail = false

	-- 스타피스 이름
	self.star_piece_name = 'sauna_star_piece'

	-- 튜토리얼은 진행 했는가?
	self.is_play_tutorial_custom_state = -1

	-- 튜토리얼 진행 여부 키
	self.tutorial_custom_state_key = 'mini_game_tutorial'

	-- 파티원 캐싱용
	self.cached_party = nil
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent), 'on_mini_game_end_event')

	-- 매니져 세팅
	local manager = self.controller.get_manager()
	character_util.add_listener(manager, self.controller)
	character_util.set_position(manager, self.controller.get_manager_pos().position)
	character_util.set_direction(manager, 'left')
	character_util.set_active_state(manager, 'enabled')
	character_util.set_anim(manager, { name = 'question', loop = false })

	if self.controller.starting_inner_progress < 0 then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	end

	manager.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(1.1, 0.8, 1.3))

	-- 손님 세팅
	for i = 1, 4 do
		local customer = self.controller.get_customer(i)
		local pos = self.controller.get_customers_marker(i).position

		if i <= 2 then
			character_util.set_emotion(customers, { name = 'attack' })
		end
		character_util.set_direction(customer, 'right')
		character_util.set_position(customer, pos)
		character_util.set_active_state(customer, 'enabled')
		character_util.add_listener(customer, self.controller)
	end

	-- 손님 대화 연속 방지용 bool값
	self.is_talking_customer = { false, false, false, false }
	self.controller:set_active_wall_invisible(false)
	self.controller.get_sauna_effect()
	self.is_play_tutorial_custom_state = quest_util.get_custom_state(self.controller.quest_progress, self.tutorial_custom_state_key)

	-- 사우나 주인에게 퀘스트 마커를 달아준다.
	quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.quest_marker_name, manager)

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent))

	local manager = self.controller.get_manager()
	character_util.remove_relate_event(manager, self.controller)

	for i = 1, 4 do
		local customer = self.controller.get_customer(i)
		character_util.remove_relate_event(customer, self.controller)
	end

	self.cached_party = nil
	self.is_talking_customer = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	-- 사우나 매니져 인터렉트 확인
	local manager = self.controller.get_manager()
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, manager) then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.interact_manager, self))
		return true
	end

	-- 사우나 손님들과 인터렉트 했을 때
	for i = 1, 4 do
		local customer = self.controller.get_customer(i)
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, customer) and not self.is_talking_customer[i] then
			self.is_talking_customer[i] = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.talk_customer, self, i, customer))
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:talk_customer(index, customer)
	if index == 4 then
		character_util.show_emoticon_async(customer, nil, 'angry')
	else
		-- 오랜만에 푹 쉬려고 왔더니 이게 뭐야! / 준비도 안 됐으면서 오픈한다는 가게가 어디 있어! / 에잇, 잔뜩 기대했건만…
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(customer, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_sauna_interact_1_' .. index })
	end

	self.is_talking_customer[index] = false
end

function local_class:on_mini_game_end_event(e)
	if e.Name == self.game_name then
		self.controller:set_active_wall_invisible(false)
		if e.Success then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.mini_game_success, self)
		else
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.mini_game_fail, self)
		end
		return true
	end
end

function local_class:interact_manager()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	local princess = user_party.Leader
	local manager = self.controller.get_manager()

	-- 매니저 옆으로 이동
	party_util.align_party(manager.Position, 'left', 0.5, 'linear')

	local string_key
	if not self.is_first_talk then
		character_util.remove_anim(manager)
		character_util.show_emoticon_async(manager, nil, 'notice')

		-- 앗… 혹시 잠깐 시간 괜찮으실까요?
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(manager, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_sauna_6', skip = true })

		-- 공주 끄덕
		character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(princess, { name = 'nod', count = 1 })

		-- 저희 직원이 또 연락도 없이 결근을 해서 곤란하군요…
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		character_util.set_anim(manager, { name = 'cross_arm', loop = false })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(manager, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_sauna_7', skip = true })
		character_util.remove_anim(manager)

		-- 급하게 일을 도와줄 사람이 필요한데 잠시 사우나 관리 좀 도와주시겠어요?
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(manager, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_sauna_8', skip = true })

		-- 물론 일당은 챙겨드리겠습니다.
		character_util.set_animation_n_times(manager, { name = 'release', sfx = '01_swing_01', count = 2 })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(manager, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_sauna_9', skip = true })
		character_util.remove_anim(manager)
		self.is_first_talk = true
	else
		-- 사우나 관리를 도와주시겠어요? / 다시 일할 준비 되셨나요?
		string_key = self.is_fail and 'nightmare_futurecastle_sauna_14' or 'nightmare_futurecastle_sauna_13'
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(manager, { key = string_key, skip = true })
	end

	local is_accepted = quest_util.process_quest_request(self.quest_spec.QuestId, false)
	if not is_accepted then
		if not self.is_fail then
			-- 미안… 지금은 바빠서…
			character_util.set_emotion(princess, { name = 'tired' })
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_sauna_12', skip = true })
			character_util.remove_emotion(princess)

		party_util.reset_controllers()
		field_ui_manager:Show()

	-- 사우나?! 재밌겠다! 내가 도와줄게! / 응, 준비됐어! 이번에는 잘해볼게!
	if self.is_fail then
		character_util.set_animation_n_times(princess, { name = 'nod', count = 1 })
	else
		character_util.set_anim(princess, { name = 'victory_get', loop = false, scale = 1, sfx_name = '01_jump_01' })
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(princess, { name = self.is_fail and 'attack' or 'smile' })
	string_key = self.is_fail and 'nightmare_futurecastle_sauna_15' or 'nightmare_futurecastle_sauna_10'
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, { key = string_key, skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(princess)

	-- 정말 감사합니다! 안으로 들어오시죠. / 열정이 넘치는 모습이 보기 좋네요. 그럼 다시 시작해보죠!
	if self.is_fail then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_clap_02')
		character_util.set_anim(manager, { name = 'clap', loop = true })
	end
	string_key = self.is_fail and 'nightmare_futurecastle_sauna_16' or 'nightmare_futurecastle_sauna_11'
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(manager, { key = string_key, skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim(manager)

	-- 퀘스트 마커 제거
	quest_marker_util.remove(self.quest_marker_name)

	-- 튜토리얼을 진행했다면 현재 시점에서 muted
	if self.is_play_tutorial_custom_state >= 0 then
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 2 })
	end

	-- 페이드 아웃
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	-- 튜토리얼을 한번도 진행 안했다면 진행
	if self.is_play_tutorial_custom_state < 0 then
		yield_return_func(self.mini_game_tutorial, self)
	end

	-- 사우나 주인 disabled
	character_util.set_active_state(manager, 'disabled')

	-- 손님들 disabled
	for i = 1, 4 do
		local customer = self.controller.get_customer(i)
		character_util.set_active_state(customer, 'disabled')
	end

	-- 미니게임 준비
	-- 미니 게임이 로드 될 때 까지 기다림.
	local is_mini_game_load_complete = false

	while not is_mini_game_load_complete do

	local start_pos = self.get_game_start_marker().position
	character_util.set_position(princess, start_pos)
	character_util.set_direction(princess, 'right')
	self.controller:set_active_wall_invisible(true)

	-- 공주를 제외하고 파티원에서 제외한다.
	self.cached_party = {}
	for i = user_party.Count - 1, 1, -1 do

		character_util.set_active_state(party_member, 'disabled')

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(manager, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_sauna_33', skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim(manager)

	-- 오늘 영업은 공친 거라 일당을 드리긴 힘들 거 같네요.

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(manager, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_sauna_35', skip = true })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.set_anim(manager, { name = 'question', loop = false })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(manager, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_sauna_21', skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim(manager)

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(manager, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_sauna_23', skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim(manager)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(princess, { name = 'smile' })
	character_util.normal_jump(princess, true)

	character_util.remove_emotion(princess)

	-- 손님 불꽃 이팩트 루틴 시작
	self.controller.is_in_camera_grid = true
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.controller.show_sauna_burn_effect, self.controller))

	manager.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(1.1, 0.8, 1.1))

	yield_return_func(quest_util.complete_quest, self.controller, 0, true, false, false, false)

	local manager = self.controller.get_manager()
	local princess = user_party.Leader

	character_util.set_position(manager, vector(-14, 0, 57.5))
	character_util.set_direction(manager, 'left')
	character_util.set_active_state(manager, 'enabled')
	yield_return_func(self.active_party_members, self, manager.Position)

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	-- 손님이 4명이나 나가 버리다니…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_01')
	character_util.set_anim(manager, { name = 'question', loop = false })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(manager, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_sauna_25', skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim(manager)

	character_util.set_animation_n_times(manager, { name = 'release', sfx = '01_swing_01', count = 2 })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(manager, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_sauna_26', skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim(manager)

	-- 말씀드린 대로 오늘 일당은 못 드릴 것 같습니다.
	character_util.set_anim(manager, { name = 'cross_arm', loop = false })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(manager, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_sauna_27', skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim(manager)

	-- 다시 도와주실 마음이 있다면 잠시 쉬었다가 도전해보시겠어요?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(manager, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_sauna_28', skip = true })

	-- 미, 미안… 알았어…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(princess, { name = 'tired' })
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(princess, { name = 'nod', count = 1 })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_sauna_29', skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(princess)

	-- 사우나 주인에게 다시 마커 추가
	quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.quest_marker_name, manager)

	self.is_fail = true
end

function local_class:active_party_members(align_pos)
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field', mix = 2 })

	-- 파티원 복구
	for i = #self.cached_party, 1, -1 do

		character_util.set_active_state(party_member, 'enabled')
		character_util.convert_to_party_member(party_member, user_party, true)
	end
	self.cached_party = nil

	party_util.align_party(align_pos, 'left', 0, 'linear')
end

return local_class

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)

	self.get_bodyguard = controller.get_bodyguard
	self.get_sera = controller.get_sera
	self.get_grave = controller.get_grave

	-- 리즈 이벤트 존
	self.event_zone_name = 'sera_present_zone_1'
	-- 대화 이벤트를 봤는 지
	self.see_leez_talk = false
	self.see_leez_request = false

	self.stage_name = controller.stage_name
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return true
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')

	-- 퀘스트 수락 전 세팅
	local marker_pos = stage.Field:GetMarker('leez_point_1').position
	local leez = self.get_leez()
	local bodyguard = self.get_bodyguard()

	character_util.set_position(leez, marker_pos)
	character_util.set_direction(leez, 'up')
	character_util.remove_anim(leez)

	character_util.set_position(bodyguard, marker_pos + vector(1,0,2))
	character_util.set_direction(bodyguard, 'left')
	character_util.set_emotion(bodyguard, { name = 'idle' })
	character_util.set_anim(bodyguard, { name = 'eat' })

	-- 리즈 위에 퀘스트 마커 표시
	character_util.add_listener(leez, self.cs_controller)
	quest_icon.SetQuestNotice(leez)
	return true

function local_class:start()

	end

	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return false
	end

	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_leez()) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.request_leez, self)
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_grave()) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_grave, self)
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter == false then
		return false
	end
	if e.FieldObject ~= user_party.Leader then
		return false
	end
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name
	if zone_name == self.event_zone_name then
		if not self.see_leez_talk then
			self.see_leez_talk = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.leez_talk, self))
		end
	end

	return false
end
--endregion

-- 세라 묘지 interact
function local_class:interact_grave()
	-- 세라
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_sera_present_s1_15' })
end

-- 리즈와 경호원의 대화
function local_class:leez_talk()
	local leez = self.get_leez()
	local bodyguard = self.get_bodyguard()
	local equipping_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true,
			  parent = bodyguard, type_priority = 'loop', player_priority = 'npc'})

	-- 아저씨, 아직도 못 찾았어요?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(leez,
			{ key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_sera_present_1'})

	equipping_sfx:Stop()

	if self.see_leez_request then
		return
	end

	-- 죄송합니다, 아가씨. 친구분께서 꼼꼼히 숨겨둔 것 같습니다.
	character_util.set_direction(bodyguard, 'down')
	character_util.set_emotion(bodyguard, { name = 'tired' })
	character_util.remove_anim(bodyguard)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(bodyguard,
			{ key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_sera_present_2'})

	if self.see_leez_request then
		return
	end

	-- 흐음… 세라가 어디에 선물을 놓고 간거지…
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_rustle_01', loop = false, parent = leez, player_priority = 'npc'})
	character_util.set_direction(leez, 'left')
	character_util.set_emotion(leez, { name = 'tired' })
	character_util.set_anim(leez, { name = 'question', loop = false })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(leez,
			{ key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_sera_present_3'})

	if self.see_leez_request then
		return
	end

	-- 경호원 다시 선물을 찾음
	character_util.set_direction(bodyguard, 'left')
	character_util.set_anim(bodyguard, { name = 'eat' })
end

-- 리즈에게서 퀘스트 수락
function local_class:request_leez()
	local leez = self.get_leez()
	local bodyguard = self.get_bodyguard()
	-- 퀘스트 아이콘 제거
	quest_icon.RemoveIcon(leez)

	party_util.align_to_target(leez, 'left', 1, 'linear')

	if not self.see_leez_request then
		self.see_leez_request = true
		speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(leez)
		speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(bodyguard)
		coroutine.yield()

		character_util.set_direction(bodyguard, 'left')
		character_util.set_anim(bodyguard, { name = 'eat' })

		-- 안녕! 못 보던 친구네!
		character_util.look_at(leez, user_party.Leader)
		character_util.set_emotion(leez, { name = 'smile' })
		character_util.remove_anim(leez)
		character_util.normal_jump(leez, true)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(leez,
				{ key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_sera_present_4', skip = true })

		-- 반가워~! 난 리즈라고 해.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(leez,
				{ key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_sera_present_5', skip = true })

		-- 히히, 안녕! 여기서 뭐하고 있던거야?
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
		character_util.look_at(user_party.Leader, leez)
		character_util.set_emotion(user_party.Leader, { name = 'smile' })
		character_util.remove_anim(user_party.Leader)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(user_party.Leader,
				{ key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_sera_present_6', skip = true })

		character_util.remove_emotion(user_party.Leader)

		-- 내 친구 세라가 여행 떠나기전에 특별한 선물을 어딘가 두고갔다고 해서…
		character_util.remove_emotion(leez)
		character_util.set_anim(leez, { name = 'cross_arm', loop = true })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(leez,
				{ key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_sera_present_7', skip = true })

		-- 우리집에서 맨날 따라다니는 아저씨랑 같이 찾고 있었어!
		character_util.set_direction(leez, 'up')
		character_util.set_animation_n_times(leez, { name = 'release', count = 4, sfx = '01_swing_01' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(leez,
				{ key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_sera_present_8', skip = true })

		-- 그런데 세라가 대체 어디다 숨긴건지 도무지 찾질 못 하겠네…
		character_util.look_at(leez, user_party.Leader)
		character_util.set_emotion(leez, { name = 'tired' })
		character_util.remove_anim(leez)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(leez,
				{ key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_sera_present_9', skip = true })

		-- 괜찮다면 너도 세라가 남긴 선물 찾는 것 좀 도와줄래?
		character_util.remove_emotion(leez)
		character_util.set_animation_n_times(leez, { name = 'release', count = 4, sfx = '01_swing_01' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(leez,
				{ key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_sera_present_10', skip = true })
	else
		-- 도와줄 수 있어?
		character_util.look_at(leez, user_party.Leader)
		character_util.set_emotion(leez, { name = 'idle' })
		character_util.remove_anim(leez)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(leez,
				{ key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_sera_present_11', skip = true })
	end

	local is_accepted = quest_util.process_quest_request(self.quest_spec.QuestId)

	if is_accepted then
		-- 수락한 경우

		-- 좋아! 내가 도와줄게~!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
		character_util.set_emotion(user_party.Leader, { name = 'smile' })
		character_util.set_animation_n_times(user_party.Leader, { name = 'nod', count = 2 })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(user_party.Leader,
				{ key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_sera_present_12', skip = true })

		-- 고마워 친구~ 부탁할께!
		character_util.set_emotion(leez, { name = 'smile' })
		character_util.remove_anim(leez)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(leez,
				{ key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_sera_present_13', skip = true })

		floating_text_util.activate_for_quest(user_party.Leader, self.quest_spec.QuestName, 0)
		yield_return_func(quest_util.activate_quest, self.controller)
	else
		-- 거절한 경우

		-- 미안, 지금은 힘들 것 같아…
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_01')
		character_util.set_emotion(user_party.Leader, { name = 'tired' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(user_party.Leader,
				{ key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_sera_present_14', skip = true })

		-- 알겠어… 바쁘면 어쩔 수 없지.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_01')
		character_util.set_emotion(leez, { name = 'tired' })
		character_util.remove_anim(leez)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(leez,
				{ key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_sera_present_15', skip = true })

		character_util.set_direction(leez, 'left')
		character_util.set_anim(leez, { name = 'question', loop = false })
		quest_icon.SetQuestNotice(leez)
	end

	party_util.remove_emotion()
	party_util.remove_animation()
end


return local_class

	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller

	self.get_bodyguard = controller.get_bodyguard

	self.bear_doll_id = controller.bear_doll_id
	self.candy_id = controller.candy_id

function local_class:dispose()

	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return true
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.SNSTouchPoppedEvent), 'on_event')

	local give_banana = stage_progress:GetCustomData(self.controller.custom_key.get_banana)
	local give_bear_doll = stage_progress:GetCustomData(self.controller.custom_key.get_bear_doll)
	local give_candy = stage_progress:GetCustomData(self.controller.custom_key.get_candy)

	local give_item_clear = give_banana and give_bear_doll and give_candy

	-- 선물을 다 전달하지 않았을 경우
	if not give_item_clear then
		local marker_pos = field:GetMarker('leez_point_1').position
		local leez = self.get_leez()
		local bodyguard = self.get_bodyguard()

		character_util.set_position(leez, marker_pos)
		character_util.set_direction(leez, 'left')
		character_util.set_emotion(leez, { name = 'tired' })
		character_util.set_anim(leez, { name = 'question', loop = false })
		character_util.add_listener(leez, self.cs_controller)
		quest_icon.SetQuestAccepted(leez)

		character_util.set_position(bodyguard, marker_pos + vector(1,0,2))
		character_util.set_direction(bodyguard, 'left')
		character_util.set_emotion(bodyguard, { name = 'idle' })
		character_util.set_anim(bodyguard, { name = 'eat' })
	end

	-- 세라 세팅
	local sera = self.get_sera()
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(sera, 0, 0)
	sera.SpineController:AddColor(sera.Name, unity_color({0.5,0.5,1,1}), 1, 0)
	character_util.set_active_shadow(sera, false)

	return true

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return
	end
end

function local_class:exit()

		return
	end

	if not is_unity_null(self.phone) then
		self.phone:ConsumeComplete()
		self.phone = nil
	end

	character_util.remove_relate_event(self.get_leez(), self.cs_controller)

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.SNSTouchPoppedEvent))
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return false
	end

	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.SNSTouchPoppedEvent) then
		return self:on_sns_touch_popped_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_leez()) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.give_item, self)
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_grave()) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_grave, self)
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_sns_touch_popped_event(e)
	self.wait_for_sns = false
	return false
end

-- 리즈한테 아이템을 줌
function local_class:give_item()
	local give_banana = stage_progress:GetCustomData(self.controller.custom_key.get_banana)
	local give_bear_doll = stage_progress:GetCustomData(self.controller.custom_key.get_bear_doll)
	local give_candy = stage_progress:GetCustomData(self.controller.custom_key.get_candy)

	local give_item_clear = give_banana and give_bear_doll and give_candy

	local get_banana_item = self.controller.get_banana_item
	local get_bear_doll_item = self.controller.get_bear_doll_item
	local get_candy_item = self.controller.get_candy_item

	local leez = self.get_leez()
	local bodyguard = self.get_bodyguard()

	-- 퀘스트 아이콘 제거
	quest_icon.RemoveIcon(leez)

	party_util.align_to_target(leez, 'left', 1, 'linear')

	-- 뭐 찾은거 있어?
	character_util.look_at(leez, user_party.Leader)
	character_util.remove_emotion(leez)
	character_util.remove_anim(leez)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(leez,
			{ key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_sera_present_s1_1', skip = true })

	while not give_item_clear do
		local branches = create_generic_list(typeof(CS.Oak.TalkBranch))
		local wait_for_branch = true
		local result = 0

		if not give_banana and get_banana_item then
			-- 바나나 껍질을 건네준다
			branches:Add({
				Text = game_string:GetString('nightmare_futurecastle_sera_present_s1_2_1'),
				Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Normal,
				Callback = function()
					wait_for_branch = false
					result = 1
				end })
		end

		if not give_bear_doll and get_bear_doll_item then
			-- 곰인형을 건네준다
			branches:Add({
				Text = game_string:GetString('nightmare_futurecastle_sera_present_s1_2_2'),
				Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Normal,
				Callback = function()
					wait_for_branch = false
					result = 2
				end })
		end

		if not give_candy and get_candy_item then
			-- 거대한 사탕을 건네준다
			branches:Add({
				Text = game_string:GetString('nightmare_futurecastle_sera_present_s1_2_3'),
				Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Normal,
				Callback = function()
					wait_for_branch = false
					result = 3
				end })
		end

		-- 아무것도 못 찾았다
		branches:Add({
			Text = game_string:GetString('nightmare_futurecastle_sera_present_s1_2_4'),
			Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Normal,
			Callback = function()
				wait_for_branch = false
				result = 4
			end })

		ui_overlay_util.push_overlay(leez, branches)

		while wait_for_branch do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		-- 아무것도 못 찾았을 경우
		if result == 4 then
			character_util.set_direction(leez, 'left')
			character_util.set_emotion(leez, { name = 'tired' })
			character_util.set_anim(leez, { name = 'question', loop = false })
			quest_icon.SetQuestAccepted(leez)
			return
		end

		character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(user_party.Leader, { name = 'throw', count = 1 })
		local item_id = 0

		if result == 1 then
			item_id = self.banana_id
		elseif result == 2 then
			item_id = self.bear_doll_id
		elseif result == 3 then
			item_id = self.candy_id
		end

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_throw_01')
		local drop_item = drop_item_util.create_item({itemid = item_id, notforinven = true,
													  pos = user_party.Leader.Position,
													  target = leez.Position + vector(-0.5,0,0),
													  lootstate = "dontfindlooter"})
		wait_for_sec(1)

		drop_item.ConsumeTarget = leez

		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		if result == 1 then
			-- 바나나 껍질을 줄 경우

			-- 엥? 이게 뭐야?
			character_util.set_emotion(leez, { name = 'attack' })
			character_util.normal_jump(leez, true)
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(leez,
					{ key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_sera_present_s1_3', skip = true })

			-- 이건 먹고 버린 바나나 껍질이잖아!
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
			character_util.set_emotion(leez, { name = 'attack' })
			character_util.set_anim(leez, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(leez,
					{ key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_sera_present_s1_4', skip = true })

			-- 대체 세라를 뭘로 생각하는 거야! 이런 걸 선물로 남겼을 리 없다고!
			character_util.set_emotion(leez, { name = 'attack' })
			character_util.set_anim(leez, { name = 'cross_arm', loop = true })
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(leez,
					{ key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_sera_present_s1_5', skip = true })

			-- 커스텀 데이터 처리
			local stage_custom = stage_progress:SetCustomData(self.controller.custom_key.get_banana, true)
			local req = api_connection:SendSetCustom(stage.StageId, stage_custom)
			coroutine.yield(req)
		elseif result == 2 then
			-- 곰인형을 줄 경우

			-- 와~! 귀여운 곰인형이네!
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
			character_util.set_emotion(leez, { name = 'smile' })
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(leez,
					{ key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_sera_present_s1_6', skip = true })

			-- 흠… 근데 난 이미 인형이 많아서 세라가 이걸 선물로 두고 갔을거 같진않아…
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
			character_util.set_emotion(leez, { name = 'idle' })
			character_util.set_anim(leez, { name = "question", loop = false })
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(leez,
					{ key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_sera_present_s1_7', skip = true })

			-- 곰인형을 주웠을 때 읽는다를 선택했을 경우
			if self.controller.saw_doll_rabel then
				-- 잠깐, 인형 뒤를 봐봐 너 이름 적혀있는 거 아니야?
				character_util.remove_emotion(user_party.Leader)
				character_util.set_animation_n_times(user_party.Leader,
						{ name = 'release', count = 4, sfx = '01_swing_01' })
				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(user_party.Leader,
						{ key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_sera_present_0_5', skip = true })

				-- 내 이름이 적혀있다고?!
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
				character_util.set_emotion(leez, { name = 'surprise' })
				character_util.remove_anim(leez)
				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(leez,
						{ key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_sera_present_0_6', skip = true })

				-- 흠… 인형 뒤쪽에 …즈 라고 적혀있긴 하네…
				character_util.remove_emotion(leez)
				character_util.set_anim(leez, { name = 'push' })
				local doll_item = drop_item_util.create_item({ itemid = item_id, notforinven = true,
											pos = leez.Position + vector(0,0.3,0),
											lootstate = "dontfindlooter", skip_text = true })

				local scale_time = 0.01
				while scale_time < 0.25 do
					scale_time = scale_time + unity_class.time.deltaTime
					doll_item.Position = leez.Position + vector(-scale_time,0.3,0)
					coroutine.yield()
				end

				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(leez,
						{ key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_sera_present_0_7', skip = true })

				doll_item.ConsumeTarget = leez
				drop_item = nil

				-- 근데 그게 리즈인지 홈즈인지는 모르는 거잖아.
				character_util.set_animation_n_times(leez, { name = 'release', count = 4, sfx = '01_swing_01' })
				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(leez,
						{ key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_sera_present_0_8', skip = true })

				character_util.set_emotion(user_party.Leader, { name = 'embarrassed' })
				character_util.show_emoticon_async(user_party.Leader, nil, 'silence')
				character_util.remove_emotion(user_party.Leader)
			end

			-- 커스텀 데이터 처리
			local stage_custom = stage_progress:SetCustomData(self.controller.custom_key.get_bear_doll, true)
			local req = api_connection:SendSetCustom(stage.StageId, stage_custom)
			coroutine.yield(req)
		elseif result == 3 then
			-- 사탕을 줄 경우

			-- 흠… 이건 크게 특별해 보이진 않는데…
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
			character_util.set_emotion(leez, { name = 'idle' })
			character_util.set_anim(leez, { name = "question", loop = false })
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(leez,
					{ key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_sera_present_s1_8', skip = true })

			-- 커스텀 데이터 처리
			local stage_custom = stage_progress:SetCustomData(self.controller.custom_key.get_candy, true)
			local req = api_connection:SendSetCustom(stage.StageId, stage_custom)
			coroutine.yield(req)
		end

		-- 혹시 다른건 없어?
		character_util.remove_emotion(leez)
		character_util.set_animation_n_times(leez, { name = 'release', count = 4, sfx = '01_swing_01' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(leez,
				{ key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_sera_present_s1_2_5', skip = true })

		-- 클리어 체크
		give_banana = stage_progress:GetCustomData(self.controller.custom_key.get_banana)
		give_bear_doll = stage_progress:GetCustomData(self.controller.custom_key.get_bear_doll)
		give_candy = stage_progress:GetCustomData(self.controller.custom_key.get_candy)

		give_item_clear = give_banana and give_bear_doll and give_candy
	end

	if give_item_clear then
		-- 모든 선물을 다 줬을 경우
		character_util.remove_emotion(leez)
		character_util.remove_anim(leez)

		-- 이제 여기에는 더 없는 거 같아…
		character_util.set_emotion(user_party.Leader, { name = 'tired' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(user_party.Leader,
				{ key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_sera_present_s1_9', skip = true })

		character_util.remove_emotion(user_party.Leader)

		-- 흠… 여긴 아닌가?
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		character_util.set_direction(leez, 'left')
		character_util.set_emotion(leez, { name = 'tired' })
		character_util.set_anim(leez, { name = 'question', loop = false })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(leez,
				{ key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_sera_present_s1_10', skip = true })

		-- 다른 곳으로 가서 한번 찾아봐야겠어!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
		character_util.look_at(leez, user_party.Leader)
		character_util.remove_emotion(leez)
		character_util.remove_anim(leez)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(leez,
				{ key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_sera_present_s1_11', skip = true })

		-- 혹시 또 새로운 거 찾으면 연락해줘!
		character_util.set_animation_n_times(leez, { name = 'release', count = 3, sfx = '01_swing_01' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(leez,
				{ key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_sera_present_s1_12', skip = true })

		character_util.remove_emotion(leez)
		character_util.remove_anim(leez)
		character_util.remove_emotion(bodyguard)
		character_util.remove_anim(bodyguard)

		local leez_wp = { leez.Position + vector(2, 0, 0),
						  leez.Position + vector(2, 0, -2),
						  leez.Position + vector(13, 0, -2)}

		local bodyguard_wp = { bodyguard.Position + vector(1,0,0),
							   bodyguard.Position + vector(1,0,-4),
							   bodyguard.Position + vector(12,0,-4)}

		wait_all({
			util.cs_generator(wp_util.move_way_points_async, leez, { waypoints = leez_wp, speed = 4.5, run = false }),
			util.cs_generator(wp_util.move_way_points_async, bodyguard, { waypoints = bodyguard_wp, speed = 4.5, run = false })
		})

		character_util.set_position(leez, vector(999,0,999))
		character_util.set_position(bodyguard, vector(999,0,999))

		party_util.remove_emotion()
		party_util.remove_animation()
	end
end

-- 세라 묘지 interact
function local_class:interact_grave()
	-- 세라
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_sera_present_s1_15' })

	-- 선택지
	-- 리즈에게 메세지를 보낸다 / 그냥 간다
	local result = choose_util.play_choose_event({ { 'nightmare_futurecastle_sera_present_s1_18_1', 'mercy' },
									{ 'nightmare_futurecastle_sera_present_s1_18_2', 'normal' } })

	if result == 2 then
		return
	end

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({name = 'bgm_steampunk_basement_02', state = 'event', mix = 2})

	local grave = self.get_grave()
	local leez = self.get_leez()
	local bodyguard = self.get_bodyguard()
	local sera = self.get_sera()
	local leez_pos = grave.Position + vector(-1,0,-1)

	character_util.show_emoticon_async(user_party.Leader, nil, 'silence')
	character_util.set_emotion(user_party.Leader, { name = 'sad' })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	party_util.align_party(leez_pos + vector(0,0,0), 'right', 1, 'linear')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_phone_receive_02')
	character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'left')
	character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'push', scale = 0.5 })

	-- 휴대폰 세팅
	self.phone = drop_item_util.create_item(
			{itemid = 20017, notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter'
			, pos = user_party.Leader.Position + vector(-0.2, 0, 0.1), sprscale = 0.01, showoncharacter = true })

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
		local time = 0.01
		while time <= 0.5 do
			time = time + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			self.phone.SpriteTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * time
		end
		end))

	wait_for_sec(1)

	local target_name = 'nightmare_future_leez'
	local portrait_name = 'steampunk_citizen_girl'
	-- 새로운 걸 발견했다고? 곧 거기로 갈게!
	local sns_obj_1 = CS.Oak.SNSMessage.Create(target_name, portrait_name,
			game_string:GetString('nightmare_futurecastle_sera_present_s1_19'))

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.SNSEvent.Create(sns_obj_1))

	local time_passed = 0
	while self.wait_for_sns and time_passed < 2 do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if self.wait_for_sns then
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.SNSPopEvent.Instance)
	end

	character_util.remove_anim(user_party.Leader)
	self.phone:ConsumeComplete()
	self.phone = nil

	party_util.align_party(leez_pos + vector(2,0,0), 'right', 1, 'linear')
	character_util.remove_anim(user_party.Leader)

	character_util.set_position(leez, vector(111,0,29))
	character_util.set_position(bodyguard, vector(110,0,29))

	quest_icon.RemoveIcon(leez)
	character_util.remove_anim(leez)
	character_util.remove_emotion(leez)
	character_util.remove_anim(bodyguard)
	character_util.remove_emotion(bodyguard)
	coroutine.yield()

	camera_util.move(leez_pos, 1)

	local leez_wp = { leez_pos + vector(-1, 0, -1),
					  leez_pos + vector(-1, 0, 0)}

	local bodyguard_wp = { leez_pos + vector(-3,0,-1)}



	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(wp_util.move_way_points_async, leez, { waypoints = leez_wp, speed = 4.5, run = false }),
		util.cs_generator(wp_util.move_way_points_async, bodyguard, { waypoints = bodyguard_wp, speed = 4.5, run = false })
	})

	-- 정말로 세라 이름이 적혀있는 돌덩이가 있네?
	character_util.set_direction(leez, 'right')
	character_util.set_emotion(leez, { name = 'smile' })
	character_util.set_anim(leez , { name = 'idle' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(leez,
			{ key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_sera_present_s1_20', skip = true })

	-- 응… 여기 와서 읽어봐…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(user_party.Leader,
			{ key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_sera_present_s1_21', skip = true })


	character_util.move_to_async(leez, leez_pos, nil, 2, true, true)
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	-- 정말로 세라 이름이 적혀있는 돌덩이가 있네?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	character_util.set_emotion(leez, { name = 'surprise' })
	character_util.set_anim(leez , { name = 'idle' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(leez,
			{ key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_sera_present_s1_22', skip = true })

	-- 세라가 나를 위해 숨겨둔 선물이 바로 이거였나봐~!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(leez, { name = 'smile' })
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(leez, { name = 'release', count = 4, sfx = '01_swing_01' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(leez,
			{ key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_sera_present_s1_23', skip = true })

	-- 근데 왜 이런 돌덩이를 선물로 두고 간 걸까?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(leez, { name = 'sleep_deep' })
	character_util.set_anim(leez, { name = 'question', loop = false })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(leez,
			{ key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_sera_present_s1_24', skip = true })

	-- 음… 그게 아니라, 이건…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(user_party.Leader, { name = 'embarrassed' })
	character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'idle' })

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(user_party.Leader,
			{ key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_sera_present_s1_25' })

	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	-- tint 적용
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fade_out_02')
	field:Tint('sera_tint', unity_color({ 0.2, 0.2, 0.4, 1 }), 1.5)
	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(user_party.Leader)
	party_util.set_emotion( { name = 'scared' })
	party_util.set_anim( { name = 'embarrassed' })
	party_util.jump(0.5,0.3)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(leez, { name = 'surprise' })
	character_util.set_anim(leez , { name = 'idle' })
	character_util.normal_jump(leez, true)

	character_util.set_emotion(bodyguard, { name = 'scared' })
	character_util.set_anim(bodyguard, { name = 'embarrassed' })

	-- 세라 유령 등장
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 2 })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_ghost_disappear_03')
	character_util.set_position(sera, grave.Position + vector(0,1,0))
	character_util.set_direction(sera, 'down')
	character_util.remove_emotion(sera)
	character_util.remove_anim(sera)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(sera, 0.6, 1)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	party_util.remove_animation()
	character_util.remove_anim(bodyguard)

	-- 리…즈…
	camera_util.resize_to(4,2.5)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sera,
			{ key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_sera_present_s1_26', skip = true })

	-- 반…가워… 오랜…만이야…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sera,
			{ key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_sera_present_s1_27', skip = true })

	-- 아니… 세라…!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	camera_util.resize_to(2.5,2.5)
	character_util.shake(leez, 0.02, 9999)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(leez,
			{ key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_sera_present_s1_28', skip = true, bubble_direction = 'lt' })

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- ……
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(leez,
			{ key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_sera_present_s1_29', skip = true, bubble_direction = 'lt' })

	wait_for_sec(0.75)

	-- tint 및 카메라 원복
	field:RemoveTint('sera_tint', 0.3)
	camera_util.resize_to_default(0.3)
	camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.3)

	character_util.remove_emotion(bodyguard)
	party_util.remove_emotion()
	party_util.remove_animation()
	character_util.set_emotion(user_party.Leader, { name = 'embarrassed' })

	-- 역시 세라는 대단하니깐! 이렇게 특별한 선물을 두고 갈 줄이야!
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field', mix = 1.5 })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
