function local_class:start_beast_racing()
	local beast = get_character('race_beast')
	local reload_duration = 1
	local prepare_duration = 3
	local charge_duration = 0.5
	local charge_dist = 20.5
	local charge_count = 3
	local current_count = 0

	local attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateRect(unity_class.vector3.zero, unity_class.vector2(charge_dist, 3.8))
	attack_range:Hide()

	if beast.Hitbox.size.z < 2 then
		local scale_box = beast.Hitbox
		scale_box.size = vector(scale_box.size.x, scale_box.size.y, 2)
		beast.Hitbox = scale_box
	end

	while (current_count < charge_count) do
		current_count = current_count + 1

		--Prepare
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_shadow_beast_prepare_01')

		beast:RemoveAnimation()
		character_util.set_anim(beast, {name = 'devour_charge', loop = false, scale = 0.1})

		attack_range_util.setup_by_direction(attack_range, beast.Position, unity_class.vector3.right, 0)
		attack_range_util.show(attack_range, 0)

		stage_camera:Shake({direction = unity_class.vector3.up, magnitude = 0.3, duration = 0.3, useUnScaledTime = true})

		wait_for_sec(prepare_duration)

		--Chase
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_shadow_beast_rush_01')

		character_util.set_anim(beast, {name = 'devour_charge', loop = false, scale = 1.3})
		attack_range:Hide()

		local time_passed = 0
		local start_pos = beast.Position
		local end_pos = beast.Position + unity_class.vector3.right * charge_dist
		local leader_crashed = false
		local leader_dead_routine
		while(time_passed <= charge_duration) do
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

			local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / charge_duration)
			local cur_pos = beast.Position
			local next_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress)

			local collide_fos = CS.Oak.LuaCollisionUtil.GetFieldObjectsCollidedBy(beast.Bounds, next_pos - cur_pos)

			if collide_fos:Contains(user_party_leader) and not leader_crashed then
				leader_crashed = true
				leader_dead_routine = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
						util.cs_generator(self.leader_crashed_beast, self))
			end
			collide_fos:Dispose()

			beast.Position = next_pos

			coroutine.yield()
		end

		beast.Position = end_pos

		-- 리더가 충돌됬다면 리더가 죽는연출이 끝날때까지 대기하고 레이스 다시 시작
		if leader_crashed then
			while (not leader_dead_routine.IsDone) do
				coroutine.yield()
			end

			self:restart_race()

			return
		else
			-- ReLoad
			beast:RemoveAnimation()
			wait_for_sec(reload_duration)
		end
	end

	beast.SpineController:SetAlphaFade(0, 2)
	wait_for_sec(2)
	beast.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
end

function local_class:restart_race()
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_drown_01')
	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(1, 'ease_in_out_sine')

	local leader_reset_point = field:GetMarker('leader_race_reset').position
	local sohee_reset_point = field:GetMarker('sohee_race_reset').position
	local beast_reset_point = field:GetMarker('beast_race_reset').position

	party_util.set_emotion({name = 'attack'})
	party_util.remove_animation()
	party_util.set_direction('left')
	party_util.position_party(leader_reset_point, 'left')

	local sohee = get_character('sohee')
	sohee.Position = sohee_reset_point
	sohee:SetEmotion('attack', true)

	local lavi = get_character('lavi')
	lavi.Position = sohee.Position + unity_class.vector3.right
	lavi.Direction = character_util.get_direction('left')
	lavi:SetEmotion('attack', true)
	lavi:SetUpperAnimation('hold_loop', true)

	local favi = get_character('favi')
	favi:SetEmotion('scared', true)
	favi:SetAnimation('prostrate', true)

	local beast = get_character('race_beast')
	beast.Position = beast_reset_point
	beast.Direction = character_util.get_direction('right')
	beast:RemoveAnimation()

	-- 0.5초 정도 기다려준다
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(1, 'ease_in_out_sine')

	wait_for_sec(1)

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_shadow_beast_scream_01')
	beast:SetAnimation('scream', false)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	screen_util.show_boss_title('shadow_beast', 'nightmare_ms_beast_race_subtitle', 2)

	self.race_routine = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.start_beast_racing, self))

	party_util.remove_emotion()

function local_class:leader_crashed_beast()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		local member = user_party[i]
		member.SpineController:PulseColor(CS.Oak.Constants.DamageColor, 1, 1, 1)
		member.SpineController:DamageSquish(1.3, 0.7, 1, 0.3)
		member.Direction = direction_util.to_side_dir(member.Direction)
	end

	party_util.set_emotion({name = 'hurt'})
	party_util.set_animation('dead', false)

	CS.DamageNumber.ShowDamageNumber(user_party_leader, math.floor(user_party_leader.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP),
			unity_class.color.red, user_party_leader.Position)

	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_hit_shadow_beast_rush_01')

	wait_for_sec(1.7)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.event_progress = nil
	self.controller = nil
end

return local_class

		Index = 4 @

]]

function local_class:init(controller, _)
	self.controller = controller

	self.event_progress = {
		none = 1,
		sohee_talk_oneself = 2,
		kick_demon_twin = 3,
		defeat_shadow_beast = 4
	}
	self.current_progress = self.event_progress.none

	self.brazier_zone_prefix = 'brazier_'
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.controller.main_stage_4_name then
		return true
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent), 'on_event')

	screen_util.preload_boss_title()

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('time_travel_clock')
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('time_travel_glow')

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent))

	self.event_progress = nil
	self.controller = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) and e.FullEnter then
		local sohee = get_character('sohee')
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, sohee) and e.Zone.Name == 'BOSS' and self.current_progress == self.event_progress.sohee_talk_oneself then
			self.current_progress = self.event_progress.kick_demon_twin
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.kick_demon_twin, self)
		end

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) and e.Zone.Name == 'brazier_1' and
				self.current_progress == self.event_progress.none then

			self.current_progress = self.event_progress.sohee_talk_oneself

			-- 그림자 마수… 밝은 곳에서 놈은 벽을 통과할 수 없었지…
			local sohee = get_character('sohee')
			local sohee_png = self.controller.sohee_portrait_name
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(sohee, {key = 'nightmare_magicschool_main4_7_0', portraitname = sohee_png})
		end

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) and string_helper.start_with(e.Zone.Name, self.brazier_zone_prefix) then
			for i = 1, 2 do
				local target_name = e.Zone.Name .. '_' .. i
				local brazier = get_field_object(target_name)

				if not brazier.CombustibleBehaviour.IsBurning then
					command_util.execute_burn(user_party_leader, brazier)
				end
			end
		end
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent) then
		local battle_beast = get_character('battle_beast')
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, battle_beast) and self.current_progress == self.event_progress.kick_demon_twin then
			self.current_progress = self.event_progress.defeat_shadow_beast
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.defeat_shadow_beast, self)
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller

	self.event_progress = {

	}

end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.controller.main_stage_5_name then
		return true
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

	self.event_progress = nil
	self.controller = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) and e.FullEnter and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) then
		if e.Zone.Name == 'MAD_SOHEE' and self.current_progress == self.event_progress.none then
			self.current_progress = self.event_progress.mad_sohee
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.mad_sohee_event, self)
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)

	self.event_progress = {

		talk_to_founder = 2,
		battle_to_founder = 3,
		defeat_founder = 4,

function local_class:enter()

	screen_util.preload_boss_title()

	quest_icon.PreLoad()

end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.controller.main_stage_6_name then
		return true
	end

	local prostrate_character_names = {
		"teacher1",
		"president",
		"bad_male",
		"bad_female",
		"student1",
		"student2",
		"student3",
		"student4",
		"student5",
		"guide"
	}
	for _, name in ipairs(prostrate_character_names) do
		local character = get_character('clear_' .. name)
		local marker = field:GetMarker('prostrate_' .. name)

		character.Position = marker.position
		character.Direction = marker.direction
		character:SetEmotion('damaged', true)
		character:SetAnimation('prostrate', true)
	end

	for i = 1, 7 do
		local cecil_fan = get_character('idol_fan' .. i)

		cecil_fan.Direction = (cecil_fan.Direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Left or cecil_fan.Direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Right) and
				cecil_fan.Direction or CS.Oak.Direction.Right
		cecil_fan:SetEmotion('damaged', true)
		cecil_fan:SetAnimation('prostrate', true)

		cecil_fan.Interactable.Talk = ''
	end

	for i = 1, 3 do
		local student = get_character('student' .. i)

		student.Direction = (student.Direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Left or student.Direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Right) and
				student.Direction or CS.Oak.Direction.Right
		student:SetEmotion('damaged', true)
		student:SetAnimation('prostrate', true)

		student.Interactable.Talk = ''
	end

	animator:Play('red')

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent))

	self.founder_explosion_pool = nil
	self.meteor_effect_pool = nil
	self.meteor_explosion_pool = nil
	self.reset_effect_pool = nil
	self.controller = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) and e.FullEnter and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) then
		if e.Zone.Name == 'TALK_TO_FOUNDER' and self.current_progress == self.event_progress.none then
			self.current_progress = self.event_progress.talk_to_founder
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.talk_to_founder_event, self)
		end
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent) then
		local founder = get_character('boss_portrait_center')
		if self.current_progress == self.event_progress.battle_to_founder and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, founder) then
			self.current_progress = self.event_progress.defeat_founder
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.defeat_founder_event, self)
		end
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		local sohee = get_character('sohee')
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(sohee, e.Target) and self.current_progress == self.event_progress.defeat_founder then
			self.current_progress = self.event_progress.interact_to_sohee
			sohee.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.talk_to_sohee, self)
		end
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent) and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) or lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party) then
		if not self.tinted_field and  e.CameraGrid.name == 'founder_room' then
			self.tinted_field = true
			music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 2 })
			field:Tint(self.boss_battle_tint_key, unity_class.color.red, 0, 0.5)
		elseif self.tinted_field and e.CameraGrid.name == 'to_founder_room' then
			self.tinted_field = false
			music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field', mix = 2 })
			field:RemoveTint(self.boss_battle_tint_key)
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:defeat_founder_event()

	local favi_png = self.controller.favi_portrait_name
	local lavi = get_character('lavi')
	local favi = get_character('favi')

	local shoot_meteor = function(target_pos, duration)
		local height = 15
		local xz_dist = 10
		local radius = 1.5
		local create_pos = target_pos + unity_class.vector3.right * xz_dist + unity_class.vector3.up * height

		local meteor = self.meteor_effect_pool:Instantiate(create_pos)
		meteor.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 2
		meteor.transform:GetComponentInChildren(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.TrailRenderer)):Clear()

		local attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(vector_util.get_x0z(target_pos, 0.05), radius)
		attack_range:Show()

		music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '02_hit_fire_01', duration = duration})

		local time_passed = 0
		while(time_passed < duration) do
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

			local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration)

			local cur_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(create_pos, target_pos, progress)

			meteor.transform.position = cur_pos

			coroutine.yield()
		end

		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_instant_heal_stomp_01')

		camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.1)

		-- FIXME: 왜 Destroy가 안되지?..
		attack_range:Hide()
		--CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Destroy(attack_range.gameObject)

		local explosion = self.meteor_explosion_pool:Instantiate(target_pos)
		explosion.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 1.8

		meteor:Dispose()
	end

	self.tap_count = 0

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), 'on_event')

	local occult_girl = get_character(self.occult_girl_name)
	occult_girl.Interactable:AddListener(self.controller.cs_controller)

	--fx_obj_event_curse_item_loop는 즉시 사용하기 때문에, 로드 될 때 까지 기다린다.
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.curse_item_loop_effect_name)
	yield_return(unity_object_pool, 'WaitAll')

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.curse_item_end_effect_name)
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.curse_debuff_effect_name)
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.buff_effect_name)
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.last_hit_effect_name)
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.level_up_effect_name)
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.hit_effect_name)

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	local ghostly_book = get_field_object(self.ghostly_book_name)
	local ghostly_scale = get_field_object(self.ghostly_scale_name)
	local ghostly_furball = get_field_object(self.ghostly_furball_name)

	if self.quest_progress ~= nil and self.quest_progress:GetCustomState('is_get_potion') ~= -1 then
		self.is_get_potion = true
	end

	self.curse_item_loop_effect_dict = {}
	if self.quest_progress == nil or self.quest_progress:GetCustomState(ghostly_book.Name) == -1 then
		self.curse_item_loop_effect_dict[ghostly_book.Name] = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.curse_item_loop_effect_name):Instantiate(ghostly_book.Position)
	end
	if self.quest_progress == nil or self.quest_progress:GetCustomState(ghostly_scale.Name) == -1 then
		self.curse_item_loop_effect_dict[ghostly_scale.Name] = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.curse_item_loop_effect_name):Instantiate(ghostly_scale.Position)
	end
	if self.quest_progress == nil or self.quest_progress:GetCustomState(ghostly_furball.Name) == -1 then
		self.curse_item_loop_effect_dict[ghostly_furball.Name] = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.curse_item_loop_effect_name):Instantiate(ghostly_furball.Position)
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent))

	if self.listening_touch_event then
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
	end

	local occult_girl = get_character(self.occult_girl_name)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(occult_girl.Interactable, typeof(CS.Oak.NPCInteractable)) then
		occult_girl.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)
	end

	if self.curse_item_loop_effect_dict ~= nil then
		if self.curse_item_loop_effect_dict[self.ghostly_book_name] ~= nil then
			self.curse_item_loop_effect_dict[self.ghostly_book_name]:Dispose()
			self.curse_item_loop_effect_dict[self.ghostly_book_name] = nil
		end
		if self.curse_item_loop_effect_dict[self.ghostly_scale_name] ~= nil then
			self.curse_item_loop_effect_dict[self.ghostly_scale_name]:Dispose()
			self.curse_item_loop_effect_dict[self.ghostly_scale_name] = nil
		end
		if self.curse_item_loop_effect_dict[self.ghostly_furball_name] ~= nil then
			self.curse_item_loop_effect_dict[self.ghostly_furball_name]:Dispose()
			self.curse_item_loop_effect_dict[self.ghostly_furball_name] = nil
		end
	end
	self.curse_item_loop_effect_dict = nil

	self.carp_coroutine = nil
	self.running_coroutine = nil

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.TouchEvent) then
		self:on_touch_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.DamageEvent) then
		self:on_damage_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ItemGetEvent) then
		self:on_item_get_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local occult_girl = get_character(self.occult_girl_name)
	local ghostly_book = get_field_object(self.ghostly_book_name)
	local ghostly_scale = get_field_object(self.ghostly_scale_name)
	local ghostly_furball = get_field_object(self.ghostly_furball_name)

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, occult_girl) then
		if self.occult_girl_state == 'scale' then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.use_potion, self)
		elseif self.occult_girl_state == 'furball' then
			if self.is_occult_girl_mad == false then
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.catch_occult_girl, self)
			else
				stop_coroutine(self.running_coroutine)
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.knockback_player, self))
			end
		end
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, ghostly_book) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.book_of_necromancy, self)
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, ghostly_scale) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.scale_of_necromancy, self)
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, ghostly_furball) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.furball_of_necromancy, self)
	end
end

function local_class:on_touch_event(e)
	if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.TouchDown and self.time_since_last_tap_count > 0.3 then
		--연타 QTE 중 클릭했을 때 캐릭터 행동 연출
		local occult_girl = get_character(self.occult_girl_name)
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_player_jump_01')
		character_util.jump({ user_party_leader, occult_girl }, 0.4, 0.25)

		self.time_since_last_tap_count = 0
		self.tap_count = self.tap_count + 1

		camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.1)
	end
end

function local_class:on_damage_event(e)
	local occult_girl = get_character(self.occult_girl_name)

	if self.is_occult_girl_mad == true and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.target, occult_girl) and e.Info.sender.Name == '[breakable]pot1_1' then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.stun_occult_girl, self)
	end
end

function local_class:on_item_get_event(e)
	local item_data = CS.Oak.GameDataService.GetData("ItemData")
	local occult_girl = get_character(self.occult_girl_name)

	if e.Getter == occult_girl then
		if e.Item.ItemId == item_data:GetSpec(self.potion_item_name).Id then
			self.is_throw_potion = true
		end
	end
end

function local_class:book_of_necromancy()

		self.time_since_last_tap_count = self.time_since_last_tap_count + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		total_time_passed = total_time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if self.tap_count > 13 or total_time_passed > 8 then
			break
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if self.time_since_last_tap_count < 0.3 then
		wait_for_sec(0.3 - self.time_since_last_tap_count)

function local_class:disabled_ghostly_thing(flag)
	local ghostly_thing_name_list = { self.ghostly_book_name, self.ghostly_scale_name, self.ghostly_furball_name }

	for i = 1, #ghostly_thing_name_list do
		local fo = get_field_object(ghostly_thing_name_list[i])

		if flag then
			fo.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
		else
			fo.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
		end
	end
end

function local_class:occult_girl_run(speed, init_func, wait_func)
	local occult_girl = get_character(self.occult_girl_name)
	local run_position_list = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)

	for i = 1, 4 do
		local marker = field:GetMarker(self.occult_girl_marker_name .. i).position
		run_position_list:Add(marker)
	end

	if init_func ~= nil then
		yield_return_func(init_func, self)
	end

	while true do
		character_util.move_waypoint_async(occult_girl, { run_position_list[self.occult_girl_run_num - 1] }, speed, true, nil, nil, nil, true)

		if self.occult_girl_run_num == 2 or self.occult_girl_run_num == 4 then
			if wait_func ~= nil then
				yield_return_func(wait_func, self)
			end
		end

		self:cycling_occult_girl_run_num()
	end
end

function local_class:knockback_player()
	local occult_girl = get_character(self.occult_girl_name)

	local knockback_info = character_util.knockback_info("physics", true, direction, 13000, 0.05, CS.Oak.Constants.DefaultFrictionCoefficient)

	party_util.reset_controllers()
	character_util.remove_anim(occult_girl)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(occult_girl, { key = 'mediumistic_occult_girl_42' })
	character_util.jump(occult_girl, 0.5, 0.3)

local local_class = newclass('NightmareOutsideWorldCommunicationSection1')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = NightmareOutsideWorldCommunication @
		Comment = 나이트메어 설산 외계와의 교신 스타피스 이벤트 @
		Index = 0 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	-- 미니게임 이름
	self.game_name = 'whack_a_mole'

	-- 스타피스를 가져오는 함수
	self.get_star_piece = controller.get_star_piece

	-- 캐릭터를 가져오는 함수
	self.get_chris = function() return get_character('chris') end

	-- 오브젝트를 가져오는 함수
	self.get_satellite = function(num) return get_field_object('whack_a_mole_mole_' .. num) end

	-- 이펙트 오브젝트 풀을 가져오는 함수
	self.get_tesla_electric_ray_idle = controller.get_tesla_electric_ray_idle

	-- 원래 파티원 캐싱
	self.cached_party = nil

	-- 크리스와 이미 한번 이상 대화 했는지.
	self.is_saw_chris_event = false
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent), 'on_event')

	local chris = self.get_chris()
	chris.Position = vector(68.5, 0, 41)
	character_util.add_listener(chris, self.controller)

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent), 'on_event')

	local chris = self.get_chris()
	character_util.remove_relate_event(chris, self.controller)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region event

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent) then
		return self:on_mini_game_end_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local chris = self.get_chris()

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, chris) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_chris, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_mini_game_end_event(e)
	if e.Name == self.game_name then
		if e.Success then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.mini_game_clear, self)
		else
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.mini_game_fail, self)
		end
		return true
	end

	return false
end

--endregion

function local_class:interact_chris()
	local chris = self.get_chris()

	party_util.align_to_target(chris, 'down', 1, 'arc')

	if not self.is_saw_chris_event then
		camera_util.move_async(chris.Position + vector(0, 0, 1), 1)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_lightning_strike_01')
		local satellite = self.get_satellite(6)
		local effect_offset = vector(0.25, 1.5, -0.5)
		local effect = self.get_tesla_electric_ray_idle():Instantiate(satellite.Position + effect_offset)

		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		-- 신호다!
		character_util.normal_jump_async(chris, true)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(chris, { key = 'nightmare_outside_world_communication_1', skip = true })

		wait_for_sec(1)
		effect:Dispose()

		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
		character_util.look_at(chris, user_party_leader)
		wait_for_sec(1)

		-- 아, 오랜만이야. 생명의 은인.
		character_util.set_emotion(chris, { name = 'smile' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(chris, { key = 'nightmare_outside_world_communication_2', skip = true })

		-- 기억하지? 네가 얼음 속에서 구해 준 고고학자 겸 인류학자 겸 생물학자 크리스야.
		character_util.set_anim(chris, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(chris, { key = 'nightmare_outside_world_communication_2_1', skip = true })

		-- 이렇게 다시 보다니, ‘진정한 여행은 회귀’라는 말이 떠오르는군.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
		character_util.set_direction(chris, 'left')
		character_util.set_anim(chris, { name = 'victory_get', loop = false, sfx_name = '01_jump_01' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(chris, { key = 'nightmare_outside_world_communication_3', skip = true })
		character_util.remove_anim(chris)

		-- 그사이 나는 이 쉬버링 산맥에 127GHz의 주파수로 전파가 송신되고 있음을 발견했어.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_01')
		character_util.look_at(chris, user_party_leader)
		character_util.remove_emotion(chris)
		character_util.set_anim(chris, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(chris, { key = 'nightmare_outside_world_communication_4', skip = true })

		-- ±0.34초의 낮은 오차범위로 지속적으로 송신하고 있는 걸 보아 무언가 중요한 메시지임이 분명해.
		character_util.set_anim(chris, { name = 'cast' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(chris, { key = 'nightmare_outside_world_communication_5', skip = true })

		-- 외계 행성에서 보내는 신호일까? 아니면 오히려 마계로부터의 신호?
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
		character_util.look_at(chris, user_party_leader)
		character_util.set_anim(chris, { name = 'shoot' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(chris, { key = 'nightmare_outside_world_communication_6', skip = true })

		-- 가능성은 무궁무진하지만, 신호가 불규칙적이라 제대로 기록을 못 하고 있지.
		character_util.remove_anim(chris)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(chris, { key = 'nightmare_outside_world_communication_7', skip = true })

		-- 이것도 인연인데, 내 교신을 도와주지 않겠어?
		character_util.set_emotion(chris, { name = 'smile' })
		character_util.set_anim(chris, { name = 'cast' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(chris, { key = 'nightmare_outside_world_communication_8', skip = true })

		character_util.remove_anim(chris)
	else
		-- 내 계산에 따르면 약 7.32초 후에 다음 신호가 올 거야.
		character_util.look_at(chris, user_party_leader)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(chris, { key = 'nightmare_outside_world_communication_26', skip = true })

		-- 한 번 더 도와줄 수 있을까?
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(chris, { key = 'nightmare_outside_world_communication_27', skip = true })
	end

	-- 도와준다. / 돕지 않는다.
	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({ { 'nightmare_outside_world_communication_8_1', 'mercy' }, { 'nightmare_outside_world_communication_8_2', 'intellect' } })
	if choose_result == 1 then
		-- 고마워, 통신 센터로 들여보내 줄게.
		character_util.normal_double_jump(chris, true)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(chris, { key = 'nightmare_outside_world_communication_9', skip = true })

		screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })

		-- 플레이어를 제외한, 파티원을 모두 파티에서 제외함.
		self.cached_party = {}
		for i = user_party.Count - 1, 1, -1 do
			local party = user_party[i]

			character_util.convert_to_npc(party)
			table.insert(self.cached_party, party)
		end

		-- 미니 게임이 로드 될 때 까지 기다림.
		local is_mini_game_load_complete = false
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.MiniGameLoadEvent.Create(self.game_name, 'nightmare_snowmountain_2', function()
			is_mini_game_load_complete = true
		end))

		while not is_mini_game_load_complete do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

		-- 신호가 오는 통신기를 터치해 주면 돼!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(chris, { key = 'nightmare_outside_world_communication_28', skip = true, bubble_type = 'shout', screen_pos = vector(0, 250), offset = vector(0, 0, 0) })

		-- 신호를 4회 이상 놓치면 해독하기 어려우니 잘 부탁해!
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(chris, { key = 'nightmare_outside_world_communication_29', skip = true, bubble_type = 'shout', screen_pos = vector(0, 250), offset = vector(0, 0, 0) })

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.MiniGameStartEvent.Create(self.game_name))
	else
		-- 그래, 바쁘면 어쩔 수 없지.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(chris, { key = 'nightmare_outside_world_communication_10', skip = true })
	end

	character_util.set_direction(chris, 'up')

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(chris)

	self.is_saw_chris_event = true
end

-- 미니게임 실패 시
function local_class:mini_game_fail()
	local chris = self.get_chris()

	character_util.set_direction(chris, 'down')

	yield_return_func(self.player_position_return, self)

	-- 이런, 해독에 필요한 표본 신호의 21.05%를 놓쳐버렸네.
	character_util.normal_jump_async(chris, true)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(chris, { key = 'nightmare_outside_world_communication_11', skip = true })

	-- 어쩔 수 없지, 다음 신호를 기다리는 수밖에.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(chris, { key = 'nightmare_outside_world_communication_12', skip = true })

	character_util.set_direction(chris, 'up')
end

-- 미니게임 성공 시
function local_class:mini_game_clear()
	local chris = self.get_chris()

	character_util.set_direction(chris, 'down')

	yield_return_func(self.player_position_return, self)

	-- 수고했어, 덕분에 신호의 해독이 완료되었어.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	character_util.normal_jump(chris, true)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(chris, { key = 'nightmare_outside_world_communication_14', skip = true })

	-- 여기 해독된 신호를 프린트했어.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(chris, { key = 'nightmare_outside_world_communication_15', skip = true })

	-- 같이 확인해 보자.
	character_util.set_anim(chris, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(chris, { key = 'nightmare_outside_world_communication_16', skip = true })

	-- 쉬버링 자두사랑, 듣고 있나? 나 주문번호 BR-4797, 주문자명 소히.
	character_util.remove_anim(chris)
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'nightmare_outside_world_communication_17' })

	-- 이렇게 늦게 배송 올 줄 알았으면 카마존에서 주문했을 거야. 내가 직접 자두 나무를 심어서 열매를 따 먹었어도 이거 보단 빨리 먹었겠다고.
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'nightmare_outside_world_communication_18' })

	-- 고객센터도 따로 없어서 쉬버링 산맥 전역으로 전파 날리니까, 들리면 어서 배송 좀 부탁해. 배송 지연에 대한 보상으로 서비스도 잊지 말고?
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'nightmare_outside_world_communication_19' })

	-- 전파 발신지는 고도 31.2km… 헤븐홀드.
	character_util.set_anim(chris, { name = 'cast' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(chris, { key = 'nightmare_outside_world_communication_20', skip = true })

	-- 저런… 이번에야말로 다시 마계와 교신할 수 있게 됐나 기대했는데.
	character_util.remove_anim(chris)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(chris, { key = 'nightmare_outside_world_communication_21', skip = true })

	-- 분명 지난번 마계 방문 때 리리스가 연락하겠다고 했는데, 아직인가 봐.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(chris, { key = 'nightmare_outside_world_communication_22', skip = true })

	-- ‘오늘의 기다림이 내일의 반가움을 키운다’고 하던데, 과연 그렇겠지?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	character_util.set_anim(chris, { name = 'hold_loop' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(chris, { key = 'nightmare_outside_world_communication_22_1', skip = true })

	-- 아무튼 고마워. 네가 아니었다면 나는 지금쯤 ‘자두사랑’ 정도까지밖에 해독하지 못했을 거야.
	character_util.remove_anim(chris)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(chris, { key = 'nightmare_outside_world_communication_23', skip = true })

	character_util.set_anim(chris, { name = 'get' })

	local star_piece = self.get_star_piece()
	star_piece_util.appear(star_piece, chris.Position)
	wait_for_sec(2)

	-- 이건 내 감사의 증표야. 123,250 cd의 높은 광도로 빛나는 멋진 물건이지.
	character_util.set_anim(chris, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(chris, { key = 'nightmare_outside_world_communication_24', skip = true })

	-- 언젠가 또 보자, 생명의 은인 겸 신호 탐지 전문가.
	character_util.remove_anim(chris)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(chris, { key = 'nightmare_outside_world_communication_25', skip = true })

	chris.Interactable.Talk = 'nightmare_outside_world_communication_25'

	yield_return_func(quest_util.complete_quest, self.controller, 0, false, false, false)
end

-- 플레이어의 위치를 미니게임 시작 전으로 되돌림.
function local_class:player_position_return()
	local chris = self.get_chris()

	-- 파티원 복구
	for i = #self.cached_party, 1, -1 do
		local party = self.cached_party[i]
		character_util.convert_to_party_member(party, user_party, false)
	end
	self.cached_party = nil

	party_util.align_to_target(chris, 'down', 0, 'arc')

	wait_for_sec(1)

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field' })
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
end

return local_class

local local_class = newclass('NightmarePoliceAndThiefSection1')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = NightmarePoliceAndThief @
		Comment = 고블린 경찰을 들어서 도둑한테 던지면 잡을 수 있음 @
		Index = 0 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	-- 경찰을 한 번이라도 들었으면 true
	self.is_held = false
	-- 현재 경찰을 들고있는지
	self.is_holding = false
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.HoldUpEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ThrowEvent), 'on_event')

	local goblin_police = get_character('goblin_police')

	goblin_police.Holdable = CS.Oak.Holdable()
	return true
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.HoldUpEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ThrowEvent))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	local goblin_police = get_character('goblin_police')
	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.HoldUpEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, goblin_police) then
			self:hold_up_goblin_police()
			return true
		end
	end

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ThrowEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, goblin_police) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.throw_goblin_police, self))
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

-- 고블린 경찰 들었을 때
function local_class:hold_up_goblin_police()
	local goblin_police = get_character('goblin_police')

	-- 처음 들었을 때
	if not self.is_held then
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(goblin_police, { key = 'nightmare_forest_5_goblin_thief_8' })

		character_util.set_anim(goblin_police, { name = 'cliff' })
		character_util.set_emotion(goblin_police, { name = 'surprise' })
	end

	self.is_held = true
end

-- 고블린 경찰 던졌을 때
function local_class:throw_goblin_police()
	local goblin_police = get_character('goblin_police')
	local goblin_thief = get_character('goblin_thief')
	CS.SpeechBubble.Return(goblin_police)

	character_util.set_direction(goblin_police, user_party_leader.Direction)
	if user_party_leader.Direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Up then
		character_util.set_direction(goblin_police, 'down')
	end

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	character_util.remove_anim(goblin_police)
	character_util.remove_emotion(goblin_police)
	character_util.set_anim(goblin_police, { name = 'prostrate' })
	character_util.set_emotion(goblin_police, { name = 'confused' })

	-- 고블린 경찰의 던져진 상태가 끝날 때까지
	while lua_helper.type_compare(goblin_police.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentState, CS.Oak.FieldObjectThrownState) do
		local dist = (goblin_police.Position - goblin_thief.Position):GetX0z().magnitude
		if dist < 0.4 then
			coroutine.yield(self:crash_goblin_thief())
			return
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

-- 고블린 도둑과 고블린 경찰 충돌
function local_class:crash_goblin_thief()
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()

	local goblin_police = get_character('goblin_police')
	goblin_police.Holdable = CS.Oak.NonHoldable.Instance

	local goblin_thief = get_character('goblin_thief')
	-- 고블린 상태 변경
	local idle_stage_change_event = CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(CS.Oak.CharacterIdleState.Create(goblin_thief))
	message_system:SendSync(goblin_thief, idle_stage_change_event)

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_hit_big_01')
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_goblin_hit_01')

	-- 경찰과 도둑 충돌 연출
	message_system:SendSync(goblin_police, CS.Oak.GetThrownEndEvent.Instance)
	goblin_police.SpineController:DamageRedPulse()
	goblin_police.SpineController:DamageSquish(0.6)
	goblin_thief.SpineController:DamageRedPulse()
	goblin_thief.SpineController:DamageSquish(0.6)

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(goblin_thief, { key = 'nightmare_forest_5_goblin_thief_9' })

	character_util.set_direction(goblin_thief, 'right')
	character_util.set_anim(goblin_thief, { name = 'prostrate' })
	character_util.set_emotion(goblin_thief, { name = 'confused' })

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.5))

	screen_util.fade_out_async(0.7, unity_class.color.black, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear)

	CS.SpeechBubble.Return(goblin_thief)

	local marker = field:GetMarker('catch_goblin_thief').position
	goblin_thief.Position = marker

	goblin_police.Position = marker + unity_class.vector3.left
	character_util.set_direction(goblin_police, 'down')
	character_util.remove_anim(goblin_police)
	character_util.remove_emotion(goblin_police)
	character_util.set_anim(goblin_police, { name = 'idle' })
	character_util.set_emotion(goblin_police, { name = 'smile' })

	local pos = marker + vector(-1, 0, -2)
	user_party:PositionParty(pos, CS.Oak.Direction.Up, 0, CS.Oak.Party.AlignType.Arc)

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.2))

	screen_util.fade_in_async(0.7, unity_class.color.black, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear)

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_positive_01')

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(goblin_police,
		{ key = 'nightmare_forest_5_goblin_thief_4', skip = true })

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(goblin_police,
		{ key = 'nightmare_forest_5_goblin_thief_5', skip = true })

	local star_piece = get_field_object('goblin_thief_star_piece')
	star_piece:OnEvent(CS.Oak.StarPieceAppearEvent.Create(goblin_police.Position))

	goblin_police.Interactable.Talk = 'nightmare_forest_5_goblin_thief_6'
	goblin_thief.Interactable.Talk = 'nightmare_forest_5_goblin_thief_7'

	field_ui_manager:Show()

	coroutine.yield(quest_util.complete_quest(self.controller, 0,true, false))
end

return local_class

	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

function local_class:enter()
	for i = 1, 4 do

		armor.Interactable:AddListener(self.cs_controller)
	end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()

		if lua_helper.type_compare(armor.Interactable, CS.Oak.NPCInteractable) then
			armor.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.cs_controller)
		end
	end

	local teacher = get_character(self.teacher_name)

	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		local teacher = get_character(self.teacher_name)
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, teacher) then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.start_quest, self)
			return true
		end
		for i = 1, 4 do
			local armor = get_character(self.armors_name .. i)
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, armor) then
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.start_quest, self)
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

-- 퀘스트 시작
function local_class:start_quest()
	local armors = {}
	for i = 1, 4 do
		local armor = get_character(self.armors_name .. i)
		armor.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.cs_controller)
		table.insert(armors, armor)
	end

	local teacher = get_character(self.teacher_name)
	teacher.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.cs_controller)

	camera_util.move(armors[1].Position, 1)

	local marker = field:GetMarker('puzzle_times_leader').position
	party_util.align_party(marker, 'right')

	wait_for_sec(0.7)

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.set_anim(teacher, { name = 'question', loop = false })
	character_util.set_emotion(teacher, { name = 'tired' })
	-- ...이 문제만 맞히면 우리도 이 크로스워드 퍼즐을 완성할 수 있어요.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(teacher,
		{ key = 'nightmare_magicschool_6_crossword_1', skip = true })

	-- 가로 4번. 작지만 기술력이 뛰어난 종족들의 나라를 일컫는 네 글자 단어는?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(teacher,
		{ key = 'nightmare_magicschool_6_crossword_2', skip = true })

	character_util.remove_anim(teacher)

	-- '석’으로 시작하는 말이야.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(armors[1],
		{ key = 'nightmare_magicschool_6_crossword_3', skip = true })

	--세 번째 글자는 ‘냉’이어야 하고.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(armors[2],
		{ key = 'nightmare_magicschool_6_crossword_4', skip = true })

	-- ... 이모티콘
	character_util.show_emoticon(teacher, nil, 'silence')
	for _, v in pairs(armors) do
		character_util.show_emoticon(v, nil, 'silence')
	end
	wait_for_sec(2.5)

	-- 애니메이션에 attack 키가 3개가 있는데 한 번만 호출하기 위한 콜백 추가
	local count = 0
	local sfx_handler = function(_, _)

		if count == 1 then
			music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_mech_stomp_01')
		end

local local_class = newclass('NightmareShellGameSection1')

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller

	self.gambler_name = 'shell_game_merchant'
	self.kids_name = {
		'shell_game_kid_1',
		'shell_game_kid_2',
		'shell_game_kid_3',
		'shell_game_kid_4'
	}

	self.challenge_price = 100

	self.is_played_once = false

	self.gold_item_id = 20007
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')

	local gambler = get_character(self.gambler_name)

	if lua_helper.type_compare(gambler.Interactable, CS.Oak.NPCInteractable) then
		gambler.Interactable:AddListener(self.cs_controller)
	end
end

function local_class:start()
	self:start_gambler_routine()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	self:stop_gambler_routine()

	local gambler = get_character(self.gambler_name)

	if lua_helper.type_compare(gambler.Interactable, CS.Oak.NPCInteractable) then
		gambler.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.cs_controller)
	end

	self.kids_name = nil

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local gambler = get_character(self.gambler_name)

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, gambler) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.talk_with_gambler, self)
	end
end

function local_class:gambler_routine()
	local gambler = get_character(self.gambler_name)

	local pos_list = {
		vector(-15.5, 0, 120),
		vector(-18.5, 0, 120),
		vector(-21.5, 0, 120)
	}

	-- 자자~  여러분 흔히 찾아오는 기회가 아니에요!
	-- 단돈 100G로 비싼 아이템을 얻을 수 있는 절호의 기회!
	local string_key_list = {
		'nightmare_china_6_shell_game_1',
		'nightmare_china_6_shell_game_2',
	}

	local pos_index = 2
	local pos_dif = 1

	local string_index = 1

	while true do
		wp_util.move_way_points_async(gambler, {waypoints = pos_list[pos_index], speed = 4,
												last_direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Down})

		character_util.set_emotion(gambler, {name = 'smile'})
		character_util.set_anim(gambler, {name = 'clap', loop = true})
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(gambler, {key = string_key_list[string_index]})
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(gambler)

		string_index = string_index == 1 and 2 or 1

		pos_index = pos_index + pos_dif

		if pos_index == 0 then
			pos_dif = 1
			pos_index = 2
		elseif pos_index == 4 then
			pos_dif = -1
			pos_index = 2
		end
	end
end

function local_class:start_gambler_routine()
	self:stop_gambler_routine()

	self.gambler_coroutine = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
			util.cs_generator(self.gambler_routine, self))
end

function local_class:stop_gambler_routine()
	if self.gambler_coroutine ~= nil then
		stop_coroutine(self.gambler_coroutine)
		self.gambler_coroutine = nil

		local gambler = get_character(self.gambler_name)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(gambler)
		character_util.stop(gambler)
		speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(gambler)
	end
end

function local_class:talk_with_gambler()
	self:stop_gambler_routine()

	local gambler = get_character(self.gambler_name)

	character_util.set_direction(gambler, 'down')
	character_util.align_party(gambler, 'down', 1, 'arc')

	-- 반갑습니다. 기사님!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(gambler, {key = 'nightmare_china_6_shell_game_3', skip = true})

	-- Idle, idle, front 단돈 100골드로 비싼 아이템을 얻을 수 있답니다!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(gambler, {key = 'nightmare_china_6_shell_game_4', skip = true})

	-- Idle, idle, front 도전해 보시겠습니까?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(gambler, {key = 'nightmare_china_6_shell_game_5', skip = true})

	local result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		{'nightmare_china_6_shell_game_talk_branch_1', 'mercy'},
		{'nightmare_china_6_shell_game_talk_branch_2', 'brutal'}
	})

	if result == 1 then
		local user_gold = CS.Oak.User.Me.Gold

		if user_gold >= self.challenge_price then
			coroutine.yield(CS.Oak.StageApiRouter.SendPayGold(stage.StageId, self.challenge_price))

			-- smile, clap 자자 여러분! 여기 도전자가 나타났습니다.
			local clap_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx(
					{ sfx_name = '01_clap_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc'})
			character_util.set_anim(gambler, {name = 'clap', loop = true})
			character_util.set_emotion(gambler, {name = 'smile'})
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(gambler, {key = 'nightmare_china_6_shell_game_6', skip = true})
			clap_sfx:FadeOut(0.3)

-- ex) behave_table = { 2, -1, -4, 3 } -> 2번 3번은 각각 1번 4번 자리로 점프, 1번 4번은 2번 3번 자리로 걸어감
function local_class:shuffle_kids_new(kids, kid_pos_list, behave_info, time_scale)
	local dur = 0.5 / time_scale
	local jump_height = 1

	local wait_list = {}
	local order_list = {}

	for i = 1, #kids do
		local info = behave_info[i]
		if info < 0 then
			-- behave_info의 value를 직접 바꾸면 원본 테이블이 변경되기 때문에 테이블을 따로 만들어서 처리
			table.insert(order_list, -info)
			local angle = -info > i and 360 or -360
			table.insert(wait_list, util.cs_generator(self.spin_jump_async, self,
					kids[i], jump_height, dur, angle, kid_pos_list[-info]))
		else
			table.insert(order_list, info)
			table.insert(wait_list, util.cs_generator(character_util.move_to_async,
					kids[i], kid_pos_list[info], dur, nil, true, true, true))
		end
	end

	wait_all(wait_list)

	for _, v in pairs(kids) do
		character_util.set_direction(v, 'down')
	end

	return self:reorder_table(kids, order_list)
end

function local_class:spin_jump_async(character, height, duration, spin_angle, move_pos)
	character_util.jump(character, height, duration)
	character_util.spine_rotate(character, spin_angle, duration)

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_throw_01')

	if move_pos ~= nil then
		character_util.move_to_async(character, move_pos, duration, nil, true, false, false)
	else
		wait_for_sec(duration)
	end

	character_util.spine_rotate(character, 0, 0)
end

function local_class:reorder_table(list, index_list)
	local new_list = {}

	for i = 1, #list do
		new_list[index_list[i]] = list[i]
	end

	return new_list
end

function local_class:dispose()
end

return local_class

	self.get_star_piece = function() return get_field_object('star_piece_1') end
	self.get_barrel = function() return get_field_object('normal_barrel') end
	self.get_frozen_barrel = function() return get_field_object('frozen_barrel') end

	-- 맥주를 시음하는 씬을 보여주고 있는가
	self.showing_taste_scene = false
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_zone_leave_event')

	local dungeon_devil_warrior = self:get_dungeon_devil_warrior()
	local snowman_female = self:get_snowman_female()
	local snowman_male = self:get_snowman_male()

	character_util.set_position(dungeon_devil_warrior, self.devil_warrior_start_position)
	character_util.set_position(snowman_female, self.snowman_no_hat_start_position, true)
	character_util.set_position(snowman_male, self.snowman_male_start_position, true)

	character_util.set_direction(dungeon_devil_warrior, 'down')
	character_util.set_direction(snowman_male, 'right')
	character_util.set_direction(snowman_female, 'left')

	character_util.set_anim(snowman_male, { name = 'seat' })
	character_util.set_anim(snowman_female, { name = 'seat' })

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	local barrel = self.get_barrel()
	local ice_break = get_field_object('ice_break')
	local field_object_pair = CS.Oak.FieldObjectPair(barrel,ice_break)
	field:AddIgnoreCrash(field_object_pair)

	local seal = self:get_seal()
	character_util.set_active_shadow(seal, false)
	character_util.set_position(seal, vector(-30.5,-0.1,-91.5))
	field_ui_manager:HideTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats, seal)
	seal.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
	character_util.set_anim(seal, { name = 'getin', loop = false })
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil

	self.demonkiss_event_states = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if e:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local devil_warrior = self:get_dungeon_devil_warrior()
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, devil_warrior) and
			self.current_demonkiss_event_state == self.demonkiss_event_states.talk_devil_warrior then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_devil_warrior, self)
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, devil_warrior) then
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(devil_warrior, { key = self.demonkiss_talk .. 74 })
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local barrel = self.get_barrel()
	local frozen_barrel = self.get_frozen_barrel()
	if e.Zone.Name == self.demonkiss_zone_name and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) and
			self.current_demonkiss_event_state == self.demonkiss_event_states.none then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.start_demonkiss_progress, self)
		return true
	end

	local barrel_bhv = barrel.FieldObjectBehaviour
	cast(barrel_bhv, typeof(CS.Oak.IFieldObjectBehaviour))
	local barrel_thrown = lua_helper.type_compare(barrel_bhv.CurrentState, CS.Oak.FieldObjectThrownState)
	if e.Zone.Name == self.seal_zone_name and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject,
			barrel) and not self.is_fall_water and barrel_thrown then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.seal_interact, self)
		return true
	end

	if not e.FullEnter then
		return false
	end

	if e.Zone.Name == self.devil_warrior_zone_name and not self.showing_taste_scene then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, barrel) and
				barrel.CombustibleBehaviour.IsBurning and not self.is_drunk_fire_beer then
			self.current_demonkiss_event_state = self.demonkiss_event_states.fire
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.drink_beer_event, self))
			return true
		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, barrel) and
				self.current_demonkiss_event_state == self.demonkiss_event_states.cool  and
				not self.is_drunk_cool_beer and not barrel.CombustibleBehaviour.IsBurning then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.drink_beer_event, self))
			return true
		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, frozen_barrel) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.drink_beer_event, self))
			return true
		end
	end

	if self.current_demonkiss_event_state == self.demonkiss_event_states.finish then
		if not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, frozen_barrel) then
			return false
		end
		if e.Zone.Name == self.cold_igloo_out_zone_name and not self.is_out_barrel then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.igloo_out_barrel, self,
					false, vector(-63.5,0,-105),vector(-24,0,-57)))
		elseif e.Zone.Name == self.cold_igloo_in_zone_name and not self.is_in_barrel then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.barrel_in_igloo,
					self,false,vector(-24,0,-54),vector(-63.5,0,-101)))
		elseif e.Zone.Name == self.normal_igloo_in_zone_1_name and not self.is_in_barrel then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.barrel_in_igloo,
					self,false,vector(-29,0,-48),vector(-63.5,0,-80)))
		elseif e.Zone.Name == self.normal_igloo_in_zone_2_name and not self.is_in_barrel then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.barrel_in_igloo,
					self,false,vector(-29,0,-59),vector(-63.5,0,-120)))
		elseif e.Zone.Name == self.normal_igloo_out_zone_1_name and not self.is_out_barrel then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.igloo_out_barrel, self,
					false, vector(-63.5,0,-85),vector(-29,0,-51)))
		elseif e.Zone.Name == self.normal_igloo_out_zone_2_name and not self.is_out_barrel then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.igloo_out_barrel, self,
					false, vector(-63.5,0,-125),vector(-29,0,-62)))
		end
	else
		if not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, barrel) then
			return false
		end
		if e.Zone.Name == self.cold_igloo_in_zone_name and not self.is_in_barrel then
			self.controller.is_barrel_in = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.freeze_barrel, self))
		elseif e.Zone.Name == self.normal_igloo_in_zone_1_name and not self.is_in_barrel then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.barrel_in_igloo, self,true,
					vector(-29,0,-48),vector(-63.5,0,-80)))
		elseif e.Zone.Name == self.normal_igloo_in_zone_2_name and not self.is_in_barrel then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.barrel_in_igloo, self,true,
					vector(-29,0,-59),vector(-63.5,0,-120)))
		elseif e.Zone.Name == self.normal_igloo_out_zone_1_name and not self.is_out_barrel then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.igloo_out_barrel, self,
					true, vector(-63.5,0,-85),vector(-29,0,-51)))
		elseif e.Zone.Name == self.normal_igloo_out_zone_2_name and not self.is_out_barrel then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.igloo_out_barrel, self,
					true, vector(-63.5,0,-125),vector(-29,0,-62)))
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if not e.FullLeave then
		return false
	end

	local barrel
	if self.current_demonkiss_event_state == self.demonkiss_event_states.finish then
		barrel = self:get_frozen_barrel()
	else
		barrel = self:get_barrel()
	end

	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, barrel) then
		return false
	end

	local event_zone = e.Zone.Name
	if event_zone == self.cold_igloo_in_zone_name or event_zone == self.normal_igloo_in_zone_1_name or
			event_zone == self.normal_igloo_in_zone_2_name or event_zone == self.cold_igloo_out_zone_name or
			event_zone == self.normal_igloo_out_zone_1_name or event_zone == self.normal_igloo_out_zone_2_name then
		self.is_leave_barrel = true
	end
end

-- 어떤 종류든 맥주를 가져오면 호출
function local_class:drink_beer_event()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

	self.showing_taste_scene = true

	local barrel
	local beer_spec

	if self.current_demonkiss_event_state == self.demonkiss_event_states.fire then
		barrel = self:get_barrel()
		beer_spec = self.fire_beer_spec_id
	elseif self.current_demonkiss_event_state == self.demonkiss_event_states.cool then
		barrel = self:get_barrel()
		beer_spec = self.cool_beer_spec_id
	else
		barrel = self:get_frozen_barrel()
		beer_spec = self.frozen_beer_spec_id
	end

	local devil_warrior = self:get_dungeon_devil_warrior()
	local snowman_male = self:get_snowman_male()
	local snowman_no_hat = self:get_snowman_no_hat()

	camera_util.move(devil_warrior.Position + vector(0,0,-2), 0,

	wait_for_sec(1)

	if lua_helper.type_compare(user_party.Leader.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentActionState, CS.Oak.CharacterHoldUpState) then
		local held = user_party.Leader.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentActionState.HoldTarget

	screen_util.fade_in_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	snowman_no_hat.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon2', 'shield_beer_full')

	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	character_util.remove_anim(snowman_no_hat, true)

	elseif self.current_demonkiss_event_state == self.demonkiss_event_states.cool then

-- 술통이 추운 이글루에 들어가는 연출
function local_class:freeze_barrel()
	self.is_in_barrel = true
	self.is_leave_barrel = false

	while lua_helper.type_compare(user_party.Leader.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentActionState, CS.Oak.CharacterHoldUpState) do
		if self.is_leave_barrel then
			self.is_in_barrel = false
			return
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	local barrel = self:get_barrel()
	local frozen_barrel = self:get_frozen_barrel()
	barrel.Holdable = CS.Oak.NonHoldable.Instance
	message_system:Send(barrel, CS.Oak.GetThrownEndEvent.Instance)
	character_util.move_to_async(barrel, barrel.Position + vector(0,-barrel.Position.y,0),
			0.2, nil,false,false)
	character_util.move_to_async(barrel, vector(-24,0,-54),0.2, nil,
			false,false)
	if barrel.CombustibleBehaviour.IsBurning then
		command_util.execute_extinguish(user_party.Leader, barrel)
	end
	barrel.Position = vector(99,0,99)
	frozen_barrel.Position = vector(-63.5,0,-101)

	self.is_in_barrel = false
	self.current_demonkiss_event_state = self.demonkiss_event_states.finish

	end

	self.is_fall_water = false

local local_class = newclass('NightmareSnowMountainKillerBunnySection1')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = NightmareSnowMountainKillerBunny @
		Comment = 토끼의 위험성을 알려주는 기사 @
		Index = 0 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	-- 이벤트 진행 단계 확인용 플래그들
	self.seen_knight_announcement = false
	self.seen_knight_describing = false
	self.burned_mouse = false
	self.keep_mouse_mouse_around = true
	self.interacted_with_innuit_male = false
	self.interacted_with_innuit_female = false

	-- 대사 키
	self.killer_bunny_prefix = "nightmare_snowmountain_killer_bunny_"
	self.innuit_name_prefix = 'innuit_'

	-- 기믹들
	self.cheese_name = 'cheesecake'
	self.brazier_name = 'brazier_'
	self.sign_board_name = 'sign_board_'

	-- 존 이름
	self.knight_announce_zone_name = 'knight_announce'
	self.mouse_cave_name = 'mouse_cave'

	-- 이누이트 상호 작용시에 사용할 대사 키들.
	self.innuits = {}
	self.innuits['innuit_1'] = 14
	self.innuits['innuit_2'] = 15

	-- Getters
	self.get_innuit_male = function() return get_character('innuit_1') end
	self.get_innuit_female = function() return get_character('innuit_2') end
	self.get_mouse =  function() return get_character('white_mouse') end
	self.get_knight = function() return get_character('heavy_knight') end
	self.get_field_fire_pool = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_field_fire') end
	self.get_black_smoke_pool = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_black_smoke') end
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')

	self.get_field_fire_pool()
	self.get_black_smoke_pool()

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	local mouse = self:get_mouse()
	local mouse_scale = 0.5
	-- 쥐 스탯 표시 지워주기.
	field_ui_manager:HideTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats, mouse)
	mouse.transform.localScale = vector(mouse_scale, mouse_scale, mouse_scale)
	mouse.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(mouse_scale, mouse_scale, mouse_scale))

	local brazier_2 = get_field_object(self.brazier_name .. 2)
	brazier_2.CombustibleBehaviour = CS.Oak.BrazierCombustibleBehaviour()
	command_util.execute_burn(user_party_leader, brazier_2, true)

	local knight = self:get_knight()
	character_util.add_listener(knight, self.controller)
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	self.innuits = nil
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	self.innuits = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	end
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	-- 타겟 이름에 innuit가 들어가는지 확인
	if string.find(e.Target.Name, self.innuit_name_prefix) then
		if e.Target.Name == 'innuit_1' then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
					stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.interact_with_innuit_male, self, e.Target))
		else
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
					stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.interact_with_innuit_female, self, e.Target))
		end
	elseif e.Target.Name == 'heavy_knight' then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.trigger_knight_describing_monster, self)
	end
end

function local_class:interact_with_innuit_male(innuit)
	if self.interacted_with_innuit_male == true then return end

	self.interacted_with_innuit_male = true;
	local string = self.killer_bunny_prefix .. 14
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(innuit, { key = string })
	self.interacted_with_innuit_male = false;
end

function local_class:interact_with_innuit_female(innuit)
	if self.interacted_with_innuit_female == true then return end

	self.interacted_with_innuit_female = true;
	local string = self.killer_bunny_prefix .. 15
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(innuit, { key = string })
	self.interacted_with_innuit_female = false;
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name
	local entered_object = e.FieldObject

	-- 들어간 존이 knight_announce 일 경우
	if zone_name == self.knight_announce_zone_name then
		if not e.FullEnter then return end

		-- 들어온 fo가 플레이어일 경우
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(entered_object, user_party_leader) then
			local triggered_event = util.cs_generator(self.trigger_knight_announce, self)
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, triggered_event)
		end
		-- 들어간 존이 mouse_front 일 경우
	elseif zone_name == self.mouse_cave_name then
		local entered_name = entered_object.Name

		-- 이름에 'brazier_'가 꼭 들어가야하며, 선행 이벤트를 보았어야함.
		if string.find(entered_name, self.brazier_name) ~= nil and self.seen_knight_describing then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.trigger_burnning_mouse, self, entered_object)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:trigger_knight_announce()
	if self.seen_knight_announcement then return end

	self.seen_knight_announcement = true

	local knight = self:get_knight()

	-- 기사(남): 자, 다들 이제 잘 아셨죠?
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(knight, {name = 'release', count = 2})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(knight,
			{key = self.killer_bunny_prefix .. 1, skip = true })
end

function local_class:trigger_burnning_mouse(brazier)

	self.burned_mouse = true

		@async: 비동기로 작성할것인지 여부
		@speed: fo가 도망치는 속도
	]]
	local run_away = function(fo, async, speed)
		local way_points = { true, true}
		local fo_pos = fo.Position
		local is_async = lua_helper.get_or_default(async, true)
		local move_speed = lua_helper.get_or_default(speed, 3)

		way_points[1] = vector(26, 0, fo_pos.z)
		way_points[2] = vector(26, 0, 9)

		if is_async then
			wp_util.move_way_points_async(fo, { waypoints = way_points, speed = move_speed, run = true })
		else
			wp_util.move_way_points(fo, { waypoints = way_points, speed = move_speed, run = true })
		end
	end

	local innuit_male = self:get_innuit_male()
	local innuit_female = self:get_innuit_female()

	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	-- 쥐구멍에 불 성대하게 질러버리기
	local fire_at_cave_pos = vector(22.256, 0.198, 31.936)

	local fire_at_cave_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_fire_03', loop = true,
	                                                      fade_in_time = 2, fade_out_time = 2})
	fire_at_cave.transform.localScale = vector(2.5, 1.7, 1.7)
	fire_at_cave.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(-47.07755, 0, 0))

	wait_for_sec(3)

	-- 쥐구멍 쪽에서 외침 말풍선 “찍…! 찍찍!”
	local speech_bubble_data = 	{key = self.killer_bunny_prefix .. 6, bubble_type = 'shout', skip = true }
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_mouse_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(mouse, speech_bubble_data)

	-- 쥐, 쥐구멍에서 나오는데 몸에 불이 붙어 있고 damaged 표정
	local field_fire_pool = self.get_field_fire_pool()

	character_util.set_emotion(mouse, { name = 'damaged' })

	-- 쥐가 쥐굴에서 도망칠 좌표
	local out_dest_from_cave = vector(0, 0, 0)
	-- brazier가 플레이어 손에 들려있다면
	if brazier.Holdable.IsHeld then
		-- 밖(22.5, 0, 29.5)으로
		out_dest_from_cave.x = 22.5
		out_dest_from_cave.z = 29
	-- 들려있지 않다면

		-- 밖(22.5, 0, 32.5)으로

		out_dest_from_cave.z = 31.5
	end

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({state = 'event', name = 'bgm_trickery_theme', mix = 2.0})
	-- 밖(22.5, 0, 29.5)으로 나와 왼쪽으로 1칸 가 점프 콩콩, “찍찍!”

	local move_to_right = vector(mouse.Position.x + 0.5, mouse.Position.y, mouse.Position.z)

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(mouse, speech_bubble_data)

	-- 오른쪽으로 2칸 가 점프 콩콩, “찍찍!”

	character_util.normal_double_jump(mouse, '01_small_jump_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_die_mouse_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(mouse, speech_bubble_data)

	-- 아래로 쭉 달려간다: 카메라, 쥐를 따라간다.
	local move_down_way_point = {
		vector(23, 0, 29),
		vector(22, 0, 29),
		vector(22, 0, 19)
	}
	local mouse_run = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_dash_01', loop = true})
	wp_util.move_way_points_async(mouse, {waypoints = move_down_way_point, speed = 8})
	mouse_run:Stop()

	-- (22, 0, 19)지점에서 쥐, 멈춰서서 점프 콩콩 후
	stage_camera:CancelMove()
	character_util.normal_double_jump(mouse, '01_small_jump_01')

	-- 외침 “찍찍!” 하며 근처를 빙글빙글 돈다: 제자리에서 빙글X, 우상좌하 순으로 1칸씩 움직이며 빙글빙글 돈다.
	local triggered_event = util.cs_generator(self.move_mouse_round, self)
	mouse_run = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_dash_01', loop = true})
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, triggered_event)

	-- 쥐가 있는 방향을 바라보는 이누이트들
	character_util.look_at(innuit_male, mouse)
	character_util.look_at(innuit_female, mouse)

	-- 이누이트2 [shout 말풍선] : 꺄아아아악!
	character_util.jump(innuit_female, 1, 0.5)
	character_util.jump(innuit_male, 1, 0.5)

	camera_util.shake(0.4, 0.3)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_count_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_jump_01')

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 깜짝 놀라는 이누이트들
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(innuit_male, {name = 'embarrassed'},
			{name = 'surprise'})
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(innuit_female, {name = 'embarrassed'},
			{name = 'surprise'})

	local bubble_pos = vector(21.5, 0, 17)
	local bubble = {key = self.killer_bunny_prefix .. 16, bubble_type = 'shout', world_pos = bubble_pos,  skip = true}
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_crowd_shout_02')

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(innuit_female, bubble)

	-- 이누이트 1 : 하… 하얀 털, 분홍색 귀! 빨리 도망쳐!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(innuit_male,
			{key = self.killer_bunny_prefix .. 17,  skip = true})

	-- 이누이트 1,2 아랫길로 도주
	local innuit_run = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_dash_01', loop = true})
	run_away(innuit_male, false, 8)
	run_away(innuit_female, false, 8)

	wait_for_sec(0.645)
	self.keep_mouse_mouse_around = false

	-- 쥐도 따라서 도망감
	run_away(mouse, true, 8)


	-- 도망간 이누이트들과 쥐 비활성화 시켜줌.
	character_util.set_active_state(innuit_male, 'disabled')
	character_util.set_active_state(innuit_female, 'disabled')
	character_util.set_active_state(mouse, 'disabled')

	innuit_run:Stop()
	mouse_run:Stop()
	fire_at_cave_sfx:Stop()

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({state = 'event', name = 'bgm_shivermore_main', mix = 2.0})

	fire_at_cave:Dispose()
	fire_on_mouse:Dispose()

	character_util.remove_emotion(innuit_male)
	character_util.remove_emotion(innuit_female)
	character_util.remove_emotion(mouse)

	camera_util.resize_to_default(0.5)
	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)

	yield_return_func(quest_util.complete_quest, self.controller, 0, false, false, false)
end

function local_class:move_mouse_round()
	local mouse = self:get_mouse()
	local way_points =
	{
		vector(mouse.Position.x + 1, mouse.Position.y, mouse.Position.z),
		vector(mouse.Position.x + 1, mouse.Position.y, mouse.Position.z + 1),
		vector(mouse.Position.x, mouse.Position.y, mouse.Position.z + 1),
		vector(mouse.Position.x, mouse.Position.y, mouse.Position.z)
	}

	while self.keep_mouse_mouse_around do
		wp_util.move_way_points_async(mouse,{waypoints = way_points, speed = 6.7})
	end
end


return local_class

-- 여관 카메라 사이즈 조절
function local_class:resize_tavern_camera(camera, size, duration)
	local time_passed = 0
	local start_size = camera.orthographicSize
	while time_passed < duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local size = CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear(time_passed, start_size, size - start_size, duration)

		camera.orthographicSize = size

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

local local_class = newclass('NightmareSnowMountainMainSection2')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = NightmareSnowMountainMain @
		Comment = 루피나를 만난 코코와 주인공 @
		Index = 1 @
		NextSections = 2 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	self.stage_name = 'nightmare_snowmountain_1'
	self.coco_sprite_name = 'innuit.png'
	self.lupina_sprite_name = 'witch_coco.png'

	self.get_coco = controller.get_coco
	self.get_lupina = controller.get_lupina

	--루피나의 핸드폰
	self.phone = nil

	-- 블리자드가 진행중인지
	self.is_blizzard_active = nil

	self.blizzard_state = {
		clear = 0,
		normal = 1,
		strong = 2
	}

	self.section_progress = {
		-- 초기값
		none = 0,
		-- 루피나 동굴 앞 이벤트
		lupina_cave = 1,
		-- 루피나 방 앞 이벤트
		lupina_room = 2,
		-- 루피나 대화 이벤트
		lupina_talk = 3
	}

	self.current_progress = self.section_progress.none

	-- 훅샷지점에서 코코가 경고했는지
	self.coco_warning = false

	-- 루피나의 혼잣말
	self.lupina_mumble = false

	self.marker_target = nil

	self.shoot_helper = nil

	self.ice_effect = nil
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return true
	end

	self.is_blizzard_active = self.blizzard_state.clear

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')

	self:set_environment()

	self.marker_target = { get_field_object('cave_entrance'), get_field_object('entrance_outside_2'),
						   get_field_object('house_entrance'), get_field_object('house_entrance'), self.get_lupina() }

	--projectile 설정
	local spec = CS.Oak.GameDataService.GetData('ProjectileData'):GetSpec('event_witch_coco_dark_hound')

	local pattern_Info = CS.Oak.ShootPatternInfo()
	pattern_Info.columns = 1
	pattern_Info.spreadDistance = 1
	pattern_Info.parallel = true

	-- ShootHelper 설정
	local ps = CS.Oak.LuaIProjectileShooter(self, self.get_lupina())
	self.shoot_helper = CS.Oak.ShootHelper(CS.Oak.Projectile.MoveType.Directional,
			ps, spec, pattern_Info, CS.Oak.ShootHelperShootEffectType.EachShootWithShootOffset)

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_red_ice')

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		self.controller:set_default_quest_marker()
	else
		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('nightmare_snowmountain_main', self.quest_spec.QuestId,
				self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, self.marker_target[1])
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	CS.Oak.UIQuestMarkersController.Instance:RemoveQuestMarker('nightmare_SnowMountain_main')

	if not is_unity_null(self.phone) then
		self.phone:ConsumeComplete()
		self.phone = nil
	end

	local lupina = self.get_lupina()
	if lupina ~= nil then
		lupina.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)
	end

	self.marker_target = nil
	self.shoot_helper = nil
	self.blizzard_state = nil
	self.section_progress = nil

	if self.ice_effect ~= nil then
		for i = 1, #self.ice_effect do
			self.ice_effect[i]:Dispose()
		end
		self.ice_effect = nil
	end
end

--region on event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_lupina()) and self.current_progress < self.section_progress.lupina_talk then
		self.current_progress = self.section_progress.lupina_talk
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.first_meet, self)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter == false then return false end
	if e.FieldObject ~= user_party_leader then return false end
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == 'section_2_blizzard_1' then
		-- 눈보라가 없을때만 눈보라가 친다
		if self.is_blizzard_active == self.blizzard_state.clear then
			self.is_blizzard_active = self.blizzard_state.normal
			self.controller:blizzard_play_sfx()
			self.controller:blizzard_start({alpha = 0.1})
			-- 눈보라가 강할땐 약하게 만든다
		elseif self.is_blizzard_active == self.blizzard_state.strong then
			self.is_blizzard_active = self.blizzard_state.normal
			--music_player_util.play_stage_music({state = 'field', mix = 2})
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.blizzard_weaker, self))
		end
	elseif zone_name == 'section_2_blizzard_2' then
		-- 이미 강한 눈보라일때는 무시
		if self.is_blizzard_active == self.blizzard_state.strong then
			return false
		-- 눈보라가 없을때 만들어서 친다.
		elseif self.is_blizzard_active == self.blizzard_state.clear then
			self.controller:blizzard_play_sfx()
			self.controller:blizzard_start({alpha = 0.1})
		end

		self.is_blizzard_active = self.blizzard_state.strong
		--music_player_util.play_stage_music({state = 'muted', mix = 2})
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.blizzard_stronger, self))

		if self.coco_warning == false then
			self.coco_warning = true
			music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_blizzard_02')
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.get_coco(), {key = 'nightmare_snowmountain_main_s2_1',
															   portraitname = self.coco_sprite_name})
		end

	elseif zone_name == 'section_2_no_blizzard' then
		-- 눈보라가 켜져있을때만 꺼준다
		if self.is_blizzard_active ~= self.blizzard_state.clear then
			self.is_blizzard_active = self.blizzard_state.clear
			self.controller:blizzard_fade_sfx(2)
			self:blizzard_remove()
		end

	elseif zone_name == 'section_2_blizzard_clear' then
		-- 눈보라가 켜져있을때만 꺼준다
		if self.is_blizzard_active ~= self.blizzard_state.clear then
			self.is_blizzard_active = self.blizzard_state.clear
			self.controller:blizzard_fade_sfx(2)
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.blizzard_clear, self))
		end

	--씬 진행
	elseif zone_name == 'section_2_before_cave_enter' and self.current_progress < self.section_progress.lupina_cave then
		self.current_progress = self.section_progress.lupina_cave
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.introduce_lupina, self)
	elseif zone_name == 'section_2_lupina_room' and self.current_progress < self.section_progress.lupina_room then
		self.current_progress = self.section_progress.lupina_room
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.real_lupina, self)
	end

	-- 마커처리
	for i = 1, 5 do
		if zone_name == 'section_2_marker_zone_' .. i then
			CS.Oak.UIQuestMarkersController.Instance:RemoveQuestMarker('nightmare_SnowMountain_main')

			ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('nightmare_snowmountain_main', self.quest_spec.QuestId,
					self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, self.marker_target[i])
		end
	end

	return false
end
--endregion

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
