--region blizzard
function local_class:blizzard_remove()
	stage.BuffManager:RemoveBuff(user_party_leader, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None,
			user_party_leader, 'speed_cap_persistent')
	self.controller:blizzard_dispose()
end

function local_class:blizzard_stronger()
 	--슬로우 디버프
	stage.BuffManager:AddBuff(user_party_leader, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None,
			user_party_leader, 'speed_cap_persistent', 0, false, false)

	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time;
	local blizzard_time = 1

	while self.is_blizzard_active == self.blizzard_state.strong and unity_class.time.time - cur_time < blizzard_time do
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Min((unity_class.time.time - cur_time) / blizzard_time, 1)

		self.controller:blizzard_update(progress, progress * 0.5)
		self.controller:blizzard_color_refresh()
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:blizzard_weaker()
	--디버프 해제
	stage.BuffManager:RemoveBuff(user_party_leader, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None,
			user_party_leader, 'speed_cap_persistent')

	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time;
	local blizzard_time = 1

	while self.is_blizzard_active == self.blizzard_state.normal and unity_class.time.time - cur_time < blizzard_time do

		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Max(1 - ((unity_class.time.time - cur_time) / blizzard_time), 0.1)

		self.controller:blizzard_update(progress, progress * 0.5)
		self.controller:blizzard_color_refresh()
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:blizzard_clear()
	--디버프 해제
	stage.BuffManager:RemoveBuff(user_party_leader, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None,
			user_party_leader, 'speed_cap_persistent')

	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time;
	local blizzard_time = 1

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < blizzard_time do

		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Max(1 - ((unity_class.time.time - cur_time) / blizzard_time), 0)

		self.controller:blizzard_update(progress, progress * 0.1)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self.controller:blizzard_dispose()
end
--endregion

-- 루피나가 폰을 던진후 그 폰이 서서히 사라질때 사용
function local_class:fade_sprite(sprite)
	local time_passed = 0
	local duration = 0.5

	local custom_sprite = sprite.SpriteTransform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
	local custom_alpha = 1

	local shadow_sprite = sprite.ShadowTransform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
	local shadow_alpha = shadow_sprite.Alpha

	while time_passed <= duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local alpha_progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01( 1 - (time_passed / duration))
		local custom_progress = custom_alpha * alpha_progress
		local shadow_progress = shadow_alpha * alpha_progress

		custom_sprite.TintColor = unity_color({custom_progress, custom_progress, custom_progress, custom_progress})
		shadow_sprite.TintColor = unity_color({0, 0, 0, shadow_progress})

		custom_sprite:Rebuild()
		shadow_sprite:Rebuild()

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	sprite:ConsumeComplete()
end

function local_class:blizzard_weaker()

			user_party_leader, 'speed_cap_persistent')

		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Max(1 - ((unity_class.time.time - cur_time) / blizzard_time), 0.0)

		self.controller:blizzard_update(progress, progress * 0.5)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self.controller:blizzard_dispose()

local local_class = newclass('NightmareSnowMountainMainSection4')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = NightmareSnowMountainMain @
		Comment = 얼어붙은 코코 앞에서 왕자와 재회. @
		Index = 3 @
		NextSections = 4 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	self.stage_name = 'nightmare_snowmountain_2'

	--npc 찾기
	self.get_prince = function()
		return get_character('prince')
	end

	self.is_oneline_active = {false, false, false, false, false, false}

	-- 왕자의 혼잣말
	self.prince_mumble = false
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return true
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')

	self:set_environment()

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		self.controller:set_default_quest_marker()
	else
		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('nightmare_snowmountain_main', self.quest_spec.QuestId,
				self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, self:get_prince())
	end

end

function local_class:exit()
	CS.Oak.UIQuestMarkersController.Instance:RemoveQuestMarker('nightmare_SnowMountain_main')

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

	local prince = self:get_prince()
	if prince ~= nil then
		prince.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)
	end

	self.is_oneline_active = nil
end

--region on event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self:get_prince()) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.meet_prince, self)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	--if e.FullEnter == false then return false end
	if e.FieldObject ~= user_party_leader then return false end
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	for i = 1, 6 do
		if zone_name == 's4_oneline_' .. i and self.is_oneline_active[i] == false then
			self.is_oneline_active[i] = true
			local crowd = get_character('s3_snowman_' .. i)
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(crowd, {key = 'nightmare_snowmountain_main_s4_oneline_' .. i})
		end
	end

	if zone_name == 's4_prince_mumble' and self.prince_mumble == false then
		self.prince_mumble = true
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.prince_mumbling, self))
	end

	return false
end
--endregion

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:set_environment()
	local ice_coco = get_character('coco_iced')
	local prince = self:get_prince()

	character_util.set_position(ice_coco, field:GetMarker('ice_coco').position)

	character_util.set_position(prince, field:GetMarker('s4_prince').position)
	character_util.set_emotion(prince, {name = 'tired'})
	character_util.set_direction(prince, 'up')
	prince.Interactable:AddListener(self.controller.cs_controller)

	local crowds = {}
	for i = 1, 6 do
		local crowd = get_character('s3_snowman_' .. i)
		local marker_pos = field:GetMarker('s4_oneline_' .. i).position
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(crowd)
		character_util.set_position(crowd, marker_pos)
		character_util.look_at(crowd, ice_coco)
		crowd.Interactable.Talk = 'nightmare_snowmountain_main_s4_oneline_' .. i
		crowds[i] = crowd
	end

	table.insert(crowds, prince)
	table.insert(crowds, ice_coco)
	self.controller:activate_characters(crowds)
end

function local_class:meet_prince()
	local prince = self:get_prince()
	local leader = user_party_leader

	self.prince_mumble = false
	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(prince)

	party_util.align_to_target(prince, 'left')

	character_util.set_direction(prince, 'left')
	character_util.set_emotion(prince, {name = 'surprise'})
	character_util.normal_jump_async(prince, '01_jump_01')
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(prince, {key = 'nightmare_snowmountain_main_s4_1', skip = true})
	--자네는…?!

		return true
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_battle_group_eliminated_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')

	screen_util.preload_boss_title()

function local_class:start()

function local_class:on_event(e)

	return false
end

		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.prince_surprise, self)
	end

end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)

	if e.FieldObject ~= user_party_leader then return false end
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == 's5_battle_clone' and self.boss_zone_enter == false then
		self.boss_zone_enter = true
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.before_boss, self)

	character_util.set_position(clone, field:GetMarker('s5_clone').position)

	character_util.set_direction(clone, 'left')

function local_class:before_boss()

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_boss_intro', state = 'event', mix = 2 })

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	for i = 1, 4 do
		character_util.set_anim(crowds[i], {name = 'bomb_idle'})
	end

	--wait_for_sec(0.5)

local local_class = newclass('NightmareSnowMountainMainSection7')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = NightmareSnowMountainMain @
		Comment = 결국 밤에 몰래 코코를 풀어주는 왕자 @
		Index = 6 @
		NextSections = 7 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	self.stage_4_name = 'nightmare_snowmountain_4'
	self.stage_5_name = 'nightmare_snowmountain_5'

	self.get_coco = controller.get_coco
	self.get_lupina = controller.get_lupina

	self.coco_sprite_name = 'innuit.png'
	self.lupina_sprite_name = 'witch_coco.png'

	-- 4스테이지 괴롭힘 당한 씬을 보았는지
	self.saw_poor_event = false
	-- 4스테이지 모반자 이벤트 봤는지
	self.saw_reactionary_event = false

	-- 돌팔매질을 할것인지
	self.throwing_rock = false

	self.get_prince = function()
		return get_character('prince')
	end

	self.red_ice = nil
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_4_name and stage.Name ~= self.stage_5_name then
		return true
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')

	self:set_environment()
	screen_util.preload_boss_title()
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_levelup_new')

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_5_name then
		self.controller:set_default_quest_marker()
	else
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.prince_melting, self)
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

	CS.Oak.UIQuestMarkersController.Instance:RemoveQuestMarker('nightmare_snowmountain_main')

	local prince = self:get_prince()
	if prince ~= nil then
		prince.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)
	end

	if self.red_ice ~= nil then
		self.red_ice:Dispose()
	end
end

--region on event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self:get_prince()) then
		if stage.Name == self.stage_4_name then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.raise_up, self)
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter == false then return false end
	if e.FieldObject ~= user_party_leader then return false end
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if stage.Name == self.stage_4_name then
		if zone_name == 's6_poor_snowman' and self.saw_poor_event == false then
			self.saw_poor_event = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.poor_snowman, self))
		elseif zone_name == 's6_reactionary' and self.saw_reactionary_event == false then
			self.saw_reactionary_event = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.reactionary, self))
		end
	end

	return false
end
--endregion

function local_class:set_environment()
	local prince = self:get_prince()
	prince.Interactable:AddListener(self.controller.cs_controller)

	if stage.Name == self.stage_4_name then
		local son = get_character('s6_fixer_son')

		character_util.set_active_state(son, 'enabled')
		son.gameObject:SetActive(true)

		character_util.set_position(son, field:GetMarker(son.Name).position)
		character_util.set_direction(son, 'down')
		character_util.set_emotion(son, {name = 'damaged'})
		character_util.shake(son, 0.04, 999)

		for i = 1, 4 do
			local innuit = get_character('s6_innuit_kid_' .. i)
			character_util.set_active_state(innuit, 'enabled')
			innuit.gameObject:SetActive(true)

			character_util.set_position(innuit, field:GetMarker(innuit.Name).position)
			character_util.look_at(innuit, son)
			character_util.set_emotion(innuit, {name = 'attack'})
		end

		for i = 1, 3 do
			local reactionary = get_character('s6_snowman_reactionary_' .. i)
			local marker = field:GetMarker(reactionary.Name)

			character_util.set_active_state(reactionary, 'enabled')
			reactionary.gameObject:SetActive(true)

			character_util.set_position(reactionary, marker.position)
			character_util.set_direction(reactionary, marker.direction)

			field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(reactionary, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)

			--reactionary.Interactable.Talk = 'nightmare_snowmountain_main_s6_' .. i + 21
			--nightmare_snowmountain_main_s6_22, 23, 24

			--모르겠어?! 가스트 장군을 찌른 창도, 붉은 얼음 창이었잖아! 녹았을 거라고!
			--호오… 그렇다면 쉬버링 산맥을 다시 설인 중심으로 만들 수 있겠어!
			--가스트 장군을 찾아서 왕자만 처치하면…!!
		end

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	self.get_coco = controller.get_coco
	self.get_lupina = controller.get_lupina

	self.coco_sprite_name = 'innuit.png'
	self.lupina_sprite_name = 'witch_coco.png'

	self.saw_judge = false

	self.get_prince = function()
		return get_character('prince')
	end

	self.red_ices = nil

	self.shoot_helper = nil
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return true
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DyingEndEvent), 'on_dying_end_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_battle_group_eliminated_event')

	self:set_environment()
	screen_util.preload_boss_title()
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_red_ice')
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_lasthit')
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit')

	--projectile 설정
	local spec = CS.Oak.GameDataService.GetData('ProjectileData'):GetSpec('red_ice')

	local pattern_Info = CS.Oak.ShootPatternInfo()
	pattern_Info.columns = 1
	pattern_Info.spreadDistance = 1
	pattern_Info.parallel = true

	-- ShootHelper 설정
	local ps = CS.Oak.LuaIProjectileShooter(self, self.get_coco())
	self.shoot_helper = CS.Oak.ShootHelper(CS.Oak.Projectile.MoveType.Directional,
			ps, spec, pattern_Info, CS.Oak.ShootHelperShootEffectType.EachShootWithShootOffset)

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		self.controller:set_default_quest_marker()
	else
		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint('nightmare_snowmountain_main', self.quest_spec.QuestId,
				self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, field:GetMarker('s7_quest_marker_1').position)
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DyingEndEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))

	CS.Oak.UIQuestMarkersController.Instance:RemoveQuestMarker('nightmare_snowmountain_main')

	local prince = self:get_prince()
	if prince ~= nil then
		prince.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)
	end

	if self.red_ices ~= nil then
		for i = 1, #self.red_ices do
			self.red_ices[i]:Dispose()
		end

		self.red_ices = nil
	end

	self.shoot_helper = nil
end

--region on event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self:get_prince()) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.before_fight, self)
		--sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.after_fight, self)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter == false then return false end
	if e.FieldObject ~= user_party_leader then return false end
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == 's7_judgement' and self.saw_judge == false then
		self.saw_judge = true
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.judgement, self)
	end

	local marker_target = {get_field_object('cave_entrance_1'), get_field_object('cave_exit_1'), self:get_prince()}
	for i = 1, 3 do
		if zone_name == 'main_quest_marker_zone_' .. i then
			CS.Oak.UIQuestMarkersController.Instance:RemoveQuestMarker('nightmare_snowmountain_main')

			ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('nightmare_snowmountain_main', self.quest_spec.QuestId,
					self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, marker_target[i])
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_dying_end_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.character, get_character('boss')) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.after_fight, self)
	end
end

	if e.BattleGroupName == 'boss' then

	end

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(ice_bar)
		character_util.set_emotion(ice_bar, {name = 'attack'})

		character_util.set_direction(ice_bar, 'up')

	end

	camera_util.move(prince.Position + vector(0, 0, -2), 1)

	party_util.set_emotion({name = 'attack'})
	party_util.align_to_target(prince.Position + vector(0, 0, -4), 'up', 1, 'arc')

	for i = 6, 11 do
		local x = 0
		local z = 0
		local dir = ''

		if i < 9 then
			x = ice_bars[1].Position.x - 2
			z = (4 - (i - 5)) * 1.5
			dir = 'right'
		else
			x = ice_bars[5].Position.x + 2
			z = (i - 8) * 1.5
			dir = 'left'
		end

		character_util.move_waypoint(ice_bars[i], {vector(x, 2, ice_bars[i].Position.z),
												   vector(x, 2, ice_bars[i].Position.z + z + 1)}, 4, false, nil, nil, dir)

	general.Position = prince.Position

	local up_duration = 0.35
	local up_height = 3
	local white_duration = 0.5

	--local camera_orig_pos = stage_camera.LookAtPosition
	camera_util.move(stage_camera.LookAtPosition + vector(0, up_height, 0), up_duration)
	wait_for_sec(up_duration)

	local free_fall = CS.CalculatorFreeFall(0, 80, 10, 0)

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 2 })
	screen_util.fade_out(white_duration, unity_class.color.white, linear)

	local time_passed = 0
	while time_passed < white_duration do
		local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime
		time_passed = time_passed + dt
		free_fall:Proceed(dt)
		general.SpineController.SpineOffset = vector(0, free_fall:GetDistance(), 0)
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	character_util.set_anim(general, { name = 'monster_idle', loop = true })

	general.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Down
	general.SpineController.SpineOffset = vector(0, 0, 0)

	character_util.set_emotion(prince, { name = 'damaged', loop = false })

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		local party_member = user_party[i]
		character_util.set_direction(party_member, 'left')
		character_util.set_anim(party_member, { name = 'prostrate', loop = false })
		character_util.set_emotion(party_member, { name = 'damaged', loop = false })
		character_util.shake(party_member, 0.04, 9999)
	end

	for i = 1, 5 do
		character_util.set_position(ice_bars[i], ice_bars[i].Position + vector(0, 0, -2))
		character_util.set_anim(ice_bars[i], {name = 'bomb_idle'})

		character_util.set_position(ice_bars[i], vector(999, 0, 999))

	general.SpineController:RemoveColor('general_black', 1)

	character_util.set_anim(general, { name = 'monster_idle', loop = true })

	character_util.set_direction(general, 'left')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(general, { key = 'nightmare_snowmountain_main_s7_14',
														   skip = 'true', offset = vector(2.3, 2.35, 1.7) })
	--오랜만이군, 왕자.

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_player_popup_01')
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		local party_member = user_party[i]
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(party_member)
		character_util.stop_shake(party_member)
		character_util.set_direction(party_member, 'up')
		character_util.mario_jump_new(party_member, 'left')
	end

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(general, { key = 'nightmare_snowmountain_main_s7_15',
														   skip = 'true', offset = vector(2.3, 2.35, 1.7) })
	--어때, 내가 보고 싶었나?

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(general, { key = 'nightmare_snowmountain_main_s7_15_1',
														   skip = 'true', offset = vector(2.3, 2.35, 1.7) })
	--고맙게도 붉은 얼음을 녹여주었어.

	camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.5)
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_count_final_01')
	character_util.set_anim(general, {name = 'monster_piercedash', loop = false, scale = 0.7})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(general, { key = 'nightmare_snowmountain_main_s7_15_2',
														   skip = 'true', offset = vector(2.3, 2.35, 1.7), bubble_type = 'shout' })
	--내 등에 박혔던 창도 함께 말이지!
	character_util.set_anim(general, { name = 'monster_idle', loop = true })

	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	character_util.set_direction(general, 'down')

	screen_util.show_boss_title('nightmare_general_boss_title', 'nightmare_general_boss_subtitle', 2)

	wait_for_sec(1)

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_heavy_slash_01')
	character_util.set_anim(general, {name = 'monster_pierce', loop = false, remove_after = 1})

	wait_for_sec(1)

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)

	character_util.convert_to_monster(general, 'boss', 'boss')
	character_util.set_death_type(general, 'bossexplosion')
	command_util.execute_cmd(CS.Oak.MonsterNoticeCommand.Create(general,
			leader, CS.Oak.MonsterNoticeLevel.Battle))

	-- bgm_transition: Event -> Combat(bgm_battle_boss)
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_battle_boss', state = 'combat' })
end

function local_class:after_fight()
	-- bgm_transition: Muted -> Event(bgm_shivermore_suspense)
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_boss_intro', state = 'event' })

	local prince = self:get_prince()
	local leader = user_party_leader

	local coco = self.get_coco()
	coco.SpineController:AddColor('coco_black', unity_class.color.black, 1, 0)

	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	---test
	--prince.Position = prince.Position + vector(-4, 0, 0)
	--prince.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right
	--prince.OverrideCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
	---test

	character_util.remove_anim(prince)
	character_util.set_emotion(prince, { name = 'tired' })
	character_util.stop_shake(prince)

	local marker = field:GetMarker('s7_prince_2')

	local ice_bars = {}
	for i = 1, 8 do
		local ice_bar = get_character('s7_snowman_' .. i)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(ice_bar)
		character_util.set_emotion(ice_bar, {name = 'attack'})

		local offset = 1.5

		if i < 5 then
			character_util.set_position(ice_bar,
					marker.position + vector(2, 0, (i - 2) * offset - offset / 2))
		else
			character_util.set_position(ice_bar,
					marker.position + vector(4, 0, (i - 2 - 4) * offset - offset / 2))
		end

		character_util.set_direction(ice_bar, 'left')

		ice_bars[i] = ice_bar
	end

	camera_util.move(marker.position + vector(0, 0 , 1), 0)
	party_util.align_to_target(prince.Position + vector(3, 0, 0), 'left', 1, 'arc')

	local prince_party = {}

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		local member = user_party[i]
		character_util.set_emotion(member, {name = 'attack'})
		prince_party[i + 1] = member
	end

	table.insert(prince_party, prince)

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(ice_bars[5], { key = 'nightmare_snowmountain_main_s7_16', skip = 'true' })
	--진짜… 끈질기게…

	character_util.set_anim(ice_bars[3], {name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(ice_bars[3], { key = 'nightmare_snowmountain_main_s7_16_1', skip = 'true' })
	--이렇게 된 거, 우리 손으로 끝내자고!
	character_util.remove_anim(ice_bars[3])

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	for i = 1, #prince_party do
		local member = prince_party[i]
		character_util.set_locked_dir(member, 'right')
		character_util.set_emotion(member, {name = 'tired'})
		character_util.move_waypoint(member, member.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0), 1, false, nil, nil, 'right')
	end

	for i = 1, #ice_bars do
		local member = ice_bars[i]
		character_util.move_waypoint(member, member.Position + vector(-1.5, 0, 0), 1.5, false)
	end

	camera_util.move(marker.position + vector(-1, 0 , 1), 1)

	character_util.set_position(coco, prince.Position + vector(-3, 8, 2))
	character_util.set_direction(coco, 'right')

	wait_for_sec(0.4)

	self.red_ices = {}

	local target_pos = leader.Position + vector(2.5, 0, 0)

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.ice_shoot, self, target_pos + vector(0, 0, 2)))
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	for i = 1, #prince_party do
		local member = prince_party[i]
		character_util.set_emotion(member, {name = 'surprise'})
	end

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_crowd_shout_05')

	for i = 1, #ice_bars do
		local member = ice_bars[i]
		character_util.set_locked_dir(member, 'left')
		character_util.set_emotion(member, {name = 'surprise'})
		character_util.normal_jump(member)
	end

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.ice_shoot, self, target_pos + vector(0, 0, 1)))
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.ice_shoot, self, target_pos + vector(0, 0, 0)))
	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	for i = 1, #ice_bars do
		local member = ice_bars[i]
		character_util.move_waypoint(member, member.Position + vector(1, 0, 0), 1, false, nil, nil, 'left')
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.ice_shoot, self, target_pos + vector(0, 0, -1)))
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.ice_shoot, self, target_pos + vector(0, 0, -2)))

	wait_for_sec(1)

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_runaway_01')
	for i = 1, #ice_bars do
		local member = ice_bars[i]
		character_util.shake(member, 0.05, 999)
	end

	wait_for_sec(1)

	character_util.set_position(coco, prince.Position + vector(-10, 0, 0))

	for i = 1, #prince_party do
		local member = prince_party[i]
		character_util.set_locked_dir(member, 'none')
		character_util.set_emotion(member, {name = 'smile'})
	end

	for i = 1, #ice_bars do
		local member = ice_bars[i]
		character_util.set_locked_dir(member, 'none')
	end

	character_util.set_anim(coco, {name = 'run'})

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_twohand_stomp_jump_01')
	character_util.jump_move(coco, leader.Position + vector(1.5, 0, 0), 8, 5)
	character_util.remove_anim(coco)

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_mech_stomp_01')

	camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.3)

	character_util.set_emotion(coco, {name = 'attack'})
	coco.SpineController:RemoveColor('coco_black', 1)

	wait_for_sec(1)

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(ice_bars[1], { key = 'nightmare_snowmountain_main_s7_17', skip = 'true' })
	--마녀… 풀려난 마녀가 왔다!

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(ice_bars[4], { key = 'nightmare_snowmountain_main_s7_18', skip = 'true' })
	--우… 우릴 전부 죽일 거야!

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(ice_bars[3], { key = 'nightmare_snowmountain_main_s7_19', skip = 'true' })
	--저 마녀 잡아! 이렇게 질 수는 없다고!

	character_util.set_direction(coco, 'up')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_rustle_01')

		Type = progress @
		QuestName = NightmareSnowMountainMain @
		Comment = 설산을 떠나는 코코일행 @
		Index = 8 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	self.stage_name = 'nightmare_snowmountain_6'

	self.get_coco = controller.get_coco
	self.get_lupina = controller.get_lupina

	self.coco_sprite_name = 'innuit.png'
	self.lupina_sprite_name = 'witch_coco.png'

	self.get_prince = function()
		return get_character('prince')
	end

	self.saw_ending = false

	self.is_activate_blizzard = false
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return true
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	self:set_environment()

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		self.controller:set_default_quest_marker()
	else
		if self.controller.starting_inner_progress < 8 then
			ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('nightmare_snowmountain_main', self.quest_spec.QuestId,
					self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, self.get_coco())
		else
			ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('nightmare_snowmountain_main', self.quest_spec.QuestId,
					self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, get_field_object('cave_entrance_1'))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	CS.Oak.UIQuestMarkersController.Instance:RemoveQuestMarker('nightmare_snowmountain_main')
	self.controller:blizzard_dispose()
	self.controller:blizzard_fade_sfx(0)
end

--region on event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter == false then return false end
	if e.FieldObject ~= user_party_leader then return false end
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == 's8_blizzard' and self.is_activate_blizzard == false then
		self.is_activate_blizzard = true
		self.controller:blizzard_play_sfx()
		self.controller:blizzard_start({alpha = 0.1})
	elseif zone_name == 's8_no_blizzard' and self.is_activate_blizzard == true then
		self.is_activate_blizzard = false
		self.controller:blizzard_fade_sfx(2)
		self.controller:blizzard_dispose()
	elseif zone_name == 's8_ending' and self.saw_ending == false then
		self.saw_ending = true
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.ending, self)
	end

	local marker_target = {get_field_object('cave_entrance_1'), get_field_object('cave_exit_1'), self.get_coco()}
	for i = 1, 3 do
		if zone_name == 'main_quest_marker_zone_' .. i then
			CS.Oak.UIQuestMarkersController.Instance:RemoveQuestMarker('nightmare_snowmountain_main')

			ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('nightmare_snowmountain_main', self.quest_spec.QuestId,
					self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, marker_target[i])
		end
	end

	return false
end

	self.preset.blizzard_fade = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate("FX_Screen_Blizzard_Cloud")

	-- stage 진행 중 생성할 경우 끊기는 현상이 발생해, 미리 생성

function local_class:start()
end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))

	self.blizzard = nil
	self.fade.gradient = nil
	self.fade = nil

	for key in pairs(self.preset) do
		self.preset[key] = nil
	end

function local_class:dispose()

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		return self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent) then
		return self:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then
			if e.Zone.Name == 'blizzard_zone' then
				self.is_in_blizzard_zone = true
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.turn_on_blizzard, self, 0.2))
				return true
			elseif e.Zone.Name == 'obelisk_after_zone' and not self.played_event then
				self.played_event = true
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.start_event, self))
				return true
			end
		end
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if e.FullLeave then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then
			if e.Zone.Name == 'blizzard_zone' then
				self.is_in_blizzard_zone = false
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.turn_off_blizzard, self, true))
				return true
			end
		end
	end
	return false
end

-- 눈보라 효과
function local_class:turn_on_blizzard(value)
	while self.is_blizzard_changing do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
	if not self.is_blizzard_active and self.is_in_blizzard_zone then
		self.is_blizzard_changing = true
		-- flag set
		self.is_blizzard_active = true

		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 2 })
		-- blizzard start
		self:blizzard_start()

		---[[
		stage.BuffManager:AddBuff(user_party.Leader, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None,
				user_party.Leader, self.blizzard_buff, 0, false, false)
				--]]

		self.blizzard_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
			sfx_name = '01_blizzard_01', loop = true, fade_in_time = 2, type_priority = "event", player_priority = "player"
		})
		local fade_time = 0.3
		local cur_time = unity_class.time.time

		local mult = lua_helper.get_or_default(value, 0.4)

		-- blizzard update
		while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < fade_time do
			local progress = unity_class.mathf.Max((unity_class.time.time - cur_time) / fade_time, 0) * mult

			self:blizzard_update(progress)

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		self.is_blizzard_changing = false
	end
end

function local_class:turn_off_blizzard(force)
	while self.is_blizzard_changing do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
	local cond = not self.is_in_blizzard_zone
	if force then
		cond = true
	end
	if self.is_blizzard_active and cond then
		self.is_blizzard_changing = true
		-- flag set
		self.is_blizzard_active = false

		music_player_util.play_stage_music( { state = 'field', mix = 2})
		-- blizzard inner param refresh
		self:blizzard_color_refresh()

		stage.BuffManager:RemoveBuff(user_party_leader, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None, user_party_leader, self.blizzard_buff)

		local fade_time = 0.4
		if force then
			fade_time = 1
		end

		local wait_time = fade_time + 1.5
		--local remove_buff_time = 1.5
		local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
		--local remove_buff = false

		self.blizzard_sfx:FadeOut(2)

		-- blizzard update
		while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < wait_time do
			local progress = unity_class.mathf.Max(1 - (unity_class.time.time - cur_time) / fade_time, 0) * 0.4

			self:blizzard_update(progress)

			coroutine.yield(nil)

			if unity_class.time.time - cur_time > fade_time and self.is_in_lupina_zone and not force then
				break
			end
		end

		-- blizzard dispose
		self:blizzard_dispose()
		self.is_blizzard_changing = false
	end
end

-- blizzard 이펙트 셋업
function local_class:blizzard_start(args)
	if self.blizzard == nil or self.fade == nil then return end
	if self.blizzard.obj ~= nil or self.fade.obj ~= nil then return end

	local with_fade = lua_helper.get_value(args, 'with_fade', true)
	local alpha = lua_helper.get_value(args, 'alpha', -1)
	local custom_alpha = false

	if not float_util.almost_close_to(alpha, -1) then
		custom_alpha = true
	end

	local camera = stage_camera

	self.blizzard.obj = self.preset.blizzard:Instantiate(
			camera.Transform.position + vector(0, 5, 10), unity_class.quaternion.identity, camera.Transform)
	self.blizzard.material = self.blizzard.obj.transform:GetComponentInChildren(
			typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Renderer)).material

	self.blizzard.color = self.blizzard.material:GetColor(self.property_name)

	local target_alpha = custom_alpha and alpha or self.blizzard.color.a * 0.2

	self.blizzard.material:SetColor(self.property_name, unity_color(
			{ self.blizzard.color.r, self.blizzard.color.g, self.blizzard.color.b, target_alpha }))

	if with_fade then
		self.fade.obj = self.preset.blizzard_fade:Instantiate(
				camera.Transform.position, unity_class.quaternion.identity, camera.Transform)
		self.fade.main_module = self.fade.obj.transform:GetComponentInChildren(
				typeof(CS.UnityEngine.ParticleSystem)).main
		self.fade.color = self.fade.main_module.startColor.color

		target_alpha = custom_alpha and alpha or self.fade.color.a * 0.2

		self.fade.gradient.color = unity_color(
				{ self.fade.color.r, self.fade.color.g, self.fade.color.b, target_alpha })

		self.fade.main_module.startColor = self.fade.gradient
		self.fade.color = self.fade.main_module.startColor.color
	end
end

function local_class:blizzard_lerp(from, to, duration)

	self.is_blizzard_changing = true
	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local tint = from

	-- blizzard update
	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < duration do
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Max((unity_class.time.time - cur_time) / duration, 0)
		tint = from + (to - from) * progress

		self:blizzard_update(tint)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
	self.is_blizzard_changing = false
end

function local_class:blizzard_update(alpha, fade_alpha)
	if fade_alpha == nil then
		fade_alpha = alpha
	end

	self.blizzard.material:SetColor(self.property_name, unity_color(
			{ self.blizzard.color.r, self.blizzard.color.g, self.blizzard.color.b, alpha }))

	if self.fade.obj ~= nil then
		self.fade.gradient.color = unity_color(
				{ self.fade.color.r, self.fade.color.g, self.fade.color.b, fade_alpha })

		self.fade.main_module.startColor = self.fade.gradient
	end
end

function local_class:blizzard_fade_max()
	if self.fade.obj == nil then return end

	self.fade.gradient.color = unity_color({ self.fade.color.r, self.fade.color.g, self.fade.color.b, 1 })

	self.fade.main_module.startColor = self.fade.gradient
end

function local_class:blizzard_color_refresh()
	self.blizzard.color = self.blizzard.material:GetColor(self.property_name)

	if self.fade.obj ~= nil then
		self.fade.color = self.fade.main_module.startColor.color
	end
end

-- 눈보라 관련 이펙트 dispose
function local_class:blizzard_dispose()
	if self.blizzard.obj ~= nil then
		self.blizzard.material = nil
		self.blizzard.color = nil
		self.blizzard.obj:Dispose()
		self.blizzard.obj = nil
	end

	if self.fade.obj ~= nil then
		self.fade.main_module = nil
		self.fade.color = nil
		self.fade.obj:Dispose()
		self.fade.obj = nil
	end
end

return local_class

local local_class = newclass('NightmareSnowmountainPenguinSection1')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = NightmareSnowmountainPenguin @
		Comment = 악몽 설산 5스테이지 남극대탐험 @
		Index = 0 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress


	self.talk_name = 'nightmare_snowmountain_penguin_race_'
	self.quest_marker_name = 'penguin_racing_snowmountain'
	self.time_scale_key = 'snowmountain_penguin_race'

	self.playable_state = true

	-- 펭귄 관련 페러미터
	self.penguin_run_speed = 5.5
	self.penguin_running = false
	self.penguin_jumping = false
	self.penguin_jump_call = false

	-- 플레이어 관련 페러미터
	self.run_speed = 7
	self.slow_mult_const = 4 / 7
	self.slow_mult = 1
	self.slow_duration = 1
	self.slow_timer = -1
	self.y_collision_threshold = 0.1
	self.over_hole = false
	self.is_running = false
	self.is_jumping = false
	self.is_falling = false
	self.is_cleared = false

end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.GotCrashedEvent), 'on_event')

	CS.Oak.QuestIcon.PreLoad()
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.PreloadActivityClear()
	self.fx_water = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_common_water_splash_in')
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit')

	self.controller:race_setting()

	local seal = get_character('sealeopard')
	seal.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if self.controller.starting_inner_progress < 0 then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.race_routine, self))
	else
		local penguin = get_character('penguin_racer')
		quest_icon.SetQuestNotice(penguin)
		character_util.add_listener(penguin, self.controller)
		get_character('penguin_sub_1').Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
		get_character('penguin_sub_2').Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
	end

end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.GotCrashedEvent))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local penguin = get_character('penguin_racer')
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.TouchEvent) and self.is_running then
		-- 대쉬 터치시 점프
		if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.Action1TouchDown then
			self.is_jumping = true
			return true
		end
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, penguin) then
			character_util.remove_relate_event(penguin, self.controller)
			if self.is_cleared then
				-- 플레이어 승리시
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.win_race, self)
			else
				if self.playable_state then
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.retry_race, self))
				else
					ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.quest_marker_name)
					quest_icon.RemoveIcon(penguin)
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.lose_race, self))
				end
			end
			return true
		end
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent) then
		if not e.FullLeave and e.Zone.Name == 'floor_hole' and e.FieldObject == user_party_leader then
			self.over_hole = false
		end
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		if e.FullEnter and e.Zone.Name == 'floor_hole' and e.FieldObject == user_party_leader then
			self.over_hole = true
		end
		if not e.FullEnter and e.Zone.Name == 'penguin_jump' and e.FieldObject == penguin and not self.penguin_jump_call then
			self.penguin_jump_call = true
		end
		if e.FullEnter and e.Zone.Name == 'penguin_race_end' then
			if e.FieldObject == penguin and self.penguin_running then
				-- 펭귄이 결승점에 도달함
				self.penguin_running = false
				if self.is_cleared then
					-- 플레이어 승리시 펭귄 리액션
					character_util.set_emotion(penguin, {name = 'tired'})
				else
					-- 플레이어 패배시 펭귄 리액션
					self.playable_state = false
					character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(penguin, {name = 'victory_get', loop = false}, {name = 'smile'})
				end
			end
			if e.FieldObject == user_party_leader then
				-- 플레이어가 결승점에 도달함
				if self.is_running and self.penguin_running then
					-- 펭귄이 아직 달리는 중이므로, 플레이어가 먼저 들어온 것이 된다.
					self.is_cleared = true
					CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowActivityClear()
				end
				self.is_running = false
			end
		end
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:race_routine()
	stage.FieldUIManager:Hide()
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 2.0 })
	screen_util.fade_out_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	self.controller:race_start_setting()

	local marker = field:GetMarker('player_race_start')
	local penguin_marker = field:GetMarker('penguin_race_start')
	local penguin = get_character('penguin_racer')

	party_util.align_party(marker.position + vector(1, 0, 0), 'left', 0, 'linear')
	penguin.Position = penguin_marker.position
	character_util.set_direction(penguin, 'right')


	wait_for_sec(1)
	screen_util.fade_in_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(penguin, {key = self.talk_name .. 1, skip = true})

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(penguin, {key = self.talk_name .. 2, skip = true})

	user_party:ResetControllers()

	local manual_touch_state = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState.Create(user_party.Leader, false)
	manual_touch_state:DisableControls(CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Dash | CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Attack |
			CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Super | CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Hold | CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Assassination)

	local state_change_event = CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(manual_touch_state)
	message_system:SendSync(user_party.Leader.FieldObjectController, state_change_event)

	coroutine.yield(nil)
	coroutine.yield(nil)
	field_ui_manager:Show()

	--6성 리더 스킬 버튼 추가에 따른, 필요한 UI만 출력하도록 수정.
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	field_ui_util.show_target_ui({
		show_target = field_ui_type.action_button | field_ui_type.party_state,
		show_navigation_bar = true,
		show_minimap = true,
	})

	self.is_running = true

	character_util.set_anim(user_party_leader, {name = 'run'})

	local vertical_speed = 8
	local gravity = 16
	local y_calculator = CS.CalculatorFreeFall.Create(vertical_speed, gravity, 0, 0)
	self.slow_timer = -1

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_whistle_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_slide_01')
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({name = 'bgm_penguin', state = 'event', mix = 0})
	--music_player_util.play_stage_music({name = 'bgm_lana', state = 'event', mix = 0})
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.penguin_routine, self))
	while self.is_running do

		-- 이동
		CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameStageLogic.ExecuteMove(user_party_leader, vector(1, 0, 0), 7 * self.slow_mult * unity_class.time.deltaTime)

		-- 플레이어 점프 관련 코드
		if self.is_jumping then

			if y_calculator:GetProgress() == 0 then
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_jump_01')
				y_calculator = CS.CalculatorFreeFall(vertical_speed, gravity, 0, 0)
				y_calculator:Proceed(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
				user_party_leader.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(user_party_leader.Position, y_calculator:GetDistance())
				character_util.set_anim(user_party_leader, {name = 'get'})
				user_party_leader.OverrideCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance

			elseif y_calculator:GetProgress() == 1 then
				self.is_jumping = false
				y_calculator = CS.CalculatorFreeFall(vertical_speed, gravity, 0, 0)
				user_party_leader.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(user_party_leader.Position, 0)
				character_util.set_anim(user_party_leader, {name = 'run'})
				user_party_leader.OverrideCrashBehaviour = nil

			else
				y_calculator:Proceed(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
				user_party_leader.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(user_party_leader.Position, y_calculator:GetDistance())
			end
		else
			-- 플레이어가 점프중이 아니라면, 충돌 가능한 상태로 판정한다.
			self:update_dash_state(user_party_leader, vector(0.5, 0, 0))
		end

		-- 구덩이 판정 범위 내에서 점프중인 상태가 아니면 구덩이에 빠진 것으로 판정한다.
		if self.over_hole and not self.is_jumping then
			self.is_running = false
			self.is_falling = true
			self.is_jumping = false
			self.penguin_running = false
			self.penguin_jumping = false
			self.over_hole = false
		end

		-- 둔화 관련 계수 적용 코드
		-- 음수 : 타이머 비활성화 / 이외 : 타이머 활성화
		if self.slow_timer >= 0 then
			if self.slow_timer < self.slow_duration then
				-- 둔화 타이머가 도는 동안 둔화 계수 적용
				self.slow_timer = self.slow_timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime
				self.slow_mult = self.slow_mult_const
			elseif not self.is_jumping then
				-- 둔화 타이머가 만료되면 둔화 계수 초기화 및 타이머 비활성화
				character_util.remove_emotion(user_party_leader)
				self.slow_timer = -1
				self.slow_mult = 1
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
	-- 어떤 이유에서든 경주가 종료되면 둔화 계수 및 타이머, 충돌 판정 초기화
	self.slow_timer = -1
	self.slow_mult = 1
	user_party_leader.OverrideCrashBehaviour = nil

	y_calculator:Dispose()

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({name = 'bgm_shivermore_main', state = 'event', mix = 2})
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party_leader)

	-- 구덩이에 빠지는 연출
	if self.is_falling then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.falling_routine, self)
	else
		-- 레이스를 완주하여 파티원과 합류함.
		local end_point = field:GetMarker('seal_point')
		stage.FieldUIManager:Hide()
		user_party:StopAndDisableControl()
		self.controller:race_end_setting()
		party_util.align_party(end_point.position + vector(-3.5, 0, -2), 'left', 1, 'linear')
		party_util.reset_controllers()
		field_ui_manager:Show()
	end
end

function local_class:penguin_routine()
	local penguin = get_character('penguin_racer')
	character_util.set_anim(penguin, {name = 'run'})

	local vertical_speed = 8 * 6 / 6.5
	local gravity = 16
	local penguin_y = CS.CalculatorFreeFall.Create(vertical_speed, gravity, 0, 0)
	penguin.OverrideCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
	self.penguin_running = true
	self.penguin_jumping = false
	self.penguin_jump_call = false

	local prev_box = penguin.Hitbox
	penguin.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(0.5, 0, 0.5), vector(0.7, 1, 0.7))
	while self.penguin_running do

		-- 펭귄 이동
		CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameStageLogic.ExecuteMove(penguin, vector(1, 0, 0), 6.5 * unity_class.time.deltaTime)

		-- 펭귄 점프 관련 코드
		if self.penguin_jumping then

			if penguin_y:GetProgress() == 0 then
				penguin_y = CS.CalculatorFreeFall(vertical_speed, gravity, 0, 0)
				penguin_y:Proceed(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
				penguin.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(penguin.Position, penguin_y:GetDistance())
				character_util.set_anim(penguin, {name = 'jump'})

			elseif penguin_y:GetProgress() == 1 then
				self.penguin_jumping = false
				penguin_y = CS.CalculatorFreeFall(vertical_speed, gravity, 0, 0)
				penguin.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(penguin.Position, 0)
				character_util.set_anim(penguin, {name = 'run'})

			else
				penguin_y:Proceed(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
				penguin.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(penguin.Position, penguin_y:GetDistance())
			end
		end

		if self.penguin_jump_call and not self.penguin_jumping then
			self.penguin_jump_call = false
			self.penguin_jumping = true
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	penguin.Hitbox = prev_box

	penguin.OverrideCrashBehaviour = nil
	penguin_y:Dispose()

	local marker = field:GetMarker('seal_point')
	if not self.penguin_jumping then
		character_util.stop(penguin)
	end
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(penguin)
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(penguin, marker.position + vector(-3.5, 0, 0.5),
			5.5, true, 'stop', 'floor', 'down')

	ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_progress.QuestId,
			self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, penguin)
	quest_icon.SetQuestCleared(penguin)

	self.penguin_jump_call = false
	character_util.add_listener(penguin, self.controller)
end

function local_class:falling_routine()
	local marker = field:GetMarker('seal_point')
	local penguin = get_character('penguin_racer')

	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local fall_time = 0.5

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
	character_util.set_active_shadow(user_party_leader, false)
	user_party_leader:SetScale(unity_class.vector3.zero, fall_time)
	user_party_leader:SetRotation(720, fall_time)

	local free_fall = CS.CalculatorFreeFall(0, 5, 0, 0)

	local pos = user_party_leader.Position

	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(user_party_leader, {name = 'embarrassed'}, {name = 'surprise'})

	local on_fx_play = false

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < fall_time do
		free_fall:Proceed(unity_class.time.deltaTime)

		cur_y = free_fall:GetDistance()

		user_party_leader.Position = vector(pos.x, cur_y, pos.z)

		if unity_class.time.time - cur_time > 0.3 and not on_fx_play then
			on_fx_play = true
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_dive_01')
			self.fx_water:Instantiate(user_party_leader.Position + vector(0, 0.1, 0))
		end

		coroutine.yield()
	end
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_02')
	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(0.5, 'linear')

	self.controller:race_end_setting()
	user_party_leader:SetRotation(0, 0)
	user_party_leader:SetScale(unity_class.vector3.one, 0)
	character_util.set_active_shadow(user_party_leader, true)
	character_util.set_direction(penguin, 'down')
	penguin.Position = marker.position + vector(-3.5, 0, 0.5)
	party_util.align_to_target(penguin, 'down', 0, 'linear')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party_leader)
	character_util.add_listener(penguin, self.controller)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.quest_marker_name)
	quest_icon.RemoveIcon(penguin)

	self.is_falling = false
	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(0.5, 'linear')

	yield_return_func(self.lose_race, self)
end

function local_class:update_dash_state(fo, dir)
	--- 앞에 있는 물체 리스트
	local ifo_list = CS.Oak.LuaCollisionUtil.GetFieldObjectsCollidedBy(fo.Bounds, dir)
	--- 리스트에서 breakable인지 체크하여 파괴
	for i = 0, ifo_list.Count - 1 do
		local target = ifo_list[i]
		local damaged_behaviour = target.DamagedBehaviour
		if lua_helper.type_compare(damaged_behaviour, CS.Oak.PotDamagedBehaviour) then
			--- 대미지 적용
			self:on_damage(fo, target)
		end
	end

	ifo_list:Dispose()
end

function local_class:on_damage(fo, target)
	local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
	damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Explosion | CS.Oak.DamageType.AffectGimmick
	damage_info.sender = fo
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.damage = 100
	command_util.execute_damage(damage_info)

	if self.slow_timer < 0 then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_hit_comic_01')
	end
	self.slow_timer = 0
	character_util.set_emotion(user_party_leader, {name = 'hurt'})
end

return local_class

local local_class = newclass('NightmareSnowMountainSculptorPreSection')

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	self.get_sculptor = function() return get_character('sculptor') end

	self.get_statue = function(num) return get_field_object('sculptor_statue_' .. num) end
	self.get_door = function() return get_field_object('sculptor_entrance') end

	self.door_interactable = nil

	self.statue_pushable = {}
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')

	self.door_interactable = self.get_door().Interactable
	self.get_door().Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

	for i = 1, 3 do
		local statue = self.get_statue(i)

		self.statue_pushable[i] = statue.Pushable
		statue.Pushable = CS.Oak.NonPushable.Instance

		statue.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
	end

	local sculptor = self.get_sculptor()

	character_util.add_listener(sculptor, self.controller)
	character_util.set_anim(sculptor, {name = 'embarrassed'})
	character_util.set_emotion(sculptor, {name = 'damaged'})

	quest_icon_util.set_quest_notice(sculptor)
end

function local_class:start()

end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	self.get_door().Interactable = self.door_interactable
	self.door_interactable = nil

	character_util.remove_relate_event(self.get_sculptor(), self.controller)

	for i = 1, 3 do
		local statue = self.get_statue(i)
		statue.Pushable = self.statue_pushable[i]
		statue.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
	end
	self.statue_pushable = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		if table_util.contain_value({
			self.get_statue(1),
			self.get_statue(2),
			self.get_statue(3),
			self.get_door()
		}, e.Target) then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.sculptor_warning, self)
			return true
		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_sculptor()) then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.talk_with_sculptor, self)
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)

	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	self.get_sculptor = function() return get_character('sculptor') end
	self.get_statue_npc = function(num) return get_character('sculptor_statue_npc_' .. num) end
	self.get_iced_villager = function() return get_character('sculptor_iced_villager') end
	self.get_gatsby = function() return get_character('sculptor_gatsby') end
	self.get_bodyguard = function(num) return get_character('sculptor_bodyguard_' .. num) end

	self.get_statue = function(num) return get_field_object('sculptor_statue_' .. num) end
	self.get_door = function() return get_field_object('sculptor_entrance') end
	self.get_reset_switch = function() return get_field_object('sculptor_reset_switch') end

	self.get_statue_origin_pos = function(num) return field:GetMarker('sculptor_origin_pos_' .. num).position end

	self.door_interactable = nil

	self.is_statue_routine_on = false

	self.statue_pushable = {}
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.SwitchOnOffEvent), 'on_event')

	self.door_interactable = self.get_door().Interactable
	self.get_door().Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

	self.get_sculptor().ActiveState = active_state('disabled')

	for i = 1, 3 do
		local statue = self.get_statue(i)
		self.statue_pushable[i] = statue.Pushable
	end
end

function local_class:start()
	if self.controller.starting_inner_progress < 0 then
		self:start_statue_routine()
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.SwitchOnOffEvent))

	self.get_door().Interactable = self.door_interactable
	self.door_interactable = nil
	self.statue_pushable = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_door()) then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(field_ui_util.show_narration_async,
					{key = 'nightmare_snowmountain_sculptor_38'})
		end
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent) then
		if type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, 'sculptor') then
			self:start_statue_routine()
		end
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent) then
		if type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, 'sculptor') then
			self:stop_statue_routine()
		end
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.SwitchOnOffEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.SwitchObject, self.get_reset_switch()) and e.IsTurningOn then
			self:reset_statues()
		end
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent) then
		if e.Params[0] == 'statue_move_done' then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.after_positioning_done, self)
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:start_statue_routine()
	if self.is_statue_routine_on == false then
		self.is_statue_routine_on = true
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.statue_routine, self))
	end
end

function local_class:stop_statue_routine()
	self.is_statue_routine_on = false
end

function local_class:reset_statues()
	local need_reset = false
	for i = 1, 3 do
		local pushable_statue = self.get_statue(i)
		local target_pos = self.get_statue_origin_pos(i)

		if pushable_statue.Position ~= target_pos then
			need_reset = true

			message_system:SendSync(pushable_statue.FieldObjectBehaviour, CS.Oak.GimmickResetEvent.Instance)
			self.get_statue_npc(i).Position = target_pos

			if lua_helper.type_compare(pushable_statue.Pushable, CS.Oak.NonPushable) then
				pushable_statue.Pushable = self.statue_pushable[i]
			end
		end
	end

	if need_reset then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_guild_warp_01')
	end
end

function local_class:statue_routine()
	local pushable_statues = {
		self.get_statue(1),
		self.get_statue(2),
		self.get_statue(3),
	}
	local statue_npcs = {
		self.get_statue_npc(1),
		self.get_statue_npc(2),
		self.get_statue_npc(3),
	}
	local target_pos_list = {
		vector(-15, 0, 88),
		vector(-12, 0, 88),
		vector(-9, 0, 88),
	}

	while self.is_statue_routine_on do
		local done_count = 0

		for i = 1, 3 do
			if pushable_statues[i].Position.x >= -2 then
				local cmd = CS.Oak.PushEndCommand.Create(user_party.Leader, pushable_statues[i], user_party_leader.Position, pushable_statues[i].Position)
				command_util.execute_cmd(cmd)

				self:reset_statues()
			else
				statue_npcs[i].Position = pushable_statues[i].Position

				if (pushable_statues[i].Position - target_pos_list[i]):IsAlmostZero() then
					done_count = done_count + 1
					pushable_statues[i].Pushable = CS.Oak.NonPushable.Instance
				end
			end
		end

		if done_count == 3 then
			message_system:SendSync(self.controller.cs_controller, CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(user_party.Leader, { 'statue_move_done' }))
			return
		end

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	for i = 1, 3 do
		statue_npcs[i].Position = pushable_statues[i].Position
	end
end

local local_class = newclass('NightmareSnowMountainSnowFightSection1')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = NightmareSnowMountainSnowFight @
		Comment = 나이트메어 설산 눈싸움 스타피스 퀘스트 @
		Index = 0 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	-- Marker
	self.get_leader_marker = function() return field:GetMarker('snow_fight_manual') end
	self.get_party_marker = function() return field:GetMarker('snow_fight_party') end
	self.get_snowman_kid_marker = function(index) return field:GetMarker('snow_fight_kid_' .. index) end
	self.get_master_appear_marker = function() return field:GetMarker('snow_fight_master_appear') end
	self.get_snow_fight_master_marker = function() return field:GetMarker('snow_fight_master') end
	self.get_listening_marker = function() return field:GetMarker('snow_fight_listening') end
	self.get_kids_cheer_marker = function() return field:GetMarker('snow_fight_kids_cheer') end

	-- 눈싸움 마스터 전용 bgm
	local is_kong_japan = CS.Foundations.GameEnvironment.IsKongJapan
	self.bgm_snow_master_name = lua_helper.get_conditional_value(is_kong_japan,
			'bgm_shivermore_suspense_kong', 'bgm_shivermore_suspense')
	self.bgm_win_snow_master_name = lua_helper.get_conditional_value(is_kong_japan,
			'bgm_shivermore_pursuit_kong', 'bgm_shivermore_pursuit')

	-- 화로 이름 (눈싸움 전투 들어갈때 꺼줌)
	self.braizer_name = 'liftable_braizer'

	-- 기본 전투 bgm 이름
	self.default_battle_bgm_name = 'bgm_battle_normal'

	-- 눈싸움 전투 bgm 이름
	self.snow_fight_bgm_name = 'bgm_red_hood'

	-- 눈싸움 배틀 그룹 이름
	self.battle_group_name = 'snow_fight'

	-- 눈싸움 스타피스 이름
	self.star_piece_name = 'snow_fight_star_piece'

	-- 처음 스테이지에 들어왔을 때 눈싸움 매뉴얼 캐릭터를 변경하였는지
	self.is_change_maunal_character = false

	-- 눈싸움 진행도
	self.snow_fight_talk_progress = { none = 0, first_talk = 1, second_talk = 2 }
	self.current_talk_progress = self.snow_fight_talk_progress.none

	-- 눈싸움에 관련된 이벤트를 구독 중에 있는지
	self.is_in_snow_fight_subscribe = false

	-- 설인 아이들의 원래 경험치 상태
	self.snowman_kid_default_exp = 0

	-- 눈싸움 할 때 조작할 캐릭터
	self.get_holder = function() return get_character('snow_fight_manual') end

	-- Party 캐싱
	self.party = {}

	-- 설인 아이들 Default Position
	self.snowman_kid_default_positions = {}

	-- 전투 끝나고 리더가 있을 위치
	self.leader_battle_end_position = vector(21, 0, -44)

	-- 텍스트 키 값 형식 저장
	self.string_key = 'nightmare_snowmountain_snow_fight_'
	self.choose_string_key = 'nightmare_snowmountain_snow_fight_choose_'

	-- qte 체크 성공여부 확인
	self.qte_complete = false

	-- 날라오는 눈덩이 관련 Object
	self.custom_sprite_pool = nil
	self.is_subscribe_touch_event = false

	self.res_holder = nil

	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.PreloadTutorialSpine()
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')

	-- 설인 아이들에게 리스너를 추가하며, 기존 경험치 및 좌표를 캐싱해 둔다.
	local snowman_kid_boys = self:get_snowman_kids()
	self.snowman_kid_default_exp = snowman_kid_boys[1].FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.Exp

	self.snowman_kid_default_positions = {}
	for i = 1, #snowman_kid_boys do
		table.insert(self.snowman_kid_default_positions, snowman_kid_boys[i].Position)
		character_util.add_listener(snowman_kid_boys[i], self.cs_controller)
	end

	self.custom_sprite_pool = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate("custom_sprite")
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_event_snowball_hit')

	return true
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- AddListener 해제
	local snowman_snowfight_master = self.controller.get_snow_fight_master
	character_util.remove_relate_event(snowman_snowfight_master, self.cs_controller)

	local snowman_kid_boys = self:get_snowman_kids()
	for i = 1, #snowman_kid_boys do
		character_util.remove_relate_event(snowman_kid_boys[i], self.cs_controller)
	end

	if self.res_holder ~= nil then
		self.res_holder:Dispose();
		self.res_holder = nil
	end

	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil

	self.party = nil
	self.snowman_kid_default_positions = nil
	self.leader_battle_end_position = nil

	self.custom_sprite_pool = nil
end

function local_class:start()
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		table.insert(self.party, user_party[i])
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	self:unsubscribe_snow_fight_events()

	-- 터치 이벤트를 구독중이라면 구독해지
	if self.is_subscribe_touch_event then
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local snow_fight_master = self.controller.get_snow_fight_master()

	-- 눈싸움 마스터와 상호작용시
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, snow_fight_master) then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.propose_snow_fight, self))
		return true
	end

	-- 설인 아이들과 상호작용시
	for i = 1, self.controller.snowman_kid_count do
		local snowman_kid = self.controller.get_snowman_kid(i)
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, snowman_kid) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.propose_snow_fight, self))
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	-- 눈싸움이 끝났을때
	if e.BattleGroupName == self.battle_group_name then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.win_battle, self))
	end
end

function local_class:on_damage_event(e)
	-- 리더의 HP가 1미만이 되었을때
	local holder_for_leader = self.get_holder()
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.target, holder_for_leader) then
		if e.HpBefore - e.Info:GetTotalDamage() < 1 then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.lose_battle, self))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_touch_event(e)
	-- 터치 이벤트 (qte) 가 들어왔을때 스와이프를 아래로 했을 경우
	if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeDown then
		self.qte_complete = true
		return true
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:propose_snow_fight()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	local snowman_kid_boys = self:get_snowman_kids()

	-- 파티가 듣는 위치로 이동
	party_util.align_party(self.get_listening_marker().position, 'left', 0.5, 'linear')

	-- 첫번째 대화 진행
	if self.current_talk_progress ~= self.snow_fight_talk_progress.second_talk then
		local is_meet_snow_fight_master = self:talk_part_1(snowman_kid_boys)
		if not is_meet_snow_fight_master then
			party_util.reset_controllers()
			field_ui_manager:Show()
			return
		end
	end

	-- 어때? 어때? 이길 수 있겠어?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(snowman_kid_boys[1], { name = 'smile' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(snowman_kid_boys[1], { key = self.string_key .. 20, skip = true })

	-- 선택지 : 1. 충분하지, 덤벼. / 나중에
	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({ { self.choose_string_key .. 7, 'intellect' }, { self.choose_string_key .. 8, 'normal' } })
	character_util.remove_emotion(snowman_kid_boys[1])

	-- 나중에를 선택할 경우 눈싸움 마스터가 등장했으니 눈싸움 마스터에게만 리스너를 추가해준다.
	if choose_result ~= 1 then
		local snow_fight_master = self.controller.get_snow_fight_master()
		character_util.add_listener(snow_fight_master, self.cs_controller)

		-- 첫번째 이벤트를 본 상황이라면 다른 bgm이 재생중임으로 원래대로 돌립니다.
		if music_player.CurrentStageMusicName ~= 'bgm_shivermore_main' then
			music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field' })
		end

		party_util.reset_controllers()
		field_ui_manager:Show()
		return
	end

	-- 충분하지, 덤벼!
	character_util.set_emotion(user_party_leader, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(user_party_leader, { name = 'release', sfx = '01_swing_01', count = 2 })
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party_leader)

	--  그럼 한 수 가르쳐드리겠습니다!
	local snow_fight_master = self.controller.get_snow_fight_master()
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(snow_fight_master, { key = self.string_key .. 21, skip = true })

	-- 눈싸움 시작전 세팅
	self:start_snow_fight()

	party_util.reset_controllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()
end

function local_class:talk_part_1(snowman_kid_boys)
	local snow_fight_master = self.controller.get_snow_fight_master()

	if self.current_talk_progress == self.snow_fight_talk_progress.none then
		self:talk_part_2(snowman_kid_boys)
	end

	self.current_talk_progress = self.snow_fight_talk_progress.first_talk

	-- 복수의 기회야! 다시 눈싸움하자!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(snowman_kid_boys[1], { name = 'smile' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(snowman_kid_boys[1], { key = self.string_key .. 4, skip = true })

	-- 선택지 : 1. 이번에는 이길 수 있겠어? / 2. 그래, 덤벼! / 3. 지금은 바빠, 나중에.
	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({ { self.choose_string_key .. 1, 'brutal' }, { self.choose_string_key .. 2, 'intellect' }, { self.choose_string_key .. 3, 'normal' } })

	if choose_result == 3 then return false end

	if choose_result == 1 then
		-- 이번에는 이길 수 있겠어? 선택시 ) 리더 애니메이션 question 이모션 doyagao
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(user_party_leader, { name = 'question', loop = false }, { name = 'doyagao' })
		wait_for_sec(1.25)
	else
		-- 그래, 덤벼! 선택시 ) 리더 애니메이션 release 두번, 이모션 attack
		character_util.set_emotion(user_party_leader, { name = 'attack' })
		character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(user_party_leader, { name = 'release', sfx = '01_swing_01', count = 2 })
	end
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party_leader)

	-- 아니! 이번엔 우리 삼촌이 상대해 줄 거야!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(snowman_kid_boys[1], { name = 'victory_extra', loop = true }, { name = 'smile' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(snowman_kid_boys[1], { key = self.string_key .. 5, skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(snowman_kid_boys[1])

	-- 얘네 삼촌 진짜 무서운데!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(snowman_kid_boys[2], { name = 'cross_arm', loop = true }, { name = 'smile' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(snowman_kid_boys[2], { key = self.string_key .. 6, skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(snowman_kid_boys[2])

	-- 이제 너 큰으은일 났다!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(snowman_kid_boys[3], { name = 'hold_loop', loop = true }, { name = 'smile' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(snowman_kid_boys[3], { key = self.string_key .. 7, skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(snowman_kid_boys[3])

	-- 여기서 딱 기다려! 삼촌 금방 온다고 했어!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(snowman_kid_boys[1], { name = 'smile' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(snowman_kid_boys[1], { key = self.string_key .. 8, skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(snowman_kid_boys[1])

	-- 눈싸움 마스터 등장하는 부분으로 좌표이동
	local pos = self.get_master_appear_marker().position
	character_util.set_position(snow_fight_master, pos)

	-- 눈덩이 날라온다.
	self:set_projectile_snowball(pos)

	-- 설인 아이 1 위를 한번 보고 0.5초 이후 아래로 내려감
	character_util.set_direction(snowman_kid_boys[1], 'up')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	character_util.move_to_async(snowman_kid_boys[1], vector(23.2, 0, -44.5), 0.3, nil, true, true)
	character_util.set_direction(snowman_kid_boys[1], 'left')

	-- 눈싸움 마스터 내려옴
	character_util.move_to_async(snow_fight_master, vector(23.2, 0, -43.5), 1.5, nil, true, true)
	character_util.set_direction(snow_fight_master, 'left')
	character_util.set_direction(user_party_leader, 'right')

	-- 오랜만입니다, 헤실헤실씨.
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(snow_fight_master, { name = 'cross_arm' }, { name = 'doyagao' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(snow_fight_master, { key = self.string_key .. 13, skip = true })

	-- 선택지 : 1. 올리버 검사? / ...검사직 잘린거야?
	choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({ { self.choose_string_key .. 4, 'normal' }, { self.choose_string_key .. 5, 'brutal' } })
	character_util.set_emotion(user_party_leader, { name = 'tired' })

	-- 오늘은 검사가 아닌… 무패의 눈싸움 마스터로서!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	character_util.set_anim(snow_fight_master, { name = 'twohand_damaged', loop = false })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(snow_fight_master, { key = self.string_key .. 14, skip = true })

	-- 당신의 실력을 확인해 보겠습니다!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(snow_fight_master, { key = self.string_key .. 15, skip = true })

	camera_util.resize_to(3, 0.2)
	local camera_pos = vector(snow_fight_master.Position.x, 0, user_party_leader.Position.z)
	camera_util.move(camera_pos, 0.2)
	camera_util.shake(0.4, 0.3)

	-- 하지만 딱 봐도 헤실헤실, 참으로 부실해 보이는군요!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	character_util.set_anim(snow_fight_master, { name = 'attack_stab', loop = false })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(snow_fight_master, { key = self.string_key .. 16, bubble_type = 'shout', skip = true })
	character_util.set_anim(snow_fight_master, { name = 'cross_arm' })

	self:resize_default_and_return_leader(0.2)
	wait_for_sec(0.3)
	character_util.remove_emotion(user_party_leader)

	self.current_talk_progress = self.snow_fight_talk_progress.second_talk
	return true
end
