function local_class:start_snow_fight()
	local snowman_kid_boys = self:get_snowman_kids()

	-- 눈싸움 시작 필요한 이벤트 구독
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_battle_group_eliminated_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), 'on_damage_event')
	self.is_in_snow_fight_subscribe = true

	-- 스테이지 배경음악 muted
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	-- combat 상태 음악을 bgm_red_hood로 변경
	music_player_util.set_stage_music_clip_async({ name = self.snow_fight_bgm_name, state = 'combat' })

	-- 파티원들 응원하러 뒤로 빠짐
	local party_emotion = { 'attack', 'awesome', 'smile' }
	local party_action = { 'release', 'success', 'clap' }
	local party_marker = self.get_party_marker().position

	for i = 2, #self.party do
		character_util.convert_to_npc(self.party[i])
		self.party[i].Position = party_marker + (i - 2) * 2 * unity_class.vector3.back
		character_util.set_direction(self.party[i], 'right')
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.party[i], { name = party_action[i - 1] }, { name = party_emotion[i - 1] })
	end

	-- 눈싸움 메뉴얼 캐릭터 세팅
	local holder_for_leader = self.get_holder()

	-- 눈싸움 메뉴얼 캐릭터가 리더와 같지 않다면 눈싸움 메뉴얼 캐릭터를 리더와 같은 코스튬을 쓰도록 수정
	if not self.is_change_maunal_character then
		self.is_change_maunal_character = true
		yield_return_func(self.setting_snow_fight_holder, self)
	end

	-- 기존 리더 캐릭터를 화면 밖으로 세팅
	user_party_leader.Position = vector(99, 0, 99)

	-- 눈싸움 메뉴얼 캐릭터를 조작 캐릭터로 변경하고 불사 세팅
	local param = CS.Oak.CharacterConvertParam:ManualDefault()
	param.HidePreviousParty = false
	character_util.convert_to_manual_character(holder_for_leader, param)
	character_util.set_immortal(holder_for_leader, true)

	-- 눈싸움 메뉴얼 캐릭터의 좌표를 leader_marker 좌표로 이동
	-- 두번째 전투 진행일 수도 있으니 체력을 회복시켜준다.
	-- 눈싸움 메뉴얼 캐릭터 레벨 1로 세팅 및 UI삭제
	self:set_snow_fight_character(self.get_leader_marker().position, holder_for_leader)
	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(holder_for_leader, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TopHpBar)
	coroutine.yield(nil)
	coroutine.yield(nil)
	field_ui_manager:SetUI(holder_for_leader, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TopHpBar)

	character_util.set_direction(holder_for_leader, 'right')

	-- 눈싸움 마스터 세팅
	local snow_fight_master = self.controller.get_snow_fight_master()
	self:set_snow_fight_character(self.get_snow_fight_master_marker().position, snow_fight_master)

	-- 설인 아이들 응원하러 뒤로 이동
	local kids_cheer_marker = self.get_kids_cheer_marker().position
	for i = 1, #snowman_kid_boys do
		snowman_kid_boys[i].Position = kids_cheer_marker + (i - 2) * 1 * unity_class.vector3.back
		character_util.remove_relate_event(snowman_kid_boys[i], self.cs_controller)
		character_util.set_direction(snowman_kid_boys[i], 'left')
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(snowman_kid_boys[i], { name = party_action[i] }, { name = party_emotion[i] })
	end

	-- 화로를 Disable
	stage_util.set_fo_active_state(self.braizer_name, 'disabled')

	-- 조작 캐릭터를 변경해서 DisableContol가 풀렸을수 있기에 다시 멈추게 한다.
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_bell_01')
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	self:snow_fight_start_counting()

	-- 눈싸움 마스터 적으로 변경
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(snow_fight_master)
	character_util.convert_to_monster(snow_fight_master, 'snow_fight', 'snow_fight')
	character_util.set_death_type(snow_fight_master, 'prostrate')
	command_util.execute_monster_notice(snow_fight_master, holder_for_leader, 'battle')
	snow_fight_master.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.NoticeLinkName = 'snow_fight'
end

function local_class:set_snow_fight_character(position, character)
	character.Position = position
	character.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour:SetExp(0)
	character.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour:Heal(10000, false)
	field_ui_manager:HideTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats, character)
end

-- 눈싸움 시작 카운트
function local_class:snow_fight_start_counting()
	-- 3
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_whistle_01')
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowStageTitle('3', 2.1)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 2
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_whistle_01')
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowStageTitle('2', 2.1)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 1
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_whistle_01')
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowStageTitle('1', 2.1)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 시작!
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowStageTitle(game_string:GetString('nightmare_snowmountain_snow_fight_narration_1'), 2.1)
end

function local_class:setting_snow_fight_holder()
	self.res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()

	local asset_bundle_name = user_party_leader.CharacterInfo.AssetName.assetBundleName
	local asset_name = user_party_leader.CharacterInfo.AssetName.assetName
	local skin_name = user_party_leader.CharacterInfo.SkinName

	local holder_for_leader = self.get_holder()

	-- 코스튬이 있다면 코스튬으로 아니면 캐릭터 기본 스팩의 데이터로 SpriteAssetName 세팅
	if user_party_leader.Costume == nil then
		holder_for_leader.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.CharacterSpec.SpriteAssetName = user_party_leader.CharacterInfo.CharacterSpec.SpriteAssetName
	else
		holder_for_leader.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.CharacterSpec.SpriteAssetName = user_party_leader.Costume.CostumeSpec.AssetName
	end

	-- 캐릭터 일반 이름 세팅
	holder_for_leader.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.CharacterSpec.CharacterName = user_party_leader.CharacterInfo.CharacterSpec.CharacterName

	-- 메뉴얼 조종할 때 캐릭터 걷기 속도 세팅
	holder_for_leader.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.CharacterSpec.ManualWalkSpeed = user_party_leader.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.CharacterSpec.ManualWalkSpeed

	-- 메뉴얼 조종할 때 캐릭터 달리기 속도
	holder_for_leader.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.CharacterSpec.ManualDashSpeed = user_party_leader.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.CharacterSpec.ManualDashSpeed

	-- 프리팹 불러올 때 까지 대기
	yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync, self.res_holder,
		   asset_bundle_name, asset_name, function(prefab)
			   local go = CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Instantiate(prefab)
			   local spine_controller = go:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.SpineController))

			   if spine_controller ~= nil then
				   holder_for_leader.SpineController:SwitchSpineController(spine_controller)
			   else
				   CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(go)
			   end
		   end)

	-- 스킨 설정
	if skin_name then
		holder_for_leader.SpineController.SkinName = skin_name
	end
end

function local_class:win_battle()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	local snow_fight_master = self.controller.get_snow_fight_master()
	local snowman_kid_boys = self:get_snowman_kids()
	self:battle_end_common(snow_fight_master, true)

	-- 설인 아이들이 놀란다
	for i = 1, #snowman_kid_boys do
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(snowman_kid_boys[i])
		character_util.set_emotion(snowman_kid_boys[i], { name = 'surprise' })
	end

	screen_util.fade_out_async(1.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	-- 화로 enabled
	stage_util.set_fo_active_state(self.braizer_name, 'enabled')

	-- 올리버 눈싸움 마스터 위치이동
	character_util.set_position(snow_fight_master, self.snowman_kid_default_positions[1])
	character_util.set_direction(snow_fight_master, 'left')
	character_util.remove_anim(snow_fight_master)
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(snow_fight_master, { name = 'seat' }, { name = 'damaged' })
	snow_fight_master.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour:SetExp(self.snowman_kid_default_exp)
	field_ui_manager:ShowTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats, snow_fight_master)

	-- 설인 아이들 원래 자리로 이동
	for i = 1, #snowman_kid_boys do
		character_util.set_position(snowman_kid_boys[i], self.controller.snowman_kid_positions[i])
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	self:return_leader_controll()

	-- 리더 이모션 doyagao, 애니메이션 cross_arm
	character_util.set_position(user_party_leader, self.leader_battle_end_position)
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(user_party_leader, { name = 'cross_arm' }, { name = 'doyagao' })

	-- 나머지 파티원 뒤에서 기본 idle로 대기
	local party_member_pos = self.leader_battle_end_position + vector(-1, 0, 3)
	for i = 2, #self.party do
		character_util.set_position(self.party[i], vector(party_member_pos.x, 0, party_member_pos.z - i))
		character_util.set_direction(self.party[i], 'right')
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.party[i])
	end
	camera_util.move(snow_fight_master.Position, 0)

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	wait_for_sec(1)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party_leader)

	-- 마, 마, 마, 마, 말도 안 됩니다!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_02')
	character_util.shake(snow_fight_master, 0.02, 1)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(snow_fight_master, { key = self.string_key .. 22, bubble_type = 'shout', skip = true })

	-- 제가 너무 봐 드렸군요!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(snow_fight_master, { key = self.string_key .. 23, bubble_type = 'shout', skip = true })

	-- 다시 한 번 붙으시죠!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(snow_fight_master, { name = 'release', scale = 0.6, sfx = '01_swing_01', count = 2 })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(snow_fight_master, { key = self.string_key .. 24, bubble_type = 'shout', skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim(snow_fight_master)

	-- 설인 아이 1 attack 설인 아이 2,3 tried Emotion
	for i = 1, #snowman_kid_boys do
		local emotion_name = i == 1 and 'attack' or 'tired'
		character_util.set_emotion(snowman_kid_boys[i], { name = emotion_name })
	end
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 에이
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(snowman_kid_boys[1], { key = self.string_key .. 33, skip = true })

	-- 올리버 검사 돌아본다.
	character_util.set_direction(snow_fight_master, 'right')

	-- 아저씨 졌잖아요!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(snowman_kid_boys[3], { key = self.string_key .. 28, skip = true })
	character_util.shake(snow_fight_master, 0.04, 0.5)

	-- 맞아, 진정한 눈싸움 선수라면 깔끔히 승복해야 돼요!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_kid_boy_shout_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(snowman_kid_boys[2], { key = self.string_key .. 29, skip = true })
	character_util.shake(snow_fight_master, 0.08, 0.5)

	-- 삼촌… 창피하니까 그만해…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(snowman_kid_boys[1], { key = self.string_key .. 30, skip = true })

	-- 으...으으으으….
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
	camera_util.resize_to(stage_camera:GetDefaultSize() - 0.6, 0.5, nil)
	character_util.shake(snow_fight_master, 0.08, 0.5)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(snow_fight_master, { key = self.string_key .. 25, skip = true })

	-- 으으으… 이건...
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
	camera_util.resize_to(stage_camera:GetDefaultSize() - 1.2, 0.5, nil)
	character_util.shake(snow_fight_master, 0.08, 0.5)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(snow_fight_master, { key = self.string_key .. 26, skip = true })

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 이건 말도 안돼애애애애애!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_02')
	camera_util.shake(0.8, 0.5)
	camera_util.resize_to(stage_camera:GetDefaultSize() - 1.8, 0.5, nil)
	character_util.set_anim(snow_fight_master, { name = 'dead4', sfx_name = '02_hit_critical_01', loop = false })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(snow_fight_master, { key = self.string_key .. 27, bubble_type = 'shout', skip = true })
	wait_for_sec(0.25)

	screen_util.fade_out_async(1.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	wait_for_sec(0.25)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party_leader)
	self:resize_default_and_return_leader(0)

	-- 암전 이후 설인 아이들 smile로 변경
	for i = 1, #snowman_kid_boys do
		character_util.set_emotion(snowman_kid_boys[i], { name = 'smile' })
	end

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field', mix = 1.5 })
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	-- 엄청난 경기였어!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(snowman_kid_boys[3], { key = self.string_key .. 31, skip = true })

	-- 맞아! 무시무시한 실력이였어!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(snowman_kid_boys[2], { key = self.string_key .. 32, skip = true })

	-- 자, 이건 선물이야!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(snowman_kid_boys[1], { key = self.string_key .. 34, skip = true })

	-- 스타피스 드롭
	local star_piece = get_field_object(self.star_piece_name)
	message_system:Send(star_piece, CS.Oak.StarPieceAppearEvent.Create(snowman_kid_boys[1].Position))
	wait_for_sec(3)

	-- 다음번엔 다 같이 눈싸움하자!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(snowman_kid_boys[3], { key = self.string_key .. 35, skip = true })

	-- 다 같이 하면 더 재밌을 거야!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(snowman_kid_boys[2], { key = self.string_key .. 36, skip = true })

	-- 삼촌도 특별히 끼워줄께요!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(snowman_kid_boys[1], { key = self.string_key .. 37, skip = true })

	self:remove_emotions(snowman_kid_boys)

	yield_return_func(quest_util.complete_quest, self.controller, 0, false, false, false)

	party_util.reset_controllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()
end

function local_class:lose_battle()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	local snow_fight_master = self.controller.get_snow_fight_master()
	local snowman_kid_boys = self:get_snowman_kids()
	self:battle_end_common(snow_fight_master, false)

	-- 리더 및 파티원 세팅
	local holder_for_leader = self.get_holder()
	self:cry_party_members()
	self:slow_dead_leader(holder_for_leader)

	screen_util.fade_out_async(1.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	-- 화로 enabled
	stage_util.set_fo_active_state(self.braizer_name, 'enabled')

	-- 눈싸움 마스터 위치이동
	character_util.set_position(snow_fight_master, vector(23.2, 0, -43.5))
	character_util.set_direction(snow_fight_master, 'left')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(snow_fight_master, { name = 'cross_arm' }, { name = 'doyagao' })
	snow_fight_master.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour:SetExp(self.snowman_kid_default_exp)
	field_ui_manager:ShowTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats, snow_fight_master)

	-- 설인 아이들 원래 위치로 이동
	for i = 1, #snowman_kid_boys do
		if i == 1 then
			character_util.set_position(snowman_kid_boys[i], vector(23.2, 0, -44.5))
		else
			character_util.set_position(snowman_kid_boys[i], self.snowman_kid_default_positions[i])

function local_class:set_projectile_snowball(startPos)
	self.res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()

	local customAtlas

	-- CustomAtlas 생성
	-- 눈덩이를 날리기 위해 추가한 옵션입니다.
	yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync, self.res_holder, "spritesheets/projectiles", "projectiles_custom", function(prefab)
		customAtlas = prefab:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomAtlas));
		customAtlas:Initialize();
	end)

	local pooledObject = self.custom_sprite_pool:Instantiate(unity_class.vector3.one);

	local snowballSprite = pooledObject:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
	snowballSprite.Transform.position = vector(user_party_leader.Position.x, 0, startPos.z - 1)
	snowballSprite.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 180, 0)
	snowballSprite.Transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one
	snowballSprite.Atlas = customAtlas
	snowballSprite.SpriteName = 'projectile_snowball.png';
	snowballSprite:Rebuild();

	-- 리더를 제외한 파티원 눈날라오는거 보고 놀라는 연출
	for i = 2, #self.party do
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.party[i], { name = 'embarrassed' }, { name = 'surprise' })
	end

	-- 눈덩이의 마지막 좌표는 리더좌표에서 z축으로  + 0.5
	local end_pos = user_party_leader.Position + vector(0, 0, 0.5)
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_touch_event')
	self.is_subscribe_touch_event = true

	-- 눈덩이 오브젝트를 비동기로 옮겨줍니다.
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.MoveTo(snowballSprite.transform, end_pos, 0.3, nil, -1, false))

	camera_util.move(vector(user_party_leader.Position.x, 0, user_party_leader.Position.z + 1.4), 0.3)
	camera_util.resize_to(stage_camera:GetDefaultSize() - 1, 0.3)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_slowmotion_01')

	-- 눈날라오는걸 아주 살짝 보기위한 딜레이
	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_snowball_throw_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_tap_guide_01')
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.QTESwipe("down")

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })

	-- TimeScale을 0.1로 변경합니다.
	CS.GlobalTimeManager.Instance:Mod(0.1, "show_fight")

	-- qte 시간 계산
	-- qte 시간 안에 성공하면 이팩트를 연출해 줍니다.
	local qte_delay = 0
	local qte_time = 1.5
	while qte_delay < qte_time do
		if self.qte_complete then
			yield_return_func(CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.QTEComplete, qte_time - qte_delay)
			break
		end

		qte_delay = qte_delay + unity_class.time.unscaledDeltaTime
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- TimeScale을 원래대로 변경
	CS.GlobalTimeManager.Instance:Unmod("show_fight")
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.CloseTutorialSpine()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
	self.is_subscribe_touch_event = false

	-- 파티의 애니메이션 이모션 수정
	for i = 2, #self.party do
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.party[i])
	end

	if not self.qte_complete then
		-- qte 실패
		-- qte 연출을 꺼주고 리더에게 맞는 연출을 보여주고 난뒤 대화를 진행 합니다.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_small_01')
		self:dispose_object_and_show_hit_effect(end_pos, pooledObject)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_big_01')
		character_util.spine_pulse_color(user_party_leader, CS.Constants.DamageColor, 1, 1, 0.5)
		character_util.spine_damage_squish(user_party_leader, 1.3, 0.7, 1, 0.5)
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(user_party_leader, { name = 'prostrate' }, { name = 'damaged' })
		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = self.bgm_snow_master_name, state = 'event' })
		self:resize_default_and_return_leader(0.3)

		-- 훗훗훗…
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_male_laugh_at_01')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(user_party_leader, { key = self.string_key .. 11, skip = true, bubble_type = 'shout', world_pos = vector(21, 0, -43) })

		-- 눈싸움 챔피언이 정도도 피할 수 없다니요
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(user_party_leader, { key = self.string_key .. 12, skip = true, bubble_type = 'shout', world_pos = vector(21, 0, -43) })

		-- 리더 부들부들
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		character_util.shake(user_party_leader, 0.02, 1)
		wait_for_sec(1)

		-- 표정,애니메이션 remove 및 리더 마리오 점프
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_popup_01')
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party_leader)
		character_util.mario_jump_async(user_party_leader, 'right')
	else
		-- qte 성공
		-- 리더가 눈덩이를 아래로 피하고 난뒤 자리로 돌아옵니다.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_twohand_stomp_jump_01')
		character_util.set_direction(user_party_leader, "up")
		character_util.jump(user_party_leader, 1, 0.5)
		character_util.move_to_async(user_party_leader, user_party_leader.Position + vector(0, 0, -1), 0.2, nil, false)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_snowball_hit_01')
		self:dispose_object_and_show_hit_effect(end_pos, pooledObject)
		self:resize_default_and_return_leader(0.3)
		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		-- 리더 피하고 물음표 이모션
		character_util.show_emoticon_async(user_party_leader, nil, 'question')
		character_util.remove_anim(user_party_leader)

		-- 위로 올라옴
		character_util.move_waypoint_async(user_party_leader, user_party_leader.Position + vector(0, 0, 1), 5, false)

		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = self.bgm_snow_master_name, state = 'event' })

		-- 훗훗훗, 이걸 피하다니…
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_male_laugh_at_01')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(user_party_leader, { key = self.string_key .. 9, skip = true, bubble_type = 'shout', world_pos = vector(21, 0, -43) })

		-- 눈싸움 챔피언 타이틀이 폼은 아니군요.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(user_party_leader, { key = self.string_key .. 10, skip = true, bubble_type = 'shout', world_pos = vector(21, 0, -43) })
	end
end

function local_class:resize_default_and_return_leader(duration)
	camera_util.resize_to_default(duration)
	camera_util.return_to_leader(duration)
end

function local_class:dispose_object_and_show_hit_effect(pos, pooledObject)
	-- 해당 좌표에서 터트려주고
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_event_snowball_hit'):Instantiate(pos)

	-- 눈덩이 오브젝트 및 리소스 홀더를 Dispose 시켜준다.
	pooledObject:Dispose();
	if self.res_holder ~= nil then
		self.res_holder:Dispose();
		self.res_holder = nil
	end
end

function local_class:remove_emotions(target_list)
	for i = 1, #target_list do
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(target_list[i])
	end
end

function local_class:battle_end_common(snow_fight_master, is_win)
	self:unsubscribe_snow_fight_events()

	-- combat 상태 음악을 원래대로 변경
	music_player_util.set_stage_music_clip_async({ name = self.default_battle_bgm_name, state = 'combat' })

	-- field state bgm 재생
	if is_win then
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = self.bgm_win_snow_master_name, state = 'event' })
	else
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field' })
	end

	-- 눈싸움 마스터 Npc로 Convert
	character_util.convert_to_npc(snow_fight_master)
	character_util.add_listener(snow_fight_master, self.cs_controller)
end

function local_class:slow_dead_leader(holder_for_leader)
	-- 눈덩이 장전중인 상태일 수도 있으니 모든 배틀액션을 취소
	holder_for_leader.CharacterBehaviour:CancelAllBattleActions()

	-- 상 하단은 죽는 모션이 없다보니 왼쪽이 아닐 경우에는 right로 방향 전환
	if holder_for_leader.Direction ~= CS.Oak.Direction.Left then
		character_util.set_direction(holder_for_leader, 'right')
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_02')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_crowd_shout_03')

	-- 메뉴얼 캐릭터 죽은 처리
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(holder_for_leader, { name = 'dead', loop = false, sfx_name = '01_hit_npc_01' }, { name = 'hurt' })

	wait_for_sec(3)
end

function local_class:cry_party_members()
	-- 파티원들 울음
	for i = 2, #self.party do
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.party[i])
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.party[i], { name = 'cast' }, { name = 'cry' })
	end
end

function local_class:get_snowman_kids()
	local snowman_kid_boys = {}

	for i = 1, self.controller.snowman_kid_count do
		local kid = self.controller.get_snowman_kid(i)
		table.insert(snowman_kid_boys, kid)
	end

	return snowman_kid_boys
end

function local_class:unsubscribe_snow_fight_events()
	if not self.is_in_snow_fight_subscribe then
		return
	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent))
	self.is_in_snow_fight_subscribe = false
end

function local_class:return_leader_controll()
	-- 파티원 원상태로 복구
	local holder_for_leader = self.get_holder()
	holder_for_leader.Position = vector(99, 0, 99)

	-- 리더 TopHpBar 복구를 위해 Remove
	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(self.party[1], CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TopHpBar)

	-- 메뉴얼 캐릭터를 다시 원래 캐릭터로 변경
	local param = CS.Oak.CharacterConvertParam:ManualDefault()
	param.HidePreviousParty = false
	character_util.convert_to_manual_character(self.party[1], param)

	-- 파티원들도 다시 파티멤버로 들어온다.
	for i = 2, #self.party do
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.party[i])
		character_util.convert_to_party_member(self.party[i], user_party)
	end

	coroutine.yield(nil)
	coroutine.yield(nil)

	-- 리더 TopHp 복구
	field_ui_manager:SetUI(user_party.Leader, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TopHpBar)
end

return local_class

			self.played_event = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.start_event, self))
			return true
		end

function local_class:start_event()
	local garam = self.controller:get_garam()
	local snowman = self.controller.get_snowman()

	-- …
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(garam, {key = 'nightmare_snowmountain_snowman_after_1' , skip = false})

	--[[
	character_util.set_direction(garam, 'down')
	local tmp = garam.Position
	character_util.move_to_async(garam, tmp + 1 * unity_class.vector3.back, nil, 3, true, true)

	--]]

	local effect_twinkle = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('MagicCircle_Ready_Light'):Instantiate(garam.Position)

	effect_twinkle:Dispose()

	--[[
	local wps = {
		tmp + 1 * unity_class.vector3.back,
		tmp + 1 * unity_class.vector3.back + 3 * unity_class.vector3.left,
		tmp + 20 * unity_class.vector3.back + 3 * unity_class.vector3.left
	}
	wp_util.move_way_points(garam, { waypoints = wps, speed = 3, run = false  })


	wait_for_sec(3)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(garam, 0, 1)
	--]]

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_magic_shield_01' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_lights_01' })

	local effect_1 = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_common_event_transform'):Instantiate(snowman.Position)
	effect_1.TimeScaleModifier = 2.23/3

	--[[
	wait_for_sec(1)
	character_util.set_active_state(garam, 'disabled')
	--]]

	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(snowman, 0, 0.5)

local local_class = newclass('NightmareSteampunkCovertDealSection2')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = NightmareSteampunkCovertDeal @
		Comment = NightmareSteampunkCovertDeal 퀘스트/이벤트 섹션 @
		Index = 1 @
		NextSections = 2 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	-- 아이템 스펙 이름
	self.paper_piece_item_spec_name = controller.paper_piece_item_spec_name

	-- 이벤트 존 이름
	self.cat_event_zone_name = 'cat_event_zone'
	self.telephone_box_event_zone_name = 'telephone_box_event_zone'
	self.box_event_zone_name = 'box_event_zone'
	self.police_sns_event_zone_name = 'police_sns_event'

	-- 캐릭터를 가져오는 함수
	self.get_police = function() return get_character('police') end
	self.get_errand_girl = function() return get_character('errand_girl') end
	self.get_bicycle_thief = function() return get_character('bicycle_thief') end
	self.get_bicycle_owner = function(num) return get_character('bicycle_owner_' .. num) end
	self.get_cat = function() return get_character('box_cat') end
	self.get_bicycle = function(num) return get_character('bicycle_' .. num) end

	-- 오브젝트를 가져오는 함수
	self.get_cat_box = function() return get_field_object('cat_box') end
	self.get_telephone_box = function(num) return get_field_object('telephone_box_' .. num) end
	self.get_bench = controller.get_bench
	self.get_box = function() return get_field_object('box') end

	-- 마커를 가져오는 함수
	self.get_paper_piece_position_marker = controller.get_paper_piece_position_marker

	-- 이벤트 진행도
	self.square_event_enum = {
		none = 0,
		bicycle_thief = 1,
		bicycle_owner = 2,
		telephone_box = 4,
		box = 8,
		all = 15,
	}
	self.square_event_progress = self.square_event_enum.none

	-- 이벤트를 봤는지 여부
	self.is_saw_sns_call = false
	self.is_saw_cat_event_zone = false
	self.is_saw_bicycle_owner_event_zone = false
	self.is_saw_telephone_box_event_zone = false
	self.is_saw_interact_bicycle_owner = false
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.SwitchOnOffEvent), 'on_event')

	local thief = self.get_bicycle_thief()
	character_util.add_listener(thief, self.controller)

	local cat_box = self.get_cat_box()
	cat_box.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

	local owner_1 = self.get_bicycle_owner(1)
	character_util.add_listener(owner_1, self.controller)

	local owner_2 = self.get_bicycle_owner(2)
	character_util.add_listener(owner_2, self.controller)

	for i = 1, 2 do
		local telephone_box = self.get_telephone_box(i)
		telephone_box.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
	end

	for i = 3, 4 do
		for j = 1, 2 do
			if not (i == 3 and j == 1) then
				local bench = self.get_bench(i, j)
				bench.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
			end
		end
	end

	for i = 1, 2 do
		local bicycle = self.get_bicycle(i)
		field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(bicycle, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
	end

	local girl = self.get_errand_girl()
	character_util.add_listener(girl, self.controller)

	quest_util.load_pool_resource(
			'FX_reset_object'
	)
	return true
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.SwitchOnOffEvent), 'on_event')

	local thief = self.get_bicycle_thief()
	character_util.remove_relate_event(thief, self.controller)

	local cat_box = self.get_cat_box()
	cat_box.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

	local owner_1 = self.get_bicycle_owner(1)
	character_util.remove_relate_event(owner_1, self.controller)

	local owner_2 = self.get_bicycle_owner(2)
	character_util.remove_relate_event(owner_2, self.controller)

	for i = 1, 2 do
		local telephone_box = self.get_telephone_box(i)
		telephone_box.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
	end

	for i = 3, 4 do
		for j = 1, 2 do
			local bench = self.get_bench(i, j)
			bench.Interactable = CS.Oak.Interactable()
		end
	end

	local girl = self.get_errand_girl()
	character_util.remove_relate_event(girl, self.controller)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		return self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.GuildCastleSitEvent) then
		return self:on_guild_castle_sit_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.SwitchOnOffEvent) then
		return self:on_switch_on_off_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local thief = self.get_bicycle_thief()
	local cat_box = self.get_cat_box()
	local owner_1 = self.get_bicycle_owner(1)
	local owner_2 = self.get_bicycle_owner(2)
	local telephone_box_1 = self.get_telephone_box(1)
	local telephone_box_2 = self.get_telephone_box(2)
	local girl = self.get_errand_girl()

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, thief) and self.square_event_progress & self.square_event_enum.bicycle_thief == 0 then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_bicycle_thief, self)
		return true
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, cat_box) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_cat_box, self)
		return true
	elseif (lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, owner_1) or lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, owner_2)) and self.square_event_progress & self.square_event_enum.bicycle_owner == 0 then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_bicycle_owner, self)
		return true
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, telephone_box_1) and self.square_event_progress & self.square_event_enum.telephone_box == 0 then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_telephone_box_1, self)
		return true
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, telephone_box_2) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_telephone_box_2, self)
		return true
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, girl) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_errand_girl, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local box = self.get_box()

	if e.FullEnter then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then
			if e.Zone.Name == self.cat_event_zone_name and not self.is_saw_cat_event_zone then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.near_cat_box, self))
				return true
			elseif e.Zone.Name == self.telephone_box_event_zone_name and not self.is_saw_telephone_box_event_zone then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.near_telephone_box_1, self))
				return true
			elseif e.Zone.Name == self.police_sns_event_zone_name and not self.is_saw_sns_call then
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.police_sns_call, self)
				return true
			end
		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, box) then
			if e.Zone.Name == self.box_event_zone_name then
				self.square_event_progress = self.square_event_progress | self.square_event_enum.box
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	local box = self.get_box()

	if e.FullLeave then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, box) then
			if e.Zone.Name == self.box_event_zone_name then
				self.square_event_progress = self.square_event_progress & ~self.square_event_enum.box
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_guild_castle_sit_event(e)
	if e.IsSittingOn then
		local bench_1_1 = self.get_bench(1, 1)
		local bench_1_2 = self.get_bench(1, 2)

		if (lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Chair, bench_1_1) or lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Chair, bench_1_2)) and
			self.square_event_progress & self.square_event_enum.all == self.square_event_enum.all then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_bench, self)
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_switch_on_off_event(e)
	local switch = get_field_object('box_reset_switch')
	local switch2 = get_field_object('box_reset_switch_2')
	if e.IsTurningOn then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.SwitchObject, switch) or lua_helper.reference_equals(e.SwitchObject, switch2) then
			local not_box = self.square_event_enum.all ~ self.square_event_enum.box
			self.square_event_progress = self.square_event_progress & not_box
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_guild_warp_01')
			local box = self.get_box()
			unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate("FX_reset_object"):Instantiate(box.Position)
			box.Position = vector(106,0,26)
			unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate("FX_reset_object"):Instantiate(box.Position)
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end
--endregion

--region police_sns
function local_class:police_sns_call()
	self.is_saw_sns_call = true

	-- 부소장님, 첩보입니다.
	yield_return_func(self.controller.sns_message, self.controller, { target_name = 'steampunk_officer', portrait_name = 'steampunk_officer', key = 'nightmare_steampunk_covert_deal_11_1' })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'question', loop = false })
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(user_party.Leader, nil, 'question')

	user_party.Leader:HideWeapon(true)
	wait_for_sec(0.25)

	character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'twohand_idle' })
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 지금 진입하신 광장에서 놈이 거래를 시도한다고 합니다.
	yield_return_func(self.controller.sns_message, self.controller, { target_name = 'steampunk_officer', portrait_name = 'steampunk_officer', key = 'nightmare_steampunk_covert_deal_11_2' })

	-- 카메라, 살짝 줌아웃한 뒤 오른쪽으로 카메라 패닝하여 광장 전체를 보여준다.
	camera_util.resize_to(7, 1)
	camera_util.move_async(vector(104.5, 0, 31.5), 1, { ignorecameragrids = true })

	-- 이때, 심부름 꼬마, 자전거 주인 듀오, 자전거 도둑이 순서대로 각자 자신의 oneline 대사(위에 퀘스트 획득 전 대사 기준)를 한다.
	local girl = self.get_errand_girl()
	local owner_1 = self.get_bicycle_owner(1)
	local owner_2 = self.get_bicycle_owner(2)
	local thief = self.get_bicycle_thief()

	-- 나비야~ 나비야~ 이리 날아오너라~
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(girl, { key = 'nightmare_steampunk_covert_deal_oneline_2', skip = true })

	-- 지금 시각은? 접선 시간까지는 멀었나?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(owner_1, { key = 'nightmare_steampunk_covert_deal_oneline_4', skip = true })

	-- 쉿, 쓸데 없이 이목 끌지 말자고.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(owner_2, { key = 'nightmare_steampunk_covert_deal_oneline_5', skip = true })

	-- 여기를 이렇게 돌리면…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_clang_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(thief, { key = 'nightmare_steampunk_covert_deal_oneline_3', skip = true })

	-- 카메라, 원상복구.
	camera_util.resize_to_default(1)
	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

	-- 녀석이 나타날까요? 모쪼록 부탁드립니다!
	yield_return_func(self.controller.sns_message, self.controller, { target_name = 'steampunk_officer', portrait_name = 'steampunk_officer', key = 'nightmare_steampunk_covert_deal_11_3' })
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	user_party.Leader:HideWeapon(false)
	character_util.remove_anim(user_party.Leader)
end

--region bicycle_thief
-- 자전거 도둑에게 상호작용 했을 때
function local_class:interact_bicycle_thief()
	local thief = self.get_bicycle_thief()

	party_util.align_to_target(thief, 'down', 1, 'arc')

	-- 플레이어 자전거 도둑 아래 플레이어 정렬
	-- 자전거 도둑 (surprise, jump 1회, down)
	character_util.remove_anim(thief)
	character_util.look_at(thief, user_party.Leader)
	character_util.set_emotion(thief, { name = 'surprise' })
	character_util.normal_jump_async(thief, '01_player_jump_01')

	-- 자전거 도둑, 약하게 캐릭터 쉐이킹
	character_util.shake(thief, 0.02, 99999)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 자전거 도둑 (scared, idle) : 어… 음… 내 자전거 근사하지?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(thief, { name = 'scared' })
	character_util.set_anim(thief, { name = 'cast' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(thief, { key = 'nightmare_steampunk_covert_deal_12', skip = true })

	-- 자전거 도둑 좌, 우로 두리번 거림
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_direction(thief, 'left')
	character_util.set_anim(thief, { name = 'idle' })
	thief.SpineController:ForceUpdateSpines(0)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_direction(thief, 'right')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 자전거 도둑 (scared, idle) : …새로 산거다 보니 음… 지금 세팅 하는 중이야!
	character_util.look_at(thief, user_party.Leader)
	character_util.remove_anim(thief)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(thief, { key = 'nightmare_steampunk_covert_deal_13', skip = true })

	-- 플레이어 (idle, question) ‘?’ 이모티콘 표시
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(user_party.Leader, nil, 'question')

	-- 자전거 도둑 (scared, release 2회) : 그, 그 눈빛은 뭐, 뭐야! 내가 뭐 남의 자전거를 훔치는 중이기라도 한 것 같아?!
	character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(thief, { name = 'release', count = 2, sfx = '01_swing_01' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(thief, { key = 'nightmare_steampunk_covert_deal_14', skip = true })

	-- 대화 종료
	-- 자전거 도둑 다시 자전거 방향 보고 eat 상태 전환
	character_util.set_direction(thief, 'right')
	character_util.remove_emotion(thief)
	character_util.set_anim(thief, { name = 'eat' })
	character_util.stop_shake(thief)

	character_util.remove_relate_event(thief, self.controller)

	local owner_1 = self.get_bicycle_owner(1)
	local owner_2 = self.get_bicycle_owner(2)
	character_util.add_listener(owner_1, self.controller)
	character_util.add_listener(owner_2, self.controller)

	-- 캐릭터 쉐이크 제거
	-- 재 인터랙션 시
	-- 자전거 도둑 : 세팅 중이니까 방해하지마!
	thief.Interactable.Talk = 'nightmare_steampunk_covert_deal_15'

	self.square_event_progress = self.square_event_progress | self.square_event_enum.bicycle_thief
end

-- 상자에 들어가고 나올 때 살짝 들리는 연출
function local_class:rotate_box(box, rotation, duration)
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_gatcha_box_remove_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local start_rotation = box.Transform.localRotation.eulerAngles.x

	local start_y = box.Transform.localPosition.y
	local end_y

	if rotation > 0 then
		end_y = 0.5
	else
		end_y = 0
	end

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < duration do
		local cur_rotation = CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear(
			unity_class.time.time - cur_time, start_rotation, rotation, duration)

		box.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(cur_rotation, 0, 0))

		local cur_y = CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear(
			unity_class.time.time - cur_time, start_y, end_y - start_y, duration)

		box.Transform.localPosition = vector(box.Transform.localPosition.x, cur_y, box.Transform.localPosition.z)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	box.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(start_rotation + rotation, 0, 0))
	box.Transform.localPosition = vector(box.Transform.localPosition.x, end_y, box.Transform.localPosition.z)
end
--endregion

local local_class = newclass('NightmareSteampunkFindingPennySection1')

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	self.get_requester = function() return get_character('penny_requester') end
end

function local_class:enter()
	character_util.add_listener(self.get_requester(), self.controller)
end

function local_class:start()

end

function local_class:exit()
	character_util.remove_relate_event(self.get_requester(), self.controller)
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_requester()) then
			character_util.remove_relate_event(self.get_requester(), self.controller)
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.talk_with_requester, self)
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:talk_with_requester()
	local requester = self.get_requester()

	--페니 오빠 옆에 파티 정렬
	party_util.align_to_target(requester, 'left', 1, 'linear')

	--tired, question “부소장님, 혹시 우리 페니 못 보셨나요?”

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(requester,
			{key = 'nightmare_steampunk_finding_penny_1', skip = true})

	--tired, idle, “이상해요, 요즘따라 어딜 자꾸 다니는지…”

			'nightmare_steampunk_finding_penny_2')

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(requester,
			{key = 'nightmare_steampunk_finding_penny_3', skip = true})

local local_class = newclass('NightmareSteampunkFindingPennySection2')

	self.get_penny_2 = function() return get_character('penny_2') end
	self.get_penny_3 = function() return get_character('penny_3') end
	self.get_refugee = function(num) return get_character('penny_refugee_' .. num) end
	self.get_soldier = function(num) return get_character('penny_soldier_' .. num) end
	self.get_invader = function(num) return get_character('penny_invader_' .. num) end

	self.refugee_count = 4
	self.soldier_count = 4
	self.invader_count = 3

	self.inner_state = {
		none = 0,
		penny_run = 1,
		meet_invader = 2,
		done = 99
	}

	self.event_state = {
		none = 0,
		penny_run = 1,
		back_talk = 2,
		after_back_talk = 3,
		one_line_talk = 4,
		after_penny_gone = 5,
		done = 99
	}

	self.refugee_event_state = self.event_state.none
	self.soldier_event_state = self.event_state.none

	self.current_inner_state = self.inner_state.none

	self.battle_name = 'penny_battle'

	self.penny_solider_index = 3
	self.penny_refugee_index = 4
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent), 'on_camera_grid_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_battle_group_eliminated_event')

	for i = 1, self.refugee_count do
		local refugee = self.get_refugee(i)
		refugee.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
	end

	for i = 1, self.soldier_count do
		local soldier = self.get_soldier(i)
		soldier.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
	end

	for i = 1, self.invader_count do
		local invader = self.get_invader(i)

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then
		if e.Zone.Name == 'penny_back_talk_1' and self.refugee_event_state == self.event_state.penny_run then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.back_talk_1_routine, self)

			return true
		elseif e.Zone.Name == 'penny_back_talk_2' and self.soldier_event_state == self.event_state.penny_run then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.back_talk_2_routine, self)

			return true

		elseif e.Zone.Name == 'penny_invader_room' and self.current_inner_state == self.inner_state.penny_run then
			self.current_inner_state = self.inner_state.meet_invader
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.before_battle_scene, self)

			return true

		elseif e.Zone.Name == 'penny_disappear_1' and self.refugee_event_state == self.event_state.one_line_talk then
			self.refugee_event_state = self.event_state.after_penny_gone
			speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(self.get_refugee(self.penny_refugee_index))
			self.get_refugee(self.penny_refugee_index).ActiveState = active_state('disabled')

			return true

		elseif e.Zone.Name == 'penny_disappear_2' and self.soldier_event_state == self.event_state.one_line_talk then
			self.soldier_event_state = self.event_state.after_penny_gone
			speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(self.get_soldier(self.penny_solider_index))
			self.get_soldier(self.penny_solider_index).ActiveState = active_state('disabled')

			return true

		elseif e.Zone.Name == 'penny_run_3' and self.current_inner_state == self.inner_state.none then
			self.current_inner_state = self.inner_state.penny_run
			self.refugee_event_state = self.event_state.after_penny_gone
			self.soldier_event_state = self.event_state.after_penny_gone

			speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(self.get_refugee(self.penny_refugee_index))
			self.get_refugee(self.penny_refugee_index).ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
			speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(self.get_soldier(self.penny_solider_index))
			self.get_soldier(self.penny_solider_index).ActiveState = active_state('disabled')

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.penny_run_3, self))

			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, 'penny_run_1')
			and self.refugee_event_state == self.event_state.none then
		self.refugee_event_state = self.event_state.penny_run
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.penny_run_1, self))

		return true

	elseif type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, 'penny_room_1')
			and self.refugee_event_state == self.event_state.after_back_talk then
		self.refugee_event_state = self.event_state.one_line_talk

		return true

	elseif type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, 'penny_run_2')
			and self.soldier_event_state == self.event_state.none then
		self.soldier_event_state = self.event_state.penny_run
		wp_util.move_way_points(self.get_penny_2(),
				{waypoints = vector(87.5, 0, -40), speed = 7, run = true, play_sfx = true,
				 callback = function()
					self.get_penny_2().ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
				end})

		return true

	elseif type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, 'penny_room_2')
			and self.soldier_event_state == self.event_state.after_back_talk then
		self.soldier_event_state = self.event_state.one_line_talk

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	if e.BattleGroupName == self.battle_name then
		sp_util.play_battle_end_screenplay(self.after_battle_scene, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:exit()
    message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
    message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))
    message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
    message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))

    self.controller = nil
    self.quest_spec = nil

    self.audios_source_holder = nil
end

function local_class:dispose()
end

--region event related
function local_class:on_event(e)

    return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
    if e.FullEnter == false then return false end
    if e.FieldObject ~= user_party_leader then return false end

    if e.Zone.Name == 'dog_zone' and self.progress == self.enum.none then
        coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.check_dog_distance, self))
    end
    return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
    if e.FullLeave == false then return false end
    if e.FieldObject ~= user_party_leader then return false end

    if e.Zone.Name == 'dog_zone' and self.is_in_dog_zone == true then
        self.is_in_dog_zone = false
    end

    return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
    if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.telephone_box) then
        sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_telephone_box, self)
    end
    return false
end

function local_class:on_touch_event(e)
    if self.check_tap then
        if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.TouchDown and self.time_since_last_tap_count > 0.3 then
            coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,  util.cs_generator(self.jump_react_on_biting, self, user_party_leader))
        end
    end
    return false
end
--endregion

--region custom function
function local_class:jump_react_on_biting(target)
    local dog_corgi = self.get_dog_corgi()
    music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_jump_01')
    character_util.jump_move(target, target.Position +
            vector(self.jump_dir_val * 0.5, 0, 0), 3, 0.4, false)
    character_util.jump_move(dog_corgi, dog_corgi.Position +
            vector(self.jump_dir_val * 0.5, 0, 0), 3, 0.4, false)

    self.jump_dir_val = self.jump_dir_val * -1
    self.time_since_last_tap_count = 0
    self.tap_count = self.tap_count + 1

    camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.1)
end

function local_class:check_dog_distance()
    self.is_in_dog_zone = true
    local dog_corgi = self.dog_corgi
    local distance

    -- 거리에 따른 강아지의 행동 설정
    while true do
        if self.is_in_dog_zone == false or self.progress ~= self.enum.none then
            break
        end
        distance = math.sqrt(user_party_leader.Position:SqrDistance(vector(dog_corgi.Position.x, 0, dog_corgi.Position.z)))

        local barking = (distance < self.barking_distance and distance >= self.bite_distance)
        local biting = (distance < self.bite_distance)

        if barking == true then
            local dir = (user_party_leader.Position - dog_corgi.Position).normalized
            local str_dir = dir.x < 0 and 'left' or 'right'
            str_dir = math.abs(dir.x) < math.abs(dir.z) and 'down' or str_dir
            character_util.set_direction(dog_corgi, str_dir)

            if self.dog_state ~= self.dog_state_enum.barking then
                self.dog_state = self.dog_state_enum.barking
                character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(dog_corgi, {name = 'angry'}, {name = 'mad'})
                music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_pet_grr_01')
            end
        elseif biting == true then
            if self.dog_state ~= self.dog_state_enum.biting then
                self.dog_state = self.dog_state_enum.biting
                sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.dog_attack_player, self)
            end
        elseif barking == false and biting == false then
            if self.dog_state ~= self.dog_state_enum.idle then
                self.dog_state = self.dog_state_enum.idle
                character_util.set_direction(dog_corgi, 'right')
                character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(dog_corgi, {name = 'idle'}, {name = 'idle'})
            end
        end

        coroutine.yield(nil)
    end

    character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(dog_corgi)
end

-- 강아지가 플레이어를 공격하는 루틴
function local_class:dog_attack_player()
    local dog_corgi = self.dog_corgi
    dog_corgi.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance

    self:dog_biting_part(user_party_leader)

    for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
        character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(user_party[i], {name = 'embarrassed'}, {name = 'scared'})
    end

    character_util.set_locked_dir(dog_corgi, 'right')
    character_util.set_locked_dir(user_party_leader, 'left')

    camera_util.shake(0.05, math.huge)
    character_util.shake(dog_corgi, 0.03, math.huge)
    camera_util.resize_to(3, 0.3)
    stage.Field:Darken("qte", 0.5, 0.3)
    wait_for_sec(0.3)
    self.check_tap = true
    CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowTurboTap(1)
    local total_time_passed = 0

    while true do
        local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime
        self.time_since_last_tap_count = self.time_since_last_tap_count + dt
        total_time_passed = total_time_passed + dt

        if self.tap_count >= 7 or total_time_passed > 5 then
            if self.audios_source_holder ~= nil then
                self.audios_source_holder:FadeOut()
            end
            music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field' })
            self.tap_count = 0
            self.check_tap = false
            self.jump_dir_val = 1
            break
        end

        coroutine.yield(nil)
    end

    self.dog_corgi.SpineController:SetSortingLayer('Default', 0)
    camera_util.cancel_shake()
    character_util.stop_shake(dog_corgi)
    camera_util.resize_to_default(0.3)
    stage.Field:Undarken("qte", 0.3)
    wait_for_sec(0.3)

    for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
        character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party[i])
    end
    character_util.remove_anim(dog_corgi)
    character_util.jump_move(dog_corgi, self.get_dog_corgi_marker().position, 4, 1, false)
    character_util.set_locked_dir(user_party_leader, 'none')
    CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.CloseTutorialSpine()
    party_util.align_party(self.get_dog_corgi_marker().position + vector(2, 0, 0), 'right', 0.8, 'arc')
    wait_for_sec(0.5)

    dog_corgi.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.NPCCrashBehaviour.Instance
    character_util.set_locked_dir(dog_corgi, 'none')
    character_util.set_direction(dog_corgi, 'right')

    wait_for_sec(0.5)
end

-- 강아지가 타겟을 물기 위해 뛰어드는 행동을 수행하는 함수
function local_class:dog_biting_part(target)
    local dog_corgi = self.dog_corgi
    dog_corgi.SpineController:SetSortingLayer('Default', 1)

    music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_pet_attack_02')
    music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_01')

    local target_jump_pos = target.Position + self.bite_offset
    character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(dog_corgi,
            {name = 'attack', loop = false}, {name = 'mad'})
    character_util.jump_move(dog_corgi, target_jump_pos, 4, 1, false)
    character_util.set_locked_dir(dog_corgi, 'none')

    while target_jump_pos ~= dog_corgi.Position do
        coroutine.yield(nil)
    end
    character_util.set_direction(dog_corgi, 'right')
    character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(dog_corgi, {name = 'bite'}, {name = 'bite'})

    music_player.StageBgmState = CS.Oak.StageBgmState.Muted
    self.audios_source_holder = music_player_util.play_sfx({
        sfx_name = '03_pet_bite_loop_01', loop = true, type_priority = "loop", player_priority = "npc"})
end

function local_class:interact_telephone_box()
    local telephone_box = self.controller.get_telephone_box()
    party_util.align_party(telephone_box.Position,
            direction_util.get_opposite(user_party_leader.Direction), 0.5,'arc')

    local leader_origin_pos = user_party_leader.Position
    music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_door_push_01')
    camera_util.move(telephone_box.Position, 0.75)
    character_util.move_waypoint_async(user_party_leader, telephone_box.Position, 2, false, 'stop')
    character_util.set_position(user_party_leader, vector(999, 0, 999))

    local wait = true
    local ans = -1

    local branches = create_generic_list(typeof(CS.Oak.TalkBranch))
    branches:Add({
        -- 부유성에 전화한다.
        Text = game_string:GetString('nightmare_steampunk_hidden_starpiece_6'),
        Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Mercy,
        Callback = function()
            wait = false
            ans = 1
        end
    })
    branches:Add({
        -- 동물보호청에 전화한다.
        Text = game_string:GetString('nightmare_steampunk_hidden_starpiece_7'),
        Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Intellect,
        Callback = function()
            wait = false
            ans = 2
        end
    })

    ui_overlay_util.push_overlay(nil, branches)

    while wait do
        coroutine.yield(nil)
    end

    if ans == 1 then
        local rock_state = quest_util.get_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.custom_key)
        if rock_state == -1 then
            -- 공주님으로부터 힘내라는 응원을 받았다.
            field_ui_util.show_narration_async({key = 'nightmare_steampunk_hidden_starpiece_8'})
            -- 공주님이 가짜 바위를 만들어서 길을 막아두고 스타피스를 숨겨두었으니 찾아가라고 당부한다.
            field_ui_util.show_narration_async({key = 'nightmare_steampunk_hidden_starpiece_8_1'})
        else
            -- 공주님으로부터 힘내라는 응원을 들었다.
            field_ui_util.show_narration_async({key = 'nightmare_steampunk_hidden_starpiece_8_2'})
        end
    elseif ans == 2 then
        -- 사나운 강아지에 대해 신고했다. 동물보호청으로부터 곧바로 출동하겠다는 답변을 받았다.
        field_ui_util.show_narration_async({key = 'nightmare_steampunk_hidden_starpiece_9'})
        self.progress = self.enum.call
        self:poacher_event()
    end

    character_util.set_position(user_party_leader, telephone_box.Position)
    camera_util.return_to_leader(0.01)
    music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_door_push_01')
    wait_for_sec(0.01)
    character_util.move_waypoint_async(user_party_leader, leader_origin_pos, 3, false, 'stop')
end

function local_class:poacher_event()
    local dog_corgi = self.get_dog_corgi()
    local poacher = self.get_poacher()
    local poacher_lady = self.get_poacher_lady()
    local poacher_marker = self.get_poacher_appear_marker()

    camera_util.move(poacher_marker.position, 1)
    wait_for_sec(2)

    character_util.set_anim(poacher, {name = 'walk'})
    character_util.set_anim(poacher_lady, {name = 'walk'})

    character_util.set_position(poacher, poacher_marker.position + vector(-0.5, 0, -5))
    character_util.set_position(poacher_lady, poacher_marker.position  + vector(0.5, 0, -5))

    local poacher_dest_pos = poacher_marker.position + vector(-0.5, 0, 0)
    local poacher_lady_dest_pos = poacher_marker.position + vector(0.5, 0, 0)

    character_util.move_waypoint(poacher, poacher_dest_pos,
            3, false, 'stop', 'floor', 'up')
    character_util.move_waypoint(poacher_lady, poacher_lady_dest_pos,
            3, false, 'stop', 'floor', 'up')

    while poacher.Position ~= poacher_dest_pos do
        coroutine.yield(nil)
    end
    character_util.remove_anim(poacher)
    character_util.remove_anim(poacher_lady)
    wait_for_sec(1)

    -- 두리번 거리는 사냥꾼들
    local look_around_dir = {'right', 'left'}

    for i = 1, 2 do
        music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
        character_util.set_direction(poacher, look_around_dir[i])
        character_util.set_direction(poacher_lady, look_around_dir[i])
        wait_for_sec(0.75)
    end

    wait_for_sec(0.5)
    character_util.normal_jump_async(poacher, '01_small_jump_01')
    music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
    -- 저기, 저깄네!
    speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(poacher, {key = 'nightmare_steampunk_hidden_starpiece_10', skip = true})
    character_util.move_waypoint_async(poacher, dog_corgi.Position + vector(2, 0, 0), 3, false, 'stop')
    character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(dog_corgi, {name = 'angry'}, {name = 'mad'})
    music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_pet_grr_01')
    -- 녀석, 제법 통통한 게 귀여운 걸?
    speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(poacher, {key = 'nightmare_steampunk_hidden_starpiece_11', skip = true})
    -- 라 제국 출신 강아지라니, 팔면 제법…
    speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(poacher, {key = 'nightmare_steampunk_hidden_starpiece_12', skip = true})

    -- 미쳤어?
    speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(poacher_lady, {key = 'nightmare_steampunk_hidden_starpiece_13', skip = true})
    character_util.set_emotion(poacher_lady, {name = 'mad'})
    character_util.jump(poacher_lady, 0.4, 0.3)
    music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_jump_01')
    wait_for_sec(1)
    character_util.shake(poacher_lady, 0.03, 0.3)
    wait_for_sec(0.3)
    character_util.set_direction(poacher, 'right')
    wait_for_sec(0.15)
    music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_small_jump_01')
    character_util.set_emotion(poacher, {name = 'surprise'})
    character_util.jump(poacher, 0.4, 0.3)
    wait_for_sec(0.35)
    character_util.set_anim(poacher_lady, {name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01'})

    music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
    -- 그랬다가 걸리면, 그 라 제국 공주님이 가만 있을 것 같아?
    speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(poacher_lady, {key = 'nightmare_steampunk_hidden_starpiece_14', skip = true})
    character_util.remove_anim(poacher_lady)
    character_util.set_emotion(poacher_lady, {name = 'tired'})
    -- 동물 좀 다뤄본 적 있다고 동물보호청에서 일하게 해준 것만 해도 감지덕지야.
    speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(poacher_lady, {key = 'nightmare_steampunk_hidden_starpiece_15', skip = true})

    character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(poacher_lady, {name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01'}, {name = 'attack'})
    -- 괜히 욕심 부리다가 다시 수용소 끌려가서 노가다 하고 싶지 않으면 내 말 들어.
    speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(poacher_lady, {key = 'nightmare_steampunk_hidden_starpiece_16', skip = true})

    character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(poacher_lady)
    character_util.remove_anim(poacher)
    character_util.set_emotion(poacher, {name = 'tired'})
    music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
    -- 농담이에요, 저도 안다구요…
    speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(poacher, {key = 'nightmare_steampunk_hidden_starpiece_17', skip = true})

    wait_for_sec(0.5)
    character_util.set_direction(poacher, 'left')
    character_util.set_emotion(poacher, 'doyagao')
    -- 운 좋은 줄 알아 멍멍아. 넌 라 제국 동물 보호소로 가는 거야.
    speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(poacher, {key = 'nightmare_steampunk_hidden_starpiece_18', skip = true})
    wait_for_sec(0.3)

    character_util.move_waypoint_async(poacher, dog_corgi.Position + vector(1, 0, 0), 3, false, 'stop')

    camera_util.move(poacher.Position, 0.3)
    camera_util.resize_to(3, 0.3)
    wait_for_sec(0.3)

    self:dog_biting_part(poacher)
    character_util.set_locked_dir(dog_corgi, 'right')
    character_util.shake(dog_corgi, 0.03, math.huge)
    character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(poacher, {name = 'embarrassed'}, {name = 'surprise'})
    character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(poacher_lady, {name = 'embarrassed'}, {name = 'scared'})

    camera_util.shake(0.05, math.huge)
    character_util.set_locked_dir(poacher, 'left')

    -- 으아아아악!
    speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(poacher, {key = 'nightmare_steampunk_hidden_starpiece_20', skip = true})
    music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
    -- 꺅! 뭐, 뭐야!
    speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(poacher_lady, {key = 'nightmare_steampunk_hidden_starpiece_21', skip = true})

    local jump_times = 4
    for i = 1, jump_times do
        coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,  util.cs_generator(self.jump_react_on_biting, self, poacher))
        wait_for_sec(0.5)
    end

    camera_util.move(poacher_marker.position, 0.3)
    camera_util.resize_to_default(0.3)
    camera_util.cancel_shake()
    character_util.set_locked_dir(poacher, 'none')
    character_util.set_locked_dir(dog_corgi, 'none')
    character_util.remove_anim(poacher)
    character_util.remove_anim(dog_corgi)
    character_util.set_emotion(dog_corgi, {name = 'mad'})

    character_util.jump_move(dog_corgi, poacher.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0), 4, 1, false, 'right')
    while dog_corgi.Position.y ~= 0 do
        coroutine.yield(nil)
    end

    -- 저리가! 저리가아아아!
    speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(poacher, {key = 'nightmare_steampunk_hidden_starpiece_22', skip = true})

    local dash_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_dash_01', loop = true})
    coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.run_away, self, poacher))
    wait_for_sec(0.1)
    self:run_away(dog_corgi)
    dash_sfx:Stop()

    character_util.remove_anim(poacher_lady)
    music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
    -- 거, 거기 서
    speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(poacher_lady, {key = 'nightmare_steampunk_hidden_starpiece_23', skip = true})
    local poacher_lady_pos = poacher_lady.Position
    character_util.move_waypoint_async(poacher_lady, poacher_lady_pos + vector(0, 0, -5), 6, true)
    dash_sfx:Stop()

    if self.audios_source_holder ~= nil then
        self.audios_source_holder:FadeOut()
    end
    music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field' })

    camera_util.cancel_shake()
    self.dog_corgi.SpineController:SetSortingLayer('Default', 0)
    character_util.stop_shake(dog_corgi)
    character_util.reset_all_state(poacher, 'right')
    character_util.reset_all_state(poacher_lady, 'right')
    character_util.reset_all_state(dog_corgi, 'right')

    character_util.set_active_state(poacher, 'disabled')
    character_util.set_active_state(poacher_lady, 'disabled')
    character_util.set_active_state(dog_corgi, 'disabled')
    self.progress = self.enum.clear
    camera_util.move_async(self.controller.get_telephone_box().Position, 1)

    yield_return_func(quest_util.complete_quest, self.controller, 0, false, false, false)
end

function local_class:run_away(target)
    local poacher_marker = self.get_poacher_appear_marker()

    local waypoints = {
        vector(-25, 0, 49.5),
        vector(-25, 0,  48),
        vector(-27.5, 0, 48),
        vector(-27.5, 0, 49.5)
    }
    local exit_waypoints = {
        vector(poacher_marker.position.x - 0.5, 0, 49.5),
        vector(poacher_marker.position.x - 0.5, 0, 44)
    }

    for i = 1, 5 do
        local idx = (i > 4) and i - 4 or i
        local waypoint = waypoints[idx]
        character_util.move_waypoint_async(target, waypoint, 6, true)
    end

    character_util.move_waypoint_async(target, exit_waypoints[1], 6, true)
    character_util.move_waypoint_async(target, exit_waypoints[2], 6, true)
end
--endregion

return local_class

local local_class = newclass('NightmareSteampunkMainSection1')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = NightmareSteampunkMain @
		Comment = 아이샤의 명을 받고 순찰 @
		Index = 0 @
		NextSections = 1 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	self.get_ishya = controller.get_ishya
	self.ishya_portrait_name = 'steam_princess.png'

	self.stage_name = 'nightmare_steampunk_1'

	self.controller.shake = true

	self.origin_party = nil

	self.saw_train_event = false
	self.saw_reporter_event = false

	self.scrap_origin_pos = nil
	self.scrap_origin_pos = nil
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return true
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')

	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.PreloadStageTitle()

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		self.controller:set_default_quest_marker()
	else
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.ishya_order, self)
	end

end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter == false then return false end
	if e.FieldObject ~= user_party_leader then return false end
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == 'section_1_start' and self.saw_train_event == true and self.saw_reporter_event == false then
		self.saw_reporter_event = true
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.stage_start, self)
	end

	return false

function local_class:scrap_shake()
	local timer = 0.35
	local duration = 0.75

	self.controller.scrap_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_amb_mining_01', loop = true,
															 type_priority = 'loop', play_pos = get_field_object('s1_scrap_4').Position})

	while self.controller.shake do
		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if timer >= duration then
			timer = 0
			for i = 1, 4 do
				local scrap = get_field_object('s1_scrap_' .. i)
				scrap:Shake(0.04, 0.5)
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

return local_class

local local_class = newclass('NightmareSteampunkMainSection2')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = NightmareSteampunkMain @
		Comment = 그날 밤, 암살당하는 전 소장. 이를 빌미로 첫째왕자가 와서 조롱한다. @
		Index = 1 @
		NextSections = 2 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	-- 마지막 레버
	self.get_lever = function()
		return get_field_object('s2_lever')
	end

	self.get_ishya = controller.get_ishya

	self.ishya_portrait_name = 'steam_princess.png'

	self.stage_name = 'nightmare_steampunk_1'

	self.section_progress = {
		-- 초기값
		none = 0,
		-- 전 소장 살해당하는 이벤트
		dead_ex_manager = 1,
		-- 다음날 아이샤와 대화함
		next_day_morning = 2,
		-- 잘 해보려는데 비명소리가 들림
		screaming = 3,
		-- 시체 수습하고 하려는데 오라버니 뜸
		clean_body = 4
	}

	---1 assassinate_event
	---2 ready_for_work
	---3 screaming
	---4 body_investigation
	---5 truth
	---6 investigation

	self.current_progress = self.section_progress.none

	self.residence_interactable = nil

	self.crystal_shaking = false

	self.duration = 0.6

	self.investigation_count = 0

	self.saw_slacking_off = false

	self.ishya_eat = nil
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return true
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')

	self:set_environment()

	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.PreloadStageTitle()

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		self.controller:set_default_quest_marker()
	else
		CS.Oak.UIQuestMarkersController.Instance:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('nightmare_steampunk_main', self.quest_spec.QuestId,
				self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, self:get_lever())
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	CS.Oak.UIQuestMarkersController.Instance:RemoveQuestMarker('nightmare_steampunk_main')

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

	self.residence_interactable = nil
end

function local_class:dispose()

	local ishya = self.get_ishya()
	if ishya ~= nil then
		character_util.remove_relate_event(ishya, self.controller.cs_controller)
	end

	local ex_manager = get_character('s2_ex_manager')
	if ex_manager ~= nil then
		character_util.remove_relate_event(ex_manager, self.controller.cs_controller)
	end

	local target = {get_character('s2_sub_refugee_1'), get_character('s2_sub_refugee_3'), get_character('s2_sub_refugee_7')}
	for i = 1, #target do
		if target[i] ~= nil then
			character_util.remove_relate_event(target[i], self.controller.cs_controller)
		end
	end

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

--region on event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self:get_lever()) and self.current_progress == self.section_progress.none then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.assassinate_event, self)
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_character('s2_ex_manager'))
			and self.current_progress == self.section_progress.screaming then
		self.current_progress = self.section_progress.clean_body
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.body_investigation, self)
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_ishya()) then
		if self.current_progress == self.section_progress.dead_ex_manager then
			self.current_progress = self.section_progress.next_day_morning
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.ready_for_work, self)
		elseif self.current_progress == self.section_progress.clean_body then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.truth, self)
		end
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_character('s2_sub_refugee_5')) then
		--'nightmare_steampunk_main_s2_0'

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
			local worker = get_character('s2_sub_refugee_5')
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(worker, {key = 'nightmare_steampunk_main_s2_0'})
			--요새 수용소에 수상한 사람들이 돌아다녀...
		end))
	else
		local target = {get_character('s2_sub_refugee_1'), get_character('s2_sub_refugee_3'), get_character('s2_sub_refugee_7')}
		for i = 1, #target do
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, target[i]) then
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.investigation, self, i)
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter == false then return false end
	if e.FieldObject ~= user_party_leader then return false end
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == 'section_2_marker_1' and self.current_progress == self.section_progress.dead_ex_manager then
		self.current_progress = self.section_progress.next_day_morning
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.ready_for_work, self)
	elseif zone_name == 'section_2_scream' and self.current_progress == self.section_progress.next_day_morning then
		self.current_progress = self.section_progress.screaming
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.screaming, self))
	elseif zone_name == 'section_2_slacking_off' and self.saw_slacking_off == false and self.current_progress == self.section_progress.none then
		self.saw_slacking_off = true
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.slacking_off, self))
	else
		local marker_target = {get_field_object('residence_exit'), get_character('s2_ex_manager')}
		if self.current_progress == self.section_progress.next_day_morning then
			for i = 1, 2 do
				if zone_name == 'section_2_marker_' .. i then
					CS.Oak.UIQuestMarkersController.Instance:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('nightmare_steampunk_main', self.quest_spec.QuestId,
							self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, marker_target[i])
					if i == 2 then
						message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.SetBackgroundColorEvent.Create(CS.UnityEngine.Color32(255, 255, 255, 255), 0))
						if self.current_progress == self.section_progress.next_day_morning then
							music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_intro_steampunk_01')
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:slacking_off()

	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(function ()
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(ex_manager, {key = 'nightmare_steampunk_main_s2_0_1'})
			--아~ 일하기 싫다~~

		util.cs_generator(function ()
			wait_for_sec(1)

			for i = 1, #soldiers do
				character_util.set_direction(soldiers[i], 'up')
				character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(soldiers[i], 0, 0)
				character_util.set_position(soldiers[i], ex_manager.Position + vector(-1.5, 0, -8.5 -i))

						5, false, nil, nil, 'right')

			wait_for_sec(2)
		end)
	})

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(soldiers[1], {key = 'nightmare_steampunk_main_s2_0_2'})
	--이 분 또 이러고 계시네~ 저기요, 할당량 반도 못 채우셨어요~

	character_util.normal_jump_async(ex_manager, '01_small_jump_01')

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(ex_manager, {key = 'nightmare_steampunk_main_s2_0_3'})

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(ex_manager, {key = 'nightmare_steampunk_main_s2_0_4'})

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(soldiers[2], {key = 'nightmare_steampunk_main_s2_0_4_1'})
	--이젠 전 소장님이시잖아요…

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(soldiers[2], {key = 'nightmare_steampunk_main_s2_0_5'})

	character_util.remove_anim(soldiers[2])

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function ()
		for i = 1, #soldiers do
			character_util.move_waypoint(soldiers[i], soldiers[i].Position + vector(0, 0, -10),
