function local_class:screaming()
	local ishya = self.get_ishya()
	local leader = user_party_leader
	local ex_manager = get_character('s2_ex_manager')

	CS.Oak.UIQuestMarkersController.Instance:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('nightmare_steampunk_main', self.quest_spec.QuestId,
			self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, ex_manager)

	character_util.add_listener(ex_manager, self.controller.cs_controller)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_teatan_scream_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
	camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.5)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(ishya, {key = 'nightmare_steampunk_main_s2_11',
														screen_pos = vector(0, -150), bubble_type = 'shout'})
	--으아아아아아아!

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_crowd_buzz_01', fade_out_time = 2})

	local sub_refugee = {}
	for i = 1, 7 do
		local npc = get_character('s2_sub_refugee_' .. i)
		sub_refugee[i] = npc
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_crowd_shout_05')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sub_refugee[2], {key = 'nightmare_steampunk_main_s2_11_1'})
	--이… 이게 뭐야!

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_01')
	camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.3)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sub_refugee[6], {key = 'nightmare_steampunk_main_s2_11_2', bubble_type = 'shout'})
	--시… 시체다! 시체야!

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sub_refugee[1], {key = 'nightmare_steampunk_main_s2_11_3'})
	--저… 정말 주… 죽은 거야?
end

function local_class:body_investigation()
	local ex_manager = get_character('s2_ex_manager')
	local ishya = self.get_ishya()
	local leader = user_party_leader
	local refugee = {get_character('s2_refugee_1'), get_character('s2_refugee_2')}

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_boss_intro', state = 'event', mix = 2 })

	character_util.remove_relate_event(ex_manager, self.controller.cs_controller)

	camera_util.move(ex_manager.Position + vector(0, 0, 0), 1)

	character_util.convert_to_npc(ishya)
	character_util.move_waypoint(ishya, {ex_manager.Position + vector(1, 0, 0)},
			4, false, nil, nil, 'left')

	party_util.align_to_target(ex_manager, 'up', 1, 'arc')

	character_util.show_emoticon_async(ishya, nil, 'notice')

	character_util.set_emotion(ishya, {name = 'scared'})

	character_util.normal_jump_async(ishya, '01_jump_01')

	local eat_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true })
	character_util.set_anim(ishya, {name = 'eat'})

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(ishya, {key = 'nightmare_steampunk_main_s2_14', skip = true,
														portraitname = self.ishya_portrait_name})
	--이건…

	eat_sfx:Stop()
	character_util.remove_anim(ishya)
	character_util.set_emotion(ishya, {name = 'sleep_deep'})

	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'nightmare_steampunk_main_s2_body_investigation_1'})
	--캔터베리 수용소 전 소장의 시체이다.

	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'nightmare_steampunk_main_s2_body_investigation_2'})
	--대구경 소총에 의한 상처를 확인할 수 있다.

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	character_util.show_emoticon_async(ishya, nil, 'silence')
	character_util.remove_emotion(ishya)

	local sub_refugee = {}
	for i = 1, 7 do
		local npc = get_character('s2_sub_refugee_' .. i)
		sub_refugee[i] = npc
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_direction(ishya, 'right')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_direction(ishya, 'left')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_direction(ishya, 'right')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	character_util.set_emotion(ishya, {name = 'attack'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(ishya, {key = 'nightmare_steampunk_main_s2_12', skip = true,
														portraitname = self.ishya_portrait_name})
	--이곳은 내가 살펴보도록 하겠다!
	character_util.remove_anim(ishya)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sub_refugee[5], {key = 'nightmare_steampunk_main_s2_12_1', skip = true})
	--그… 그렇지만…

	character_util.set_direction(ishya, 'left')
	character_util.set_emotion(ishya, {name = 'attack'})
	character_util.normal_jump_async(ishya)

	camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.5)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_count_01')
	character_util.set_anim(ishya, {name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(ishya, {key = 'nightmare_steampunk_main_s2_12_2', skip = true,
														portraitname = self.ishya_portrait_name, bubble_type = 'shout'})
	--뭣들 하는 건가, 일과로 복귀하지 않고!
	character_util.remove_anim(ishya)

	for i = 1, #refugee do
		character_util.set_animation_n_times(refugee[i], {name = 'nod', count = 2})
	end

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(refugee[1], {key = 'nightmare_steampunk_main_s2_13', skip = true})
	--네… 네…!

	character_util.remove_emotion(ishya)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_dash_06')

	for i = 1, #sub_refugee do
		local target_marker_1 = field:GetMarker(sub_refugee[i].Name .. '_2')
		local target_marker_2 = field:GetMarker(sub_refugee[i].Name .. '_3')
		local way_point = {target_marker_1.position, target_marker_2.position}

		character_util.move_waypoint(sub_refugee[i], way_point, 4,
				false, nil, nil, target_marker_2.direction)
	end

	for i = 1, #refugee do
		local dir_vector = CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.ToVector3(refugee[i].Direction) * 2

		character_util.move_waypoint(refugee[i],
				{refugee[i].Position + dir_vector,
				 refugee[i].Position + vector(0, 0, -10) + dir_vector},
				4, false)
	end

	wait_for_sec(2.5)

	for i = 1, #refugee do
		character_util.stop_shake(refugee[i])
		character_util.set_position(refugee[i], vector(99, 0, 99))
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.5)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(ishya, {key = 'nightmare_steampunk_main_s2_15', skip = true,
														screen_pos = vector(-100, -150), bubble_type = 'shout'})
	--아이고, 이게 웬일이야!

	character_util.remove_anim(ishya)
	character_util.set_direction(ishya, 'down')

	local prince_marker = field:GetMarker('s1_ishya_start')
	local princes = {get_character('s2_prince'), get_character('s2_prince_guard_1'), get_character('s2_prince_guard_2')}
	for i = 1, #princes do
		character_util.set_position(princes[i], prince_marker.position + vector(-1, 0, 2 - i))
	end

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	for i = 1, #princes do
		character_util.move_waypoint(princes[i], ex_manager.Position + vector(-1, 0, 1 - i), 4, false)
	end

	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(function ()
			character_util.move_waypoint_async(princes[1], {ex_manager.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0)},
					4, false, nil, nil, 'right')

			character_util.set_direction(ishya, 'left')

			--쫄따구만 움직인다
			for i = 2, #princes do
				character_util.move_waypoint(princes[i], {princes[i].Position + vector(-0.7, 0, 0),
														  princes[i].Position + vector(-0.7, 0, 1.5)},
						4, false, nil, nil, 'right')
			end
		end),
		util.cs_generator(function ()
			wait_for_sec(2)

			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princes[1], {key = 'nightmare_steampunk_main_s2_16', skip = true})
			--아이고 우리 예~쁜 동생!
		end)
	})

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(princes[1], {name = 'bomb_idle'}, {name = 'doyagao'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princes[1], {key = 'nightmare_steampunk_main_s2_17', skip = true})
	--이게 웬 난리야~?
	character_util.remove_anim(princes[1])

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(ishya, {key = 'nightmare_steampunk_main_s2_18', skip = true,
														portraitname = self.ishya_portrait_name})
	--…오랜만이군요.

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(ishya, {key = 'nightmare_steampunk_main_s2_19', skip = true,
														portraitname = self.ishya_portrait_name})
	--…첫째 오라버니.

	character_util.nod_twice(princes[1])
	character_util.set_emotion(princes[1], {name = 'doyagao'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princes[1], {key = 'nightmare_steampunk_main_s2_20', skip = true})
	--그래, 아이샤. 요새 캔터베리 난민에게 기본 생활을 보장한다 어쩐다 너 요새 유명하더라?

	character_util.set_anim(princes[1], {name = 'bomb_idle'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princes[1], {key = 'nightmare_steampunk_main_s2_21', skip = true})
	--근데 이게 다 뭐니…

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.set_anim(princes[1], {name = 'question', loop = false})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princes[1], {key = 'nightmare_steampunk_main_s2_21_1', skip = true})
	--투명한 아이샤라면 이런 소식도 제국인에게 알려야겠지?

	character_util.set_direction(princes[1], 'down')
	character_util.set_emotion(princes[1], {name = 'attack'})

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_clap_02', duration = 0.35})
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(princes[1], {name = 'clap', count = 2})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(princes[1], {key = 'nightmare_steampunk_main_s2_21_2', skip = true})
	--자, 기자님들 여깁니다! 특종이에요!

	local reporters = {}
	for i = 1, 6 do
		local npc = get_character('s1_reporter_' .. i)
		local marker = field:GetMarker('s2_reporter_' .. i)
		character_util.set_with_marker(npc, marker)
		reporters[i] = npc
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_dash_06')
	local reporter_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_amb_interview_01', loop = true, fade_in_time = 2 })
	for i = 1, #reporters do
		character_util.move_waypoint(reporters[i], reporters[i].Position + vector(0, 0, 6), 5, false)
	end

	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.flash_light, self))

	wait_for_sec(2)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	character_util.normal_double_jump(reporters[1], '01_small_jump_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(reporters[1], {key = 'nightmare_steampunk_main_s2_21_3', skip = true})
	--피해자가 수용소 노동인 중 한 명인가요?

	character_util.set_anim(reporters[4], {name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(reporters[4], {key = 'nightmare_steampunk_main_s2_21_4', skip = true})
	--아이샤 님, 캔터베리 수용소의 치안에 대해 한 말씀…!
	character_util.remove_anim(reporters[4])

	reporter_sfx:FadeOut(2)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princes[1], {key = 'nightmare_steampunk_main_s2_21_5', skip = true})
	--우리 가여운 동생에게는 딱 하나의 죄 밖에 없습니다!

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_count_final_01')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(princes[1], {name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01'}, {name = 'attack'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princes[1], {key = 'nightmare_steampunk_main_s2_22', skip = true, bubble_type = 'shout'})
	--수용소 관리에 무능한 죄! 캔터베리인의 살인 행각을 거의 방치한 거나 다름 없죠!
	character_util.remove_anim(princes[1])

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(ishya, {name = 'attack'})
	character_util.normal_jump(ishya, '01_jump_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(ishya, {key = 'nightmare_steampunk_main_s2_23', skip = true,
														portraitname = self.ishya_portrait_name})
	--어째서 범인이 캔터베리인이라고 속단을…!

	character_util.set_direction(princes[1], 'right')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(princes[1], {name = 'bomb_idle'}, {name = 'doyagao'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princes[1], {key = 'nightmare_steampunk_main_s2_24', skip = true})
	--딱 보면 척이지.

	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(princes[1], {name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01'}, {name = 'attack'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princes[1], {key = 'nightmare_steampunk_main_s2_25', skip = true})
	--자기들을 괴롭혔던 이전 소장을 캔터베리인들이 놔둘 것 같아?!
	character_util.remove_anim(princes[1])

	character_util.set_emotion(ishya, {name = 'sleep_deep'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(ishya, {key = 'nightmare_steampunk_main_s2_26', skip = true,
														portraitname = self.ishya_portrait_name})
	--조사를 해 보면…

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(princes[1], {name = 'bomb_idle'}, {name = 'doyagao'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princes[1], {key = 'nightmare_steampunk_main_s2_27', skip = true})
	--황족이라면 상처받은 제국민들의 마음을 우선시 해야 되는거 아닌가?

	character_util.remove_emotion(ishya)

	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(princes[1], {name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01'}, {name = 'attack'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princes[1], {key = 'nightmare_steampunk_main_s2_28', skip = true})
	--황족이라면 상처받은 제국민들의 마음을 우선시 해야 되는거 아닌가?

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_male_laugh_at_01')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(princes[1], {name = 'question', loop = false}, {name = 'doyagao'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princes[1], {key = 'nightmare_steampunk_main_s2_29', skip = true})
	--…크크크크…
	character_util.remove_anim(princes[1])

	local reporter_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_amb_interview_01', loop = true, fade_in_time = 2 })
	character_util.set_direction(princes[1], 'down')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princes[1], {key = 'nightmare_steampunk_main_s2_30', skip = true})
	--기자님들, 그럼 내일 신문 1면 기사, 자알~ 부탁드립니다!

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princes[1], {key = 'nightmare_steampunk_main_s2_31', skip = true})
	--제목은… 잔혹한 제국민 혐오 범죄와 이를 방조하는 황녀… 정도가 어떨까요?

	for i = 1, 3 do
		character_util.set_direction(reporters[i], 'left')
	end
	for i = 4, 6 do
		character_util.move_waypoint(reporters[i], reporters[i].Position + vector(-1, 0, 0), 3, false, nil, nil, 'right')
	end

	character_util.move_waypoint(princes[2], princes[2].Position + vector(0.7, 0, 0),
			2, false, nil, nil, 'down')
	character_util.move_waypoint(princes[3], princes[3].Position + vector(0.7, 0, 0),
			2, false, nil, nil, 'down')

	character_util.move_waypoint_async(princes[1], princes[1].Position + vector(0, 0, -1.5),
			4, false, nil, nil, 'down')

	for i = 1, #princes do
		character_util.move_waypoint(princes[i], princes[i].Position + vector(0, 0, -6),
				3, false, nil, nil, 'down')
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	for i = 1, #reporters do
		local clms = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerLookAtState.Create(reporters[i], princes[1])
		reporters[i]:OnEvent(CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(clms))
	end

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(reporters[2], {key = 'nightmare_steampunk_main_s2_31_1', skip = true})
	--왕자님, 아이샤 님의 지위에 뭔가 변화가 생기게 될 까요?!

	wait_for_sec(2)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_dash_06')
	for i = 4, 6 do
		character_util.move_waypoint(reporters[i], reporters[i].Position + vector(1, 0, 0), 2, false, nil, nil, 'right')
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	for i = 1, #reporters do
		character_util.move_waypoint(reporters[i], reporters[i].Position + vector(0, 0, -8), 6, false)
	end

	character_util.show_emoticon_async(ishya, nil, 'silence')

	character_util.set_direction(ishya, 'left')
	character_util.set_anim(ishya, {name = 'eat'})
	self.ishya_eat = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true, play_pos = ishya.Position })

	for i = 1, #princes do
		character_util.set_position(princes[i], vector(99, 0, 99))
	end

	for i = 1, #reporters do
		character_util.set_position(reporters[i], vector(99, 0, 99))
	end

	CS.Oak.UIQuestMarkersController.Instance:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('nightmare_steampunk_main', self.quest_spec.QuestId,
			self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, ishya)

	character_util.add_listener(ishya, self.controller.cs_controller)

	reporter_sfx:FadeOut(2)
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_steampunk_main', state = 'field', mix = 2 })

	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)
end

function local_class:truth()
	CS.Oak.UIQuestMarkersController.Instance:RemoveQuestMarker('nightmare_steampunk_main')

	local ishya = self.get_ishya()
	local leader = user_party_leader

	character_util.remove_relate_event(ishya, self.controller.cs_controller)

	party_util.align_to_target(ishya, 'right', 1, 'arc')

	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({ { 'nightmare_steampunk_main_s2_31_2', 'mercy' },
														  { 'nightmare_steampunk_main_s2_31_2_1', 'intellect' } })
	--정말 캔터베리인의 짓일까?
	--할아버지의 이름을 걸고.. 범인은 이 안에 있어!
	if choose_result == 1 then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(leader, {name = 'question', loop = false},
				{name = 'tired'})
	else
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(leader, {name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01'},
				{name = 'attack'})
	end

	wait_for_sec(1)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

	self.ishya_eat:Stop()
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.remove_anim(ishya)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	character_util.set_direction(ishya, 'right')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(ishya, {key = 'nightmare_steampunk_main_s2_31_3', skip = true,
														portraitname = self.ishya_portrait_name})
	--아무리 생각해도 이상하다.

	character_util.set_anim(ishya, {name = 'question', loop = false})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(ishya, {key = 'nightmare_steampunk_main_s2_32', skip = true,
														portraitname = self.ishya_portrait_name})

function local_class:crystal_shake()
	local timer = 0.3

	local manager_crystal = get_field_object('manager_crystal')

	self.crystal_shaking = true

	while self.crystal_shaking do
		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if timer >= self.duration then
			timer = 0

			manager_crystal:Shake(0.04, 0.3)
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:flash_light()
	for count = 1, 3 do

		for _ = 1, times_rand do
			if count == 1 then

			end
			screen_util.fade_in_async(0.1, unity_class.color.white, 'linear')
			wait_for_sec(0.1)
		end

		wait_for_sec(1)
	end
end

return local_class

local local_class = newclass('NightmareSteampunkMainSection3')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = NightmareSteampunkMain @
		Comment = 전 소장 암살 사건의 범인을 찾기 위해 탐문수사. @
		Index = 2 @
		NextSections = 3 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	self.get_ishya = controller.get_ishya
	self.ishya_portrait_name = 'steam_princess.png'

	self.stage_name = 'nightmare_steampunk_2'
	self.previous_stage = 'nightmare_steampunk_1'

	self.section_progress = {
		-- 초기값
		none = 0,
		-- 거지들에게 탐문 수사 시작
		beggar = 1
	}

	self.current_progress = self.section_progress.none
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return true
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')

	self:set_environment()

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		self.controller:set_default_quest_marker()

		if stage.Name == self.previous_stage then
			message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent), 'on_camera_grid_enter_event')
		end
	else
		CS.Oak.UIQuestMarkersController.Instance:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('nightmare_steampunk_main', self.quest_spec.QuestId,
				self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, get_field_object('entrance_1'))
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	CS.Oak.UIQuestMarkersController.Instance:RemoveQuestMarker('nightmare_steampunk_main')

	for i = 1, 4 do
		CS.Oak.UIQuestMarkersController.Instance:RemoveQuestMarker('nightmare_steampunk_main_' .. i)
	end

	if stage.Name == self.previous_stage then
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent))
	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

	local oneline = {'nightmare_steampunk_main_s3_11', 'nightmare_steampunk_main_s3_16',
					 'nightmare_steampunk_main_s3_18', 'nightmare_steampunk_main_s3_20'}
	for i = 1, 4 do
		local beggar = get_character('beggar_' .. i)
		if beggar ~= nil then
			beggar.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)
			beggar.Interactable.Talk = oneline[i]
		end
	end
end

--region on event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	for i = 1, 4 do
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_character('beggar_' .. i)) then
			CS.Oak.UIQuestMarkersController.Instance:RemoveQuestMarker('nightmare_steampunk_main_' .. i)
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.beggar, self, i)
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, 'square_cam') then
		self:change_quest_marker('clear_exit')
	elseif type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, 'residence_cam') then
		self:change_quest_marker('residence_exit')
	end
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter == false then return false end
	if e.FieldObject ~= user_party_leader then return false end
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == 'section_3_beggar' and self.current_progress == self.section_progress.none then
		self.current_progress = self.section_progress.beggar
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.intro, self)
	elseif zone_name == 'section_3_beggar_out' and self.current_progress == self.section_progress.beggar then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.go_back, self)
	else
		if self.current_progress == self.section_progress.none then
			local targets = {get_field_object('entrance_1'), get_field_object('exit_1'),
							 get_field_object('exit_1'), get_field_object('camp_fire_center')}
			for i = 1, 4 do
				if zone_name == 'section_3_marker_' .. i then
					CS.Oak.UIQuestMarkersController.Instance:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('nightmare_steampunk_main', self.quest_spec.QuestId,
							self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, targets[i])
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end
--endregion

function local_class:change_quest_marker(fo_name)
	quest_marker_util.remove('nightmare_steampunk_main')
	local fo = get_field_object(fo_name)
	quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'nightmare_steampunk_main', fo, true)
end

function local_class:set_environment()
	local anim = {'seat', 'seat', 'prostrate', 'seat'}
	local emo = {'damaged', 'doyagao', 'damaged', 'tired'}

	for i = 1, 4 do
		local beggar = get_character('beggar_' .. i)
		character_util.set_with_marker(beggar, field:GetMarker('s3_' .. beggar.Name))
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(beggar, {name = anim[i]}, {name = emo[i]})

		if i == 1 or i == 2 then
			beggar.SpineController:AddColor('darken', unity_color({ 0, 0, 0, 0.2 }), 0.8, 0)
		elseif i == 4 then
			stage.FieldUIManager:RemoveUI(beggar, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
		end

		beggar.Interactable:AddListener(self.controller.cs_controller)
	end

	local daughter = get_character('beggar_daughter')
	character_util.set_with_marker(daughter, field:GetMarker('s3_' .. daughter.Name))
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(daughter, {name = 'seat'}, {name = 'cry'})

local local_class = newclass('NightmareSteampunkMainSection4')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = NightmareSteampunkMain @
		Comment = 단서를 쫓아 레스토랑에 입장, 습격당하는 주인공 일행 @
		Index = 3 @
		NextSections = 4 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	self.get_ishya = controller.get_ishya
	self.ishya_portrait_name = 'steam_princess.png'

	self.stage_name = 'nightmare_steampunk_3'

	self.section_progress = {
		-- 초기값
		none = 0,
		-- 레스토랑에서 갱들이 습격함
		gang_attack = 1,
		-- 이번엔 로봇이 습격함
		robot_attack = 2,
		-- 전화를 받음
		phone = 3
	}

	self.current_progress = self.section_progress.none

	self.swipe_type = ''
	self.qte_success = false
	self.cur_swipe_index = 0
	self.aim = nil

	self.do_phone_ringing = true

	self.origin_party = nil

	self.exit_interactable = nil

	self.crowd_buzz_sfx = nil
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return true
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_battle_group_eliminated_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DyingEndEvent), 'on_dying_end_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_GunShot_Groundhit')
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit')
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_lasthit')

	screen_util.preload_boss_title()
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.PreloadTutorialSpine()

	self:set_environment()

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		self.controller:set_default_quest_marker()
	else
		CS.Oak.UIQuestMarkersController.Instance:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('nightmare_steampunk_main', self.quest_spec.QuestId,
				self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, get_field_object('restaurant_entrance'))
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	CS.Oak.UIQuestMarkersController.Instance:RemoveQuestMarker('nightmare_steampunk_main')

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DyingEndEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
end

--region on event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter == false then return false end
	if e.FieldObject ~= user_party_leader then return false end
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == 'section_4_restaurant' and self.current_progress == self.section_progress.none then
		self.current_progress = self.section_progress.gang_attack
		self.crowd_buzz_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_crowd_buzz_02', loop = true, fade_in_time = 2, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'default' })
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.party_wait, self))
	elseif zone_name == 'section_4_robot' and self.current_progress == self.section_progress.gang_attack then
		self.current_progress = self.section_progress.robot_attack
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.robot, self)
	else
		local targets = {get_field_object('restaurant_entrance'), get_character('s4_waiter')}
		for i = 1, 2 do
			if zone_name == 'section_4_marker_' .. i then
				CS.Oak.UIQuestMarkersController.Instance:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('nightmare_steampunk_main', self.quest_spec.QuestId,
						self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, targets[i])
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	if e.BattleGroupName == 'gang' then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.mad_waiter, self))
	elseif e.BattleGroupName == 'boss' then
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({state = 'muted', mix = 2.3 })
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_dying_end_event(e)
	local boss = get_character('boss')
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.character, boss) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.ringing, self)
	end
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_field_object('phone')) and self.current_progress == self.section_progress.robot_attack then
		self.current_progress = self.section_progress.phone
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.calling, self)
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_field_object('restaurant_counter')) or
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_character('s4_waiter'))then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.welcome, self)
	end
end

function local_class:on_touch_event(e)
	if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeLeft then
		self.swipe_type = 'left'
		return true
	elseif e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeRight then
		self.swipe_type = 'right'
		return true
	elseif e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeUp then
		self.swipe_type = 'up'
		return true
	elseif e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeDown then
		self.swipe_type = 'down'
		return true
	elseif e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.TouchDown then
		self.swipe_type = 'touch_down'
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:rotate_table(angle, duration)
	local table = get_field_object('restaurant_table')
	local cur_rotation = table.transform.localRotation.eulerAngles

	local time_passed = 0
	while time_passed < duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local progress = time_passed / duration
		local target_angle = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(cur_rotation, angle, progress)
		table.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(target_angle)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	table.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(0.8, 0, 0.8), vector(2, 1, 1))
end

-- QTE 함수
function local_class:qte_swipe(type, qte_duration, rebound_duration, aim, rebound, idx)

	local waiter = get_character('s4_waiter')

	character_util.set_anim(waiter, { name = 'rifle_shoot', scale = 0, loop = false})

	---- 슬로우모션 중인지 여부
	--local slow = true
	--time_util.mod('gun', 0.2)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_tap_guide_01')
	if type == 'touch_down' then
		CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowTurboTap(1)
	else
		CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.QTESwipe(type)
	end

	self.swipe_type = ''
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_touch_event')

	local result = false
	local qte_time_passed = 0

	-- 이펙트생성 주기
	local effect_term = 0.1

	-- 총이 이동하는 시간
	local effect_time_passed = 0

	character_util.set_anim(waiter, { name = 'rifle_shoot2'})

	camera_util.shake(0.1, qte_duration, false)

	local hit_sound = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_hit_loop_01', loop = true})
	while qte_time_passed < qte_duration do
		if self.swipe_type == type then
			result = true
			CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.CloseTutorialSpine()

			--slow = false
			--time_util.unmod('gun')
		end

		qte_time_passed = qte_time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if effect_time_passed + effect_term <= qte_time_passed then
			local progress = qte_time_passed / qte_duration
			local aim = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(self.aim, self.aim + aim, progress)

			local rad = math.pi * CS.UnityEngine.Random.value * 2
			local target_x = math.cos(rad) * CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(0.4, 0.8)
			local target_z = math.sin(rad) * CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(0.4, 0.8)
			unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_GunShot_Groundhit'):Instantiate(aim + vector(target_x, 0, target_z))
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	hit_sound:FadeOut(1.5)
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.CloseTutorialSpine()

	self.aim = self.aim + aim

	--실패 연출
	if result == false then

		--if slow == true then
		--	slow = false
		--	time_util.unmod('gun')
		--end

		self:fail_qte()
	else
		--성공 연출
		if idx == 1 then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.restaurant_back_step, self))
		elseif idx == 2 then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.restaurant_run, self))
		elseif idx == 3 then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.restaurant_jump, self))
		elseif idx == 4 then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.restaurant_kick_table, self))
		end
	end

	qte_time_passed = 0
	effect_time_passed = 0

	camera_util.shake(0.1, rebound_duration, false)

	while qte_time_passed < rebound_duration do
		qte_time_passed = qte_time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if effect_time_passed + effect_term <= qte_time_passed then
			local progress = qte_time_passed / rebound_duration
			local aim = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(self.aim, self.aim + rebound, progress)

			local rad = math.pi * CS.UnityEngine.Random.value * 2
			local target_x = math.cos(rad) * CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(0.4, 0.8)
			local target_z = math.sin(rad) * CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(0.4, 0.8)

			unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_GunShot_Groundhit'):Instantiate(aim + vector(target_x, 0, target_z))
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self.aim = self.aim + rebound

	self.qte_success = result
end

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)

	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	self.get_ishya = controller.get_ishya
	self.ishya_portrait_name = 'steam_princess.png'

	self.stage_name = 'nightmare_steampunk_5'

		none = 0,
		-- 문지기에게 안내받음
		gate_keeper = 1,
		-- 간부와 상담
		member = 2
	}

	self.current_progress = self.section_progress.none
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return true
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')

	self:set_environment()

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		self.controller:set_default_quest_marker()
	else
		CS.Oak.UIQuestMarkersController.Instance:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('nightmare_steampunk_main', self.quest_spec.QuestId,
				self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, get_field_object('cafe_entrance'))
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	CS.Oak.UIQuestMarkersController.Instance:RemoveQuestMarker('nightmare_steampunk_main')

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	local ishya = self.get_ishya()
	if ishya ~= nil then
		character_util.remove_relate_event(ishya, self.controller.cs_controller)
	end

	local gang = get_character('member')
	if gang ~= nil then
		character_util.remove_relate_event(gang, self.controller.cs_controller)
	end

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

--region on event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter == false then return false end
	if e.FieldObject ~= user_party_leader then return false end
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == 'section_5_start' and self.current_progress == self.section_progress.none then
		self.current_progress = self.section_progress.gate_keeper
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.gate_open, self)
	else
		local marker_targets = {get_field_object('cafe_entrance'), get_field_object('secret_room_entrance'),
								get_field_object('secret_room_entrance'), get_character('member'),
								self.get_ishya()}
		for i = 1, 4 do
			if zone_name == 'section_5_marker_' .. i then
				CS.Oak.UIQuestMarkersController.Instance:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('nightmare_steampunk_main', self.quest_spec.QuestId,
						self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, marker_targets[i])

				if i == 4 and self.current_progress == self.section_progress.member then
					CS.Oak.UIQuestMarkersController.Instance:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('nightmare_steampunk_main', self.quest_spec.QuestId,
							self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, marker_targets[5])
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_character('member')) and self.current_progress == self.section_progress.gate_keeper then
		self.current_progress = self.section_progress.member
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.negotiate, self)
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_ishya())then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.discuss, self)
	end

	return false
end

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(ishya, {key = 'nightmare_steampunk_main_s5_11', skip = true,
														portraitname = self.ishya_portrait_name})
	--그쪽 부하들은 실망스럽더군. 적을 치면서 준비도 제대로 하지 않다니.

	wait_for_sec(1)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(ishya, true)

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(ishya, {key = 'nightmare_steampunk_main_s5_12', skip = true,
														portraitname = self.ishya_portrait_name})
	--말장난은 이쯤 하고, 단도직입적으로 묻지.

	character_util.set_emotion(ishya, {name = 'attack'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(ishya, {key = 'nightmare_steampunk_main_s5_13', skip = true,
														portraitname = self.ishya_portrait_name})
	--붉은 두건의 암살자, 너희 사람인가?

	camera_util.move_async(redhood.Position, 0.5)

	wait_for_sec(2)

	camera_util.move_async(field:GetMarker('s5_center').position + vector(0, 0, 1), 0.5)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(ishya, {name = 'sleep_deep'})
	character_util.set_anim(ishya, {name = 'unique/seat_idle', upper = true})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(ishya, {key = 'nightmare_steampunk_main_s5_13_1', skip = true,
														portraitname = self.ishya_portrait_name})
	--물어볼 필요도 없는 질문이었군.
	character_util.remove_anim(ishya, true)
	character_util.remove_emotion(ishya)

	character_util.set_emotion(gang, {name = 'smile'})
	character_util.set_anim(gang, {name = 'unique/seat_idle', upper = true})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(gang, {key = 'nightmare_steampunk_main_s5_14', skip = true})
	--이제 와서 굳이 숨길 것도 없잖아?
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(gang, true)


	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(ishya, {key = 'nightmare_steampunk_main_s5_15', skip = true,
														portraitname = self.ishya_portrait_name})
	--나는 진범을 원하고, 너희는 돈을 원하지.

	character_util.set_anim(ishya, {name = 'cross_arm', upper = true})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(ishya, {key = 'nightmare_steampunk_main_s5_16', skip = true,
														portraitname = self.ishya_portrait_name})
	--비즈니스하기 딱 좋은 상황 아닌가?

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.set_anim(gang, {name = 'unique/seat_question', loop = false, upper = true})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(gang, {key = 'nightmare_steampunk_main_s5_17', skip = true})
	--흠…

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(gang, {key = 'nightmare_steampunk_main_s5_18', skip = true})
	--황실하고 너무 많이 엮이는 건 별로인데…
	character_util.remove_anim(gang, true)

	character_util.remove_anim(ishya, true)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(ishya, {key = 'nightmare_steampunk_main_s5_19', skip = true,
														portraitname = self.ishya_portrait_name})
	--'너무 많이?' 이미 엮여있나보군.

	character_util.remove_anim(gang, true)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(gang, {key = 'nightmare_steampunk_main_s5_20', skip = true})
	--아까 말했듯이.

	character_util.set_animation_n_times(gang, {name = 'nod', count = 2, upper = true})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(gang, {key = 'nightmare_steampunk_main_s5_20_1', skip = true})
	--이미 답을 알고 있는 상대에게 숨기는 것은 시간 낭비지.

	character_util.set_anim(ishya, {name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01', upper = true})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(ishya, {key = 'nightmare_steampunk_main_s5_21', skip = true,
														portraitname = self.ishya_portrait_name})
	--100만 골드.
	character_util.remove_anim(ishya, true)

	character_util.set_animation_n_times(ishya, {name = 'nod', count = 2, upper = true})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(ishya, {key = 'nightmare_steampunk_main_s5_22', skip = true,
														portraitname = self.ishya_portrait_name})
	--진범이 나서서 살인을 사주한 사람이 누군지만 밝혀주면 된다.

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.set_anim(gang, {name = 'unique/seat_question', loop = false, upper = true})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(gang, {key = 'nightmare_steampunk_main_s5_23', skip = true})
	--황녀님. 지금 메이드 된 멤버를 팔아넘기란 뜻이야?
	character_util.remove_anim(gang, true)

	character_util.set_anim(ishya, {name = 'unique/seat_idle', loop = false, upper = true})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(ishya, {key = 'nightmare_steampunk_main_s5_23_1', skip = true,
														portraitname = self.ishya_portrait_name})
	--범죄자에게도 동료애라는 것이 있나?
	character_util.remove_anim(ishya, true)

	character_util.set_emotion(gang, {name = 'doyagao'})
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(gang, {name = 'nod', count = 2, upper = true})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(gang, {key = 'nightmare_steampunk_main_s5_23_2', skip = true})
	--있고말고. 서로 죽고 죽이려는 당신 황실 남매들 보다는 말이지.
	character_util.remove_emotion(gang)

	character_util.set_emotion(ishya, {name = 'sleep_deep'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(ishya, {key = 'nightmare_steampunk_main_s5_23_3', skip = true,
														portraitname = self.ishya_portrait_name})
	--…….

	character_util.remove_emotion(ishya)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(ishya, {key = 'nightmare_steampunk_main_s5_23_4', skip = true,
														portraitname = self.ishya_portrait_name})
	--150만.

	character_util.set_emotion(gang, {name = 'smile'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(gang, {key = 'nightmare_steampunk_main_s5_24', skip = true})
	--킥…
	character_util.remove_emotion(gang)

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(gang, {key = 'nightmare_steampunk_main_s5_24_1', skip = true})
	--소문대로 얼음장 같은 분이군.

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
	character_util.set_anim(gang, {name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01', upper = true})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(gang, {key = 'nightmare_steampunk_main_s5_24_2', skip = true})
	--180만 골드.
	character_util.remove_anim(gang, true)

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(gang, {key = 'nightmare_steampunk_main_s5_24_3', skip = true})
	--그걸로 손을 써주겠어.

	character_util.show_emoticon_async(ishya, nil, 'silence')
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(ishya, {name = 'nod', count = 2, upper = true})
	wait_for_sec(1)

	character_util.remove_anim(gang)
	character_util.jump_move(gang, gang.Position + vector(-1, -0.5, 0.1), 2, 1)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_land_01')

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(gang, {key = 'nightmare_steampunk_main_s5_25', skip = true})
	--좋은 비즈니스를 하게 되어 영광이야, 황녀님.

	character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(gang, {name = 'nod', scale = 0.3, count = 1})
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_evil_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(gang, {key = 'nightmare_steampunk_main_s5_25_1', skip = true})
	--돈만 준비해둬. 쇼는 이쪽에서 준비할 테니.

	character_util.move_waypoint(gang, {gang.Position + vector(-1.5, 0, 0),
											gang.Position + vector(-1.5, 0, -10)}, 2, false)

	wait_for_sec(1)

	character_util.remove_anim(ishya)
	character_util.jump_move(ishya, ishya.Position + vector(1, -0.5, 0.5),
			3, 1, true, 'down')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_land_01')

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	character_util.stop(gang)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(ishya, {key = 'nightmare_steampunk_main_s5_26', skip = true,
														portraitname = self.ishya_portrait_name})
	--저수지의 뱀.

	character_util.show_emoticon_async(gang, nil, 'notice')

	character_util.set_direction(gang, 'up')

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(ishya, {key = 'nightmare_steampunk_main_s5_26_1', skip = true,
														portraitname = self.ishya_portrait_name})
	--언제까지고 어둠 속에서 활개칠 수 있을 거라 생각하지 않는 게 좋아.

	character_util.set_direction(gang, 'down')
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(gang, nil, 'silence')
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(gang, {name = 'nod', count = 1})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(gang, {key = 'nightmare_steampunk_main_s5_26_2', skip = true})
	--고객님의 소중한 의견. 진중하게 받아들이도록 하겠어.
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(gang)

	character_util.move_waypoint(gang, { gang.Position + vector(0, 0, -10) }, 4, false)

	wait_for_sec(2)

	music_player_util.play_stage_music( { state = 'field', mix = 2 })
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	character_util.set_with_marker(ishya, field:GetMarker('s5_ishya'))

	character_util.set_anim(ishya, {name = 'seat'})

	character_util.set_position(gangs[8], gangs[8].Position + vector(2, 0, 1))
	character_util.set_position(gangs[7], gangs[7].Position + vector(2, 0, 0))
	--
	--wait_for_sec(4)

	for i = 1, #gangs do
		if i ~= 7 and i ~= 8 then
			character_util.set_position(gangs[i], vector(999, 0, 999))
		end
	end

	character_util.set_position(redhood, vector(999, 0, 999))

	character_util.set_position(gang, vector(999, 0, 999))

	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(ishya, {name = 'unique/seat_question', loop = false, upper = true}, {name = 'sleep_deep'})

	wait_for_sec(1)

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	character_util.remove_anim(user_party_leader)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_01')
	character_util.jump_move(user_party_leader, user_party_leader.Position + vector(1, -0.5, 0.1), 2, 1)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_land_01')

	CS.Oak.UIQuestMarkersController.Instance:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('nightmare_steampunk_main', self.quest_spec.QuestId,
			self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, ishya)

	character_util.add_listener(ishya, self.controller.cs_controller)

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)
end

function local_class:discuss()
	local ishya = self.get_ishya()
	character_util.remove_relate_event(ishya, self.controller.cs_controller)
	party_util.align_to_target(ishya.Position:GetX0z(), 'right', 1 ,'arc')

	character_util.remove_emotion(ishya)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(ishya, {key = 'nightmare_steampunk_main_s5_27', skip = true,
														portraitname = self.ishya_portrait_name})
	--…….

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(ishya, {key = 'nightmare_steampunk_main_s5_31', skip = true,
														portraitname = self.ishya_portrait_name})
	--수용소로 돌아가지, 부소장.

	character_util.set_animation_n_times(ishya, {name = 'nod', count = 2, upper = true})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(ishya, {key = 'nightmare_steampunk_main_s5_32', skip = true,
														portraitname = self.ishya_portrait_name})
	--이제 엔드게임이야.

	character_util.remove_anim(ishya)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_01')
	character_util.jump_move(ishya, ishya.Position + vector(1, -0.5, 0.5), 2, 1)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_land_01')

	local gangs = {get_character('s5_gang_7'), get_character('s5_gang_8')}
	for i = 1, #gangs do
		character_util.move_waypoint(gangs[i], {gangs[i].Position + vector(-1, 0, 0),
												gangs[i].Position + vector(-1, 0, i == 1 and 1 or -1)},
				4, false, nil, nil, 'left')
	end
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_costume_equip_01')

	character_util.convert_to_party_member(ishya, user_party, true)

	CS.Oak.UIQuestMarkersController.Instance:RemoveQuestMarker('nightmare_steampunk_main')

	ishya:HideWeapon(false)
	user_party_leader:HideWeapon(false)

	yield_return_func(quest_util.progress_section, self.controller)
end


return local_class
